article_content: The first thing you notice is the smell—rich, deep, and intriguing—somehow both fresh and musty at once. It's a scent that immediately sparks curiosity. CNN's On the Road Japan team visited Japan's oldest whisky distillery just outside Kyoto to learn more about a spirit recently named the world's best. Only weeks ago, the Yamazaki Single Malt Sherry Cask 2013, crafted by beverage giant Suntory, received top honors in Jim Murray's 'Whisky Bible.' The renowned whisky critic called it 'near indescribable genius.' Notably, Scotch failed to make the top three. Japanese whisky has been winning awards for over a decade, but this victory marks a milestone. Standing among the cellar's towering stacks of oak casks—American, Spanish, and Japanese oak alike—you sense that Japanese whisky's global rise is just beginning. Suntory's Chief Blender, Shinji Fukuyo, oversees each bottle produced at the 90-year-old distillery. Despite his Scottish training, he insists this is Japanese whisky—not Scotch. Modest about the win, Fukuyo takes clear pride in Japanese whisky's achievements. He says the secret is not in boldness, but in balance. Fukuyo credits factors like pure water, which he says gives the spirit its gentleness, as well as the maturation process within casks exposed to Japan's variable climate—hot, humid summers and cold, dry winters. Blending is also key: with only two malt and one grain distillery, Japanese producers must create diverse whisky styles within a single facility. This presents a challenge distinct from Scotland, where over 100 distilleries contribute to blends. Maintaining quality is a careful science. Fukuyo reveals that formulas for top labels might change up to two dozen times a year because no two casks are exactly alike. Altering just one ingredient can upset the critical balance. Some products feature 15 or 20 types of whisky, and even single malts often contain whisky from about ten casks—though all must come from the same distillery to earn the 'single malt' name. When it comes to tasting, there's a surprise for enthusiasts who prefer neat pours: in Japan, adding water is customary to unlock aromas and fuller flavors. Most Japanese enjoy whisky with meals—on the rocks, or as a highball with soda—so the spirit must maintain character even as the proof lowers. Fukuyo himself takes it straight but always with a drop or two of water. As for the world's best whisky? According to Fukuyo, you can't buy it in Japan. Only 3,000 bottles were produced and all were exported. Despite global acclaim, whisky culture in Japan remains low-key. Most whisky bars are small, seating just a handful, with a solitary bartender behind the counter. Takayuki Suzuki, a cocktail specialist at Park Hotel Tokyo affectionately known as 'Mr. Ice Man,' demonstrates the Japanese dedication to craft. He effortlessly shapes a large block of ice into a perfect sphere, drops it into a glass, pours in single malt, and gently lifts the ice to release the aroma. Suzuki explains that Japanese whisky offers a unique balance, maintaining flavor even when mixed. It serves well as a cocktail base but, when asked about using whisky in an Old Fashioned, Suzuki hesitates. While he is too polite to object, he suggests that mixing anything other than ice, water, or soda would diminish the whisky's purity and balance. Nevertheless, he will prepare the cocktail if requested. Lesson learned, the reporters opt for another Yamazaki 12 on the rock. The experience ends with a toast to relaxation and enjoyment. Reporting by CNN's Paula Newton and Yoko Wakatsuki.
translated_content: Jambo la kwanza linalokuvutia ni harufu—nzito, yenye kina na kuvutia—ikiwa safi na yenye ukakasi kwa wakati mmoja. Harufu hii inachochea kutaka kujua zaidi. Timu ya CNN On the Road Japan ilizuru kiwanda kongwe zaidi cha whisky nchini Japani ambacho kipo karibu na Kyoto ili kujifunza zaidi kuhusu kinywaji hiki kilichotunukiwa cheo cha bora duniani. Wiki chache zilizopita, Yamazaki Single Malt Sherry Cask 2013 inayozalishwa na kampuni kubwa ya vinywaji, Suntory, ilitwaa tuzo kuu kwenye ‘Whisky Bible’ ya Jim Murray. Mkosoaji mashuhuri wa whisky aliiita ‘ubunifu usiosimulikika.’ Scotch haikuingia hata kwenye tatu bora. Whisky ya Kijapani imekuwa ikishinda tuzo kwa zaidi ya miaka kumi, lakini ushindi huu ni hatua kubwa sana. Ukiwa kwenye pishi lililojaa mapipa makubwa ya mialoni—kutoka Marekani, Uhispania na Japani—unahisi kuwa umaarufu wa whisky ya Kijapani duniani bado unaanza. Blandaji mkuu wa Suntory, Shinji Fukuyo, anasimamia kila chupa inayozalishwa kwenye kiwanda hicho chenye umri wa miaka 90. Ingawa alipata mafunzo Scotland, anasisitiza hii ni whisky ya Kijapani, si Scotch. Hata kama ni mnyenyekevu kuhusu ushindi huu, Fukuyo ana fahari kubwa juu ya mafanikio ya whisky ya Japani. Anasema siri iko kwenye usawa badala ya ujasiri. Fukuyo anasema mambo kama ubora wa maji safi ndio unaofanya whisky iwe na upole, pamoja na mchakato wa kukomaa katika mapipa yaliyo kwenye mazingira ya misimu mibadala ya Japani—kiangazi chenye joto na unyevunyevu na baridi kali nyakati za msimu wa baridi. Kuchanganya ladha ni muhimu pia: kwa kuwa kuna viwanda viwili tu vya malt na kimoja cha nafaka, wazalishaji wa Japani lazima watengeneze aina mbalimbali za whisky ndani ya kiwanda hicho hicho. Hii inafanya iwe tofauti na Scotland ambayo ina viwanda zaidi ya 100 vinavyohuisha aina za whisky katika mchanganyiko. Kudumisha ubora ni kazi ya kisayansi. Fukuyo anaeleza kuwa mchanganyiko wa lebo bora unaweza kubadilika hadi mara ishirini na nne kwa mwaka kwa sababu hakuna pipa mbili zinazofanana kabisa. Badilisha kiungo kimoja tu na usawa wa ladha unapotea. Baadhi ya bidhaa zina aina 15 au 20 za whisky, na hata single malt ina whisky kutoka mapipa takribani kumi—lakini lazima yote yatoke kiwandani pamoja ili kuitwa ‘single malt.’ Kuhusu kuonja, kuna mshangao kwa wapenzi wa kunywa whisky bila kuongeza kitu: nchini Japani, kuongeza maji kunashauriwa ili kufungua harufu na ladha zote. Wajapani wengi hufurahia whisky na chakula—ikiwa na barafu, au kama highball na soda—hivyo kinywaji lazima kibaki na ladha hata kiwango cha pombe kinaposhuka. Fukuyo mwenyewe hunywa whisky kwa mtindo huu, lakini daima huongeza matone machache ya maji. Kuhusu hiyo whisky bora duniani? Kwa mujibu wa Fukuyo, huwezi kuinunua Japani. Chupa 3,000 tu ndizo zilizotengenezwa na zote ziliuzwa nje ya nchi. Licha ya sifa za kimataifa, tamaduni ya whisky nchini Japani inabaki kuwa ya kawaida na isiyo na makuu. Baa nyingi za whisky ni ndogo, zina viti vichache sana na mhudumu mmoja tu. Takayuki Suzuki, mtaalamu wa mchanganyiko wa vinywaji katika Park Hotel Tokyo na anayejulikana kama 'Mr. Ice Man', anaonesha umakini na ujuzi wa WaJapani kutengeneza whisky. Kwa ustadi, anaunda duara kamili la barafu, anaweka kwenye glasi, anamimina whisky na kuinua barafu taratibu ili kutoa harufu nzuri. Suzuki anasema whisky ya Kijapani ina usawa wa kipekee, haipotezi ladha hata ikiwa imechanganywa. Inaweza kutumika kama msingi mzuri wa vinywaji vingine, lakini alipoulizwa kuhusu kuitumia kwenye kinywaji cha Old Fashioned, Suzuki alisita. Ingawa ni mkarimu, anaamini kuchanganya whisky na kitu kingine zaidi ya barafu, maji au soda kutapunguza usafi na ladha yake. Hata hivyo, atasogeza ikiwa mteja atasisitiza. Waandishi wakaamua kunywa tena Yamazaki 12 juu ya barafu. Ni wakati wa kupumzika na kufurahia. Imetolewa na Paula Newton na Yoko Wakatsuki wa CNN.

article_content:
Boston is in mourning after a bomb attack claimed the life of an 8-year-old child, maimed adults, and turned a joyful athletic celebration into a tragedy. This act of terror has caused profound grief. Yet, if the attackers hoped to intimidate Boston, they chose the wrong city. As President Barack Obama said, Boston is a "tough and resilient town." It will recover, care for those affected, remember those lost, and seek justice for the perpetrators.

Boston is renowned for its intellectual and cultural vibrancy, home to institutions like Harvard and MIT, and offers world-class medical care, arts, and innovation. Its reputation attracts both young and old, distinguishing it from other aging cities. However, this cultural richness is matched by a spirit of toughness, evident in its sports teams and historical legacy.

The city’s resilience is deeply rooted in its history—from early settlers who built the first communities, to leaders who fought for independence, abolition, women's rights, and LGBTQ+ rights. Harvard, with numerous Nobel laureates and the most Medal of Honor recipients outside the military academies, exemplifies these values. The annual Marathon, held on Patriots’ Day, commemorates the city’s pioneering spirit.

Boston has faced multiple tragedies, including the assassinations of John F. Kennedy and Robert Kennedy, the deaths of John Kennedy, Jr. and Ted Kennedy, and the loss of many residents in wars. On 9/11, two hijacked planes took off from Boston. During the late 1980s and early 1990s, gang violence surged, but a comprehensive, community response led to an 80% reduction in youth homicides over five years.

Even when confronted by acts of terror, Boston’s true story is one of perseverance. The city consistently recovers and unites, demonstrating that adversity brings out courage and leadership. As in the past, Boston will confront darkness with strength and compassion. (This commentary reflects the views of David Gergen.)

article_content: Can a machine detect your emotions just by analyzing your face or emails? Startups developing emotion artificial intelligence (EAI) claim their technology can interpret subtle facial movements and even text cues to determine how people feel, making emotions quantifiable data. EAI developers say their systems can distinguish between happiness, confusion, anger, and more—even sometimes better than people themselves. This holds great appeal for companies aiming to understand their customers and sell products more effectively, adjusting app content in real time based on users' emotional responses. Some businesses already use EAI in areas like smart toys, robotics, vehicles, and empathetic chatbots. EAI is also being introduced in workplaces, where it can analyze employees' emotions to improve productivity. However, the effectiveness of this technology is highly disputed by experts, who question whether emotions can truly be read from facial expressions. Despite unresolved scientific debates, EAI is used in employee monitoring and hiring. Emotion AI systems analyze physiological signals—breathing, heart rate, perspiration, body posture—as well as textual and vocal data to infer emotional states. Applications range from detecting insurance fraud and diagnosing depression to tracking student engagement online. Smart Eye, led by Chief Marketing Officer Gabi Zijderveld, uses EAI to analyze millions of videos for research and commercial purposes, such as driver monitoring and ad testing. Participants in their studies volunteer to have their facial expressions recorded and paired with demographic information to tailor content for different audiences. In recruitment, platforms like HireVue and Retorio have used EAI to assess candidates' soft skills and emotional intelligence. HireVue, after criticism and a complaint from the Electronic Privacy Information Center about potential biases and lack of proven effectiveness, stopped using facial EAI in 2021 but continues with voice and behavior analysis. Retorio combines facial analysis, body-pose, and voice recognition with an opt-out option for candidates. Experts, including AI Now Institute's Sarah Myers West, remain skeptical of claims that EAI is free from bias, noting that use of EAI in recruitment or employment may disadvantage people who opt out or are assessed inaccurately. Emotion analysis is also being expanded in call centers, with EAI advising workers on suitable tone, sometimes creating confusion and stress. Companies like Framery are testing office furniture equipped with biosensors to anonymously assess employee well-being, but critics warn that with biometric data, true anonymity is difficult. Emotion recognition patents, such as Looksery’s, envision employers using EAI data for workforce optimization, including administrative decisions. Researchers say many employees are unaware EAI is being used on them, as emotional surveillance can piggyback on existing workplace monitoring. EAI is largely unregulated in the US, unlike in Europe, where proposals may soon limit its civilian workplace application. Scientifically, emotion recognition from facial expressions is rooted in Paul Ekman's theories, but recent reviews find little supporting evidence, especially across cultures. EAI companies argue their data covers diverse populations, but independent verification is difficult due to proprietary restrictions. Whether EAI accurately measures emotions or not, its use in workplace decision-making raises significant privacy and ethical issues as companies gain deeper access to employees’ internal states. Clem De Pressigny is a freelance writer and former Editorial Director of i-D magazine, covering technology, climate, and culture.

Washiriki wa tafiti zao hutoa ridhaa kuchukuliwa video za uso wao, na taarifa zao za kidemografia hutumika kuboresha maudhui kwa hadhira tofauti. Katika uajiri, majukwaa kama HireVue na Retorio yametumia EAI kutathmini ujuzi wa kihisia na kiakili wa wagombea. HireVue, baada ya kukosolewa na malalamiko kutoka Kituo cha Taarifa za Faragha cha Marekani kuhusu upendeleo na ukosefu wa ushahidi wa ufanisi, ilisitisha matumizi ya EAI ya uso mwaka 2021 lakini inaendelea kuchambua sauti na tabia. Retorio inachanganya uchambuzi wa uso, mkao wa mwili, na sauti, na wagombea wanaweza kukataa kushiriki. Wataalamu kama Sarah Myers West wa AI Now Institute hawaamini EAI haina upendeleo, wakionya kuwa matumizi ya EAI kwenye uajiri au kazi yanaweza kuwaathiri wale wanaokataa au wanaopimwa isivyofaa. Uchambuzi wa hisia unaenea pia kwenye vituo vya simu, ambapo EAI inawashauri wafanyakazi kuhusu sauti bora kutumia, na wakati mwingine inasababisha mkanganyiko na wasiwasi. Makampuni kama Framery yanajaribu samani za ofisini zilizo na vichunguzi vya biosensor kupima hali ya wafanyakazi kwa siri, lakini wachambuzi wanasema ni changamoto kuhakikisha data hiyo ni ya siri kikamilifu pale taarifa za kibayometriki zinapotumika. Hata hataza za kutambua hisia, kama Looksery, zinaonyesha wamiliki wa biashara wanatamani kutumia data za EAI kuboresha utendaji wa wafanyakazi na kufanya maamuzi ya kiutawala. Utafiti unaonesha wafanyakazi wengi hawajui EAI inatumika dhidi yao, kwani uchunguzi wa hisia unaweza kuongezwa kwenye mifumo iliyopo ya ufuatiliaji bila taarifa kwao. EAI haina udhibiti wa wazi Marekani, tofauti na Ulaya ambapo sheria zinapendekezwa kuzuia matumizi yake sehemu za kazi. Kisayansi, kutambua hisia kupitia nyuso kunatokana na nadharia za Paul Ekman, lakini tafiti za karibuni zimekosa ushahidi wa kutosha, hasa katika tamaduni mbali mbali. Makampuni ya EAI yanasisitiza kuwa data zao zinahusisha makundi mbalimbali, lakini uhakiki wa nje ni mgumu kutokana na usiri wa kibiashara. Iwe EAI inapima hisia kwa usahihi au la, matumizi yake kwenye maamuzi ya ajira yanaibua masuala makubwa ya faragha na maadili kwa vile makampuni yanaingia kwa undani zaidi kwenye hisia za wafanyakazi. Clem De Pressigny ni mwandishi huru na aliyekuwa Mhariri Mkuu wa i-D magazine, akiandika kuhusu teknolojia, mazingira, na utamaduni.

article_content: A federal grand jury has indicted two friends of Boston Marathon bombing suspect Dzhokhar Tsarnaev, charging them with obstruction of justice and conspiracy, according to the U.S. attorney's office in Boston. Azamat Tazhayakov and Dias Kadyrbayev, both 19-year-old Kazakh students attending the University of Massachusetts-Dartmouth and roommates of Tsarnaev, are accused of removing items from Tsarnaev's dormitory to conceal them from investigators after the April 15 bombing. Officials allege that on April 18, shortly before the FBI searched Tsarnaev’s dorm, Tazhayakov and Kadyrbayev retrieved a laptop and a backpack from the room. The backpack contained Vaseline, a thumb drive, fireworks, and a homework sheet. According to the indictment, the fireworks had been tampered with, and some explosive powder was visible. Kadyrbayev purportedly remarked that he believed Tsarnaev used the Vaseline in making bombs and showed a text from Tsarnaev granting permission to collect his possessions. Authorities say Kadyrbayev eventually threw the backpack into a dumpster. In response, more than 30 federal agents searched a landfill in New Bedford to recover these items. If convicted, Tazhayakov and Kadyrbayev could each face up to 20 years in prison for obstruction and up to five years for conspiracy, in addition to fines of up to $250,000. Tazhayakov's attorney maintains his client’s innocence, asserting there is no evidence of intent or motive to aid Tsarnaev. Meanwhile, Tsarnaev faces broader charges that include using a weapon of mass destruction, resulting in four deaths and numerous injuries. The investigation and legal proceedings remain the focus of national attention.

Azamat Tazhayakov na Dias Kadyrbayev, vijana wa miaka 19 raia wa Kazakhstan na wanafunzi wa Chuo Kikuu cha Massachusetts-Dartmouth, ni marafiki wa karibu wa Tsarnaev. Wanashtakiwa kwa kuondoa vitu vya Tsarnaev kwenye chumba chake cha bweni ili kuficha ushahidi baada ya shambulio la tarehe 15 Aprili. Maafisa wanasema kwamba Aprili 18, muda mfupi kabla ya FBI kufanya upekuzi kwenye bweni la Tsarnaev, Tazhayakov na Kadyrbayev walichukua kompyuta mpakato na mkoba chumbani. Mkoba ulikuwa na Vaseline, kidole cha kuhifadhi data, fataki, na karatasi ya kazi za nyumbani. Shtaka linasema fataki ziliathiriwa na unga wa mlipuko ulionekana. Kadyrbayev anadaiwa kusema alidhani Tsarnaev alitumia Vaseline kutengeneza mabomu na akaonyesha ujumbe wa simu kutoka kwa Tsarnaev uliotoa ruhusa ya kuchukua vitu vyake. Mamlaka zinasema Kadyrbayev baadaye alitupa mkoba kwenye pipa la taka. Zaidi ya maafisa 30 wa serikali walifanya upekuzi kwenye dampo la New Bedford kutafuta ushahidi. Iwapo watapatikana na hatia, Tazhayakov na Kadyrbayev kila mmoja anaweza kuhukumiwa hadi miaka 20 jela kwa kosa la kuzuia haki na miaka 5 kwa kula njama, na faini ya hadi dola 250,000. Wakili wa Tazhayakov anasisitiza mteja wake hana hatia, akisema hakuna ushahidi wa nia au motisha ya kusaidia Tsarnaev. Wakati huo huo, Tsarnaev anakabiliwa na mashtaka makubwa zaidi yakiwemo matumizi ya silaha ya uharibifu mkubwa na kusababisha vifo vinne na majeraha mengi. Uchunguzi na kesi hizi bado zinaendelea kufuatiliwa kwa karibu na taifa.

article_content: Mark Papermaster, CTO of US chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), stated that AMD’s Indian design centers play a key role in all aspects of global chip development. Speaking at SemiconIndia 2023 in Gandhinagar, he highlighted India's involvement in designing even the most advanced AI chips, which feature over 100 billion transistors. On Tuesday, AMD inaugurated its largest data center worldwide, the Technostar campus, in Bengaluru. Papermaster noted that Indian engineers contribute to each subsystem of AMD’s system-on-a-chip solutions, including the CPU, GPU, and the circuitry connecting these elements. AMD has operated in India for over twenty years. The CTO emphasized that differences between the Indian and Chinese markets largely depend on economic growth. In China, AMD enjoys a strong market in PCs, gaming, and data centers, with capable design teams present. Papermaster explained that rather than focusing on comparisons, AMD’s strategy is to identify and match its portfolio to opportunities in each region experiencing growth. He added that the trend for multinational companies—including AMD—to diversify beyond China is being driven by concerns over manufacturing risks, such as geopolitical disruptions or natural disasters. Diversifying supply chains helps reduce these risks. In summary, AMD is committed to expanding in major economies worldwide by aligning its growth with each market's potential and ensuring supply chain resilience.

Akizungumza kwenye mkutano wa SemiconIndia 2023 uliofanyika Gandhinagar, alieleza jinsi wahandisi wa India wanavyoshiriki kubuni hata chipu za kisasa kabisa za AI zenye zaidi ya transistori bilioni 100. Jumanne, AMD ilizindua kituo chake kikubwa zaidi cha data duniani, Technostar campus, huko Bengaluru. Papermaster alisema wahandisi wa India wanachangia kwenye kila mfumo wa suluhisho la chipu ya kampuni, ikiwa ni pamoja na CPU, GPU, na nyaya zinazounganisha vipengele hivi. Nchini China, AMD ina soko imara kwenye PC, michezo ya kompyuta na vituo vya data, na ina timu bora za wabunifu. Aliongeza kwamba kampuni nyingi duniani—including AMD—zinajitahidi kupanua maeneo yao ya uzalishaji nje ya China kutokana na hatari za uzalishaji kama mizozo ya kisiasa au majanga asilia. Kusambaza minyororo ya ugavi kunasaidia kupunguza hatari hizi. Kwa ujumla, AMD imejizatiti kupanua biashara kwenye uchumi mkubwa duniani kwa kulinganisha ukuaji wa soko na kuhakikisha uimara wa minyororo ya ugavi.

article_content: The South Australian government is considering launching an English-Mandarin bilingual program in schools as early as 2016, aiming to strengthen cultural and economic relationships with China. A special working group is tasked with exploring the program's benefits, potential funding strategies, and suitable curriculum changes. The goal is for the program to span from primary school to Year 12, with the group also responsible for choosing schools willing to adapt their curricula and for working closely with them. Julie Hayes, principal of Cowandilla Primary School in Adelaide, supports the initiative, especially for schools not already teaching another language. She believes that learning a new language helps students understand different cultures and perspectives. However, she mentions that her school already offers Greek, Italian, and Pitjantjatjara, reflecting the community’s history, and therefore does not plan to add Mandarin. Many experts, such as Angela Scarino, Associate Professor of Applied Linguistics at the University of South Australia, say bilingual programs make languages like Mandarin more accessible to students. Scarino highlights that research consistently shows bilingualism boosts learning across subjects, and immersion helps ensure real language proficiency. South Australian Premier Jay Weatherill sees the proposal as a way to deepen links with China. He envisions primary students having Mandarin lessons three to four days per week at first, gradually balancing out with English as they become more fluent. Weatherill notes that around 2,800 hours of focused study are needed for English-speaking students to master Mandarin and that an immersion setting provides this intense exposure. Meanwhile, Education Minister Jennifer Rankine is visiting China to encourage adoption of the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE), hoping to attract more international students to Adelaide. Other states like Victoria, New South Wales, and Queensland have schools already employing bilingual approaches. Mandy Scott from the Association of Learning Mandarin in Australia emphasizes the importance of extended, sustained study, suggesting more schools should offer Mandarin programs up to Year 12. Chad Sexton-Finck, principal of Redcliffe Primary School in Western Australia, echoes support for the South Australian plan. While WA currently has no bilingual schools, Sexton-Finck—whose own children are trilingual—says introducing such programs would be highly beneficial. Overall, increasing Mandarin language education is broadly viewed as vital for academic, cultural, and future workplace opportunities.

Lengo ni mpango huu uanze shule ya msingi hadi Kidato cha 12, hiki kikundi kazi pia kikiwa na jukumu la kuchagua shule zitakazokubali kubadilisha mtaala na kufanya kazi kwa karibu nao. Julie Hayes, mkuu wa shule ya Cowandilla huko Adelaide, anaunga mkono mpango huu, hasa kwa shule ambazo hazifundishi lugha nyingine tayari. Anaamini kujifunza lugha mpya kunawasaidia wanafunzi kuelewa tamaduni na mitazamo tofauti. Hata hivyo, anaeleza kuwa shule yake tayari inafundisha Kiyunani, Kiitaliano, na lugha ya kiasili ya Pitjantjatjara, kutokana na historia ya jamii hiyo, na hivyo hawana mpango wa kuongeza Kichina. Wataalamu wengi kama Angela Scarino, Profesa Mshiriki wa Isimu ya Utendaji Chuo Kikuu cha Australia Kusini, wanasema mipango ya lugha mbili inafanya lugha kama Kichina iwe rahisi kujifunza kwa wanafunzi. Scarino anasisitiza utafiti unaonyesha kujifunza lugha mbili kunaboresha ufanisi wa masomo mbalimbali, na mazingira ya kuzama kwenye lugha husaidia kujua vizuri zaidi. Waziri Mkuu wa Australia Kusini, Jay Weatherill, anachukulia mpango huu kama njia ya kudumisha uhusiano na Uchina. Anaona wanafunzi wa shule ya msingi wakifundishwa Kichina kwa siku tatu hadi nne kwa wiki mwanzoni, huku usawa na Kiingereza ukirekebishwa kadri wanavyozidi kuelewa lugha zote. Weatherill anaeleza kuwa ni takribani saa 2,800 za masomo makini zinahitajika kwa wanafunzi wasemao Kiingereza kumudu Kichina, na mazingira ya kuzamishwa kwenye lugha yanatoa nafasi nzuri kwa hilo. Kwa sasa, Waziri wa Elimu Jennifer Rankine yupo Uchina akihamasisha matumizi ya Cheti cha Elimu cha Australia Kusini (SACE), akitarajia kuleta wanafunzi wa kimataifa zaidi kusoma Adelaide. Majimbo mengine kama Victoria, New South Wales na Queensland tayari yana shule zinazotumia mfumo wa lugha mbili. Mandy Scott kutoka Chama cha Kujifunza Kichina Australia anasisitiza umuhimu wa kujifunza kwa muda mrefu, akiunga mkono shule nyingi zaidi kutoa Mandarin hadi Kidato cha 12. Chad Sexton-Finck, mkuu wa shule ya Redcliffe huko Australia Magharibi, pia anaunga mkono mpango wa Australia Kusini. Ingawa WA haina shule za lugha mbili kwa sasa, Sexton-Finck—ambaye watoto wake huzungumza lugha tatu—anasema kuanzisha mipango kama hii kutakuwa na faida kubwa. Kwa ujumla, kuongeza elimu ya Kichina inaonekana kuwa muhimu kwa mafanikio ya kitaaluma, kitamaduni, na fursa za ajira mbele.

article_content:
England’s cricket team suffered one of their lowest points with a heavy defeat by Australia at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, losing the fourth Ashes Test by eight wickets. This result gave Australia a 4-0 lead in the series and all but confirms an Ashes whitewash, marking the potential end of a once-successful era for England. Hopes were high that this Test, with the series already lost, would mark a new beginning for England and for captain Alastair Cook, yet the performance fell woefully short.

Australia capitalized on England’s fielding and batting mistakes, with Chris Rogers scoring a century and Shane Watson a half-century. England dropped key catches—Jonny Bairstow and Cook notably missed opportunities—and failed to build on promising positions. England’s first innings total of 255 was made timidly, despite an early advantage given by Australia’s risk of putting England into bat. The third day was particularly disastrous as England, favorites to win, lost five wickets for just six runs in a rapid collapse.

Australia’s successful run-chase at the MCG, the highest in 50 years, was completed with ease, and further exposed England’s lack of confidence. Stokes provided a glimmer of hope with both bat and ball, but even his efforts could not hide the team’s collective frailties. As a result, the futures of several senior players and coaching staff are now in question, and a period of major change for English cricket appears imminent.

The defeat has left the England squad demoralized and led to doubts about Cook’s captaincy, Bairstow’s role as backup wicketkeeper, and the ongoing involvement of experienced coaching personnel. Looking ahead, new managing director Paul Downton and selector James Whitaker face significant challenges. England must now regroup and consider significant changes as they look to rebuild for the future.

Matokeo haya yanaipa Australia uongozi wa 4-0 kwenye mfululizo, karibu kuthibitisha ushindi wa Ashes kwa asilimia kubwa na kuashiria mwisho wa enzi bora ya Uingereza. Kulikuwa na matumaini kuwa mtihani huu ungekuwa mwanzo mpya kwa Uingereza na nahodha Alastair Cook, lakini timu haikuweza kuwiana na matarajio hayo.

Australia walitumia ipasavyo makosa ya Uingereza katika uwanja na upigaji, Chris Rogers akifunga karne na Shane Watson nusu karne. Uingereza walikosa nafasi muhimu za kuwatoa wapinzani—Jonny Bairstow na Cook waliruhusu mipira rahisi—na hawakuweza kutumia nafasi zao vizuri. Alama 255 za inngs ya kwanza ya Uingereza zikipatikana kwa uoga, licha ya Australia kuwapa fursa ya kupiga kwanza. Australia walifanikisha mbio za ushindi kwenye MCG, ikiwa rekodi ya juu zaidi kwa miaka 50, na kuonesha udhaifu wa kujiamini kwa Uingereza. Stokes aliingiza matumaini kidogo katika upigaji na uchezaji, japo haikuweza kuficha mapungufu ya jumla ya timu. Hali hii imesababisha mustakabali wa wachezaji wakongwe na benchi la ufundi kuwekwa mashakani, na mabadiliko makubwa yanatarajiwa kwenye kriketi ya Uingereza.

Kushindwa huku kumeacha kikosi cha Uingereza kikiwa kimetamaushwa na kuleta maswali juu ya uwezo wa Cook kama nahodha, nafasi ya Bairstow kama mlinda-wiketi wa akiba, na uendelevu wa benchi la wakufunzi. Huku mkurugenzi mpya Paul Downton na mteuzi James Whitaker wakikabiliwa na changamoto kubwa, Uingereza lazima wajipange upya na kufanya mabadiliko makubwa ili kujenga timu imara kwa siku za usoni.

article_content: Doctors Steven Brigham and Nicola Riley are currently facing significant criminal charges in Maryland, accused of carrying out abortions on viable late-term fetuses. Brigham was apprehended in New Jersey and Riley in Utah, and both are awaiting hearings for extradition to Maryland. Authorities in Elkton, Maryland, have charged each physician with five counts of first-degree murder, five counts of second-degree murder, and one count of conspiracy to commit first-degree murder. According to Kerwin Miller, the deputy state's attorney for Cecil County, these cases do not fall under the lawful exceptions for abortion in Maryland. Legal representatives for both doctors dispute the charges. Tom Brown, on Brigham's behalf, stated that his client has cooperated with authorities and maintains he has not broken Maryland law. Norman Wilson, another attorney for Brigham, declined to comment, while Sharon Krevor-Weisbaum, representing Riley, argued that the charges are unjustified and that Riley should not be held without bond. The investigation started on August 13, 2010, when Riley brought a woman to an Elkton hospital after a medical procedure led to serious complications. Investigators discovered that the woman had come from New Jersey to Maryland for an abortion. When police searched the clinic, they found multiple fetuses stored in a freezer, which were subsequently sent to the medical examiner in Baltimore. Following this, indictment warrants were issued. Authorities arrested Brigham without incident in Camden, New Jersey, and detained Riley in Utah under similar circumstances. Brigham, 55, is being held in Camden County jail, while Riley, 46, remains in Salt Lake City jail pending extradition. Elkton police have announced further information will be released soon.

Brigham alikamatwa New Jersey na Riley Utah, wote wanasubiri kusikilizwa kwa mashtaka ya kuhamishiwa Maryland. Mamlaka za Elkton, Maryland zimewashtaki kila daktari kwa makosa matano ya mauaji ya kwanza, matano ya mauaji ya pili, na moja la kula njama kutenda mauaji ya kwanza. Kwa mujibu wa Kerwin Miller, naibu mwendesha mashtaka wa kaunti ya Cecil, kesi hizi hazikidhi vigezo vya sheria za utoaji mimba Maryland. Wakili wa Brigham, Tom Brown, alisema mteja wake ameshirikiana kikamilifu na mamlaka na anasisitiza hajavunja sheria yoyote ya Maryland. Norman Wilson, wakili mwingine wa Brigham, alikataa kutoa maoni, huku Sharon Krevor-Weisbaum aliyemwakilisha Riley akisema mashtaka haya hayana msingi na Riley hapaswi kuzuiliwa bila dhamana. Uchunguzi ulianza Agosti 13, 2010, Riley alipompeleka mwanamke hospitali ya Elkton kutokana na matatizo baada ya utaratibu wa kitabibu. Wachunguzi waligundua mwanamke huyo alitoka New Jersey kwenda Maryland kwa ajili ya kutoa mimba. Polisi walipopekua kliniki waligundua fetusi kadhaa zimehifadhiwa kwenye friji na zikapelekwa kwa daktari mkuu wa uchunguzi Baltimore. Baada ya hapo, waranti za kukamatwa zilitolewa. Brigham alikamatwa Camden, New Jersey bila matatizo, na Riley akakamatwa Utah vile vile. Brigham (miaka 55) yupo gereza la Camden County na Riley (46) anashikiliwa Salt Lake City akisubiri kuhamishiwa. Polisi wa Elkton wamesema taarifa zaidi zitatolewa hivi karibuni.

article_content: The United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) has warned that its humanitarian operations in war-torn Gaza could come to a halt within two days due to severe fuel shortages, as fighting between Israel and Hamas continues. “The humanitarian operation in Gaza will grind to a halt in the next 48 hours as no fuel is allowed to enter Gaza,” stated Thomas White, UNRWA’s Gaza chief, on X (formerly Twitter) on Monday. Israel launched airstrikes on Gaza following a Hamas attack on southern Israel on October 7, which, according to Israeli authorities, killed approximately 1,200 people. According to Palestinian authorities, more than 11,200 people, including over 4,000 children, have been killed in Gaza during Israel’s military offensive. After the Hamas attack, Israel cut off the supply of water, electricity, fuel, and food to Gaza's 2.4 million residents, resulting in widespread shortages. Although dozens of aid trucks have been allowed entry from Egypt through the Rafah border crossing, aid groups emphasize that the amount provided falls far short of what is needed. UNRWA Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini reported that only about 39 percent of Gaza’s food needs are being met. He explained, “In one of the governorates, families received just one or two rounds of bread and a can of tuna. In Rafah, it was one or two rounds of bread and a can of cheese for a whole family.” Since the war began, more than two-thirds of the Palestinian population in Gaza have been displaced from their homes.

article_content: Holiday celebrations across the globe bring people together with traditions like sharing gifts, food, music, and decorations, all of which foster joy and connection. Candles are used widely in festivals such as Diwali, Hanukkah, and the Winter Solstice to represent hope, fresh starts, and light triumphing over darkness. Although it may seem challenging to adapt long-standing customs, making small, conscious changes can enhance your festivities—beginning with something as simple as a light. Seungah Jeong, now MPOWERD's CEO, once experienced unreliable electricity after moving to the United States in the early 1970s. This background fuels her mission of leading MPOWERD, a company providing solar-powered portable lighting to people worldwide, especially those with limited access to power. Jeong and founder John Salzinger, together with their team in New York, are focused on serving both people and the environment. Salzinger states, "Companies have both the means and the responsibility to empower as many people as possible, since we all benefit from a better future." MPOWERD's solar lanterns bring light and connectivity to everywhere from campsites to off-grid communities. How can this innovation relate to your own holiday traditions? Salzinger points out that while businesses must lead the way, individual consumers play a key role in driving change through their spending choices. With nearly $210 billion spent on holiday gifts in 2022—and PWC projecting a 7% increase this year—spending with purpose can make a big difference, favoring companies like MPOWERD that prioritize people and the environment. Adjusting your purchasing habits, even in small ways—such as where you buy gifts, food, or decorations—can create meaningful impact. For example, Revaka, a Ukrainian company, sells candles in biodegradable containers to cut down on waste. Ravensong Soap & Candle Company, owned by an Indigenous Canadian woman, makes handcrafted candles using traditional processes. Good Market links shoppers with over 100 candle makers worldwide, all dedicated to social and environmental causes. Beyond candles, more than 11 million social enterprises around the world offer products and services that reinvest in communities and ecosystems. Tools like the SAP Community Holiday Gift Guide can help you discover these businesses so you can shop with a positive purpose. No matter what you celebrate, every thoughtful purchase can brighten your season, help start new traditions, and contribute to a more lasting, positive future. As the year comes to a close and celebrations begin, remember: the choices you make can truly make a difference.

Ingawa inaweza kuonekana vigumu kubadilisha desturi za muda mrefu, mabadiliko madogo yenye nia njema yanaweza kuboresha sherehe zako—ukianzia na kitu rahisi kama mwanga. Jeong na mwanzilishi mwenza John Salzinger na timu yao jijini New York wamejitoa kwa watu na mazingira. article_content: Singapore has opened the first phase of a seamless pedestrian and cycling route connecting Bishan to the city. This initiative, part of the Bishan-to-City Links project, aims to revitalise areas along the Kallang River. According to the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), improvements include new and upgraded underpasses and signalised crossings. The launch coincides with a public engagement exercise for the Draft Master Plan 2025, which outlines Singapore’s land use and development for the next 10 to 15 years. The plan features new central housing, a Recreation Master Plan, and enhanced identity corridors. URA and its partners are inviting feedback and ideas from Singaporeans and stakeholders through competitions, exhibitions, and focus group discussions.

Uzinduzi huu umeambatana na kuanzishwa kwa zoezi la kushirikisha umma kuhusu Rasimu ya Mpango Mkuu wa 2025, unaopanga matumizi ya ardhi na maendeleo ya Singapore kwa miaka 10 hadi 15 ijayo. Mpango huo una nyumba mpya katikati ya mji, Mpango Mkuu wa Burudani, na maeneo yenye utambulisho ulioboreshwa. article_content: Stoke City goalkeeper Asmir Begovic has expressed his desire to join Liverpool and plans to report to Anfield for pre-season training in July. In an interview in his native Bosnia, the 25-year-old said, 'I want to start preparing on July 10, with all the players of Liverpool.' With the potential departure of Begovic, Stoke is preparing accordingly. The club has already signed England international Jack Butland from Birmingham City and is considering acquiring 19-year-old FC Twente goalkeeper Timo Plattel. Plattel would provide competition for Butland if the deal is finalized. Begovic has attracted interest from several Premier League teams, including Manchester United, amid speculation that Barcelona could pursue Liverpool’s current goalkeeper, Pepe Reina. Despite the rumors, Begovic has expressed satisfaction with Stoke, stating, 'We haven’t spoken at all yet, but I think we will sit down this week and formulate plans from there. All the speculation is flattering and nice, but as long as Stoke want me, I am contracted here. I am happy here and desperate to help the club push forward, as long as they are moving in the right direction.' He added, 'I have ambition to play at the highest level and test myself at that standard, if the opportunity arises.' Begovic was also seen attending a Miami Heat basketball game in the US earlier this week. Meanwhile, Stoke chairman Peter Coates has confirmed that midfielder Steven Nzonzi has submitted a written transfer request. Coates said, 'We are not unduly worried about the situation as he is our player and has three years remaining on his contract.' Begovic is likely to depart following the dismissal of manager Tony Pulis earlier this week by Chairman Coates. Pulis, 55, released a statement through the League Managers Association saying he was disappointed but accepted that the club wanted to go in a different direction. The split was characterized as amicable. Pulis acknowledged rising fan expectations and reflected on his seven-year tenure: 'At times the minority make the noise. You have to accept criticism. The fact we've had such a wonderful five seasons (in the Premier League) gets lost, especially during a bad run. When things go wrong it is magnified tenfold. Some are genuine supporters who want the club to do well, others criticize for other reasons. The answer is to try to do your best.' He further noted the difficulty in competing with the Premier League's biggest clubs without matching their financial resources: 'Expectations keep growing. We're never going to be in a position to compete with the top five or six clubs unless we have the budget they use. I think we’ve done well with what we’ve got.'
translated_content: Kipa wa Stoke City, Asmir Begovic, ameonesha nia ya kujiunga na Liverpool na anapanga kuripoti Anfield kwa mazoezi ya kujiandaa kabla ya msimu mwezi Julai. Begovic amevutia vilabu vingine vya Ligi Kuu, akiwemo Manchester United, huku ripoti zikidai Barcelona inaweza kumnunua kipa wa Liverpool, Pepe Reina. Hata hivyo, Begovic amesema ana furaha Stoke na yuko tayari kusaidia klabu ilimradi inakwenda katika mwelekeo sahihi: 'Bado hatujakaa chini kuzungumza, lakini nafikiri wiki hii tutapanga mipango. Uvumi wote huu ni mzuri na unafurahisha, lakini mradi Stoke wananitaka, nina mkataba. Nina furaha hapa na natamani klabu isonge mbele.' Ameongeza, 'Nina ndoto ya kucheza viwango vya juu zaidi na kujipima, ikiwa nafasi itatokea.' Begovic pia alionekana wiki hii akitazama mechi ya mpira wa kikapu ya Miami Heat nchini Marekani. Kwa upande mwingine, mwenyekiti wa Stoke, Peter Coates, amethibitisha kiungo Steven Nzonzi ametuma ombi rasmi la kutaka kuondoka. Coates alisema, 'Hatujali sana suala hili kwa sababu bado ni mchezaji wetu na ana miaka mitatu kwenye mkataba.' Inaonekana Begovic anaweza kufuata nyayo za kocha Tony Pulis aliyeondolewa wiki hii na mwenyekiti Coates. Miaka mitano mizuri (katika Ligi Kuu) imesahaulika mambo yanapokwama. Mambo yakienda vibaya, mambo yanakuzwa mara kumi zaidi. Wako mashabiki wa kweli na wengine wanakosoa kwa sababu zao. Jibu ni kufanya bidii yako.' Pia aliongeza kwamba ni vigumu kushindana na klabu kubwa za Ligi Kuu bila rasilimali zao: 'Matarajio yanazidi kukua. Hatuwezi kushindana na klabu tano au sita za juu bila bajeti yao. Nafikiri tumefanya vizuri kwa kidogo tulicho nacho.'

article_content:
Professional golfer Charlie Beljan has been under extreme stress during the PGA Tour’s final event of 2012 at Disney World in Florida, where he’s fighting to keep his spot for next season. With his ranking at 139th and only the top 125 players retaining their tour cards, Beljan has felt tremendous pressure. His caddy, Rick Adcox, explained that at one point during his round on Friday, Beljan felt so unwell he genuinely feared for his life, suffering from a rapid heartbeat, high blood pressure, and numbness in his arms. Despite being hospitalized straight after he finished his round, Beljan still managed to deliver a remarkable performance, shooting an eight-under-par 64 and leading the Children's Miracle Network Hospitals Classic by three strokes.

After medical evaluation, doctors couldn’t find any physical problem and attributed his symptoms mainly to anxiety. This wasn’t Beljan’s first health scare: just a month prior, he fainted during a flight. Though medical staff advised caution, Beljan insisted on continuing in the tournament after being cleared. Now a new father, Beljan is motivated to secure the first-place prize of $846,000 and improve his standing—moving towards 63rd on the money list as of Saturday when he shot a 71, keeping a two-shot lead into the final round. He later shared that he never expected to finish the round, and is grateful simply to be able to smile and enjoy the moment after his ordeal.

Mcheza gofu wa kulipwa Charlie Beljan amekuwa chini ya msongo mkubwa wakati wa mashindano ya mwisho ya PGA Tour ya 2012 huko Disney World, Florida, akipambana kuhifadhi nafasi yake kwa msimu ujao. Beljan alikuwa nafasi ya 139 na ni wachezaji 125 wa juu pekee wanaorudi kwenye mzunguko, hivyo ametumbukia kwenye shinikizo kubwa la kufanya vizuri. Caddy wake, Rick Adcox, alisema kuwa wakati wa raundi ya Ijumaa, Beljan alihisi amechoka sana, akiwa na mapigo ya kasi ya moyo, shinikizo la damu juu, na ganzi mikononi. Ingawa alipelekwa hospitalini mara baada ya kumaliza mzunguko huo, Beljan aliweza kucheza kwa ustadi mkubwa, akapata matokeo ya ajabu ya minane chini ya par 64 na kuongoza Children's Miracle Network Hospitals Classic kwa tofauti ya mikwaju mitatu.

Baada ya uchunguzi wa kitabibu, madaktari hawakuona tatizo la kimwili na walihusisha dalili zake na wasiwasi mkubwa. Hii si mara ya kwanza Beljan kupata tatizo la afya; mwezi uliopita aliwahi kuzimia kwenye ndege. Akishauriwa awe makini na wataalamu wa afya, aliruhusiwa kuendelea kushiriki mashindano. Beljan, ambaye hivi karibuni amekuwa baba, ana motisha ya kushinda zawadi ya kwanza ya $846,000 na kuboresha nafasi yake—alifikia nafasi ya 63 kwenye orodha ya mapato baada ya raundi ya Jumamosi alipocheza 71, na kubakisha uongozi wa mikwaju miwili kuelekea raundi ya mwisho. Baadaye, alikiri hakutarajia kumaliza, akisema anashukuru kuwa anaweza kutabasamu na kufurahia maisha baada ya changamoto hiyo.

article_content: Smokers caught littering cigarette butts or related rubbish on the streets will be offered a £30 shopping voucher if they complete a stop smoking course and successfully quit. The voucher is available to anyone who receives a fine for dropping cigarette butts or empty packets and then completes a council-commissioned course. Those who give up smoking after the course can redeem taxpayer-funded vouchers at several well-known high street shops, including Debenhams and Boots. Under the scheme, anyone caught discarding cigarette butts and packets will be issued a fixed-penalty notice of £80, which is reduced to £55 if paid within 10 days. Offenders are then invited to attend a stop-smoking course. A public health charity suggested the scheme could boost the resolve of those struggling to quit smoking. However, critics of the pilot programme, which launches next month in the London borough of Wandsworth, have called it unusual. They argue it is unfair to reward those who litter and suggest council money could be better allocated. Resident Alex Gore, 30, commented: 'It's odd. What about those who don't litter or have already quit smoking? The council might be better off providing more bins with ashtrays instead of this scheme.' On the council website, Kim Willott, another resident, added: 'While it's easy to blame individuals, the council should also provide more bins.' John O'Connell, Director of the Taxpayers' Alliance, said: 'This is very strange. Litter fines exist because cleanup is costly. Rewarding littering seems like misguided justice, and the scheme could be open to abuse.' Wandsworth Council said it aims to reduce smoking by 3% next year. Those caught littering receive a fixed-penalty notice and can choose to attend a council-commissioned stop-smoking course to receive the £30 voucher.  A spokesperson from Action on Smoking and Health said: 'Most smokers want to quit, so this incentive could help those struggling to stop. Combining anti-litter efforts with smoking cessation should save money and improve health.' Health spokesperson Councillor Jim Maddan explained: 'We know 65% of smokers want to quit but may not know where to get help. This scheme will guide them to resources. We hope the £30 voucher will encourage people to take the first step to quit.' The vouchers can be used at shops like Debenhams, HMV, River Island, House of Fraser, H Samuel, Habitat, Toys R Us, Homebase, and Clinton Cards. Last year, the council issued 614 fines for littering, with around half for smoking-related waste. The borough spends £4 million a year cleaning up 7,000 tonnes of litter. Wandsworth aims to reduce smoking by 3% next year and has helped more than 6,500 people quit since 2010. The incentive scheme has drawn both support and criticism from residents and officials.

Mwaka jana, halmashauri ilitoa faini 614 kwa utupaji taka, nusu yake ikiwa taka za sigara. Wilaya hutumia pauni milioni 4 kila mwaka kusafisha tani 7,000 za taka. article_content: When the 118th Congress concludes in January 2025, the House of Representatives will see at least 381 years of collective experience depart, as 31 members have declared they won’t seek reelection. Each of these lawmakers has served an average of 12 years, totaling roughly six terms per member. Of those leaving, 20 are Democrats and 11 are Republicans. Around half—15 individuals—are stepping down to pursue other positions such as president, U.S. Senate, governor, or attorney general. Notably, California Democrats Katie Porter, Adam Schiff, and Barbara Lee are each mounting Senate campaigns, after jointly serving a collective 57 years in the House. A mid-November poll by Emerson College shows Schiff holding a slight lead among Senate contenders, but the race remains highly competitive, with 39% of surveyed voters still undecided and the 2024 election about a year away. Some lawmakers are leaving for family reasons. Democrat Derek Kilmer explained that, although serving was rewarding, it required personal sacrifices, including missing family milestones and feeling distant from loved ones after January 6th. Republican Debbie Lesko similarly cited her desire to spend more time with her husband, elderly mother, children, and grandchildren. Republican George Santos, who took office in January, announced he will not seek reelection to protect his family's privacy. This came after a critical House Ethics Committee report detailed his alleged misconduct. Before this, his campaign already faced financial struggles. The House is expected to soon vote on expelling Santos, who has said he anticipates being removed—potentially making him just the sixth member ever expelled from the House.

Karibu nusu yao—watu 15—wanaondoka kugombea nafasi nyingine za kisiasa kama urais, Seneti ya Marekani, ugavana, au mwanasheria mkuu. Wabunge mashuhuri wa California, Katie Porter, Adam Schiff, na Barbara Lee (wote WaDemocrat), wanawania Seneti baada ya kutumikia jumla ya miaka 57 Bungeni. Uchunguzi wa Emerson College wa Novemba umeonyesha Schiff anaongoza kidogo, lakini asilimia 39 ya wapiga kura bado hawajaamua kuhusu uchaguzi mkuu wa 2024 unaokaribia. Wengine wanastaafu kwa sababu za kifamilia. Derek Kilmer (Democrat) alisema kwamba, ingawa utumishi ulikuwa na maana, uligharimu muda wa kifamilia na kufanya ajihisi mbali na wapendwa baada ya Januari 6. Debbie Lesko (Republican) pia alisema anataka kutumia muda zaidi na mume wake, mama yake mzee, watoto, na wajukuu. George Santos (Republican), aliyeingia ofisini Januari, ametangaza kuwa hatagombea tena ili kulinda faragha ya familia yake. Alitoa tamko hili baada ya ripoti kali ya Kamati ya Maadili ya Bunge kuhusu madai dhidi yake. Kabla ya hapo, kampeni yake ilikuwa inashindwa kifedha. Bunge linatarajia kupiga kura karibuni kuhusu kumwondoa rasmi Santos, ambaye amesema anaamini ataondolewa—ikiwa itatokea, atakuwa mbunge wa sita tu kuondolewa Bungeni.

Fearless Weirdos is a distinctive boutique in Atlanta, fusing bold elements of Japanese street style with one-of-a-kind designs. The shop’s front door greets visitors with an upside-down phrase, 'normal is an allusion,' reflecting the quirky atmosphere inside. Racks showcase items like vibrant Harajuku Tutu skirts, repurposed denim, and playful cardigans inspired by Mickey and Minnie Mouse—all displayed using recycled materials. Their signature piece is a loose minidress, reminiscent of an apron, crafted by the store itself.

Owner Alva Glass handpicks clothing that’s functional, flexible, and different, augmenting these with bold statement items. Her core customers—creative young adults aged 18-35—seek originality in their fashion choices. Outside, Japanese lettering, oversized white eyeglasses (symbolizing clear self-identity), and inspirational quotes attract attention. Once inside, shoppers return for the exclusive, limited-run garments.

Glass sources most of the new items directly from Japan and U.S. showrooms, sprinkling in vintage blazers, accessories, and a mix of vibrant and simple fabrics. Drawing inspiration from Japanese fashion, which is known for slim cuts, artistic prints, and layered looks, Fearless Weirdos embodies this rising American trend.

Customers like Danika Goings praise the shop’s unique offerings. Staff like Jessica Dascomb, known for her upbeat attitude and bold style, energize the welcoming space—stocked with Japanese sodas and magazines. Japanese customers often appreciate the authenticity, with some taking photos to mark their experience. High-profile shoppers include Atlanta musicians B.o.B (who bought a letterman jacket) and Stic.man of Dead Prez.

Glass traces her inspiration to visits to Tokyo and Osaka, where she was captivated by the creativity and liveliness. Her early years were marked by creative freedom in her clothing choices, a value she continues in her boutique. Glass began her career in retail at 15, earned a fashion design and marketing degree (split between Atlanta and London), and gained industry experience with Citron Clothing and BCBG Max Azria before founding Fearless Weirdos.

Wateja wake wakuu ni vijana wabunifu wenye umri kati ya miaka 18 hadi 35 wanaotafuta mitindo isiyo ya kawaida. Mchanganyiko wa vitambaa vyenye rangi kali na rahisi unaakisi ushawishi wa mitindo ya barabarani kutoka Japani, ambao unazidi kupendwa Marekani kupitia mitindo myembamba, michoro ya kisanii, na tabaka nyingi za nguo.

Wateja kama Danika Goings husifu ubunifu wa bidhaa za duka hilo. Jessica Dascomb, mfanyakazi maarufu kwa tabia yake ya uchangamfu na mitindo mikali, huleta uhai—kuna vinywaji na magazeti ya Japani yanayopatikana dukani. Wateja wa Kijapani hupendezwa sana na uhalisia, wengine huzua kumbukumbu kwa kupiga picha. Wageni maalum kama msanii wa Atlanta B.o.B (aliyenunua koti la letterman) na Stic.man wa Dead Prez pia waliwahi kutembelea.

Aliingia sokoni mapema, akasomea ubunifu na uuzaji wa mitindo Atlanta na London, na kufanya kazi Citron Clothing na BCBG Max Azria kabla ya kuanzisha duka hili.

article_content: Alastair Cook has been removed as England's one-day captain due to a run of poor form, just before the World Cup. This move prompted a wide range of reactions on Twitter and in the media on Friday. Many former players and commentators, including Michael Vaughan, Alec Stewart, Jonathan Agnew, Mike Atherton, and Gary Lineker, shared their thoughts. Most agreed that the England selectors made the right call by appointing Eoin Morgan as the new one-day captain. Several suggested this gives Cook a valuable chance to take a break and focus on Test cricket, where he excels. Some, like Bob Willis and Simon Hughes, expressed sympathy for Cook, acknowledging his commitment and hard work. There were also calls for the team to reassess its overall selection and embrace a fresh start. Cook's final match as captain followed a defeat to Sri Lanka, where Sachithra Senanayake and Angelo Mathews were instrumental in taking his wicket.

Wachezaji wa zamani na wachambuzi kama Michael Vaughan, Alec Stewart, Jonathan Agnew, Mike Atherton, na Gary Lineker walitoa maoni yao. Wengi walikubaliana kwamba wachaguzi wa England wamefanya uamuzi sahihi kumchagua Eoin Morgan kama nahodha mpya. Baadhi waliona hii ni nafasi nzuri kwa Cook kupumzika na kuzingatia mechi za Test, ambako anafanya vizuri zaidi. Wengine kama Bob Willis na Simon Hughes walimhurumia Cook, wakitambua bidii na kujitolea kwake. Pia, kulikuwapo na wito wa timu kufikiria upya uteuzi na kuanza upya. Mechi ya mwisho ya Cook kama nahodha ilikuwa baada ya kushindwa na Sri Lanka, ambapo Sachithra Senanayake na Angelo Mathews walihusika kumtoa Cook uwanjani.

article_content: Toronto Mayor Rob Ford has admitted that he continues to drink alcohol, following a year marked by scandals including substance abuse and controversial behavior. Ford, leader of Canada's largest city, said on Tuesday that while he still drinks, he no longer does so excessively. 'That's behind me and we're moving forward. I'm looking forward to the campaign and debating my opponents,' Ford stated. Ford described himself as being in great shape thanks to daily gym visits, claiming he has lost weight as he campaigns for re-election in October. Despite describing his heavy drinking as being in the past, Ford acknowledged he still consumes alcohol. Over the past year, Ford has faced various scandals—ranging from admitting to smoking crack cocaine to being filmed while intoxicated and impersonating a Jamaican accent, as well as jaywalking. During a City Council meeting held to consider stripping him of mayoral powers, Ford accidentally collided with a female council member while confronting a heckler. In an interview with Matt Lauer on the Today Show, Ford stated, 'I don't use illegal drugs. I experimented with them probably a year ago, but I don't use drugs.' Recently, Ford was seen on video, apparently intoxicated and speaking in a Jamaican accent at a fast-food restaurant. The video, released just weeks after Ford had claimed sobriety, rapidly spread online. Ford explained, 'I was brought up with a lot of Jamaican friends. I drank and enjoyed myself... I can't remember what night it was. Maybe you're perfect but I'm not.' Over the weekend, Ford was caught on camera running into a fire hydrant while celebrating the Canadian Olympic hockey team's gold medal win in Sochi. On February 1, Ford was also seen at a Toronto bar, where, according to the Toronto Star, he disappeared into the bathroom for over an hour and later spoke incoherently. He reportedly continued to order drinks past the city’s 2am last call. As a result of these incidents, the City Council removed many of Ford’s mayoral powers, transferring them to the deputy mayor. When asked by Matt Lauer if he was still effective as mayor, Ford replied: 'Absolutely. We had a major ice storm and I led efforts to restore power. There has been the lowest tax increase in years, saving taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars. We're building subways. We're moving ahead.' Ford invited Lauer to check on his progress in a few months.

Nasubiri sana kampeni na ninataka kuanza kujadili na wapinzani wangu.' Ford alijieleza kuwa yuko katika hali nzuri kiafya kutokana na kwenda mazoezini kila siku, akidai amepunguza uzito akijiandaa kugombea tena Oktoba. Sijui ilikuwa usiku gani. Labda wewe ni mkamilifu lakini mimi sivyo.' Wikiendi iliyopita, Ford alinaswa kwenye kamera akikimbilia bomba la maji aliyokuwa akisherehekea timu ya hoki ya Olimpiki ya Kanada kushinda medali ya dhahabu huko Sochi. Tunajenga reli ya chini ya ardhi. Tunaendelea mbele.' Ford alimkaribisha Lauer kuangalia maendeleo yake baada ya miezi kadhaa.

Ashya King, age five, is recovering from a brain tumor and was recently seen at a pizza restaurant with his family—his first time out since starting proton beam therapy in Prague. His older brother Naveed shared a picture where Ashya looks healthier and is holding his favorite toy, as he finishes up the last of his 30 therapy sessions.

Initially diagnosed in July, Ashya underwent surgeries and was set for chemotherapy and radiotherapy in the UK. Worried these treatments might leave him severely disabled, his parents, Brett and Naghemeh, decided to seek proton beam therapy in Prague, a treatment not covered by the NHS at the time. They left the UK, planning to raise funds by selling property in Spain. This led to their brief detention by Spanish police at the request of UK authorities, but following international criticism and after 72 hours, they were released and reunited with Ashya.

After reviews, the NHS agreed to fund the therapy. Ashya is now recovering in a private room and has started to eat a little on his own, according to a spokesperson from the Proton Therapy Centre in Prague. The family is now considering moving to Spain for Ashya’s next phase of care, which may involve physiotherapy and occupational therapy under the guidance of a doctor from Madrid. Ashya still requires tube feeding, and the family expects to remain abroad for some time.

Meanwhile, the charity Kids n Cancer, which raised £50,000 in public donations for Ashya’s treatment, has allocated the funds to other children needing proton therapy once the NHS agreed to cover Ashya’s therapy. The family is frustrated that the charity would not assist with their legal costs, but Kids n Cancer affirmed that its donations are only for medical—not legal—expenses.
translated_content:
Ashya King, mtoto wa miaka mitano, anaendelea kupata nafuu baada ya kutibiwa uvimbe kwenye ubongo na alionekana kwa mara ya kwanza na familia yake kwenye mgahawa wa pizza — ikiwa ni kutoka kwake ya kwanza tangu aanze tiba ya proton beam mjini Prague. Kaka yake mkubwa, Naveed, alishiriki picha inayoonyesha Ashya akiwa na afya njema na akishika toy aipendayo kwenye siku zake za mwisho kati ya 30 za matibabu.

Awali, Ashya aligunduliwa Julai na kufanyiwa upasuaji na alipangiwa tiba ya radiotherapy na chemotherapy nchini Uingereza. Wazazi wake, Brett na Naghemeh, walikuwa na hofu kuwa matibabu hayo yangemuacha na ulemavu mkubwa, wakaamua kumpeleka Prague kwa tiba mbadala ya proton beam ambayo haikufadhiliwa na NHS wakati huo. Waliondoka Uingereza wakipanga kuuza nyumba yao nchini Uhispania ili kupata fedha. Walikamatwa na polisi wa Uhispania baada ya Uingereza kutoa agizo la kimataifa la kumkamata, lakini baada ya saa 72 na baada ya malalamiko kutoka duniani kote, waliachiwa na kuungana tena na Ashya.

Baada ya tathmini, NHS ilikubali kufadhili matibabu yake. Kwa sasa, Ashya anapata nafuu akiwa kwenye chumba cha peke yake na ameanza kula chakula kidogo mwenyewe, kwa mujibu wa msemaji wa Kituo cha Tiba ya Proton cha Prague. Familia inafikiria kumpeleka Uhispania kwa matibabu zaidi kama vile tiba ya viungo na ya kujifunza kufanya mambo mwenyewe chini ya usimamizi wa daktari kutoka Madrid. Ashya bado analishwa kwa bomba na familia inatarajia kubaki nje ya nchi kwa sasa.

Wakati huohuo, shirika la Kids n Cancer, lililopokea pauni 50,000 kama michango kwa ajili ya Ashya, limeamua kuelekeza fedha kwa watoto wengine wanaohitaji tiba ya proton beam baada ya NHS kulipia matibabu ya Ashya. Familia inahisi kufadhaika kwani fedha hizo hazitatumika kulipia gharama za kisheria, lakini shirika limesisitiza kwamba michango yao hutumika tu kwenye matibabu, sio gharama za kisheria.
post_content: Ashya King, age 5, is recovering well after brain tumor treatment in Prague. After a tough journey—including family drama, international headlines, and NHS finally paying for his care—he’s now smiling again and eating small bites. His family hopes for even more progress! #AshyaKing #CancerAwareness #Hope

A group of ten Romanian nationals has been sentenced to a total of over 82 years in prison after a series of coordinated robberies at jewellery shops across the UK. The group, aged mainly in their twenties, used EU travel rights to move between Romania and Britain, targeting shops—especially those owned by Turkish and Indian jewellers—for gold theft.

Between March and September, the gang carried out at least seven attacks, using sledgehammers to break into stores and steal gold jewellery worth more than £1 million. Many entered the UK on tourist visas before living illegally in temporary camps in Essex. Their robbery tactic involved one member discreetly entering a shop and allowing the others inside to overpower staff and seize valuables. Even though alarms and security smoke were activated, the measures did not prevent the thefts.

Authorities said the gang showed little remorse. After his arrest, member Ovidiu Gabor claimed he did not mind prison. Judge Timothy Pontius, presiding at the Old Bailey, condemned the group’s actions and stressed that the UK would not be lenient toward offenders exploiting the country’s openness. He said strong sentences were necessary to deter similar crimes from both local and international criminals.

Police arrested the gang during a failed robbery at Sabha jewellers in North London, managing to recover about £62,600 of the stolen goods. However, only a small amount of the total value stolen has been returned. The judge recognized concerns about future increases in migration from Romania and Bulgaria after the lifting of certain restrictions, and the possible impacts on employment and crime.

The gang received individual sentences ranging from nearly seven to over nine years. Upon completing their sentences, all members are to be deported.

Kikundi cha raia kumi wa Romania wamehukumiwa jumla ya zaidi ya miaka 82 jela baada ya kufanya mfululizo wa uporaji katika maduka ya vito nchini Uingereza. Wengi wao wana umri wa miaka ishirini, walitumia haki ya kusafiri ya EU kuingia na kutoka Romania na Uingereza, na kulenga maduka yanayomilikiwa na Wahindi na Waturuki kwa ajili ya kuiba dhahabu.

Kuanzia mwezi Machi hadi Septemba, genge hili lilifanya uhalifu mara saba, wakitumia nyundo kuvunja maduka na kuiba dhahabu yenye thamani ya zaidi ya pauni milioni moja. Wengi wao waliingia Uingereza kwa visa za utalii na wakaishi kwenye makambi ya muda, Essex. Njia yao ilikuwa kumtumia mtu mmoja kuingia duka kimya kimya na kuwaruhusu wengine kuingia ili kuwashinda nguvu wahudumu na kuchukua mali. Hata mifumo ya alarm na moshi wa kiusalama haikutosha kuwazuia.

Viongozi walisema genge hilo halikuonesha majuto. Baada ya kukamatwa, Ovidiu Gabor alisema hajali kwenda jela. Jaji Timothy Pontius wa Old Bailey alimkemea vikali na kusisitiza kwamba Uingereza haitawavumilia wahalifu wanaotumia vibaya ukarimu wa nchi hiyo. Alieleza kuwa hukumu kali ni muhimu ili kuzua uhalifu wa aina hiyo kutoka kwa wahalifu wa ndani na wa kigeni.

Polisi waliwakamata waliposhindwa kuiba katika duka la Sabha, Kaskazini mwa London, na kurejesha takribani pauni 62,600 za mali iliyoibiwa. Hata hivyo, kiwango kidogo pekee cha mali yote ndiyo kimepatikana. Jaji aliongeza kuwa kuna wasiwasi kuhusu ongezeko la uhamiaji kutoka Romania na Bulgaria na athari zake kwa ajira na uhalifu.

Kila mshiriki wa genge amehukumiwa kifungo kati ya karibu miaka saba hadi tisa na watarudishwa makwao wakimaliza kifungo chao.

Christopher Luxon officially became New Zealand’s prime minister on Monday, making economic improvement his chief goal. The 53-year-old former business leader heads a conservative coalition, having formed a government with two smaller parties after last month’s general election.

Governor-General Cindy Kiro presided over the swearing-in ceremony, after which Luxon called the role a major responsibility. His first Cabinet meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, and a 100-day plan is in the works. He also plans to visit Australia before Christmas.

Luxon voiced concerns about deteriorating government finances and said he would seek a comprehensive Treasury briefing. The coalition’s key promises include tax cuts, recruiting 500 more police officers within two years, and streamlining the public sector with a 6.5% staffing cut. Luxon said department leaders would decide how to achieve these reductions—by ending programs, leaving roles unfilled, or laying off staff.

A major shift under the new leadership will be the intention to repeal recent tobacco control measures, including lower nicotine limits, fewer tobacco retailers, and a permanent ban on smoking for youth. Luxon said the government disagrees with aspects of the existing policy, pointing to decreasing smoking rates over the past three decades and prioritizing education and support for vaping as a smoking cessation tool.

Opponents criticize this move, citing risks to public health and suggesting tobacco companies will benefit. Outgoing prime minister Chris Hipkins, who succeeded Jacinda Ardern and served for ten months, formally resigned but expressed support for Luxon’s team, acknowledging difficult times but noting economic improvements. Hipkins will remain as opposition leader in Parliament.

article_content: The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame has announced its 2014 inductees, recognizing genres such as grunge and glam rock. The revealed list includes alternative rock legends Nirvana and the flamboyant pop metal band KISS. Soulful duo Hall & Oates, experimental artist Peter Gabriel, versatile pop star Linda Ronstadt, and acclaimed folk singer Cat Stevens also join the Hall. These inductees have together achieved significant chart success and critical acclaim. Hall & Oates, Peter Gabriel, and Linda Ronstadt have all reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Ronstadt, Nirvana, and KISS have each sold over 20 million albums. Nirvana, who brought grunge to mainstream attention in the early 1990s, are considered highly influential in rock history. Their sound, described as both fiery and melodic, attracted fans globally, especially with their landmark album 'Nevermind.' The band’s legacy is tinged with sadness due to the suicide of frontman Kurt Cobain in 1994. Peter Gabriel, recipient of multiple Grammy Awards, is known for incorporating electronic and world music in his solo career. He previously led Genesis, which was inducted in 2010. KISS, recognized for extravagant stage shows and costumes, amassed a dedicated fan base called the 'KISS Army.' Despite mixed critical opinions, their energetic acts and popular albums made a lasting impact on rock. Linda Ronstadt started in Los Angeles’s folk scene in the late 1960s and built a celebrated, award-winning career across genres like country, new wave, and Latin music. She has sold at least 30 million albums and has openly shared her Parkinson's disease diagnosis, which has ended her ability to sing. Cat Stevens found success in the 1970s with songs such as 'Wild World' and 'Peace Train.' He converted to Islam in 1977, changing his name to Yusuf Islam, and stepped away from performing for more than 20 years before eventually returning. Hall & Oates found major pop success in the 1970s and 1980s, achieving six No. 1 singles and six platinum albums, and selling over 13 million albums. The induction ceremony will be held on April 10 at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. Fans contributed to the selection process through online voting, with the top five choices forming a 'fans' ballot' that counted alongside votes from a 600-member panel of industry professionals, prior inductees, historians, and critics. Three of the five fan-voted artists made the final list of inductees. Notable nominees not chosen this year include Chic, the Replacements, the Meters, and N.W.A. Additionally, Beatles manager Brian Epstein and Rolling Stones manager Andrew Loog Oldham will receive the Ahmet Ertegun Award, recognizing influential recording industry professionals. The E Street Band, backing group to Bruce Springsteen, will receive the Award for Musical Excellence. Springsteen was inducted in 1999.

article_content: The RSPCA is using the sensitive Police National Computer (PNC) around 1,500 times annually under an agreement granting the charity special access to criminal records. On average, the animal welfare group uses the police database about 124 times per month in connection with its prosecutions. This significant use has raised concerns because the PNC holds sensitive information that is usually inaccessible to many organizations, even public sector employers working with children. The RSPCA can request information about the criminal records of suspects, witnesses, defendants, and victims. Critics argue the charity has become more aggressive, focusing on high-profile campaigns and political actions, sometimes at the expense of its main mission of animal protection. The Information Commissioner, Christopher Graham, has announced an investigation into the 2010 agreement between the police and the RSPCA. Under this arrangement with the Association of Chief Police Officers (Acpo), the RSPCA can request criminal record checks, paying Acpo at least £35 for each search. Conservative MP Simon Hart, former head of the Countryside Alliance, said: 'If any other political organization had access to the PNC, there would be widespread public concern. This is an increasingly political animal rights group, which has moved away from its welfare origins. I will write to the Home Secretary and Attorney General to seek clarification on whether pressure groups should have such access.' The agreement allows the RSPCA to obtain criminal record information on various parties involved in its cases. In one 19-month period, it conducted 54 detailed checks that provided information on convictions, cautions, warnings, reprimands, and pending prosecutions. The majority of its activity, however, involved adding records of people it planned to prosecute—2,311 individuals in the same period—so their data would be available to the police. Other organizations with agreements with Acpo include public bodies, such as the Civil Aviation Authority and the Food Standards Agency. The RSPCA reported securing 4,168 animal welfare and cruelty convictions last year, an increase from 2,441 three years earlier. The charity claims the database is primarily used to update records for its prosecutions but has faced criticism for being too aggressive in recent legal actions and campaigns. For example, a Conservative councillor was prosecuted for illegal hunting, but the case was eventually dropped. A judge criticized the charity for pursuing the prosecution even though no fox had been seen. Sir Barney White-Spunner, head of the Countryside Alliance, called for the RSPCA’s access to police databases to be suspended until its legality is confirmed. He stated: 'The RSPCA is neither a public body nor a statutory prosecuting authority; it is a campaigning charity with an increasingly active animal rights agenda. Disclosing sensitive police data to the organization could pose significant risks to individuals.' An RSPCA spokesperson said the charity requests information from the police to 'prevent and detect' serious animal-related crime and added, 'Any response from the police is at their discretion and appropriate to the request.' According to Acpo, the RSPCA’s access is 'indirect' and does not include firearms licensing, vehicle registrations, or information unrelated to specific prosecutions.

Kwa wastani, taasisi hii ya ustawi wa wanyama hutumia hifadhidata ya polisi takriban mara 124 kwa mwezi kwa ajili ya mashitaka yao. Matumizi haya makubwa yameibua wasiwasi kwa sababu PNC ina taarifa nyeti ambazo mara nyingi hazipatikani kwa taasisi nyingi, hata waajiri kwenye sekta ya umma wanaofanya kazi na watoto. Wakosoaji wanasema taasisi hii imekuwa mkali zaidi, ikizingatia kampeni kubwa na hatua za kisiasa badala ya kazi yake kuu ya kulinda wanyama. Kamishna wa Habari, Christopher Graham, ametangaza uchunguzi kuhusu makubaliano ya 2010 kati ya polisi na RSPCA. Kupitia makubaliano na Chama cha Makamanda Wakuu wa Polisi (Acpo), RSPCA inaweza kuomba ukaguzi wa rekodi za jinai, ikilipa Acpo angalau pauni 35 kwa kila ukaguzi. Mbunge wa Conservative Simon Hart, aliyewahi kuongoza Countryside Alliance, alisema: 'Ikiwa shirika lingine la kisiasa lingepata ruhusa ya kutumia PNC, kungekuwa na wasiwasi mkubwa kwa umma. Makubaliano hayo yanaruhusu RSPCA kupata taarifa za rekodi za jinai kuhusu wahusika mbalimbali kwenye kesi zao. Katika kipindi cha miezi 19, taasisi ilifanya ukaguzi 54 wa kina kwenye PNC uliosaidia kupata taarifa za hukumu, onyo, na mashitaka yanayoendelea. Kazi nyingi zaidi zilikuwa za kuongeza kwenye hifadhidata majina ya waliokusudiwa kufunguliwa mashitaka—watu 2,311 katika kipindi hicho—ili taarifa zao ziweze kuonekana na polisi. Mashirika mengine yenye makubaliano na Acpo ni kama vile Mamlaka ya Usafiri wa Anga na Wakala wa Viwango vya Chakula. RSPCA iliripoti kupata hukumu 4,168 za kesi dhidi ya ukatili na ustawi wa wanyama mwaka jana, kutoka 2,441 miaka mitatu iliyopita. Taasisi inasema hutumia hifadhidata hasa kuhariri taarifa za mashitaka yake, japo imekosolewa kwa kuwa mkali zaidi kwenye mashitaka na kampeni zake za hivi karibuni. Kwa mfano, diwani wa Conservative alishtakiwa kwa uwindaji haramu, lakini kesi iliachwa. Jaji alimkosoa RSPCA kwa kufungua mashitaka bila mtu kuona mbweha. Sir Barney White-Spunner, mkuu wa Countryside Alliance, ameitaka RSPCA kusimamishiwa ufikiaji wa hifadhidata ya polisi hadi uthibitishwe kuwa ni halali. Alisema: 'RSPCA sio shirika la umma wala mamlaka rasmi ya mashitaka; ni taasisi ya kampeni ambayo inazidi kuwa mkali kuhusu haki za wanyama. Kutoa taarifa za siri za polisi kwa taasisi hii kunaweza kuweka watu kwenye hatari.' Msemaji wa RSPCA alisema wanaomba taarifa kutoka kwa polisi 'ili kuzuia na kugundua' uhalifu mkubwa wa wanyama na akasisitiza, 'Majibu yoyote kutoka polisi ni kwa maamuzi yao na kulingana na ombi lililotumwa.' Kwa mujibu wa Acpo, RSPCA hupata taarifa kwa 'njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja' na hawaruhusiwi kupata liseni za silaha, usajili wa magari, au taarifa zisizohusiana na mashitaka maalum.

article_content: Elon Musk has announced that his social media platform X, formerly known as Twitter, will introduce two new premium subscription tiers. One tier will offer all platform features at a lower cost, but users will still see ads. The other, pricier tier, will provide an ad-free experience, Musk shared in a post on X. This announcement comes as X has started charging new users in New Zealand and the Philippines a $1 fee to access the platform. Musk did not provide further details about the new plans. According to the company’s website, new users who choose not to subscribe will be limited to 'read only' activities, such as viewing posts, watching videos, and following accounts. It is unclear whether any free usage options will remain. Musk has stated that charging users is intended to curb bots and fake accounts. Since acquiring the firm in October last year, he has encouraged users to pay for X Premium, a service now costing $8 per month for the blue check subscription. The platform's 'Not A Bot' method aims to reduce spam and automated activity. Musk has also sought to regain advertisers with discounted offers. However, his swift restructuring—including mass layoffs and the disbanding of content moderation teams—has made some advertisers withdraw their campaigns. Musk admitted that X’s revenue has been affected and blamed activists for pressuring advertisers. Other major tech companies offer a mix of ad-supported and subscription options as well. For instance, Alphabet’s YouTube and Netflix both have paid and ad-supported plans, with YouTube sharing part of its revenue with content creators. While X also shares some ad revenue with its creators, it has not disclosed if creators will be paid under the ad-free subscription model. Although Musk seeks to boost revenue by monetizing X, ongoing concerns around lax moderation have kept advertisers cautious, especially about their ads appearing next to inappropriate content. Last week, the European Commission began investigating whether X complies with new regulations on illegal and harmful content, following disinformation on the platform after Hamas attacked Israel.
