Mambo haya yamejitokeza siku mbili tu baada ya NBC kumsimamisha kazi Williams kwa miezi sita bila mshahara kufuatia kufichuliwa kuwa aliongezea chumvi kwenye maelezo yake kuhusu tukio la shambulio la RPG nchini Iraq. article_content: The Apollo 8 'Earthrise' photograph, captured during humanity's first mission beyond Earth's orbit in 1968, stands as a lasting symbol of space exploration. To celebrate the flight's 45th anniversary, NASA has recreated this iconic moment in a new video. By combining modern data from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)—which has mapped the Moon since 2009—with original Apollo 8 audio, the simulation lets viewers experience the awe of astronauts Frank Borman, James Lovell, and William Anders as they witnessed Earth rising above the lunar horizon. The historic photo was initially taken in black and white because the astronauts were hurriedly searching for color film. William Anders was the first to notice Earth appearing over the Moon, and his famous exclamation accompanied his photograph. His color image of Earth above the lunar surface was later hailed by TIME and LIFE magazines as one of the '100 photographs that changed the world.' Recent findings—enabled by research from Ernie Wright at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center and data from the LRO—reveal that the spacecraft was rolling at the time, which allowed Earth to come into view. The new video pinpoints the role and timing of the maneuver, clarifying which window each photo was taken from and resolving details that were previously uncertain. The Apollo 8 crew returned to enthusiastic celebrations, and five months later, the U.S. Postal Service issued a commemorative stamp featuring the Earthrise image. While the photograph became globally famous, it is only through current technology that the full process behind its creation is understood. As author Andrew Chaikin remarked, there’s always more to uncover about Apollo.
translated_content: Picha ya 'Earthrise' ya Apollo 8, iliyopigwa wakati wa msafara wa kwanza wa binadamu kuvuka mzunguko wa Dunia mwaka 1968, imebaki kuwa alama ya kudumu ya uchunguzi wa anga. Kuadhimisha miaka 45 tangu safari hiyo, NASA imetengeneza upya tukio hili la kihistoria kupitia video mpya. Kwa kuchanganya data ya kisasa kutoka Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)—ambayo imekuwa ikichora ramani ya Mwezi tangu 2009—na sauti halisi ya Apollo 8, taswira hii mpya inampa mtazamaji fursa ya kushuhudia mshangao wa wanaanga Frank Borman, James Lovell, na William Anders walipotazama Dunia ikichomoza juu ya upeo wa Mwezi. Picha hiyo ya kihistoria ilipigwa kwanza kwa rangi nyeusi na nyeupe kwani wanaanga walikuwa na haraka kutafuta filamu ya rangi. William Anders ndiye aliyekuwa wa kwanza kuona Dunia ikitokea juu ya Mwezi, na msisimko wake uliambatana na upigaji wa picha maarufu. Picha yake ya Dunia ikiwa juu ya uso wa Mwezi ilitambuliwa na majarida ya TIME na LIFE kama mojawapo ya 'picha 100 zilizobadilisha dunia.' Utafiti wa hivi karibuni—ukiongozwa na Ernie Wright kutoka NASA Goddard Space Flight Center na kutumia data ya LRO—ulionyesha kuwa chombo hicho cha angani kilikuwa kikizunguka wakati picha ilipopigwa, hali iliyofanya Dunia kuonekana. Video mpya inaonyesha wakati halisi na umuhimu wa mzunguko huo, na kufafanua dirisha lililotumika kupiga kila picha, jambo ambalo hapo awali halikuwa wazi. Wanaanga wa Apollo 8 walipokelewa kwa shangwe waliporudi, na miezi mitano baadaye Huduma ya Posta ya Marekani ilitoa stempu ya kumbukumbu yenye picha ya Earthrise. article_content: Scientists have, for the first time, captured video footage of the ancient, egg-laying mammal known as Attenborough's long-beaked echidna, dispelling fears of its extinction. The rare footage, amounting to four clips of three seconds each, was recorded during an Oxford University-led expedition to Indonesia's Cyclops Mountains. Echidnas, characterized by their spikes, fur, and distinctive beaks, are often referred to as 'living fossils.' They are believed to have first appeared around 200 million years ago, during the age of dinosaurs. Until now, evidence of the Attenborough echidna (Zaglossus attenboroughi) came only from a single, decades-old specimen stored at the Naturalis museum in the Netherlands. Dr James Kempton, the biologist who led the expedition, described the excitement at finding the species alive, telling BBC News he discovered the footage on the last day, using the last SD card from their last camera overlook. Dr Kempton had kept Sir David Attenborough informed about the search, and Attenborough was reportedly 'absolutely delighted' by the rediscovery. The multinational team spent a month crossing unexplored terrain at 2,000 meters above sea level in the Cyclops Mountains, a challenging rainforest habitat. In addition to encountering the elusive echidna, they also discovered new insect and frog species, and observed flourishing populations of tree kangaroos and birds of paradise. Besides the duck-billed platypus, echidnas are unique among mammals for laying eggs. Of the four echidna species, three—including Attenborough’s and the western echidna—are critically endangered. Past expeditions found indications, such as distinctive 'nose pokes' in the earth, that suggested the species survived in these remote regions. However, physical proof remained elusive due to the rugged, inaccessible terrain. The only specimen known until now was collected decades earlier by Dutch botanist Pieter van Royen and later housed under tight security at Naturalis. Its unique status was only confirmed by X-ray analysis in 1998, revealing it was not a juvenile of another species. The Cyclops Mountains present a physically demanding and hazardous environment. Scientists faced steep, slippery ridges, frequent rain, sheer cliffs, and even earthquakes. Dr Kempton described hazardous encounters with poisonous snakes, blood-sucking leeches, and pervasive discomfort. Upon reaching higher altitudes, the team realized the area was home to a wealth of species new to science. Dr Leonidas-Romanos Davranoglou, an insect specialist, noted the frequent discovery of previously undocumented species. Despite breaking his arm early in the trip, he continued collecting samples and confirmed dozens of new insect species and even a new tree-dwelling shrimp. The team also identified an unexplored cave system. Local conservationist Gison Morib emphasized the uniqueness and sacredness of the Cyclops Mountains, warning of the need to protect such an ecologically rich environment. The Oxford team worked closely with local Papuan communities, respecting cultural restrictions and traditions, such as prohibitions on certain sacred sites and passing quietly through others. In local tradition, the echidna plays a part in conflict resolution: when disputes arise, opposing parties are sent on long, symbolic searches—one for an echidna, the other for a marlin—often taking years and fostering peace. Despite its critical endangerment, Attenborough's echidna lacks legal protection in Indonesia, and little is known about its population size or viability. Scientists hope that their rediscovery, along with finding other new species, will strengthen the case for formal conservation. Much of the region remains unexplored, so further discoveries may await those who strive to protect these 'living fossils.'
translated_content: Wanasayansi wamefanikiwa kurekodi video ya mnyama wa kale anayegawia mayai anayejulikana kama echidna wa Attenborough kwa mara ya kwanza, wakithibitisha kuwa hajaangamiza kama ilivyohofiwa. Video hii adimu, iliyochukua sekunde tatu mara nne, ilirekodiwa wakati wa msafara ulioongozwa na Chuo Kikuu cha Oxford katika Milima ya Cyclops, Indonesia. Echidna, wakiwa na miiba, manyoya na midomo mirefu ya kipekee, mara nyingi huitwa ‘fossili hai’. Wanaaminika kuishi tangu takriban miaka milioni 200 iliyopita, wakati wa zama za dinosaurs. Hadi sasa, ushahidi wa kuwepo kwa echidna wa Attenborough (Zaglossus attenboroughi) ulikuwa tu ni sampuli moja ya zamani iliyohifadhiwa kwenye makumbusho ya Naturalis nchini Uholanzi. Dkt. James Kempton, mtaalamu wa baiolojia aliyetekeleza msafara huo, alielezea furaha iliyoje walipopata ushahidi wa uhai wa spishi hiyo, akiiambia BBC News kwamba waligundua video hiyo siku ya mwisho kabisa, kwa kutumia SD card ya mwisho kutoka kamera yao ya mwisho. Dkt. Kempton alikuwa akiwasiliana na Sir David Attenborough kuhusu utafutaji huo, na Attenborough alifurahi sana na ugunduzi huo. Timu ya kimataifa ilitumia mwezi mzima kuvuka maeneo ambayo hayajawahi kuchunguzwa, mita 2,000 juu ya usawa wa bahari kwenye Milima ya Cyclops, msitu wa mvua wenye changamoto nyingi. Mbali na kumwona echidna aliyeadimika, waligundua pia aina mpya za wadudu na vyura, na kuona idadi nzuri ya kangaruu wa miti na ndege wa peponi. Mbali na platypus mwenye midomo ya bata, echidna ni miongoni mwa mamalia wachache wanaotaga mayai. Kati ya spishi nne za echidna, tatu — ikiwemo wa Attenborough na wa Magharibi — ziko hatarini kuangamia. Safari za hapo awali zilipata dalili kama 'michubuko ya pua' ardhini, zikionyesha kuwa spishi hiyo bado inaishi maeneo hayo ya mbali. Hata hivyo, kuthibitisha kimwili kulishindikana kutokana na ugumu wa kufika maeneo hayo. Sampuli pekee iliyojulikana hadi sasa, ilikusanywa miongo kadhaa iliyopita na mtaalamu wa mimea kutoka Uholanzi, Pieter van Royen, kisha ikahifadhiwa kwenye usimamizi mkali huko Naturalis. Umuhimu wa sampuli hii ulithibitishwa kwa mionzi ya X-ray mwaka 1998, ikionesha hakuwa mtoto wa spishi nyingine. Milima ya Cyclops ni mazingira magumu na hatari. Wanasayansi walikumbana na miteremko mikali, mvua za mara kwa mara, milima yenye miamba na hata matetemeko ya ardhi. Dkt. Kempton alielezea kukutana na nyoka wenye sumu, minyoo wanaonyonya damu, na magumu mbalimbali. Walipofika sehemu za juu zaidi, timu iligundua eneo hilo linakazi wanyama wengi wapya kisayansi. Dkt. Leonidas-Romanos Davranoglou, mtaalamu wa wadudu, alielezea jinsi walivyokuwa wakigundua spishi mpya mara kwa mara. Licha ya kuvunjika mkono mapema kwenye safari, aliendelea kukusanya sampuli na kuthibitisha spishi mpya kadhaa za wadudu na ujio wa kamba mti mpya. Pia waliibua mapango ambayo hayajawahi kufahamika. Mwanaharakati wa uhifadhi Gison Morib alisisitiza upekee na utakatifu wa Milima ya Cyclops, akisisitiza umuhimu wa kulinda mazingira hayo tajiri kiasili. Timu ya Oxford ilishirikiana kwa karibu na jamii za wenyeji wa Papua, wakiheshimu mila na desturi kama kutoingia maeneo fulani takatifu na kupita kimya kimya kwenye maeneo mengine. Katika mila za wenyeji, echidna hutumika kama sehemu ya utatuzi wa migogoro: pale mzozo unapozuka, pande mbili hupeana jukumu la kutafuta echidna na marlin – safari ambazo huchukua miaka mingi na hivyo kuleta amani. Licha ya kuwa katika hatari kubwa ya kutoweka, echidna wa Attenborough hana ulinzi wa kisheria nchini Indonesia, na kidogo kinajulikana kuhusu idadi au uendelevu wake. Wanasayansi wanatumai kuwa ugunduzi wao, pamoja na spishi zingine mpya, utawashawishi kuwepo kwa ulinzi rasmi. Eneo kubwa bado halijachunguzwa, hivyo kuna uwezekano wa kugundua zaidi viumbe ‘fossili hai’ kama hao.

article_content: Federal authorities have determined there is not enough evidence to pursue civil rights charges against Darren Wilson, the Ferguson police officer involved in Michael Brown’s fatal shooting. Attorney General Eric Holder still needs to make an official statement before his expected departure, but sources reveal that Justice Department prosecutors do not recommend charges. The decision has disappointed many in the Ferguson community and Brown’s family, who viewed the federal investigation as a potential path to justice. St. Louis alderman Antonio French, who lives near Ferguson, noted that people wanted to see the evidence tested publicly in court. Legal experts point out that it is difficult to bring federal civil rights cases due to the high threshold for prosecution. CNN legal analyst Jeffrey Toobin remarked that after state prosecution fails, federal charges are rarely brought. Holder previously acknowledged the tough legal standards required for federal civil rights cases. Some community members had hoped for a more aggressive approach from the Justice Department, especially after Holder’s personal engagement with Ferguson residents. Benjamin Crump, the Brown family’s attorney, had expressed skepticism about the chances for federal charges, given the demanding legal criteria. Attorney Areva Martin explained there is general confusion about the use of hate crime statutes, and legal analysts noted the investigation involved looking for concrete evidence of racial hostility. Proving intent to willfully violate civil rights or an intent to kill is a major hurdle. Nonetheless, the Brown family may still pursue a civil lawsuit against Wilson and the Ferguson Police Department. Federal law provides a path for families to seek damages for violations of constitutional rights, but such civil cases are also challenging. Meanwhile, the Justice Department continues a broader investigation into the Ferguson Police Department, focusing on potential civil rights violations, use of force, and treatment of minorities, with the goal of recommending reforms. Darren Wilson resigned from his role as a police officer last November.

Mwanasheria Mkuu Eric Holder bado anahitaji kutoa tamko rasmi kabla hajaondoka, lakini vyanzo vimebainisha kwamba waendesha mashtaka wa Wizara ya Sheria hawapendekezi mashitaka hayo. Uamuzi huu umewavunja moyo wengi katika jamii ya Ferguson na familia ya Brown, waliotarajia uchunguzi wa shirikisho kama njia ya kupata haki. Diwani wa St. Louis, Antonio French, ambaye anaishi karibu na Ferguson, alisema watu walitaka kuona ushahidi ukichunguzwa wazi mahakamani. Wataalamu wa sheria wanasema ni vigumu sana kufungua mashitaka ya haki za kiraia ya shirikisho kutokana na viwango vya juu vinavyohitajika kisheria. Mchambuzi wa sheria wa CNN, Jeffrey Toobin, alisema kwamba ikishindikana mashitaka katika mahakama za serikali, ni nadra shirikisho kufungua mashtaka. Holder hapo awali alikiri ugumu wa viwango vinavyotakiwa na mashitaka ya haki za kiraia shirikisho. Baadhi ya wanajamii walikuwa na matumaini kwamba Wizara ya Sheria ingetenda kwa ujasiri zaidi, hasa baada ya Holder kuzungumza na wakazi wa Ferguson ana kwa ana. Benjamin Crump, wakili wa familia ya Brown, alikuwa tayari ameonyesha mashaka juu ya uwezekano wa mashitaka ya shirikisho, kutokana na vigezo vigumu vya kisheria. Mwanasheria Areva Martin alieleza kuna mkanganyiko juu ya matumizi ya sheria ya uhalifu wa chuki, na wachambuzi wa sheria walibainisha uchunguzi ulilenga kutafuta dalili za uhasama wa kibaguzi. Kuthibitisha dhamira ya kukiuka haki za kiraia na nia ya kumdhuru mtu ni jambo gumu kisheria. Pamoja na hayo, familia ya Brown bado inaweza kuwasilisha kesi ya madai dhidi ya Wilson na Idara ya Polisi ya Ferguson. Sheria ya shirikisho inaruhusu familia kudai fidia kwa ukiukwaji wa haki za kikatiba, lakini kesi hizi pia ni changamoto. Wakati huo huo, Wizara ya Sheria inaendelea na uchunguzi wake mpana wa Idara ya Polisi ya Ferguson, ikichunguza vitendo dhidi ya walio wachache, matumizi ya nguvu, na uendeshaji kwa ujumla; lengo ni kutoa mapendekezo ya marekebisho. Darren Wilson alijiuzulu kuwa afisa wa polisi Novemba iliyopita.

article_content: Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has called on Muslim countries that maintain political ties with Israel to suspend those relations for a limited time, according to state media. His request follows his earlier recommendation for Islamic nations to stop exporting oil and food to Israel. Khamenei noted that although some Islamic governments have condemned Israel’s actions, others have stayed silent, which he considers unacceptable. He reiterated that a key responsibility for Islamic countries is to sever Israel's access to energy and goods. "Islamic governments should at least suspend political ties with Israel, even temporarily," he said. On November 11, a joint summit between the Organisation for Islamic Cooperation and the Arab League was held in Saudi Arabia. Despite calls from Iran's President Ebrahim Raisi, member states did not agree to broad sanctions against Israel. Khamenei made his remarks while attending an event highlighting recent advances by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ Aerospace Force, including the presentation of the Fattah 2—a new version of Iran’s hypersonic missile. Earlier in June, Iran revealed what it said was its first domestically-manufactured hypersonic ballistic missile, claiming it could evade the advanced anti-missile systems used by the United States and Israel.

Ombi lake linakuja baada ya kutoa wito kwa mataifa ya Kiislamu kusitisha usafirishaji wa mafuta na chakula kwenda Israel. Khamenei amesema kuwa ingawa baadhi ya serikali za Kiislamu zimeilaani Israel hadharani, nyingine zimebaki kimya, jambo analosema halikubaliki. Amerejea kusema kuwa jukumu kuu la nchi za Kiislamu ni kukatiza upatikanaji wa nishati na bidhaa kwa Israel. "Serikali za Kiislamu zinapaswa angalau kusitisha uhusiano wa kisiasa na Israel, hata kama ni kwa muda mfupi," alisema. Novemba 11, mkutano wa pamoja kati ya Umoja wa Ushirikiano wa Kiislamu na Jumuiya ya Kiarabu ulifanyika Saudi Arabia. Licha ya mwito wa Rais wa Iran Ebrahim Raisi, nchi wanachama hazikukubaliana kuweka vikwazo vikubwa dhidi ya Israel. Khamenei alitoa matamshi haya alipohudhuria hafla iliyokuwa ikionyesha mafanikio mapya ya Kikosi cha Anga cha Jeshi la Walinzi wa Mapinduzi ya Kiislamu, pamoja na uwasilishaji wa Fattah 2—toleo jipya la kombora la hypersonic la Iran. Mapema mwezi Juni, Iran ilizindua kile ilichosema ni kombora lake la kwanza la hypersonic lililotengenezwa nchini, ikidai lina uwezo wa kukwepa mifumo ya ulinzi ya makombora ya kisasa inayotumiwa na Marekani na Israel.

article_content: U.S. Representative Henry Cuellar, a Democrat from Texas, was carjacked by three armed individuals on Monday night in Washington, D.C., according to a statement from his office. The incident took place as Cuellar was parking his car in the Navy Yard area, near the intersection of New Jersey Avenue and K Street SE, about a mile from the U.S. Capitol. His chief of staff, Jacob Hochberg, reported that while Cuellar’s vehicle was stolen, the Congressman was not harmed during the encounter and is cooperating with local law enforcement. Police have since recovered his car. This event marks the second assault on a member of Congress in Washington, D.C. this year. In February, Democratic Representative Angie Craig of Minnesota was attacked in her apartment building, sustaining bruises but avoiding serious injury. Her chief of staff stated that Craig’s attack did not appear to be politically motivated. In June, Kendrid Khalil Hamlin, 26, pleaded guilty to charges of assaulting Rep. Craig and law enforcement officers in connection with that incident. Hamlin was also accused of assaulting two officers as they tried to arrest him on the same day.

Tukio hilo lilitokea wakati Cuellar alikuwa akipaki gari lake katika eneo la Navy Yard, karibu na makutano ya New Jersey Avenue na K Street SE, takriban maili moja kutoka Jengo la Bunge la Marekani (Capitol). Mkuu wa wafanyakazi wake, Jacob Hochberg, aliripoti kwamba ingawa gari la Cuellar liliibwa, Mbunge huyo hakuumizwa na anashirikiana na polisi wa eneo hilo. Polisi wamepata gari lake. Tukio hili ni la pili mwaka huu ambapo Mbunge wa Marekani anashambuliwa jijini Washington, D.C. Mnamo Februari, Mwakilishi wa Kidemokrasia Angie Craig kutoka Minnesota alivamiwa kwenye jengo lake la makazi, akipata majeraha ya kuchubuka lakini bila majeraha makubwa. Mkuu wa wafanyakazi wake alisema shambulio hilo halikuonekana kuwa la kisiasa. Juni, Kendrid Khalil Hamlin, mwenye umri wa miaka 26, alikiri makosa ya kumshambulia Craig na maafisa wa polisi kuhusu tukio hilo. Hamlin pia alishtakiwa kwa kuwashambulia maafisa wawili wa polisi walipojaribu kumkamata siku hiyo hiyo.

article_content: In Bolivia, scientists have discovered ancient settlements dating back 10,000 years, now identified as the oldest archaeological site found in the Amazon basin. This breakthrough reshapes the understanding of early habitation in the region, which experts previously thought was sparsely populated due to tough living conditions. The team, including archaeologists from the University of Bern in Switzerland, studied elevated landforms called 'forest islands.' Their research revealed that three of these mounds were actually shell middens—heaps of discarded snail shells, animal bones, and charcoal left by early Holocene people. The middens display different layers: the base consists mainly of snail shells, while upper layers contain pottery fragments, bone tools, and occasional human remains, divided by a band of burnt clay. Radiocarbon tests indicate these mounds built up over around 6,000 years of ongoing human activity. Dr. Umberto Lombardo explained that these sites provide insights into how people interacted with their environment in the Bolivian Amazon over millennia. Researchers think the settlements were later abandoned when the local climate became wetter.
translated_content: Wanasayansi nchini Bolivia wamegundua makazi ya kale yaliyokadiriwa kuwa na umri wa miaka 10,000, na sasa yanachukuliwa kuwa maeneo ya akiolojia ya zamani zaidi kuwahi kupatikana kwenye bonde la Amazon. Uvumbuzi huu umepinga imani ya awali kwamba eneo hilo lilikuwa na watu wachache kwa sababu ya mazingira magumu. Timu iliyohusisha wanaakiolojia kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Bern, Uswisi, ilichunguza maeneo yaliyoinuka ya ardhi yanayoitwa 'visiwa vya msitu.' Utafiti wao ulionyesha kuwa matuta matatu kati ya hayo ndiyo yaliokuwa mabaki ya maganda ya minago, mifupa ya wanyama na makaa ya mawe yaliyokusanywa na watu wa kipindi cha Holocene ya awali. Tabaka za hayo matuta zinaonyesha safu ya chini yenye maganda mengi ya minago na safu ya juu ikiwa na vipande vya vyombo vya udongo, zana za mifupa na mifupa ya binadamu kwa nadra, vikitenganishwa na tabaka la udongo ulioungua. Uchanganuzi wa mionzi ya kaboni ulithibitisha kwamba matuta haya yaliongezeka kwa zaidi ya miaka 6,000 ya shughuli za binadamu. Dkt. Umberto Lombardo alisema maeneo haya yanaonyesha namna watu walivyoishi na mazingira ya Amazon ya Bolivia kwa maelfu ya miaka. Wanasayansi wanaamini baadaye makazi hayo yalitelekezwa kutokana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa kwenda kuwa na unyevu zaidi.

article_content: Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt is facing significant criticism from senior doctors after his decision to downgrade Lewisham Hospital’s highly regarded Accident & Emergency (A&E) department in South-East London. Senior GPs have threatened to resign from executive positions after Mr Hunt, last Thursday, chose to turn Lewisham’s A&E—which treats 115,000 patients annually—into an urgent care centre, despite strong opposition from local doctors. This change means that patients with the most serious conditions will now be taken to other hospitals, as government funding is redirected from Lewisham to support a nearby NHS Trust facing financial difficulties. There is now uncertainty among doctors and hospital managers about which services will remain at Lewisham, and local campaigners and Lewisham Council are considering a judicial review of the decision. Seven GPs on the executive board of the local Clinical Commissioning Group (CCG), representing 170 family doctors, are reportedly reconsidering their positions, stating that their opposition was not taken into account by the Health Secretary. Dr. Helen Tattersfield, chairwoman of Lewisham CCG, expressed frustration: 'If we on the CCG board can’t influence crucial decisions like this, it becomes impossible for us to fulfill our mandate. Stepping down is being seriously considered.' She added that without control over how patients access hospital services, managing the CCG’s budget would be extremely challenging. Board members are unwilling to lead the organization into failure. Lewisham Council and local activists, with support from Shadow Health Secretary Andy Burnham, have criticized the decision, arguing it disregards the voices of both doctors and residents. A spokeswoman for Jeremy Hunt stated that changing services at the trust is 'perfectly legal' and aims to protect the clinical interests of patients in South-East London while also relieving historic financial debt so funds can be used for high-quality care.

Madaktari wa familia wakuu wameonya kujiuzulu nafasi zao za uongozi baada ya Bw. Hunt, Alhamisi iliyopita, kuamua kubadilisha A&E ya Lewisham—ambapo wagonjwa 115,000 hutibiwa kila mwaka—kuwa kituo cha huduma ya haraka, licha ya upinzani mkubwa kutoka kwa madaktari wa eneo hilo. Mabadiliko haya yana maana kwamba wagonjwa wenye hali mbaya zaidi sasa watahamishwa hadi hospitali zingine, huku fedha za serikali zikielekezwa kutoka Lewisham kwenda kusaidia NHS Trust ya jirani inayokabiliwa na changamoto za kifedha. Kwa sasa kuna sintofahamu miongoni mwa madaktari na wasimamizi wa hospitali kuhusu huduma gani zitasalia Lewisham, na wanaharakati wa eneo hilo pamoja na Baraza la Lewisham wanazingatia kufungua kesi mahakamani kupinga uamuzi huu. Madaktari saba wa familia walioko kwenye bodi ya utendaji ya Clinical Commissioning Group (CCG) ya eneo hilo, wanaowakilisha madaktari wa familia 170, wamesemekana kufikiria kujiuzulu wakionyesha kuwa maoni yao hayakuzingatiwa na Waziri wa Afya. Helen Tattersfield, mwenyekiti wa Lewisham CCG, alieleza kukatishwa tamaa: 'Ikiwa sisi kwenye bodi ya CCG hatuwezi kuhifadhi ushawishi wetu kwenye maamuzi muhimu kama haya, inakuwa vigumu kutekeleza jukumu letu. article_content: An intense blast of Arctic air, known as a 'polar vortex,' is gripping North America, plunging temperatures to levels not seen in decades and creating massive challenges across the U.S. and Canada. The deep freeze has forced the U.S. Coast Guard to deploy ice-breaking ships 24/7 to keep vital shipping routes open, particularly in the Great Lakes region. These ships, including the USCGC Bristol Bay, are working along key waterways such as the St. Mary’s River and Soo Locks, carving out paths through ice that is up to a foot thick in some places. This unprecedented cold has caused widespread disruptions. Flights are grounded, trains and buses are experiencing delays or cancellations, and roads have become hazardous or impassable. Cities like Chicago are experiencing their coldest days in years—temperatures have dropped as low as minus 16 degrees Fahrenheit, with wind chills plunging to negative 50. Schools and businesses are closing for multiple days, and officials are urging extra caution as public transportation and emergency services struggle to cope. News outlets report that around 187 million people are feeling the effects of the polar vortex, and forecasters predict that more than 70 daily record lows could be broken from the Midwest to the Northeast. In Ohio, cities like Toledo are facing their coldest mornings in nearly 20 years. Multiple accidents have occurred as a result of the dangerous conditions—Chicago’s Metra commuter rail had an accident injuring 14 passengers, while an Amtrak train was stranded for over eight hours in southern Michigan. In Illinois, nearly 400 vehicles were trapped overnight in snowy conditions, and the Southern Illinois University's basketball team ended up sleeping on a church floor after their team bus got stuck. As icy winds continue to blow, both big cities and rural areas are enduring historic cold, with authorities and emergency responders stretched to their limits.

Baridi kali imesababisha Walinzi wa Pwani wa Marekani kutumia meli maalum za kuvunja barafu usiku na mchana ili kuweka njia muhimu za usafirishaji wazi, hasa katika eneo la Maziwa Makuu. Meli hizi, ikiwemo USCGC Bristol Bay, zinafanya kazi kwenye maeneo muhimu kama Mto St. Mary’s na Soo Locks, zikichonga njia kupitia barafu inayoweza kufikia futi moja kwa unene. Baridi hii ya ajabu imesababisha usumbufu mkubwa. Ndege zimesimamishwa, treni na mabasi zimechelewa au kuzuiwa kusafiri, na barabara zimekuwa hatarishi au hazipitiki. Majiji kama Chicago yanapata siku zao za baridi kali zaidi kwa miaka mingi—joto limefikia hadi nyuzi pungufu 16 za Fahrenheit, na hisia ya upepo (wind chill) ikishuka hadi pungufu ya 50. Shule na biashara zimefungwa kwa siku kadhaa, na maafisa wanatoa tahadhari zaidi huku huduma za umma na za dharura zikikabiliwa na changamoto nyingi. Vyombo vya habari vinaripoti takriban watu milioni 187 wanahisi athari za polar vortex, na wataalamu wa hali ya hewa wanabashiri zaidi ya rekodi 70 za viwango vya chini vya joto zinaweza kuvunjwa kutoka Midwest hadi Kaskazini Mashariki. Katika Ohio, majiji kama Toledo yanakabiliwa na asubuhi baridi kuliko zote ndani ya karibu miaka 20. Ajali kadhaa zimetokea kutokana na hali hizi mbaya—treni ya abiria ya Metra mjini Chicago ilipata ajali na kuwajeruhi abiria 14, wakati treni ya Amtrak ilikwama kwa zaidi ya saa nane kusini mwa Michigan. Nchini Illinois, karibu magari 400 yalikwama usiku kucha kwenye barabara zilizojaa theluji, na timu ya mpira wa kikapu ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kusini mwa Illinois ililazimika kulala kanisani baada ya basi lao kukwama kwenye theluji. Upepo mkali unaendelea kuvuma, na majiji pamoja na maeneo ya vijijini wote wanashuhudia baridi ya kihistoria, huku mamlaka na huduma za dharura zikiwa na mzigo mkubwa.

article_content:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reportedly using the conflict in Gaza to push the United States toward a direct confrontation with Iran. While global media attention remains focused on the situation in Gaza, there are increasing reports of confrontations between Shia militias in Syria and Iraq and American forces stationed there. Additionally, there are claims—often not widely reported—of rising numbers of American casualties being treated in regional hospitals, raising concerns about possible further escalation.

Since the start of the recent Gaza conflict, the international community has found reassurances in the public statements of Hassan Nasrallah, leader of Lebanon’s Iran-backed Hezbollah, who has called for de-escalation and clarified that he does not seek immediate direct engagement with Israel or its allies. However, his repeated statements suggest mounting pressure in the region that could quickly spiral out of control.

The ongoing humanitarian crisis in Gaza is widely regarded as one of the gravest since World War II, with collective punishment of 2.3 million people resulting in over 14,000 deaths, including more than 5,000 children. Global leaders, particularly from the G7, have struggled to advocate for a full ceasefire, instead supporting only brief and limited humanitarian pauses. Although a temporary four-day truce was reached after 47 days, the US and its allies continued to endorse Israel’s intent to resume military operations once the pause ended.

By offering Israel broad freedom to pursue its military objectives in Gaza, with limited regard for international law and the rights of Palestinians, these nations have undermined their own claims as advocates for a rules-based international order. This position is partially attributed to Netanyahu’s influence over Western leaders, framing the events of October 7 as comparable to the Holocaust and presenting Hamas as akin to ISIS. This rhetoric, invoking the memory of the Holocaust, has discouraged criticism both within Israel and internationally.

The article argues that likening Hamas to ISIS oversimplifies the situation, as Hamas, while a militant group, is rooted in the aspirations of Palestinians for self-determination. The author suggests that even if current Hamas members were eliminated—a scenario likely resulting in further humanitarian disaster—their ideology would persist among future generations.

Iran, meanwhile, has shown reluctance to enter direct confrontation with the US, as seen in its minimal response to the assassination of General Qasem Soleimani in 2020 and subsequent military incidents. Instead, Iran relies on regional proxy groups to maintain controlled escalation without provoking direct war.

Hezbollah, the most influential of Iran’s proxies, is hesitant to become strongly involved due to its reduced regional standing and Lebanon’s fragile internal situation. The group has sought to avoid dragging Lebanon into a wider conflict, particularly considering the potential economic collapse. Recent agreements on resources, such as the Karish gas field, further demonstrate Hezbollah’s pragmatism.

Despite the desire of Iran and Hezbollah to avoid direct confrontation with the US, the article contends that Netanyahu is determined to ensure his political survival, employing religious rhetoric and emergency powers to unite Israeli society and suppress internal dissent. Repeated provocations and the lack of strong US intervention to de-escalate raise the risk of a wider regional conflict that could involve the US and Iran directly.

There is growing opposition among populations in the Arab world and the Global South to US support for Israel’s military actions in Gaza. In this volatile environment, the article warns that escalation engineered by Israel could instigate a direct US-Iran confrontation, prompting questions about the US’s willingness to become further entangled in prolonged Middle East conflicts.

The views expressed are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera's editorial stance.

Waziri Mkuu wa Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, anaripotiwa kutumia mgogoro wa Gaza kusukuma Marekani kukabiliana moja kwa moja na Iran. Wakati vyombo vya habari vya kimataifa vikiendelea kuangazia hali ya Gaza, kuna ripoti za ongezeko la mapigano kati ya wanamgambo wa Kishia nchini Syria na Iraq na wanajeshi wa Marekani walioko maeneo hayo. Pia, kuna madai—yaliyopata uangalizi mdogo—kwamba idadi ya majeruhi wa Marekani wanaotibiwa hospitalini imeongezeka, na hivyo kuzua hofu ya kuongezeka kwa mzozo.

Tangu kuanza kwa mgogoro wa hivi karibuni Gaza, jumuiya ya kimataifa imepata afueni kutokana na matamko ya umma ya Hassan Nasrallah, kiongozi wa Hezbollah nchini Lebanon inayoungwa mkono na Iran, ambaye ametoa wito wa kuzuia kuzuka kwa vita na kubainisha kwamba hauvutii kushiriki mapigano ya moja kwa moja na Israel au washirika wake kwa sasa. Hata hivyo, matamshi yake ya mara kwa mara yanaonesha kuwa shinikizo limeongezeka na hali inaweza kuchacha ghafla.

Mgogoro unaoendelea wa kibinadamu Gaza umeelezwa kuwa kati ya mikubwa zaidi tangu Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia, huku adhabu ya pamoja dhidi ya watu milioni 2.3 ikisababisha vifo vya zaidi ya watu 14,000 wakiwemo zaidi ya watoto 5,000. Viongozi wa dunia, hasa wa G7, wamekuwa na uoga kutamka neno sitisho la mapigano, badala yake wakisimamia mapumziko mafupi ya kibinadamu. Hata baada ya kuwepo kwa makubaliano ya siku nne ya kusitisha mapigano baada ya siku 47, Marekani na washirika wake waliendelea kuunga mkono mpango wa Israel kuendeleza operesheni za kijeshi mara sitisho litakapomalizika.

Kwa kuipa Israel uhuru mpana kutekeleza malengo yake ya kijeshi Gaza bila kujali sana sheria za kimataifa na haki za Wapalestina, mataifa haya yamepunguza hadhi yao kama walinzi wa utaratibu wa kimataifa. Hali hii inahusishwa na ushawishi wa Netanyahu kwa viongozi wa Magharibi, akikadiria matukio ya Oktoba 7 sawa na Holocaust na kuonesha kwamba Hamas ni kama ISIS. Kauli hizi, zinazotumia kumbukumbu ya Holocaust, zimepunguza ukosoaji ndani na nje ya Israeli.

Makala inahoji kwamba kuifananisha Hamas na ISIS kunarahisisha mambo kupita kiasi, kwani Hamas, licha ya kuwa kundi la wapiganaji, limejengwa juu ya matarajio ya Wapalestina kujitawala. Mwandishi anabainisha kwamba hata kama wapiganaji wa sasa wa Hamas wangeondolewa—hatua ambayo inaweza kuleta maafa zaidi—itikadi yao itaendelea kuishi vizazi na vizazi.

Iran, upande mwingine, imeonyesha kutotaka kuingia vitani moja kwa moja na Marekani, kama inavyoonekana kwenye majibu yake madogo baada ya kuuawa kwa Jenerali Qasem Soleimani mwaka 2020 na matukio mengine ya kijeshi. Badala yake, Iran inategemea makundi ya wapiganaji yenye uhusiano nayo kudhibiti hali bila kusababisha vita kubwa.

Hezbollah, kundi lenye ushawishi mkubwa kati ya washirika wa Iran, linaepusha kujihusisha sana kutokana na kupoteza ushawishi na hali tete ya ndani nchini Lebanon. Lengo likiwa kuepusha nchi hiyo kuingia kwenye vita vikubwa zaidi, hasa kwa kuhofia anguko la kiuchumi. Makubaliano ya gesi ya Karish, kwa mfano, yanaonesha mtazamo wa kimkakati wa Hezbollah kutokana na changamoto za kisiasa na kiuchumi za Lebanon.

Pamoja na kwamba Iran na Hezbollah hawataki mgogoro wa moja kwa moja na Marekani, makala inaeleza kuwa Netanyahu anaonekana kupigania uhai wake wa kisiasa, akitumia hoja za kidini na sheria za dharura kuiunganisha jamii ya Israel na kupunguza sauti za upinzani. Uchokozi wa mara kwa mara na kutokuwepo kwa shinikizo kali la Marekani kusitisha mapigano kunaongeza uwezekano wa vita vikubwa zaidi ambavyo vinaweza kuihusisha Marekani na Iran.

Upinzani miongoni mwa Waarabu na mataifa ya Kusini mwa Dunia dhidi ya msaada wa Marekani kwa Israel Gaza unaongezeka. Katika mazingira haya hatarishi, makala inaonya kwamba mpango wa kutanua mgogoro unaweza kuibua mapambano ya moja kwa moja kati ya Marekani na Iran, na hiyo inaibua maswali kama Marekani iko tayari kujihusisha tena na migogoro ya muda mrefu ya Mashariki ya Kati.

Maoni yaliyotolewa ni ya mwandishi na hayaakisi msimamo rasmi wa Al Jazeera.

The Irish government has ordered a recall of all pork products traced to pigs slaughtered in Ireland after laboratory tests found dioxins in animal feed and pork fat samples. Preliminary evidence from the Food Safety Authority of Ireland (FSAI) indicates the contamination likely began in September. The FSAI has advised consumers not to eat Irish pork and bacon products until further notice, while authorities work to determine the scale of the issue.

Dioxins are environmental pollutants commonly found in industrial waste. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency states that over 95 percent of human dioxin exposure comes from eating animal fats. Food dioxin levels are regulated for consumer safety.

Dr. Tony Holohan, Ireland’s Chief Medical Officer, told the UK Press Association that dioxins can affect the nervous system and liver, but are mainly dangerous after long-term exposure. Experts suspect that a feed ingredient provided by one company to over 40 farms is likely responsible for the contamination. Tests revealed polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs)—a type of dioxin-like chemical—at levels 80 to 200 times above the acceptable safety limit.

Ushahidi wa awali kutoka Mamlaka ya Usalama wa Chakula ya Ireland (FSAI) unaonyesha uchafuzi huo huenda ulianza Septemba. FSAI imewashauri wananchi wasile bidhaa za nguruwe na bacon ya Ireland hadi taarifa zaidi itakapotolewa huku mamlaka zikichunguza ukubwa wa tatizo hilo.

Wataalamu wanashuku kiunge cha chakula cha mifugo kutoka kampuni moja kwa zaidi ya mashamba 40 ndicho chanzo cha uchafuzi huu. Vipimo vilionyesha polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs)—kemikali inayofanana na dioxin—ikiwa kwenye viwango vya juu mara 80 hadi 200 zaidi ya kiwango salama kinachokubalika.

article_content: NEW DELHI: The Indian government is once again facing a 'problem of plenty' with rice stocks, just five months after it stopped selling rice from its buffer stock to state governments to help control prices. Strong paddy procurement during the current kharif marketing season and limited open market sales from the Food Corporation of India (FCI) have resulted in the FCI potentially holding over twice the required buffer stock by the end of the procurement season, according to estimates. Officials say that managing this growing surplus—especially of fortified rice—will require targeted measures to offload the grains. They note that the upcoming elections could present an opportunity to distribute more foodgrain to the poor. Sources told TOI that the Centre's June decision to stop states from purchasing rice from FCI under the Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS), along with pausing sales to grain-based ethanol plants, have contributed to the surplus. Since e-auctions started in July, FCI has sold only about one lakh tonne in the open market, making the target of selling 25 lakh tonnes to bulk buyers by next March seem unlikely. Government data shows FCI and state agencies have procured about 170 lakh tonnes so far this season, which began last month. Officials expect total procurement to exceed 500 lakh tonnes, as procurement in states like Odisha and Jharkhand is still pending. Currently, FCI holds 194 lakh tonnes of rice, while the buffer requirement for January 1 is 76 lakh tonnes. This does not include 230 tonnes still due from millers. The government estimates that procurement during the upcoming Rabi season will be another 50-60 lakh tonnes. Officials add that FCI's opening rice stock on October 1 was 221 lakh tonnes, more than twice the required buffer. Strong procurement this season will expand stocks even further. According to government estimates, the Centre needs about 400 lakh tonnes of rice each year to meet the requirements of Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana, which provides nearly 81 crore people with five kilograms of foodgrain every month.

article_content: An uneasy calm returned to major cities in Nigeria on Tuesday, after two major labor unions suspended a nationwide strike over the government's removal of the fuel subsidy. The Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) and Trade Union Congress (TUC) halted the strikes following President Goodluck Jonathan’s announcement of a reduced fuel price on Monday. In Lagos, traffic resumed but was lighter than usual, and a strong military presence remained, with checkpoints on main roads and bridges. Many fuel stations now displayed a government-set price of 97 naira (about 60 cents) per liter—down from the post-subsidy price of 141 naira (86 cents). The demonstrations began earlier in January when fuel prices spiked after removal of the subsidy, jumping from about 65 naira (40 cents). Jonathan said the new lower price was aimed at easing the hardships Nigerians were experiencing. Amid public concerns about widespread corruption, the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) was ordered to investigate fraud in fuel imports and sales. The NLC and TUC urged people to end protests, but it was unclear if everyone would accept the new price or cease further actions. The Joint Action Front (JAF) criticized the strike’s suspension and called for continued protests until fuel prices return to previous levels. JAF condemned Inspector General of Police Hafiz Ringim's warnings about arresting protestors, especially those advocating for government change. Secretary Abiodun Aremu called Ringim’s statement 'uncivilized and provocative' and accused authorities of attempting to suppress public assembly and free expression. Unions said they would keep consulting with the public about future strike action. On Tuesday, Lagos saw no visible protestors, likely due to police warnings. Security forces checked vehicles throughout the city, and soldiers remained at popular protest locations. Lagos State Governor Babatunde Fashola, on Monday, called for withdrawing soldiers from the streets, arguing the protests were mostly peaceful and lawful. Fashola stated, 'This is not a matter for the military,' and encouraged open debate on political and economic issues to strengthen democracy. Eyewitnesses reported police and soldiers blocking protestors from gathering on Monday; no violence was confirmed. Nationwide demonstrations erupted after Jonathan’s January 1 announcement ending the fuel subsidy—a benefit many Nigerians cherished in the oil-rich but poor nation. The government says removing the subsidy will free up funds to improve the economy and infrastructure, but Nigerians remain skeptical. Ending the subsidy caused petrol and goods prices to soar, fueling frustrations about corruption and economic mismanagement. Nigeria, one of the world's top oil exporters, is regularly ranked among the most corrupt countries globally.

Chama cha Wafanyakazi Nigeria (NLC) na Shirikisho la Vyama vya Wafanyakazi (TUC) walisitisha mgomo baada ya Rais Goodluck Jonathan kutangaza bei mpya ya mafuta iliyopunguzwa Jumatatu. Katika Lagos, magari yalirejea barabarani lakini trafiki ilikuwa ndogo kuliko kawaida, huku majeshi yakiendelea kuwepo kwa wingi, na vizuizi vikuu vikiwekwa kwenye barabara na madaraja makuu. Vituo vingi vya mafuta sasa vinaonyesha bei mpya ya serikali ya naira 97 (takriban senti 60 za Marekani) kwa lita—chini kutoka naira 141 (senti 86) baada ya kuondolewa ruzuku. Maandamano yalianza mapema Januari baada ya bei ya mafuta kuruka kutokana na kuondolewa kwa ruzuku, ikipanda kutoka takriban naira 65 (senti 40). Jonathan alisema kuwa punguzo hili la bei ni kutuliza machungu ambayo WaNigerian wanapitia. Kufuatia wasiwasi wa umma kuhusu ufisadi uliokithiri, Tume ya Kudhibiti Uhalifu wa Kiuchumi na Kifedha (EFCC) iliagizwa kuchunguza udanganyifu kwenye uagizaji na uuzaji wa mafuta. NLC na TUC waliwataka watu kusitisha maandamano, lakini haikuwa wazi kama wote watakubali bei mpya au kusitisha hatua zaidi. Umoja wa Joint Action Front (JAF) ulipinga kusimamishwa kwa mgomo huo na kuitaka jamii kuendelea na maandamano hadi bei ya mafuta irejee kama awali. JAF ililaani onyo la Inspekta Mkuu wa Polisi Hafiz Ringim kuhusu kuwakamata waandamanaji, hasa wanaotaka mabadiliko serikalini. Katibu Abiodun Aremu aliita kauli ya Ringim kuwa 'isiyo na ustaarabu na kuchokoza' na aliishutumu serikali kwa kujaribu kukandamiza haki za wananchi kukutana na kutoa maoni. Vyama vya wafanyakazi vimesema vitaendelea kuzungumza na umma kuhusu hatua za baadaye za mgomo. Jumanne, mji wa Lagos haukuwa na waandamanaji walionekana wazi, huenda kutokana na onyo la polisi. Vikosi vya usalama viliendelea kukagua magari na wanajeshi walibaki kwenye maeneo maarufu ya maandamano. Gavana wa Jimbo la Lagos Babatunde Fashola, Jumatatu alitaka wanajeshi waondolewe barabarani, akisema maandamano yalikuwa kwa kiasi kikubwa ya amani na halali. Fashola alisema, 'Hili si suala la jeshi,' na akapendekeza mijadala ya wazi kuhusu masuala ya kisiasa na kiuchumi ili kuimarisha demokrasia. Mashuhuda walisema polisi na wanajeshi walizuia waandamanaji kukusanyika Jumatatu; hakuna vurugu iliyothibitishwa. Maandamano kote nchini yalianza baada ya Rais Jonathan kutangaza Januari 1 kuondoa ruzuku ya mafuta—faida ambayo wengi wa Nigeria walithamini katika taifa lenye utajiri wa mafuta lakini masikini. Serikali inadai kuondoa ruzuku kutatoa fedha za kuboresha uchumi na miundombinu, lakini WaNigerian wengi hawana imani. Kuondolewa kwa ruzuku kulisababisha ongezeko kubwa la bei ya mafuta na bidhaa nyingine, na kuongeza hasira kuhusu ufisadi na uongozi mbovu wa uchumi. Nigeria, mmoja wa wauzaji wakubwa wa mafuta duniani, mara kwa mara hupangwa miongoni mwa nchi zenye ufisadi mkubwa duniani.

Insiders suggest the European Union is set to decide soon on whether Barry Callebaut can officially market this chocolate for its ability to enhance blood flow and provide health benefits. If approved, the market could see products like hot chocolates and spreads advertised for their energizing and potentially passion-boosting qualities.

Angus Kennedy, a veteran in the confectionery industry, believes this natural chocolate might offer men an appealing alternative to pharmaceutical options for intimacy, owing to its potential to increase stamina and lift mood. He describes it as a major breakthrough.

Chocolate has long been linked to feelings of love, passion, and vitality. Figures like the Aztec emperor Montezuma and the infamous lover Casanova were known for their enjoyment of chocolate. In ancient South America, cocoa beans were so valued for their health and aphrodisiac properties that they even served as currency.

Scientifically, it’s suggested that high levels of flavanols and some amino acids in cocoa can boost endorphins and serotonin in the brain, leading to increased happiness, higher blood pressure and heart rate, and greater energy. These effects may underlie chocolate's reputation as an aphrodisiac.

Barry Callebaut supplies chocolate to major companies such as Cadbury and operates factories in Chester, Banbury, and St Helens in the UK. New reports show chocolate consumption is high, with 87% of men and 91% of women in the UK enjoying chocolate, indicating its widespread and increasing appeal.

article_content: Jigger infestation, caused by the chigoe flea, is a widespread but curable health issue in sub-Saharan Africa. Although not fatal, these tiny parasites burrow into people's feet and hands, leading to intense pain that can keep children from school and prevent adults from farming. The condition often brings social stigma and isolation, especially for impoverished children. Kenyan entrepreneur Stanley Kamau suffered from jiggers as a child, enduring pain and humiliation that almost caused him to quit school. He was fortunate to cure himself with insecticidal cattle dips at home, allowing him to continue his studies and later attend university in India. After successful ventures abroad, Kamau returned to Murang'a, Kenya, seeking to help his community. He was deeply moved to find that jigger infestations still prevented many villagers from working or attending school. To combat this, he established the Ahadi Kenya Trust, which started by helping four families and has since registered 2.6 million Kenyans. The organization treats jigger victims and helps break the poverty cycle by offering programs like a communal banana farm. Survivors receive seeds, fertilizer, and training to apply new agricultural techniques at home. The Trust also supports chicken, rabbit, and beekeeping initiatives, empowering survivors to build sustainable livelihoods. Understanding the challenges many rural dwellers face in accessing healthcare, Kamau developed the Mashinani (village) ambulance—a motorbike-towed bed equipped with medical and maternity kits. This innovation provides essential transport for those in remote areas without reliable means of communication or travel. Kamau emphasizes that effective healthcare must be genuinely accessible to improve lives, not just physically available.

Taarifa kuhusu miradi na jitihada za Stanley Kamau imewasilishwa kwa ufasaha na kwa heshima. Hakuna makosa yanayohitaji kufanyiwa marekebisho zaidi.

article_content: With the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) stepping back from the upcoming Telangana assembly polls, other political parties are working to attract TDP supporters. They have extended public admiration towards TDP leader N Chandrababu Naidu, who was recently released from Rajamahendravaram Central Prison after 53 days in custody. Naidu had been detained over alleged misappropriation involving the Skill Development Corporation, with reported losses exceeding Rs 300 crore to the state. Despite securing more than 3.5% of votes and two seats in the 2018 assembly elections, TDP is not participating in the current election; the reasoning remains unspecified. This absence has led BRS minister P Ajay Kumar (running from Khammam) and Congress candidate Tummala Nageswara Rao to show support for Naidu, criticize his arrest, and appeal to TDP sympathisers. Ajay Kumar described Naidu as a national leader and condemned his arrest, referencing his family's support and participation in local rallies supporting Naidu. Rao, who considers himself trained by Naidu, not only celebrated his release but visited the TDP office to join supporters and seek their votes in the coming election. Other local legislators in Khammam expressed joy over Naidu's freedom. In a related development, TDP's Telangana president Kasani Gnaneswar resigned after the party decided not to contest, leaving the state unit leaderless and its election strategy undefined. The TDP has said a decision regarding its stance for the November 30 elections will be made soon. In other news, India’s leading telecom operators have accused global tech companies like Microsoft and Amazon of bypassing telecom regulations by using platforms such as WhatsApp to send business messages, resulting in significant revenue losses for both the government and service providers. Furthermore, the Indian government has asked Apple to participate in investigations into alleged state-sponsored attempts to hack iPhones belonging to prominent public figures. Separately, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation has told the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased planes and engines can be repossessed by lessors as the airline faces bankruptcy.

Wameonyesha heshima hadharani kwa kiongozi wa TDP, N Chandrababu Naidu, ambaye hivi karibuni aliachiliwa kutoka Gereza Kuu la Rajamahendravaram baada ya siku 53 kizuizini. Naidu alikuwa akikabiliwa na tuhuma za ubadhirifu zinazohusiana na Shirika la Uendelezaji Ujuzi, zikiwa na madai ya hasara ya zaidi ya Rupia milioni 300 kwa serikali. Licha ya TDP kupata zaidi ya asilimia 3.5 ya kura na viti viwili kwenye uchaguzi wa 2018, hakitashiriki uchaguzi huu—sababu rasmi haijabainishwa. Kutokuwepo huko kumepelekea wanasiasa kama waziri wa BRS, P Ajay Kumar (anayeomba nafasi Khammam), na mgombea wa Congress, Tummala Nageswara Rao, kumuunga mkono Naidu, kukosoa kukamatwa kwake, na kuomba sapoti kutoka kwa wafuasi wa TDP. Ajay Kumar alimwelezea Naidu kama kiongozi wa kitaifa na kulaani kukamatwa kwake, akitaja jinsi familia yake ilivyomuunga mkono na kushiriki katika maandamano ya kumuunga mkono Naidu. Rao, ambaye anasema alipata mafunzo chini ya Naidu, aliungana na wafuasi wa TDP kusherehekea kuachiliwa kwa Naidu na kuwaomba kura katika uchaguzi ujao. Wabunge wengine katika eneo la Khammam pia walieleza furaha yao kuhusu kuachiliwa kwa Naidu. Vile vile, Rais wa TDP katika jimbo la Telangana, Kasani Gnaneswar, alijiuzulu baada ya chama kutangaza kutoshiriki uchaguzi, na hivyo kuacha kitengo cha jimbo bila uongozi na mkakati wake wa uchaguzi haujulikani. Pia, serikali ya India imeiomba Apple kushiriki kwenye uchunguzi wa madai ya mashambulizi ya udukuzi yaliyofadhiliwa na dola dhidi ya watumiaji mashuhuri wa iPhone. Kwa upande mwingine, Mamlaka Kuu ya Usafiri wa Anga (DGCA) imeiambia Mahakama Kuu ya Delhi kwamba ndege na injini za Go First zinazopangishwa zinaweza kurejeshwa kwa wakodishaji kutokana na upungufu wa kifedha wa shirika hilo la ndege.

article_content: Patrick Dempsey was named People magazine’s Sexiest Man Alive for 2023. The 57-year-old actor, best known as Dr. Derek 'McDreamy' Shepherd on Grey’s Anatomy, takes over the title from last year’s winner, Chris Evans. Dempsey celebrated the honor, saying it was especially meaningful at this stage of his long Hollywood career, which spans over three decades. The announcement was made on 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!'. In addition to acting in hit films such as 'Can’t Buy Me Love', 'Sweet Home Alabama', 'Transformers: Dark of the Moon', 'Bridget Jones’s Baby', and 'Enchanted', Dempsey is a seasoned race car driver. He’s raced in world-renowned events, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Rolex 24 at Daytona, and the Baja 1000. For playing Derek Shepherd, Dempsey and his fellow cast members won Screen Actors Guild Awards for Outstanding Ensemble in 2006 and 2007, while Dempsey himself took home the People’s Choice Award for Best Male TV Star in 2007 and 2008. Up next, Dempsey portrays Italian Formula One driver Piero Taruffi in Michael Mann’s upcoming biopic, 'Ferrari.' Although Hollywood is facing a strike by actors, the film was granted a special waiver so production could continue. Dempsey, passionate about this opportunity, personally contacted director Michael Mann to secure the role. Off-screen, Dempsey created the Dempsey Center in Maine in 2008, dedicated to supporting individuals and families affected by cancer, in memory of his mother, Amanda. With this new title, Dempsey joins the ranks of previous Sexiest Man Alive recipients like Paul Rudd, Michael B. Jordan, George Clooney, Brad Pitt, John Legend, Idris Elba, Chris Hemsworth, and Channing Tatum.

article_content:
Intel has introduced the 14th Generation Core desktop processors under the Raptor Lake Refresh series. This collection includes the high-performance Core i9-14900K, the robust Core i7-14700K, and the cost-effective Core i5-14600K. Marking the end of an era, these are the last CPUs featuring the longstanding Core i9, i7, i5, and i3 names. The company will adopt a streamlined naming system in future processors, aiming to make product selection simpler for consumers.

At the top of the lineup, the Core i9-14900K matches its predecessor, the i9-13900KS, by reaching a maximum core frequency of 6.0 GHz without special modifications. This achievement underscores Intel's push for greater computing speed and strengthens its position in high-end desktop performance, particularly appealing to gamers and multitaskers.

The Core i7-14700K sets itself apart by offering more cores than the previous generation: 8 performance cores, 12 efficiency cores, a turbo speed up to 5.6 GHz, and a base power draw of 125W. This combination offers a strong mix of processing power and energy efficiency for those seeking an upgrade.

Completing the series, the Core i5-14600K improves upon the older Core i5-13600K with a modest 100MHz boost to its efficiency core frequencies. Together, these advances further enhance speeds for gaming, content creation, and everyday computing tasks.

translated_content:
Intel imetambulisha kizazi cha 14 cha prosesa za mezani (desktop) zinazoitwa Raptor Lake Refresh. Mfululizo huu una Core i9-14900K yenye utendaji wa juu, Core i7-14700K yenye nguvu zaidi, na Core i5-14600K inayoendana na bajeti. Prosesa hizi ndizo za mwisho kutumia majina maarufu ya Core i9, i7, i5, na i3. Intel inapanga kubadili majina kuwa rahisi zaidi kwenye vizazi vijavyo ili kusaidia wanunuzi kuelewa kwa urahisi.

Kinara wa kundi hili ni Core i9-14900K ambayo inaweza kufikia kasi ya juu ya 6.0 GHz sawa na mtangulizi wake, i9-13900KS, bila marekebisho yoyote. Hii inaonesha juhudi za Intel kuongeza kasi na uwezo wa kompyuta, hasa kwa wale wanaopenda gaming na kazi nyingi kwa wakati moja.

Core i7-14700K inatofautiana na vizazi vilivyopita kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa ya cores: performance cores 8, efficiency cores 12, turbo speed hadi 5.6 GHz, na matumizi ya nishati ya 125W. Huu ni mchanganyiko mzuri wa nguvu na ufanisi kwa watumiaji wanaotaka kusasisha kompyuta zao.

Kwa upande mwingine, Core i5-14600K imeboreshwa zaidi kwa kuongeza kasi ya efficiency core kwa 100MHz ukilinganisha na Core i5-13600K. Maboresho haya yanasaidia kuongeza kasi na utendaji kwenye michezo ya kompyuta, utengenezaji wa maudhui, na matumizi ya kila siku.

article_content: Car sales in India are set to reach a new high this year, exceeding initial estimates by nearly 250,000 units due to strong customer demand and robust sales during the ongoing festive season, despite inflation concerns. Automakers project total sales of cars, utility vehicles, and vans to reach 4.10 to 4.17 million units in the 2023 calendar year—an 8-10% rise over 2022 and above the earlier estimate of 0-6% growth. In 2022, sales had grown by 23% to 3.79 million units. Senior executives say better-than-expected demand for premium sports utility vehicles (SUVs) is fueling this growth. Tarun Garg, chief operating officer at Hyundai Motor India, observed that demand momentum remains strong and highlights the domestic market’s resilience in the face of global uncertainty. Hyundai saw its highest-ever deliveries this Dhanteras, and industry growth is now forecast to surpass initial expectations. In the first 10 months of 2023, Indian automakers sold 3.47 million passenger vehicles, marking about a 9% increase from 3.19 million during the same period last year. New launches in the fast-growing SUV segment—like the Maruti Suzuki Fronx, Hyundai Exter, and Kia Seltos—have increased segment share to over 48% as of October 2023, compared to about 43% the prior year. Shashank Srivastava, Maruti Suzuki’s senior executive officer for marketing and sales, noted that industry sales during the festive season (Onam to Bhai Dooj) are set to exceed one million units for the first time, reflecting 18% growth over last year’s 850,000. This surge is primarily due to SUVs and MPVs now making up nearly half of all passenger vehicle sales. Between Dhanteras and Bhai Dooj, industry deliveries are expected to range from 55,000 to 57,000 vehicles—a 21% jump from 45,000 units delivered in the same period last year. Maruti Suzuki, which uses a fiscal year reporting basis, estimates Indian market sales could reach about 4.14 million units in FY24, outpacing prior projections. Kia India’s vice-president and national head of sales and marketing, Hardeep Singh Brar, stated that strong demand for vehicles above ₹7 lakh has led to increased production to reduce customer wait times, with targets to grow sales by more than 8% to 275,000 units in 2023. Although the festive season concludes with Bhai Dooj, the upcoming wedding season in North India is also anticipated to support continued demand. Elsewhere in business, India’s Income Tax Department is investigating possible unpaid taxes by Apple, Google, and Amazon’s Indian subsidiaries regarding transfer pricing; this investigation began in 2021. Indians have become the top real estate investors in Dubai’s market, while digital payments platform Razorpay plans to relocate its parent company to India, potentially incurring a $250-300 million tax charge in the US.

Maruti Suzuki, inayoripoti kwa mwaka wa fedha, inakadiria mauzo ya soko la India yatakayofikia karibu milioni 4.14 katika mwaka wa fedha 2023/24, juu kuliko makadirio ya awali. article_content: The livestock carrier Danny F II sank off Lebanon’s northern coast Thursday night during stormy weather. The United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) and the Lebanese navy launched a difficult overnight search and rescue operation. By Friday afternoon, authorities had located 42 survivors and recovered four bodies. According to the Lebanese navy, 83 people were on board when the ship went down. Survivors from various countries received medical treatment on UNIFIL ships before being brought ashore. The vessel sank approximately 12 miles from Tripoli. After receiving a distress signal on Thursday night, UNIFIL sent three ships—the Italian frigate Zeffiro, the German mine hunter Laboe, and the German supply ship Mosel—to assist in the search alongside the Lebanese navy. Reporting by CNN’s Nada Husseini.

article_content: Singapore’s Energy Market Authority (EMA) has granted conditional approval to import 1.2 gigawatts (GW) of electricity from Vietnam. This move supports Singapore’s plan to import up to 4 GW of low-carbon electricity by 2035. The approval means the project, led by Sembcorp Utilities—a subsidiary of Sembcorp Industries—has been assessed as technically and commercially viable at this stage. The news was announced by Second Minister for Trade and Industry, Tan See Leng, during the Asia Clean Energy Summit at Singapore International Energy Week. To achieve its decarbonization targets, Singapore has also approved electricity import projects from Indonesia (2 GW) and Cambodia (1 GW). These projects will use a mix of solar, hydropower, and wind energy. Because Singapore has limited domestic renewable resources, importing energy allows access to cleaner sources. Regional power grids are expected to speed up renewable energy development and support economic growth, while reducing reliance on fossil fuels. EMA is working with regional partners on electricity import trials to refine technical and regulatory frameworks. One example is the Lao PDR-Thailand-Malaysia-Singapore Power Integration Project. Since June last year, Singapore has imported up to 100 megawatts (MW) of renewable hydropower from Lao PDR via Thailand and Malaysia. Dr Tan, who is also Manpower Minister, noted that about 270 gigawatt hours (GWh) of electricity have been exported to Singapore from Lao PDR since the project began. All four countries are now discussing expanding the project, including trading at capacities above 100 MW and enabling electricity flow in all directions. This is the first initiative of its kind among ASEAN nations.

Kibali hiki kinamaanisha mradi unaoongozwa na Sembcorp Utilities—kampuni tanzu ya Sembcorp Industries—umekaguliwa na kukubaliwa kuwa unawezekana kimawazo na kibiashara katika hatua hii. article_content: Just one day after the US House of Representatives Ethics Committee released a report detailing evidence of corruption and fraud involving Congressman George Santos, the committee's chair, Michael Guest, introduced a resolution to expel the embattled New York Republican. If the House approves the resolution—which requires a two-thirds majority—Santos would become only the sixth member ever expelled from the lower chamber of Congress. Mr. Santos would join a short list that includes politicians removed for corruption, bribery, or acts of treason. According to Jason Roberts, a political science professor at the University of North Carolina, members of Congress are often reluctant to expel colleagues, as they believe voters should ultimately decide their representatives. Most politicians facing similar charges typically resign before expulsion. Mr. Santos, however, has remained defiant. The most recent House expulsion occurred in 2002, involving Jim Traficant, an Ohio Democrat known for his quirky behavior and catchphrases. Traficant was convicted on 10 counts including bribery, tax evasion, and racketeering. He was expelled by a 420-to-1 vote and later served seven years in federal prison. Even from prison, Traficant ran unsuccessfully for Congress as an independent. Another notable expulsion occurred in 1980, during the FBI 'Abscam' sting targeting corruption. Michael Myers, a Democratic congressman from Philadelphia, was caught on tape accepting a $50,000 bribe. Myers claimed he thought it was a 'charade,' but this defense was rejected. He was convicted, sentenced to three years in prison, and expelled from the House by a 376 to 30 vote. He also later pled guilty to election fraud in 2022. Unlike Traficant and Myers, Mr. Santos faces expulsion before any criminal conviction. Still, his case resembles theirs more than the three members expelled during the Civil War era for siding with the Confederacy: John Reid, John Clark, and Henry Burnett. Political considerations play a role, as Republicans—especially those in competitive New York districts—fear association with Santos could affect their electoral chances. Unlike long-serving Traficant, Santos is a newcomer to Congress with few political allies. If expelled, New York would hold a special election to fill Santos’s seat. The House is expected to vote on Santos’s expulsion after the Thanksgiving holiday. A previous expulsion attempt failed, but details in the recent ethics report have shifted some lawmakers' positions. Given the history of expelled politicians, this may not be the last time the public hears about George Santos.

Tofauti na Traficant ambaye alikuwa muda mrefu, Santos bado hana washirika wa karibu bungeni. Akifukuzwa, uchaguzi maalumu utaandaliwa New York kujaza kiti chake. article_content: Alan Pardew has expressed concern for his family after being confronted by fans in public, as scrutiny mounts over his position as Newcastle United manager. Newcastle lost 1-0 to Stoke City on Monday, leaving them joint bottom of the Premier League with only 19 points from a possible 75 since the start of the year. Despite widespread speculation about Pardew’s future, club owner Mike Ashley has reiterated his support. Some fans have displayed 'SackPardew.com' banners, voicing their dissatisfaction, while others have offered words of encouragement. Sources reveal that televisions in the club’s training ground were turned off on Thursday to avoid a live Sky Sports News broadcast discussing Pardew before his weekly press conference. Pardew, 53, mentioned having 'one or two interactions' with unhappy supporters but said it worries him most when negative attention affects his family. He emphasized his determination, saying, 'I don’t shy away from it. I’ve been out and about all week.' Pardew admitted the pressure has increased after Newcastle’s poor start to the season but stated, 'It’s important that my resilience is the strongest.' He acknowledged both criticism and support from fans and stressed his commitment to the club. Pardew confirmed he will not step down in the short term but suggested he may reconsider if he cannot elicit a response from his players. 'You have to understand that this is my business,' Pardew said. He attributed some of the stress to the young squad and affirmed his intention to help them improve. Owner Mike Ashley, who increased his stake in Glasgow Rangers to nearly nine percent on Thursday, flew in to watch Newcastle’s defeat at Stoke and has since spoken with Pardew, offering support alongside managing director Lee Charnley. Pardew insisted that neither he nor Ashley are acting out of arrogance or stubbornness, stating, 'We’re just trying to do what’s right for the team.' He emphasized that while the team is struggling, there is no lack of fight, and highlighted the need for continued effort. Meanwhile, Swansea City manager Garry Monk criticized Sky Sports’ live coverage during the Stoke match, arguing they unfairly focused on Pardew and the Newcastle chairman. Monk described the coverage as biased but expressed confidence in Pardew’s experience and Newcastle’s squad to overcome current challenges.

Senator Bob Menendez (D-NJ) was indicted on corruption charges in September, prompting him to temporarily step down as chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee. Menendez stands accused of accepting hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes—including payments in gold bars—from Egyptian intelligence officials in exchange for influencing U.S. military financing and arms sales to Egypt. In his former leadership role, Menendez had significant influence over U.S. foreign policy, particularly arms sales. His absence could shift the dynamic for important U.S. allies like Egypt and Turkey, particularly as they seek to modernize their air forces with American fighter jets.

Menendez was a vocal critic of the Turkish government, previously blocking Turkey’s request for 40 new F-16 fighter jets and 79 F-16 upgrade kits. After Menendez stepped down, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan remarked that his departure presented an opportunity, saying, 'Menendez being out of the picture is an advantage.' Turkey, a NATO member that hosts U.S. forces, has faced strained relations over concerns about democratic backsliding and its close ties with Russia. Turkey’s acquisition of the Russian S-400 air defense system caused its removal from the F-35 program and led to U.S. sanctions. More recently, Erdogan’s delay in approving Sweden’s NATO membership drew U.S. criticism. While Turkey eventually approved Sweden’s application, it remains uncertain if Menendez’s successor, Senator Ben Cardin, will change the U.S. position on the F-16s. Cardin welcomed Turkey’s approval of Sweden’s membership, noting, 'It’s clear that they had to get this done before we would consider arms sales.' He also highlighted ongoing concerns regarding Turkey’s use of weapons systems and human rights issues.

According to Ryan Bohl, a senior analyst at RANE, Menendez’s resignation increases Turkey’s chances of receiving the F-16s, especially given U.S. incentives tied to Sweden's NATO accession. Still, Cardin may continue to emphasize human rights concerns, though the White House’s strategic focus on keeping Turkey aligned with Western interests may take precedence.

Egypt has sought to purchase F-15 fighter jets from the U.S. since 1979 but has yet to succeed, despite operating the world’s fourth-largest F-16 fleet. In March 2022, then-U.S. Central Command chief Gen. Frank McKenzie suggested potential progress on an F-15 deal, but Menendez’s indictment adds new uncertainty. Cardin, who also criticizes Egypt’s government, has paused nearly $250 million of the $1.2 billion military aid package for Egypt, citing human rights concerns.

Cardin emphasized the Committee’s oversight powers, stating he would block military funds and arms sales to Egypt unless the country made real improvements in human rights. Meanwhile, allegations of Menendez accepting bribes from Egypt may further delay or complicate a potential F-15 sale. Ryan Bohl predicts a drawn-out investigation into how the deal was formed, potentially slowing progress on fighter jet transfers to Egypt. While Egypt previously ordered Russia’s Su-35 fighter in 2018, it canceled the purchase likely due to U.S. sanctions risks. Instead, Egypt has procured 54 French Rafale jets as it seeks to diversify its air force. While Egypt could consider Chinese jets—China recently showcased its J-10C fighter at the Dubai Airshow—Bohl doubts Cairo wants to risk angering the U.S. and may look instead to French or other NATO suppliers to leverage negotiations with Washington.

Egypt’s struggling economy limits its options, and the country remains heavily reliant on U.S. military support. As immediate defense threats remain low, Egypt can move slowly in negotiations, potentially choosing less expensive equipment like drones to balance budget constraints and tactical needs. Bohl noted Turkey and China might supply such alternatives. 

This article was written by Paul Iddon, a freelance journalist specializing in Middle East affairs, military developments, politics, and history.

Seneta Bob Menendez (D-NJ) alishtakiwa kwa tuhuma za rushwa mwezi Septemba, na akajiuzulu kwa muda kama mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Mahusiano ya Kigeni ya Seneti. Menendez anatuhumiwa kupokea mamia ya maelfu ya dola kama hongo—ikiwemo vibamba vya dhahabu—kutoka kwa maafisa wa ujasusi wa Misri ili kuathiri ufadhili wa kijeshi wa Marekani na mauzo ya silaha kwa Misri. Katika nafasi yake ya zamani, Menendez alikuwa na ushawishi mkubwa kwenye sera za nje za Marekani, haswa mauzo ya silaha. Kuondoka kwake kunaweza kubadilisha mwelekeo kwa washirika muhimu wa Marekani kama Misri na Uturuki, hasa wanapotaka kuboresha vikosi vya anga kwa ndege kutoka Marekani.

Menendez alikuwa mkosoaji mkubwa wa serikali ya Uturuki, na aliwahi kuzuia ombi la Uturuki la kununua ndege 40 mpya za F-16 na vifaa vya kuboresha ndege 79 za F-16. Baada ya Menendez kujiuzulu, Rais wa Uturuki Recep Tayyip Erdogan alisema, 'Menendez kutokuwepo ni faida.' Uturuki, mwanachama wa NATO na mwenyeji wa majeshi ya Marekani, imekuwa na uhusiano tete na Marekani kutokana na wasiwasi wa kupunguza demokrasia na uhusiano wake na Urusi. Kununuliwa kwa mfumo wa ulinzi wa anga wa Urusi S-400 kulifanya Uturuki iondolewe kwenye mpango wa F-35 na kuwekwa chini ya vikwazo na Marekani. Karibuni, kuchelewesha kwa Erdogan kuidhinisha uanachama wa Uswidi kwenye NATO kulikosolewa na Marekani. Hata hivyo, Uturuki iliidhinisha ombi hilo, lakini bado haijulikani kama mrithi wa Menendez, Seneta Ben Cardin, atabadilisha msimamo wa Marekani kuhusu F-16. Cardin alikaribisha uamuzi wa Uturuki juu ya Uswidi, akisema, 'Ilikuwa ni lazima wafanye hivi kabla hatujaangalia mauzo ya silaha.' Alisisitiza pia wasiwasi kuhusu matumizi ya silaha na masuala ya haki za binadamu nchini Uturuki.

Ryan Bohl, mchambuzi mwandamizi RANE, anasema kuondoka kwa Menendez kunaongeza uwezekano wa Uturuki kupata F-16, hasa mara baada ya uamuzi wao kuhusu Uswidi na NATO. Cardin anaonekana ataendelea kusisitiza haki za binadamu, lakini Ikulu ya Marekani inataka Uturuki ibaki upande wa Magharibi.

Misri imekuwa ikiomba kununua ndege za kivita za F-15 toka 1979 lakini haijapata, licha ya kuwa na idadi ya nne kubwa ya F-16 duniani. Machi 2022, bosi wa zamani wa Kamandi Kuu ya Marekani Jenerali Frank McKenzie alisema kunaweza kuwa na maendeleo kuhusu dili ya F-15, lakini mashtaka dhidi ya Menendez yameleta sintofahamu mpya. Cardin, pia mkosoaji wa serikali ya Misri, amesimamisha dola milioni 250 karibu na msaada wa kijeshi wa dola bilioni 1.2 kwa Misri, akitaja haki za binadamu.

Cardin alisisitiza mamlaka ya Kamati, akisema atashikilia fedha na mauzo ya silaha kwa Misri bila hatua za kuboresha haki za binadamu. Pia, tuhuma za hongo dhidi ya Menendez zinaweza kuchelewesha au kugonga mwamba kwa dili ya F-15. Ryan Bohl anategemea uchunguzi utachukua muda na kuchelewesha makubaliano. Misri iliwahi kuagiza Su-35 kutoka Urusi mwaka 2018, lakini ikasitisha kwa kuhofia vikwazo vya Marekani. Badala yake, imechukua ndege 54 za Kifaransa aina ya Rafale ili kuongeza chaguzi. Ingawa China ilionyesha J-10C kwenye airshow ya Dubai, Bohl anaona Misri haitapenda kugombana na Marekani na itaendelea kushinikiza kwa wasambazaji kama Ufaransa au washirika wa NATO kuishawishi Marekani.

Uchumi wa Misri ni mgumu na nchi inategemea sana msaada wa kijeshi wa Marekani. Kwa sababu hakuna tishio la haraka, Misri haina haraka ya kununua vifaa mapya na inaweza kuchagua vifaa vya bei nafuu kama drone. Bohl alisema Uturuki na China pia zinaweza kutoa chaguo mbadala.

Mwandishi wa makala hii ni Paul Iddon, mwandishi wa kujitegemea kuhusu masuala ya Mashariki ya Kati, kijeshi, siasa na historia.
