article_content: If you’re seeking a unique winter adventure, New Brunswick, Canada, located close to Maine, offers a variety of unconventional cold-weather activities. Rather than sticking to the ordinary, travelers can discover hidden ice caves, zoom above snow-laden forests on ziplines, enjoy tranquil ice fishing, or try out dog sledding through snowy trails.  Here are five of the top winter activities worth checking out in New Brunswick:  1. Lighthouse Glamping at Broadleaf Ranch In the Bay of Fundy, Broadleaf Ranch lets guests stay in a glamping lighthouse modelled after Cape Enrage. This cozy accommodation costs $200 CAD per night and comes with a lofted double bed, two single pullout sofa beds, a complete kitchenette, and a bathroom. In winter, visitors can gaze at the stars and catch amazing sunrise views. The ranch also provides activities like snow horseback riding and spa services.  2. Dog Sledding with Birch Bark Adventures Located in North Tetagouche, about a three-hour drive from the province’s capital, Birch Bark Adventures gives guests a hands-on dog sledding experience—one rooted in Canadian history. Professional guides introduce participants to their pack of Alaskan Huskies and instruct them before heading out. Tours range from one-day solo trips starting at $129.99 CAD to multi-day excursions up to $3,899.99 CAD, available year-round.  3. Winter Ziplining at Timbertop Zip Tours Snider Mountain Ranch, about an hour from Saint John, hosts Timbertop Zip Tours—where thrill seekers can soar along 13 zip lines from November to April. After zipping over snowy woods, guests can warm up with homemade cookies and hot chocolate by a fire. Admission is $69.99 CAD per person.  4. Ice Fishing with Off the Charts Outfitters Off the Charts Outfitters organizes guided ice fishing adventures through New Brunswick’s icy landscapes. All skill levels are welcome, and gear plus live bait are provided. The trips run from January to March, cost $225 CAD per person for a full eight hours ($150 for five hours), and children under 16 get a 50% discount. An on-ice barbecue lunch is also included.  5. Hiking the Midland Ice Caves Between December and February, visitors can enjoy an easy-level, 1.5-hour hike to the Midland Ice Caves in southern New Brunswick. This family-friendly trail lets hikers admire stunning natural ice caves nestled within snow-covered scenery.

BBC London weather presenter Wendy Hurrell was seen expressing frustration on camera shortly after her 10:30 pm broadcast, despite having just delivered a sunny forecast for the week ahead. While Hurrell appeared cheerful during her report, the camera lingered on her afterward, capturing her rolling her eyes and flicking her hair in apparent annoyance. Clips of the moment quickly circulated on social media, with viewers speculating about the cause, some suggesting it was directed at news anchor Riz Lateef.

Hurrell addressed the situation on Twitter, clarifying that her reaction was due to technical difficulties—she had to complete her segment without being able to see the weather graphics. She emphasized that her frustration was not directed at any colleague and even joked about the incident, comparing it to a scene from the film 'Anchorman.' News anchor Riz Lateef also confirmed Hurrell's explanation and expressed support.

A BBC spokesperson explained that, due to technical problems in their new studio, Hurrell couldn't see the graphics, and the camera remained on her longer than intended.

Mtangazaji wa hali ya hewa wa BBC London, Wendy Hurrell, alionekana akionyesha kuchoshwa mbele ya kamera muda mfupi baada ya utabiri wake wa saa 4:30 usiku, ingawa alikuwa ametangaza hali ya hewa nzuri kwa wiki ijayo. Ingawa Hurrell alionekana mwenye tabasamu wakati wa taarifa yake, kamera iliendelea kumuonyesha hata baada ya kumaliza, na ndipo akaonekana akisongesha macho na kutikisa nywele, ishara ya kukerwa. Video ya tukio hilo ilisambaa kwa haraka kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, na watazamaji walijadili sababu zake, wengine wakifikiria kuwa hasira yake ilielekezwa kwa mtangazaji wa habari Riz Lateef.

Hurrell alitoa ufafanuzi kupitia Twitter, akieleza kwamba alikerwa na changamoto za kiteknolojia — alilazimika kutoa utabiri bila kuona picha za hali ya hewa. Alisisitiza kuwa hakulenga hisia zake kwa mfanyakazi yeyote, na hata akacheka kuhusu hali hiyo akilinganisha na filamu ya 'Anchorman.' Mtangazaji wa habari Riz Lateef pia alithibitisha maelezo hayo na kuonyesha kumuunga mkono.

Msemaji wa BBC alifafanua kwamba kutokana na matatizo ya kiufundi katika studio yao mpya, Hurrell hakuweza kuona picha za grafiki na kamera iliendelea kumuonyesha kwa muda mrefu zaidi ya ilivyotarajiwa.

article_content: Despite recently breaking her ribs in a fall, former First Lady Nancy Reagan seemed to be in good spirits as she hosted Mitt Romney and his wife Ann at her home in Los Angeles. About seven weeks after her accident, the 90-year-old greeted the Romneys while using a cane, officially announcing her support for Romney’s presidential bid. She served them lemonade and cookies, adding that her late husband, Ronald Reagan, would have admired Romney’s business acumen and strong values. Mrs. Reagan stated that in her opinion, Romney has the leadership and experience that the country urgently needs. Ongoing health issues have led her to reduce her public appearances; notably, she fractured her pelvis in a 2008 fall that required a hospital stay. Her most recent injury prevented her from attending an event featuring Paul Ryan at the Reagan Presidential Library, so she watched remotely according to the library’s executive director, John Heubusch. Her spokeswoman, Joanne Drake, said that although Mrs. Reagan has started attending some appointments again, doctors have cautioned her against large gatherings. Meanwhile, former Florida Governor Jeb Bush ruled himself out as a potential vice presidential pick for Romney, clearly stating, 'He won’t ask and I won’t do it.' Bush instead endorsed Senator Marco Rubio from Florida as his choice for the role. Mitt Romney has now secured the delegate support needed to challenge President Barack Obama in the November election.

Takribani wiki saba baada ya ajali, Reagan mwenye umri wa miaka 90 aliwapokea Romney huku akitumia fimbo kutembea, na kutangaza rasmi kumuunga mkono Romney kwa urais. Aliwahudumia lemonade na biskuti, akiongeza kuwa marehemu mumewe, Ronald Reagan, angependa ujuzi wa kibiashara na maadili thabiti ya Romney. Bi. Jeraha la hivi karibuni lilimzuia kuhudhuria tukio la Paul Ryan kwenye Makavazi ya Rais Reagan, hivyo alilitazama nyumbani kama alivyosema mkurugenzi mtendaji wa makavazi, John Heubusch. Msemaji wake Joanne Drake alisema kwamba ingawa Bi. Reagan ameanza kufanya baadhi ya miadi tena, madaktari wamemshauri aepuke mikusanyiko mikubwa. Wakati huo huo, Gavana wa zamani wa Florida Jeb Bush ameweka wazi kuwa hatakuwa mgombea mwenza wa Romney, akisema, 'Hataniomba na sitaikubali.' Badala yake, Bush alimpendekeza Seneta Marco Rubio wa Florida kuchukua wadhifa huo. Mitt Romney sasa amepata idadi ya wajumbe inayohitajika kumkabili Rais Barack Obama kwenye uchaguzi wa Novemba.

article_content: Robert Knowles, a 46-year-old TV repairman from Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria, has been fined £800 and ordered to pay £3,500 in costs and a £40 victim surcharge after his homemade remote-control plane crashed in a no-fly zone near the BAE Systems shipyard in Barrow-in-Furness, where nuclear submarines are built. Knowles's £2,000 delta-wing UAV, equipped with a surveillance camera, crashed into the sea after he lost control. The plane, bearing the name of his company, Vision TV Repairs, washed up weeks later and was recovered by a BAE employee. Police traced Knowles using footage from the camera which recorded his car registration number as the plane took off. Knowles was tried in absence and found guilty of failing to comply with air regulations. He became the first person in the UK to be successfully prosecuted for dangerous and illegal flying of an unmanned aircraft. The court heard that on August 25, Knowles's aircraft flew within 50 metres of Walney Bridge and over the BAE shipyard, violating no-fly regulations without permission from the Civil Aviation Authority. District Judge Gerald Chalk viewed the flight footage and noted it clearly showed the UAV's route over restricted areas, with evidence of Knowles launching and operating the plane. Prosecutor Alison Slater told the court that Knowles was both the operator and controller, and the video footage was analyzed by Greater Manchester Police to confirm his involvement. Knowles did not attend the hearing and his defence lawyer withdrew. He had previously pleaded not guilty, arguing he lost control of the plane and suggested possible outside interference. Knowles has indicated he may appeal the verdict, stating: 'I think it’s all a bit heavy-handed. I understand safety concerns, but at the end of the day I would not have put my name on the plane if I was a bomber or a spy.'
translated_content: Robert Knowles, fundi televisheni mwenye umri wa miaka 46 kutoka Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria, amepigwa faini ya £800 na kuamriwa kulipa £3,500 kama gharama za mahakama pamoja na ada ya mwathiriwa ya £40 baada ya ndege yake aliyoitengeneza mwenyewe kuanguka kwenye eneo lisiloruhusiwa kuruka karibu na kiwanda cha BAE Systems kinachojenga manowari za nyuklia mjini Barrow-in-Furness. UAV ya Knowles yenye thamani ya £2,000, ikiwa na kamera ya uangalizi, ilianguka baharini baada ya kupoteza mwelekeo. Ndege hiyo, yenye jina la kampuni yake, Vision TV Repairs, ilipatikana wiki kadhaa baadaye na mfanyakazi wa BAE. Polisi walimtambua Knowles kupitia video ya kamera ambayo ilionyesha namba ya gari lake wakati wa kurusha ndege. Mahakama ilisikia kwamba tarehe 25 Agosti, ndege ya Knowles iliruka ndani ya mita 50 kutoka Walney Bridge na juu ya kiwanda cha BAE, kinyume na kanuni za anga bila kibali kutoka Mamlaka ya Usafiri wa Anga (CAA). Jaji wa Wilaya Gerald Chalk aliona video ya safari ya ndege na kubaini kuwa ilionesha wazi njia iliyopitia UAV hiyo juu ya maeneo ya vikwazo, pamoja na ushahidi wa Knowles akirusha na kuendesha ndege hiyo. Mwendesha mashtaka Alison Slater alieleza kwamba Knowles alikuwa mwendeshaji na mdhibiti wa ndege, na video ilichunguzwa na Polisi wa Greater Manchester kuthibitisha ushiriki wake. Knowles ameonesha nia ya kukata rufaa dhidi ya hukumu hiyo, akisema: 'Naona mambo yameenda mbali sana. article_content: Cognizant has taken its case to the Madras High Court, contesting a recent ruling by the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) in Chennai. The tribunal previously decided that Cognizant must pay dividend distribution tax (DDT) on a share buyback valued at ₹19,000 crore, carried out through a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement. ITAT called the buyback a 'colourable device' designed to avoid paying taxes, and concluded that the DDT was applicable. During the 2017-18 financial year, Cognizant repurchased about 9.4 million of its own shares from shareholders in the US and Mauritius, paying ₹20,297 per share and totaling ₹19,080 crore. The Income Tax Department’s assessing officer (AO) considered this payment a dividend under Section 2(22)(a) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, and required Cognizant to pay DDT. This view was later upheld by the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). Tax authorities argue that the buyback amounted to the distribution of accumulated company profits to shareholders, regardless of capitalization. They say such buybacks, where a company releases its assets to shareholders, count as 'deemed dividends' and are taxable as such. The Commissioner (Appeals) also rejected Cognizant's claim that the scheme did not reduce capital, explaining that a company cannot buy its own shares without reducing its capital. Cognizant maintains that the payments should be taxed as capital gains to shareholders, not as dividends, pointing to a 2016 amendment to Section 115QA that it believes should exempt it from DDT. The company has declined to comment further due to pending court proceedings.

ITAT ilisema ununuzi huo ni ‘njama ya kukwepa kodi’ hivyo DDT ilipaswa kulipwa. Katika mwaka wa fedha 2017-18, Cognizant ilinunua takriban hisa milioni 9.4 kutoka kwa wanahisa Marekani na Mauritius, ikilipa rupia 20,297 kwa kila hisa ikiwa jumla ya rupia bilioni 19.08. Afisa wa kodi wa Idara ya Mapato aliweka malipo haya kama gawio chini ya Kifungu cha 2(22)(a) cha Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, na kuitaka Cognizant kulipa DDT. Jambo hili liliungwa mkono pia na Kamishna wa Kodi ya Mapato (Rufaa). Mamlaka za kodi zinadai kuwa ununuzi wa hisa hizo ni kama ugawaji wa faida ya kampuni kwa wanahisa wake, bila kujali kama faida hizo zimewekezwa au la. Kulingana nao, mpango kama huu ambapo kampuni inatoa mali zake kwa wanahisa ni ‘gawio linalodhaniwa’ na linapaswa kutozwa kodi. Kamishna (Rufaa) pia alikataa msimamo wa Cognizant kuwa mpango huo haupunguzi mtaji, akisema kampuni haiwezi kununua hisa zake bila kupunguza mtaji. Cognizant inasema malipo hayo yanapaswa kutozwa kodi kama faida ya mtaji kwa wanahisa na sio kama gawio, ikiashiria marekebisho ya 2016 katika Kifungu cha 115QA yanayostahili kuitoa katika ulipaji DDT. Kampuni hiyo imesema haitatoa maoni zaidi kwa kuwa suala bado liko mahakamani.

Silvio Berlusconi, aged 76 and a former Prime Minister of Italy, is on trial in Milan for allegedly paying for sex with an underage individual and abusing his office. The case involves Karima 'Ruby the Heartstealer' El Mahroug, who was reportedly 17 years old during the events in 2010. Berlusconi claims he thought El Mahroug was 24 and firmly denies any sexual relationship with her or other party attendees. He also insists that his villa gatherings did not involve prostitution or inappropriate conduct, dismissing such accusations as attempts to damage his reputation.

He faces further allegations of using his influence to obtain El Mahroug’s release from police custody by telling authorities she was the granddaughter of Egypt’s then-president Hosni Mubarak. Berlusconi stated this was to prevent a diplomatic incident, as he believed El Mahroug's claim regarding her connection to Mubarak. Magistrate Annamaria Fiorillo countered that she never authorized El Mahroug's release and doubted the truth of the alleged royal tie.

El Mahroug, who is Moroccan, has always denied having sex with Berlusconi or being a prostitute. Although several witnesses claim money was exchanged for sex at Berlusconi’s parties, both accused maintain their innocence. The prosecution alleges abuse of power and deception, presenting evidence including potential wiretaps and testimonies from high-profile guests such as Cristiano Ronaldo, George Clooney, and Elisabetta Canalis.

Berlusconi argues that the term 'bunga bunga' was simply a joke and not proof of illicit events. He continues to assert his innocence and notes his court appearances are voluntary. If found guilty, he could face up to 15 years in prison.

article_content: Over 15 million viewers tuned in on Saturday night to watch England begin their World Cup campaign at 11 p.m. Despite a 2-1 defeat to Italy, England’s performance left fans with a sense of pride—but attention quickly shifted to BBC pundit Phil Neville, who faced heavy criticism for his co-commentary. On social media, fans, celebrities, and even South Warwickshire Police commented on Neville’s performance. Many described his commentary as monotonous and lacking enthusiasm, with some viewers jokingly suggesting he be replaced at half-time. The comparisons included calling him as robotic as HAL from '2001: A Space Odyssey' and suggesting he present the Shipping Forecast instead. Saturday marked Neville’s first appearance as the BBC’s new pundit, alongside regular commentator Guy Mowbray. Public figures like Didi Hamann and Danny Baker joined in the criticism, while broadcaster Mary Ann Sieghart likened Neville’s voice to 'talking Temazepam.' The South Warwickshire Police Twitter account even lightened the mood with tongue-in-cheek tweets, joking that Neville wouldn’t excite pub crowds and that playing his commentary would keep the streets calm. The BBC has not commented on whether Neville will return for future England fixtures, noting that decisions for later matches will be made closer to the time. For now, he will not be present for England’s next two group games, which will be shown on ITV. The BBC was also embarrassed by a brief on-screen graphic error that incorrectly indicated England had scored, after a shot by Raheem Sterling hit the side netting. Despite the backlash, Neville took the criticism in good spirits, tweeting that feedback would help him improve. Some observers questioned the BBC’s approach to hiring high-profile names as pundits rather than experienced broadcasters. Neville, who retired from Everton last year, is also regular on 'Match of the Day' and is the brother of England assistant coach Gary Neville. The broadcaster emphasized that Neville was trained before going on-air.

article_content: Handre Pollard delivered a thrilling late penalty to clinch a 16-15 win for South Africa over England, setting up a Rugby World Cup final showdown against fellow three-time champions New Zealand. Coming off the bench, fly half Handre Pollard calmly slotted a long-range penalty with only minutes remaining, allowing the Springboks to edge out a dominant English side on a rainy night in Paris. England had built a 15-6 advantage in the semifinal through effective kicking, but South Africa responded with an RG Snyman try before Pollard’s deciding kick. This marks South Africa’s second consecutive one-point victory in the tournament after their 29-28 win over France. The Springboks and New Zealand will now clash in the final for just the second time, recalling South Africa’s home-soil triumph in 1995. Captain Siya Kolisi reflected on the tough contest: “It was really ugly but that is what champions are made of,” he said, also crediting England’s strong resurgence after being underestimated ahead of the World Cup. Throughout most of the match, England looked set to reach the final again after their 2019 runner-up finish. Steve Borthwick’s squad relied on persistent kicking to control play in the wet, with Owen Farrell scoring early penalties for a 6-0 lead. Manie Libbok managed one kick for the Springboks before being replaced by Pollard, who soon added another penalty. Yet England stayed controlled, adding another Farrell penalty for a 12-6 halftime lead. Despite being written off by many before the tournament, England stretched their lead to 15-6 with a superb 47-metre drop goal from Farrell, raising hopes for an upset. As the game wore on, South Africa brought on all their replacements, searching for momentum, while England missed chances to extend their lead. Since defeating South Africa in the 2003 pool stage, England have now suffered five consecutive World Cup losses to the Springboks without scoring a try, and another penalty could have made the difference this match. However, a pinpoint kick by Pollard set up Snyman’s try—the game’s only one. Pollard’s conversion closed the gap, and with three minutes to go, he capitalized on a scrum penalty to put South Africa ahead for the first time. Pollard, drafted into the squad after Malcolm Marx’s injury, described the moment as one every fly half dreams of: “It was a big moment, but these are the moments you live for as a fly half.” England coach Borthwick commended his team’s efforts and quick development: “We came here believing we would win, and I’m extremely proud of how fast the players have grown in these four months.”

Pollard aliingia akitokea benchi na akapiga penalti ndefu kwa utulivu, na kuipatia Springboks ushindi dhidi ya England waliotawala kwenye usiku wa mvua jijini Paris. England walikuwa mbele kwa alama 15-6 kupitia mikwaju yao imara, lakini Afrika Kusini walijibu kwa jaribio la RG Snyman kabla ya penalti ya Pollard iliyofunga mchezo. Huu ni ushindi wa pili mfululizo kwa tofauti ya alama moja kwa Afrika Kusini baada ya kuwashinda Ufaransa 29-28. Nahodha Siya Kolisi alisema mchezo ulikuwa mgumu: “Ilikuwa ngumu sana lakini ndiyo uhalisia wa mabingwa,” na pia akaipongeza England kwa juhudi zao licha ya kudharauliwa kabla ya mashindano. Kwa sehemu kubwa ya mchezo, England walionekana kwenda fainali kama ilivyokuwa 2019. England waliendelea kuwa na nidhamu na kupata penalti nyingine na kuongoza 12-6 mpaka mapumziko. Licha ya kutotegemewa, England waliongeza uongozi hadi 15-6 kupitia drop goal ya Farrell ya mita 47 na wakati huo ushindi ulibakia kuwa wao. Penalti nyingine kwao ingeweza kutosha, lakini mkwaju wa Pollard ulimuwezesha Snyman kufunga jaribio pekee. Pollard alibadilisha na kupeleka tofauti karibu, kisha dakika tatu kabla ya mwisho akafunga tena penalti na kuweka Springboks mbele kwa mara ya kwanza. Pollard aliyetwaa nafasi yake baada ya kuumia kwa Malcolm Marx, alisema: “Ilikuwa ni tukio kubwa, lakini haya ndiyo mambo ambayo fly half huwa anaishi kuyafanya.” Kocha Borthwick wa England alisifu timu yake: “Tulikuja hapa tukiwa na imani ya kushinda na najivunia jinsi tulivyoimarika ndani ya miezi minne.”

article_content: A Moscow court has fined Google 15 million rubles (around $164,200) for repeatedly failing to store Russian users’ personal data within Russia. The penalty marks another instance of Russian authorities targeting the US tech giant amidst broader disputes with Western nations over the war in Ukraine. Google has previously been fined for the same reasons in August 2021 and June 2022, and did not comment on the latest ruling. Additionally, in August, Google faced a separate penalty of 3 million rubles (about $32,800) for not deleting information about the Ukraine conflict that Russian officials consider false. Given that Google shut down most of its Russian operations after Russian troops entered Ukraine and had its bank accounts seized, the Russian government is unlikely to be able to collect these fines. Russian courts have also imposed fines on other companies such as Apple and the Wikimedia Foundation, which operates Wikipedia. Since February 2022, when Russia began its military action in Ukraine, authorities have escalated efforts to silence criticism. For example, opposition politician Vladimir Kara-Murza was sentenced to 25 years in prison for publicly criticizing Russia’s actions, while artist Sasha Skochilenko could receive eight years for displaying anti-war slogans in a supermarket.

Adhabu hii inaonyesha jinsi mamlaka za Urusi zinavyoilenga kampuni kubwa ya teknolojia ya Marekani, huku kukiwa na mvutano kati ya Urusi na nchi za Magharibi kuhusu vita vya Ukraine. Google tayari imewahi kutozwa faini kwa kosa kama hili mwezi Agosti 2021 na Juni 2022, na haikutolea maoni kuhusu uamuzi huu wa karibuni. Pia, mwezi Agosti, Google ilipigwa faini ya ruble milioni 3 (takriban dola 32,800) kwa kushindwa kufuta taarifa kuhusu vita vya Ukraine ambazo maafisa wa Urusi wanaziona kama za uongo. Kwa sababu Google ilifunga shughuli zake nyingi nchini Urusi baada ya majeshi ya Urusi kuingia Ukraine na akaunti zake za benki kuchukuliwa, serikali ya Urusi huenda ikashindwa kukusanya faini hizi. Mahakama za Urusi pia zimezipiga faini kampuni nyingine kama vile Apple na Wikimedia Foundation, ambayo inaendesha tovuti ya Wikipedia. Tangu Februari 2022, Urusi ilipoanza oparesheni ya kijeshi Ukraine, mamlaka zimeongeza ukandamizaji dhidi ya wakosoaji. Mfano, mwanasiasa wa upinzani Vladimir Kara-Murza alihukumiwa kifungo cha miaka 25 kwa kukemea hadharani hatua za Urusi, ilhali msanii Sasha Skochilenko anatarajiwa kuhukumiwa miaka minane kwa kuweka kauli za kupinga vita kwenye bei za madukani.

article_content: Giselle Arellano, a 33-year-old candidate for Zacatecas state’s local congress in Mexico, became the center of controversy when provocative images of her surfaced online. In the photos, Arellano appears both in a professional blue business suit and in white lace lingerie with angel wings. The images led to accusations that she worked as an escort in Las Vegas—a claim she strongly denies. Arellano says the images were from a modeling shoot and alleges the backlash was orchestrated by political opponents targeting her and other women. Although she recently lost her party’s primary election, she plans to contest the results. The National Action Party (PAN) disavowed her candidacy last week, citing concerns about whether she met the party's standards for an honest means of living, according to Mexico's Notimex news agency. Arellano emphasized her experience as a former beauty pageant participant, business owner, and translator in immigrant courts. She spoke about her firsthand experience with migration and discrimination, maintaining that she has nothing to be ashamed of and that her conscience is clear. The controversy has sparked broader conversations about gender biases in politics. CNN’s Ariel Crespo contributed to this report.

article_content: Google rolled out the Pixel 8 series at an event in New York in October 2023, just after Apple dropped its iPhone 15 range in September. These two phones represent the foundational models from both companies, each bringing updates and new features. In terms of design, the Pixel 8 introduces subtle changes with rounder corners and a flat display, while keeping the familiar camera bar and glossy glass back available in obsidian, hazel, and rose. In comparison, the iPhone 15 keeps its iconic flat edges but switches to a matte, color-infused glass back that’s more resistant to fingerprints, coming in five pastel shades: black, yellow, blue, green, and pink. The iPhone 15’s wider color options and fingerprint-resistant finish are notable highlights. Looking at displays, the Pixel 8 is equipped with a 6.2-inch LTPS OLED display, 1080x2400 resolution, a fast 120Hz refresh rate, and peak brightness up to 2000 nits. The iPhone 15 sports a 6.1-inch Super Retina OLED, also reaching 2000 nits peak brightness, but limited to a 60Hz refresh rate. This gives the Pixel 8 a smoother viewing experience. Inside, the Pixel 8 runs on Google’s updated Tensor G3 processor with 8GB of RAM, ships with Android 14, and comes with a promise of seven years of OS and security updates. The iPhone 15 uses Apple’s A16 Bionic chip with 6GB RAM and runs iOS 17, with typical Apple support lasting around six years. Both devices deliver solid performance in everyday use. When it comes to cameras, the Pixel 8 offers a 50MP main camera and a 12MP ultrawide, enhanced by AI tools like Magic Editor and Best Take. On the iPhone 15 side, there's a 48MP main camera, 12MP ultrawide, and a 12MP selfie camera with autofocus, along with leading video recording features. Each phone's cameras excel in different areas, with the Pixel specializing in AI-powered photography and the iPhone leading in video quality. Battery life on the Pixel 8 benefits from a 4575mAh battery, with fast charging and reverse wireless charging capabilities. The iPhone 15 sees a minor upgrade with its 3349mAh battery and now features USB-C along with reverse wired charging. Both phones achieve similar charging speeds of 50% in about 30 minutes. On pricing, the Pixel 8 is set at $699 for 128GB, while the iPhone 15 starts at $799 for the same storage tier. With a higher refresh rate, bigger battery, and a lower starting price, the Pixel 8 offers strong value for money. Overall, both the Pixel 8 and iPhone 15 are robust base-level smartphones. The choice between them often comes down to personal preference for Android or iOS, but the Pixel 8 stands out for budget seekers desiring top specs.

Simu hizi mbili ni chaguo la msingi kutoka kila kampuni, na zote zimeboreshwa na kuleta vipengele vipya. Kimuonekano, Pixel 8 imeongeza mabadiliko madogo kama pembe mviringo na kioo tambarare, huku ikiendelea na kamera maarufu nyuma na glasi mgongoni inayong'aa katika rangi za obsidian, hazel, na rose. iPhone 15 inaendelea na kingo tambarare lakini sasa ina glasi ya nyuma yenye mguso wa rangi wa matte ambayo haitachafuka kwa urahisi, na inapatikana kwenye rangi tano za pastel: nyeusi, njano, bluu, kijani na pinki. Uchaguzi mpana wa rangi na mguso wa matte usiochafuka ni faida kubwa kwa iPhone 15. Kwa upande wa kioo, Pixel 8 ina kioo cha inchi 6.2 aina ya LTPS OLED chenye azimio la 1080x2400, kasi ya kuburudisha ya 120Hz, na mwangaza wa juu hadi nits 2000. iPhone 15 ina kioo cha inchi 6.1 cha Super Retina OLED ambacho pia kinapata mwangaza wa juu wa nits 2000, lakini kinabaki na kasi ya kuburudisha 60Hz. Pixel 8 inatoa uzoefu laini zaidi wa kuangalia mambo kwenye kioo. Kwa ndani, Pixel 8 ina prosesa ya kisasa ya Google; Tensor G3 na RAM ya 8GB, inakuja na Android 14, na Google inaahidi matangazo ya usalama na mfumo hadi miaka saba. iPhone 15 ina prosesa ya A16 Bionic, RAM ya 6GB, inatumia iOS 17 na inapata msaada wa miaka sita kama kawaida ya Apple. Zote ni za kasi na zinatosha mahitaji ya kila siku. Kwenye kamera, Pixel 8 ina kamera kuu ya 50MP na ultrawide ya 12MP ikiwa imetunishwa na zana za AI kama Magic Editor na Best Take. Zote zinachaji hadi asilimia 50 kwa dakika zipatazo 30. Bei, Pixel 8 inaanzia $699 kwa GB 128, wakati iPhone 15 inaanzia $799 kwa ukubwa huo huo wa kumbukumbu. Titan Capital’s founders, Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal, have announced their intention to reinvest all profits earned from their investment in Mamaearth into Indian startups. The duo first backed the skincare brand’s parent company, Honasa Consumer, during its seed funding round in 2017. Following Honasa Consumer’s IPO, they sold shares worth about Rs 78 crore and have retained shares valued at roughly Rs 80 crore. Titan Capital is recognized for supporting emerging startups such as Razorpay, Shadowfax, OfBusiness, and Urban Company, and intends to direct these gains to nurture the next generation of Indian founders.

Bahl highlighted in a social media post that a startup’s success lies not only in its own achievements but also in its support for other ventures. He added that both he and Bansal are pledging 100% of their Mamaearth proceeds to foster new entrepreneurs in India. Their Rs 2.4 crore initial investment saw over a 100-fold return at the issue price of Rs 324 per share. The inspiration for investing in Mamaearth came when Bahl noticed the product at home and received favorable recommendations from parenting groups online.

In other significant news, Tata Group is set to become the first Indian firm to assemble iPhones after acquiring Wistron’s manufacturing facility for $750 million, including debt. India has surpassed China to become the most represented nation in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024. Separately, Religare Enterprises is currently in dispute, with independent directors alleging fraudulent action by the Burman family relating to a takeover attempt.

Waanzilishi wa Titan Capital, Kunal Bahl na Rohit Bansal, wametangaza kuwa watawekeza upya faida zote walizopata kutokana na uwekezaji wao kwenye Mamaearth kwenye kampuni changa za India. Wawili hawa waliwekeza mara ya kwanza katika kampuni mama ya Mamaearth, Honasa Consumer, wakati wa mzunguko wa ufadhili wa mbegu mwaka 2017. Baada ya IPO ya Honasa Consumer, waliuza hisa zenye thamani ya karibu Rs milioni 78 na bado wanamiliki hisa zinazokadiriwa kuwa na thamani ya Rs milioni 80. Titan Capital inafahamika kwa kuunga mkono makampuni changa kama Razorpay, Shadowfax, OfBusiness, na Urban Company, na sasa inalenga kutumia faida hizi kusaidia kizazi kipya cha waanzilishi wa makampuni nchini India.

Bahl alielezea kupitia mitandao ya kijamii kwamba mafanikio ya kampuni changa hupimwa siyo tu kwa yale inayoanzisha, bali pia kwa kile inachowezesha wengine kujenga. Aliongeza kuwa yeye na Bansal wanatoa ahadi ya asilimia 100 ya mapato yao kutoka Mamaearth ili kusaidia wajasiriamali wapya nchini India. Uwekezaji wao wa awali wa Rs milioni 2.4 ulirejesha faida zaidi ya mara 100 kwa kila hisa kulingana na bei ya toleo la IPO ya Rs 324 kwa hisa. Wazo la kuwekeza kwenye Mamaearth lilitokana na Bahl kugundua bidhaa hiyo nyumbani kwake na kupata mapendekezo mazuri kutoka kwa vikundi vya wazazi mtandaoni.

Katika habari nyingine, Kikundi cha Tata kinatarajiwa kuwa kampuni ya kwanza ya India kuunganisha iPhone baada ya kununua kiwanda cha Wistron kwa Dola milioni 750, ikiwa pamoja na madeni. India sasa imeipita China kama nchi inayoongoza katika QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024. article_content: The wireless industry is a rapidly evolving sector within telecommunications, playing a vital role in enabling business applications for innovations such as artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). Without the high-bandwidth and low-latency connectivity provided by 5G, many of these technologies would remain ambitious ideas with limited real-world application. Managing the complex wireless ecosystem, with its many verticals and stakeholders, remains a challenge. As a result, flagship conferences serve as milestones for industry innovation. Most recently, the Mobile World Conference (MWC) in Las Vegas offered an update on the future of indoor 5G and private wireless networks. 5G Progress and Adoption The initial excitement surrounding 5G in 2019 may have led to unrealistic expectations about its market maturity. Many anticipated that 5G would already be widely used in buildings and powering most applications. However, the rollout of 5G networks is closely following the trajectory of previous generations like 3G and 4G/LTE, which also saw major developments approximately every decade, driven by technology advancements and user needs. Considering we are still in the early stages of 5G, the progress is significant. The Global System for Mobile Communications Association (GSMA) reports that 5G will surpass 4G this year, reaching 59% adoption in North America. This comes despite initial deployments, such as AT&T and Verizon's focus on mmWave, facing challenges related to signal range and resilience. The $81 billion C-band auction in February 2021 provided critical mid-band licenses, supporting a shift to broader deployment. 5G is laying the foundation for a new era of innovation across industries, enabling new platforms and leveraging technologies like AI, IoT, and edge computing. At MWC, NTT and Qualcomm announced a partnership to develop 5G-enabled devices and utilize AI for improved edge data processing. Their collaboration targets devices such as push-to-talk systems, augmented reality headsets, computer vision cameras, and edge sensors for industries including manufacturing, automotive, and logistics. Recent Omdia data further highlights ongoing 5G expansion: between Q4 2022 and Q1 2023, 157 million new global 5G connections were established, with the number expected to approach 2 billion in 2023. Omdia also projects 6.8 billion 5G connections worldwide by 2027. Verizon plans to expand its C-band 5G coverage to rural and suburban areas by December, while AT&T forecasts doubling its available C-Band spectrum after regulatory approval. T-Mobile aims to reach 300 million people with midband 5G by the end of 2023. Private Networking and Network Slicing Alongside broader 5G progress, private 5G networks and advances in network slicing were key highlights at MWC. According to Dell’Oro Group, private networks still represent less than 1% of the total 5G RAN market, but significant growth potential remains as organizations explore better network control, enhanced security, and improved bandwidth distribution. Network slicing is currently viewed as one of 5G’s most impactful features, with the market expected to expand at an annual rate of over 50% from 2023 to 2030. Sectors like healthcare, manufacturing, transportation, logistics, and utilities are set to benefit from these advances. T-Mobile, for example, introduced Security Slice, a feature using their 5G standalone network to create virtual network slices dedicated to SASE traffic. First discussed in 2020, Security Slice is among the most anticipated new 5G features, largely because of its cost-effectiveness and flexibility. Improved network slicing will allow private 5G networks to support thousands of cellular devices, boosting connectivity for facilities like hospitals and emergency responders. Conclusion As we approach 2024, the recent MWC event reflects significant progress in the wireless industry, especially regarding 5G and private wireless networking. Continued development and rollout of 5G networks, together with increased momentum around private 5G, highlight the transformative potential of this technology. Entering the latter half of the 5G cycle, innovations and partnerships already formed are expected to accelerate adoption further.
translated_content: Sekta ya mawasiliano ya wireless inaendelea kubadilika kwa kasi, na ina jukumu muhimu katika kuwezesha matumizi ya biashara kwa ubunifu kama akili bandia (AI) na Mtandao wa Vitu (IoT). Bila muunganisho wenye data kubwa na ucheleweshaji mdogo unaotolewa na 5G, teknolojia hizi nyingi zingebaki kuwa mawazo yenye mipaka katika matumizi halisi. Kusimamia mfumo mgumu wa ecosystem ya wireless, ukiwa na sekta na wadau wengi, ni changamoto. Kwa sababu hii, mikutano mikuu kama MWC huwa ni hatua kuu za kuonesha ubunifu katika sekta. Hivi karibuni, Mobile World Conference (MWC) iliyofanyika Las Vegas ilionyesha mwelekeo wa mustakabali wa 5G ya ndani na mitandao binafsi ya wireless. Maendeleo na Upokeaji wa 5G Msisimko wa awali kuhusu 5G mwaka 2019 uliweza kusababisha matarajio makubwa kuhusu ukuaji wa soko. Wengi walitarajia 5G itakuwa inatumika sana kwenye majengo na kuendesha programu nyingi. Hata hivyo, upanuzi wa mitandao ya 5G unafuata mwenendo wa vizazi vilivyotangulia kama 3G na 4G/LTE, ambavyo pia viliona maendeleo makubwa takriban kila baada ya muongo mmoja, vikichochewa na maendeleo ya teknolojia na mahitaji ya watumiaji. Kwa kuwa bado tupo katika hatua za awali za 5G, maendeleo yaliyofikiwa ni makubwa. Shirika la GSMA linaripoti kwamba 5G itazidi 4G mwaka huu, kufikia upokeaji wa 59% Amerika Kaskazini. Haya yanatokana na changamoto katika utekelezaji wa awali, kama vile matumizi ya mmWave na AT&T na Verizon, ambayo ilikumbana na changamoto za umbali wa mawimbi na uimara. Mnada wa C-band wa dola bilioni 81 Februari 2021 ulitoa leseni muhimu za mid-band, kusaidia upanuzi mpana zaidi wa 5G. 5G inaweka msingi wa enzi mpya ya uvumbuzi katika sekta nyingi, ikiwezesha majukwaa mapya na kutumia teknolojia kama AI, IoT, na edge computing. Katika MWC, NTT na Qualcomm walitangaza ushirikiano wa kuunda vifaa vinavyotumia 5G na kutumia AI kuboresha uchakataji data kwenye mtandao wa edge. Ushirikiano wao unalenga vifaa kama mifumo ya push-to-talk, vichwa vya ukweli ulioongezwa (AR headsets), kamera za computer vision, na sensa za edge, zikiwa maalum kwa sekta za utengenezaji, magari, na lojistiki. Takwimu mpya kutoka Omdia zinaonyesha ukuaji endelevu wa 5G: kati ya robo ya nne ya 2022 na robo ya kwanza ya 2023, kulikuwa na miunganisho mipya milioni 157 ya 5G duniani, na idadi hiyo inatarajiwa kufikia karibu bilioni 2 mwaka 2023. Omdia pia inatabiri kuwepo kwa miunganisho ya 5G bilioni 6.8 duniani ifikapo 2027. Verizon inapanga kupanua huduma ya 5G C-band hadi maeneo ya vijijini na maeneo ya miji midogo ifikapo Desemba, huku AT&T ikitarajia kuongeza maradufu wigo wake wa C-Band baada ya idhini ya wadhibiti. T-Mobile inalenga kuwafikia watu milioni 300 kwa 5G ya midband kabla ya mwisho wa 2023. Mitandao Binafsi na Network Slicing Pamoja na maendeleo ya 5G, mitandao binafsi ya 5G na maendeleo ya network slicing yalikuwa vipaumbele kwenye MWC. Kwa mujibu wa Dell'Oro Group, mitandao binafsi bado ni chini ya 1% ya jumla ya soko la 5G RAN, lakini kuna fursa kubwa ya ukuaji huku mashirika yakitafuta udhibiti zaidi wa mitandao, usalama ulioboreshwa, na usambazaji bora wa bandwidth. Network slicing inaonekana kama moja ya vipengele vyenye athari kubwa vya 5G, na soko linatarajiwa kukua kwa zaidi ya 50% kwa mwaka kati ya 2023 na 2030. Sekta kama afya, utengenezaji, usafiri, lojistiki na huduma za umma zinatarajiwa kunufaika na maendeleo haya. Kwa mfano, T-Mobile ilianzisha Security Slice, huduma inayotumia mtandao wake wa 5G standalone kufanya virtual network slices kwa trafiki ya SASE. Huduma hii ilizungumziwa kwanza mwaka 2020 na ni miongoni mwa vipengele vipya vya 5G vinavyosubiriwa sana kutokana na ufanisi wa gharama na kubadilika kwake. Uboreshaji wa network slicing utawezesha mitandao binafsi ya 5G kuwahudumia maelfu ya vifaa vya simu katika taasisi kama hospitali na watoa msaada wa dharura. Hitimisho Tunapoelekea 2024, tukio la hivi karibuni la MWC linaonesha maendeleo muhimu kwenye sekta ya wireless, hasa linapokuja suala la 5G na mitandao binafsi. Maendeleo endelevu na upanuzi wa mitandao ya 5G, pamoja na kasi inayoongezeka ya kupokelewa kwa mitandao binafsi ya 5G, vinaonesha uwezo wa mabadiliko wa teknolojia hii. Tukiingia hatua ya pili ya mzunguko wa 5G, ubunifu na ushirikiano vilivyopo tayari vinatarajiwa kuongeza zaidi kasi ya upokeaji.

article_content: A gadget enthusiast from Minnesota has become the first person in the world to propose to his girlfriend using the smart headset Google Glass. Breon Nagy used the wearable computing device to record his memorable proposal to Amanda Ingle earlier this month. The event took place at Britain's Leeds Castle in Kent, and Nagy later shared the 26-second video on YouTube. During the proposal, captured from his point of view, Nagy tells his girlfriend, 'Let's start our adventure together,' as he gets down on one knee. He asks her, 'Will you marry me?' to which she replies, 'Yes! Of course I will,' her voice breaking with emotion. Ingle is seen standing on a balcony beside a lake, smiling as she accepts the ring and puts it on her finger, delighted. The video ends with Ingle leaning in to kiss Nagy, sealing the engagement. Nagy wrote on YouTube that he had carried the ring for two days, and chose Leeds Castle for the proposal because Ingle had jokingly asked him to buy her a castle.

Breon Nagy alitumia kifaa hiki cha kisasa kurekodi tukio lake la kipekee la kumposa Amanda Ingle mapema mwezi huu. Tukio hilo lilifanyika kwenye Jumba la Leeds huko Kent, Uingereza, na baadaye Nagy alishiriki video ya sekunde 26 kwenye YouTube. Katika tukio hilo la posa, lililorekodiwa kupitia mtazamo wake, Nagy alimwambia mpenzi wake, 'Hebu tuanzishe safari yetu pamoja,' huku akipiga magoti. Alimuuliza, 'Utanioa?' naye akajibu, 'Ndiyo! Bila shaka nitakubali,' sauti yake ikitikisika kwa furaha. Ingle alionekana amesimama kwenye roshani pembeni ya ziwa, akitabasamu alipokubali pete na kuivaa kwa furaha. Video inaisha Ingle anapomsogelea Nagy na kumpa busu, ikithibitisha uchumba wao. Nagy aliandika kwenye YouTube kuwa alikuwa amebeba pete hiyo kwa siku mbili, na alichagua Jumba la Leeds kwa sababu Ingle alikuwa amemwambia kimzaha anunue kasri.

If you enjoy tracking your runs, daily steps, and health stats, Amazon’s Black Friday deal on the Apple Watch Series 9 is worth checking out—you can save $70 on this recently released smartwatch. Overall, the Apple Watch Series 9 combines style with features designed to help you build healthy habits. With a $70 discount at Amazon, it’s a great chance for Apple fans to upgrade their wearables at a lower price.

article_content: KYIV, Ukraine – Russian drones targeted Kyiv overnight on Sunday, as the British Defense Ministry stated that there are 'few immediate prospects' for significant changes along the Ukrainian front line as the war enters its second winter. According to Ukraine’s military, Russia launched 20 Iranian-made Shahed drones at the Ukrainian capital and the Cherkasy and Poltava regions. Ukrainian air defenses shot down 15 of them. This was the second drone attack on Kyiv in 48 hours, reported the city’s Military Administration spokesperson, Serhii Popko. He said the drones attacked Kyiv from varying directions and in waves. Preliminary reports indicated no casualties or significant damage. The UK Defense Ministry noted that neither side has made meaningful progress recently, with intense fighting concentrated near Kupiansk in the Kharkiv region, Avdiivka in the Donetsk region, and on the left bank of the Dnieper River, where Ukrainian forces maintain a bridgehead. Meanwhile, Russian shelling injured five people, including a 3-year-old girl, in the Ukrainian city of Kherson, said Aleksandr Prokudin, the head of the Kherson regional administration. The strike damaged a residential apartment block. On Sunday night, Russian air defenses shot down a Ukrainian drone over the Moscow region, officials reported. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said debris fell in the Bogorodskiy area near the capital but no casualties were reported. Find more coverage at https://apnews.com/hub/russia-ukraine

article_content: A boat carrying 280 migrants landed on Spain's Canary Islands on Tuesday. The vessel arrived at the remote island of El Hierro, located about 380 km (238 miles) off Africa’s western coast. Rescue workers reported that those on board were of sub-Saharan African descent, making this the largest group of migrants to arrive in the Canary Islands at one time. The route to the Canary Islands is among the most frequently used—and dangerous—paths to Europe for African migrants. Journalist and former migration adviser Txema Santana commented on social media that he had never seen a single boat carrying so many people. According to the International Organization for Migration, 140 people have died or disappeared attempting the crossing so far this year. The use of this route has surged in recent years as stricter controls have been implemented along the Mediterranean. From 1 January to 30 September this year, 14,976 migrants arrived in the Canary Islands, marking a 19.8% rise compared to the same period in 2022, according to Spain’s interior ministry. On Sunday, Senegal's navy intercepted four boats in three days, carrying more than 600 people. In August, at least 60 people were believed to have died on a vessel later discovered near Cape Verde, a West African island nation situated along the migration route to the Canary Islands.

article_content: A striking white spot seen on Ceres—the asteroid belt's largest object—has caught scientists' attention. As NASA's Dawn spacecraft prepares to arrive at Ceres in March 2015, the cause of this luminous area is still unknown. Current scientific theories suggest it might be a patch of reflective ice inside a crater, but there's no confirmation yet. Dawn has been capturing increasingly detailed images as it gets closer, with the most recent photos taken from about 238,000 miles (383,000 km) away. These show surface craters and highlight the unexplained bright spot, which is sparking lively discussion among researchers. Marc Rayman, director of the Dawn mission, confirmed that the spot reflects more sunlight than its surroundings but added, 'what that is remains a mystery.' Ceres, a dwarf planet discovered in 1801, was recently found to be releasing water vapor at an estimated 13 pounds (6 kilograms) per second. Findings from the European Space Agency's Herschel telescope suggest this vapor may come from geysers or ice volcanoes on the surface. Dawn launched in 2007, spent over a year orbiting Vesta (another large asteroid), and set course for Ceres in 2012. Its arrival at Ceres will represent the first spacecraft visit to a dwarf planet. Ceres stands out as the only dwarf planet inside the inner solar system—positioned between Mars and Jupiter—and might hide a subsurface ocean. Abundant resources such as ice, water, and minerals make it a candidate for potential human missions in the future. Scientists believe that water presence on celestial bodies like Ceres could shed light on how water and organic materials might have been brought to Earth, possibly helping kick-start life. With Dawn drawing nearer, experts are eager to learn more about this mysterious world’s makeup and history.

Wakati chombo cha angani cha Dawn cha NASA kinapokaribia kuwasili Ceres mwezi Machi 2015, chanzo cha mwanga huu bado hakijulikani. Nadharia za sasa za kisayansi zinaashiria huenda ni barafu inayong'aa ndani ya krateri, lakini bado hakuna jibu la uhakika. Dawn imekuwa ikipiga picha zenye ufanisi zaidi inavyokaribia, na picha za hivi karibuni zimetwaliwa kutoka umbali wa takriban maili 238,000 (km 383,000). Picha hizo zinaonyesha krateri na kusisitiza mjadala mkali kati ya watafiti kuhusu kijise hicho kisichofahamika. Marc Rayman, mkurugenzi wa misheni ya Dawn, alithibitisha kwamba sehemu hiyo inaakisi mwangaza zaidi kuliko maeneo jirani lakini akasisitiza, 'bado hatujajua ni nini hasa.' Dawn ilizinduliwa mwaka 2007, ikazunguka Vesta (asteroidi kubwa nyingine) zaidi ya mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuelekea Ceres mwaka 2012. Kufika kwa Dawn kwenye obiti ya Ceres kutakuwa ni mara ya kwanza kwa chombo cha binadamu kutembelea sayari kibete. Ceres ni ya pekee kwa sababu ni sayari kibete pekee kwenye mfumo wa jua wa ndani—kati ya Mars na Jupiter—na huenda kuna bahari chini ya uso wake. Uwepo wa barafu, maji, na madini kwa wingi inafanya Ceres kuvutia kwa mipango ya safari za baadaye za binadamu. Wanasayansi wanaamini kuwa kuwepo kwa maji kwenye miili kama Ceres kunaweza kusaidia kuelewa jinsi maji na viambato vya uhai vilitekelezwa duniani na kuathiri asili ya uhai. Wataalamu wanatazamia kwa shauku spaceship ya Dawn ikikaribia kufichua historia na muundo wa dunia hii yenye mafumbo.

article_content: Jesse Matthew, the only known suspect in the disappearance of University of Virginia student Hannah Graham, was taken into custody on Wednesday night. He was arrested in Galveston County, Texas, after being found on the beach in Gilchrist on the Bolivar Peninsula, according to the county sheriff's office. Charlottesville Police Chief Timothy Longo told reporters, 'We have a person in custody, but there's a long road ahead of us, and that includes finding Hannah Graham.' He declined to discuss details about Matthew's arrest. An extradition process is underway for Matthew, age 32, who is also wanted on suspicion of two counts of reckless driving. Deputies responded to a call about a suspicious person camping on the beach, and after one deputy ran the license plate of the individual's vehicle, they learned he was wanted. Matthew did not resist arrest, according to CNN affiliate KPRC. Earlier, Matthew's lawyer, James Camblos, spoke briefly to the media in Charlottesville, confirming only that he was hired on Saturday as Matthew’s attorney and that neither he nor Matthew's family would make further statements at that time. Authorities issued an arrest warrant for Matthew, who they believe was the last person seen with Graham. Graham was last seen on September 13 in Charlottesville's Downtown Mall. Investigators have searched expanding areas and requested property owners in surrounding counties to look over their lands and report anything significant. Law enforcement previously searched Matthew’s apartment and car. Although they have not revealed details regarding evidence found, some items were sent to a lab for analysis. Longo said Matthew had voluntarily visited a police station when there was no warrant for his arrest. He requested a lawyer, met with one, and then left. Camblos confirmed he was present at that meeting. A reward of $100,000 is now being offered for information leading to the safe return of Hannah Graham, an 18-year-old second-year University of Virginia student. Authorities have received more than 1,500 tips and are urging the public to call their tip line at 434-295-3851. Police Chief Longo stated, 'We're asking everyone to help us find Hannah Graham.'

article_content: India's banking system experienced its largest liquidity deficit in almost five years on Tuesday, primarily due to monthly GST payments. According to data from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), the deficit reached Rs 1.74 lakh crore ($20.90 billion), the highest since December 26, 2018, when it touched Rs 1.86 lakh crore. A banker from a state-run institution noted that GST outflows since Monday amounted to around Rs 1.4 lakh crore, with further outflows of Rs 12,000-13,000 crore anticipated, suggesting the deficit could widen in the short term. To manage liquidity and combat inflation, the RBI has tightened its monetary policy and, as of October, announced plans to sell bonds through auctions. Large tax payments are causing funds to exit the banking system. Reflecting the liquidity crunch, overnight money market rates are currently trading above the RBI's Marginal Standing Facility rate of 6.75%. Additional pressures come from seasonal increases in currency withdrawals, a mildly negative balance of payments, and reduced foreign capital inflows, according to Gaura Sengupta, an economist at IDFC First Bank. Tight liquidity conditions mean the RBI may not be able to sell more bonds until December, Sengupta said. Anitha Rangan, an economist at Equirus Group, added that a temporary lull in government spending during state elections is also straining liquidity. However, she expects spending to rebound in January–March ahead of the general election. Soumyajit Niyogi, director at India Ratings & Research, anticipates banking liquidity will improve next week as government spending picks up and bonds are redeemed, though a surplus is unlikely. In other business news, the IPO market is booming, with Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery fully subscribed within hours of opening. Additionally, IndiGo is planning to introduce premium seating, hot meals, and a loyalty program by the end of 2024, aiming to attract more business travelers and compete with Air India on international routes. Since the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code was enacted, creditors have withdrawn 26,518 insolvency cases involving defaults worth up to Rs 9.33 lakh crore before adjudication. ($1 = 83.2440 Indian rupees)

Mfanyakazi wa benki ya serikali alisema kwamba malipo ya GST tangu Jumatatu yamefikia takribani rupia 1.4 lakh crore, huku malipo zaidi ya rupia 12,000-13,000 crore yakitarajiwa, jambo linaloashiria upungufu unaweza kuongezeka kwa muda mfupi. article_content: A mother from Virginia Beach believes her four-year-old son may be experiencing a haunting connected to a deceased US Marine. Michelle Lucas says her son, Andrew, has spoken about the life of Sergeant Val S. Lewis, who died during a terrorist bombing in Beirut, Lebanon, in 1983. Michelle recounted to News Channel 3 that Andrew sometimes cries and asks, 'Why did you let me die in that fire?' This has left her confused and unsettled. She explained, 'It scared me—I didn’t know if there was a spirit coming out of him.' Sergeant Val S. Lewis was serving on a peacekeeping mission in Beirut when a truck bomb struck the US Marine barracks, killing him and 240 other US service members. Of those killed, 220 were Marines and 21 were other service personnel. At the time, around 1,800 US Marines were stationed in Beirut as part of a multi-national peacekeeping force that included France, Italy, and the United Kingdom. A separate suicide bombing also targeted French paratroopers, killing 58 soldiers. Sergeant Lewis is buried at Marietta National Cemetery in Georgia. The tragic events of the Beirut bombings remain significant in US military history.

article_content: Shopify has become a go-to platform for notable celebrities looking to connect directly with fans and sell exclusive merchandise. In a recent collaboration, Shopify worked with Drake Related, the artist Drake’s e-commerce store, to give concertgoers access to new merchandise through QR codes displayed at event venues. By scanning these codes, fans could visit Drake’s Shopify store and had the chance to purchase special items and receive surprise gifts. This method isn’t unique to Drake. Major stars like Taylor Swift have also used Shopify, with her Eras Tour shop driving record sales and visits. According to Shopify President Harley Finkelstein, such campaigns have fueled Shopify’s robust third-quarter performance, including significant increases in revenue and gross merchandise volume. Shopify’s Shop app is central to these innovative fan experiences, having powered major collaborations with both Drake and YouTube star MrBeast. At Drake’s concerts, geo-fenced QR codes notified fans of exclusive giveaways. Winners received rare merch or even cash rewards. Similarly, MrBeast’s event in New York drew thousands for a live scavenger hunt with cash prizes and free samples from his Feastables chocolate brand. These examples show how Shopify is pushing e-commerce forward, enabling celebrities to connect more authentically with their audiences. The introduction of Shopify Collective lets stores like Drake Related showcase other independent brands, while Shopify handles payments and shipping behind the scenes. Drake and his team have used these tools to boost fan engagement and support emerging entrepreneurs by promoting their products. Shopify leaders cite this blend of technology and collaboration as a new way for artists to reach their communities and introduce fans to unique retail experiences. Inspired by these successes, other stars like Bad Bunny are launching exclusive products via Shopify, reflecting a broader move toward more interactive, direct-to-fan commerce.

article_content:
From an early age, Alexandra Tselios showed a strong sense for business. She often jokes about her entrepreneurial beginnings—selling her grandparents’ TV remotes back to them at marked-up prices. Rather than searching for a perfect job, Alexandra, a Sydneysider, decided to create her own opportunity. Thirteen months ago, at age 30, she launched The Big Smoke, an online platform offering Australians from diverse backgrounds a space to share their opinions.

Alexandra admits that starting her own business required a significant leap of faith and remains a continual challenge. 'You’re building something from the ground up,' she explains. 'You create something people can criticize, and often, the criticism can get personal.' Despite the obstacles and learning curves, Alexandra finds building her start-up incredibly rewarding. 'I wouldn’t have it any other way. This is deeply satisfying—it’s what I’m meant to do.'

She shares key lessons from her journey: Beginning a business isn’t for everyone—it’s tough, but establishing a start-up can be one of the most fulfilling risks a person takes. Alexandra enjoys connecting with others around Australia who have made a similar leap. She notes that launching a business can mean taking on significant financial risk, like a second mortgage, a large loan, or starting small while maintaining other employment. There’s no single formula for success, but several tips can help aspiring founders.

'A fabulous idea is just fabulous until it becomes something that can generate income, impact others, and stand alone,' Alexandra says. She cautions against rushing in and expects new entrepreneurs to be prepared for hard work and a delay before profits appear. It's important to test your concept with people outside your immediate circle for honest feedback, lest you overcommit to an idea no one wants to buy. Social media is a powerful tool for gathering fast, constructive feedback about your product.

While feedback online can sometimes be harsh—including trolls—the response can help identify if an idea is viable, needs adjustments, or if pricing is off. Alexandra spent eight months refining The Big Smoke before launch, analyzing everything from audience growth to market positioning. Over a year after the site went live, she continues testing and adapting. She emphasizes that entrepreneurship is a continuous process, regardless of how mature the company is.

It’s also pivotal to recognize that not everyone will support your venture. Starting a business is a leap of faith—and it can be a lonely, slow journey demanding patience and perseverance. People may struggle with their own disappointments or insecurities, and won't always be supportive, but it's essential to find out who truly stands by you. A strong support network is invaluable during both difficult times and successes.

There’s no 'one-size-fits-all' route to entrepreneurship. Alexandra recommends gathering a good team who can share in the highs and lows. Even experienced entrepreneurs don’t always get things right the first time. Her advice: Focus on continuous learning and adapting to the market, customer needs, and industry trends. Be resilient in your beliefs, and selectively build a positive support system. Growth takes time and effort, but those who persevere will find their place in the start-up world.

Tangu akiwa mdogo, Alexandra Tselios alikuwa anaonyesha kipaji cha biashara. Mara nyingi hutania jinsi alivyoanza ujasiriamali—akiwauzia babu na bibi yake rimoti za TV walizokuwa wamezichukua, kwa bei ya juu. Badala ya kutafuta kazi kamili, Alexandra, mkazi wa Sydney, aliamua kujitengenezea nafasi yake mwenyewe. Miezi kumi na mitatu iliyopita, akiwa na miaka 30, alianzisha The Big Smoke, jukwaa la mtandaoni linalowapa Waustralia kutoka nyanja mbalimbali nafasi ya kutoa maoni yao.

Alexandra anakiri kuwa kuanzisha biashara yake ilikuwa hatua kubwa ya ujasiri na bado ni changamoto inayodumu. 'Unajenga kitu kutoka sifuri,' anaeleza. 'Unaanzisha kitu ambacho watu wanaweza kukosoa, na mara nyingi, ukosoaji unakuwa wa kibinafsi.' Licha ya changamoto na mafunzo, Alexandra hupata kuridhika kubwa kujenga biashara yake mwenyewe. 'Siwezi kubadilisha hili na kitu chochote. Hii inaniridhisha sana—ndicho niliumbiwa kufanya.'

Anashiriki funzo muhimu: Kuanzisha biashara si rahisi kwa kila mtu—ni kazi ngumu, bali kubuni biashara mpya kunaweza kuwa kati ya hatua za kufurahisha zaidi mtu anaweza kuchukua. Alexandra anafurahia kusikia kutoka kwa watu kote Australia waliofanya uamuzi kama huo. Anaeleza kuwa kuanzisha kampuni kunaweza kukuhitaji kuchukua hatari kubwa za kifedha, kama mkopo wa pili wa nyumba, mkopo mkubwa, au kuanza kidogo ukiwa unaendelea kufanya kazi nyingine. Hakuna njia moja ya mafanikio, lakini kuna vidokezo kwa wanaonuiya kuanza.

'Wazo bora ni wazo tu mpaka liwe kitu kinachoweza kuleta fedha, kuwagusa wengine, na kujitegemea,' Alexandra anasema. Anatoa onyo kwa wasikimbilie mambo na anasema wajasiriamali wajiandae kwa kazi ngumu na kuchelewa kuona mapato. Ni muhimu kujaribu wazo lako kwa watu nje ya familia na marafiki, ili kupata maoni ya wazi. Mitandao ya kijamii ni chombo bora kupata mrejesho wa haraka na kusaidia kuboresha bidhaa yako.

Ingawa maoni mtandaoni yanaweza kuwa makali au hata ya kudhalilisha, maoni hayo yanaweza kusaidia kujua kama wazo lako linafaa, linahitaji kubadilishwa, au bei ni kubwa. Alexandra alitumia miezi minane kuboresha The Big Smoke kabla ya kuizindua, akichambua kila kitu kuanzia kupata watazamaji hadi kujiposition sokoni. Baada ya mwaka mmoja, bado anaendelea kujifunza na kubadilika. Anasisitiza kuwa ujasiriamali ni safari inayoendelea bila hata kampuni kukomaa.

Ni muhimu pia kuelewa kuwa si kila mtu atakuunga mkono. Kuanzisha kampuni ni kuruka kwa imani, na inaweza kuwa safari ya upweke inayohitaji subira na uvumilivu. Watu wana changamoto zao, na si wote watakushika mkono, lakini ni vema kujua nani yuko upande wako. Mtandao mzuri wa msaada ni muhimu katika wakati wa changamoto na mafanikio.

Hakuna njia moja ya moja kwa moja kufanikiwa kwenye ujasiriamali. Alexandra anashauri kuwa na timu nzuri inayoweza kubeba nawe nyakati nzuri na mbaya. Hata wajasiriamali wenye uzoefu wanakosea mara nyingine. Ushauri wake: endelea kujifunza na kubadilika kulingana na mahitaji ya soko na wateja. Kuwa na msimamo na uzunguke na watu sahihi. Ukuaji unahitaji subira na nguvu, lakini wanaothubutu watapata nafasi yao kwenye ujasiriamali.

article_content: Dr. Numal Momin, a senior BJP leader and Deputy Speaker of the Assam Assembly, has voiced optimism about his party’s prospects in the upcoming Mizoram Assembly elections set for November 7. Momin stated that the BJP targets winning between 6 and 8 seats—a notable rise from the party’s one seat in 2018 and an 8% vote share at that time. He anticipates the BJP’s vote share will grow to roughly 15%, attributing the momentum to supporters and leaders from other parties, including MNF, ZPM, and Congress, as well as presidents of local village councils who have recently joined BJP with hopes of advancing development. Momin underlined that the BJP campaign centers on enhancing infrastructure, education, health, and communication across the state. He was critical of Chief Minister Zoramthanga’s MNF government, particularly highlighting poor road conditions and persistent social issues such as joblessness and insufficient opportunities for youth and women. Despite high statewide literacy, Momin noted, many remote areas lack schools beyond the middle level, making access to higher education challenging for rural residents. He added that national celebrations such as Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav have yet to effectively benefit disadvantaged communities in these regions. In this election cycle, the BJP is contesting 23 of the 40 available seats. Momin believes that, with a strong performance, the party could play a pivotal kingmaker role in establishing Mizoram’s next government.

Momin alisema BJP inalenga kupata kati ya viti 6 hadi 8—ongezeko kubwa kutoka kwa kiti kimoja walichopata mwaka 2018 na asilimia 8 ya kura. Anatarajia kwamba asilimia ya kura za BJP itapanda hadi takribani 15%, akisema kasi hii imetokana na viongozi na wafuasi kutoka vyama vingine kama MNF, ZPM, na Congress pamoja na wenyeviti wa mabaraza ya vijiji waliojiunga na BJP wakitaka maendeleo. Russian troops are using a flexible defensive strategy called 'elastic defense' to push back Ukraine’s counteroffensive, reports The New York Times. With this method, Russian forces withdraw from frontline trenches under fire, retreating to secondary positions. When Ukrainian troops approach or take the empty trenches, the Russians counterattack quickly, targeting them when they are most vulnerable.

Ben Barry, a senior fellow at the International Institute for Strategic Studies, says this approach aims to inflict maximum casualties on Ukrainian attackers and set up successful counter-strikes. The fighting has been particularly intense in southern Zaporizhzhia, especially around Robotyne, where Ukraine has advanced and is working to break through Russian lines.

The purpose, The Times notes, is to prevent Ukraine from establishing strong positions and reinforcing them with armored vehicles. According to the Institute for the Study of War, a U.S. think tank analyzing the conflict, trenches near Robotyne often change hands amid fierce battles, with Russia sending elite units on counterattacks even as they suffer heavy losses.

Vikosi vya Urusi vinatumia mbinu ya ulinzi inayoitwa 'ulinzi wa elastic' kukabili mashambulizi ya Ukraine, kwa mujibu wa gazeti la The New York Times. Katika mbinu hii, wanajeshi wa Urusi huondoka kwenye mitaro ya mbele wanaposhambuliwa, na kurudi kwenye maeneo ya pili ya ulinzi. Wanapogundua majeshi ya Ukraine yanaelekea kwenye mitaro hiyo au tayari wameiteka, wanajeshi wa Urusi hufanya mashambulizi ya haraka, wakishambulia wapinzani wakati hawajajiandaa vizuri.

Ben Barry, mtaalamu mwandamizi wa Taasisi ya Kimataifa ya Mafunzo ya Mikakati, anaeleza kuwa mkakati huu unalenga kusababisha majeruhi wengi katika majeshi ya Ukraine na kuwezesha mashambulizi ya kushtukiza. Mapigano hivi karibuni yamekuwa makali katika eneo la kusini mwa Zaporizhzhia, karibu na Robotyne, ambako Ukraine imepata mafanikio na inajaribu kupenya ngome za Urusi.

Kama ilivyoripotiwa na The Times, lengolake ni kuzuia Ukraine kutengeneza ngome ambazo zinaweza kuimarishwa na magari ya kivita. Kulingana na Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Vita (ISW), think tank ya Marekani, mitaro karibu na Robotyne hubadilika mikononi mwa pande zote mara kwa mara kutokana na mapigano makali, na Urusi ikituma vikosi maalum kwenye mashambulizi licha ya kupata hasara kubwa.
post_content: Russia’s ‘elastic defense’ tactic is disrupting Ukraine’s advances near Robotyne. Russian troops pull back from trenches, then strike back fast when Ukrainians arrive—fierce battles & heavy losses on both sides. #UkraineWar #Zaporizhzhia #MilitaryTactics
translated_post: Mbinu ya 'ulinzi wa elastic' ya Urusi inashika kasi dhidi ya Ukraine karibu na Robotyne. Wanajeshi wa Urusi wanaondoka mitaroni, kisha wanapiga mashambulizi ya kushtukiza wakati Ukraine wanaingia—mapigano makali, hasara kubwa. #VitaUkraine #Zaporizhzhia #MikakatiYaVita

article_content: Marilyn Brown, 78, has been jailed for stealing £55,000 from her lifelong friend, Frances Tarne. Brown, of Christchurch, Dorset, spent years defrauding Tarne, also 78, from Brighton, out of her inheritance after the death of Tarne's husband. Despite their nearly 70-year friendship, Brown took control of Tarne's finances and sent her only £75 every fortnight, leaving her to live in near poverty. Friends raised concerns in June 2011 when they found Tarne living in poor conditions, despite being left with savings from her late husband. Brown's actions left Tarne with such little money that she could not afford a headstone for her husband's grave. Brown also cancelled Tarne's TV licence, cable package, and took away her car. Brown pleaded guilty to theft on the day her trial was due to begin in November. Last Thursday, she was sentenced to 18 months in prison at Hove Crown Court. Judge Shani Barnes told Brown: 'Your old friend lost her husband, and you systematically stole from her all that she had. You removed her dignity, her health, her money, and her trust.' The judge said Brown would have received a longer sentence if she were younger. Detective Constable Tracey Dixon said: 'I am astounded that such a long-term friend could be so cruel. I am very pleased with the sentence that Marilyn Brown has received.'
translated_content: Marilyn Brown, mwenye umri wa miaka 78, amefungwa kwa kuiba pauni 55,000 kutoka kwa rafiki yake wa maisha, Frances Tarne. Brown, mkazi wa Christchurch, Dorset, alitumia miaka kadhaa akimdanganya Tarne, pia mwenye umri wa miaka 78 kutoka Brighton, na kuchukua urithi wake baada ya kifo cha mume wa Tarne. Licha ya urafiki wao wa karibu miaka 70, Brown alichukua udhibiti wa fedha za Tarne na kumpa tu pauni 75 kila wiki mbili, na kumwacha akiishi katika umasikini. Marafiki walishuku Juni 2011 walipomkuta Tarne akiishi katika hali duni, ingawa alikuwa ameachiwa pesa na marehemu mumewe. Matendo ya Brown yalimwacha Tarne bila fedha kiasi kwamba hakuweza kumlipia kaburi la mume wake. Brown pia alisitisha leseni ya TV ya Tarne, kifurushi cha televisheni, na kuchukua gari lake. Brown alikiri kosa la wizi siku ambayo kesi yake ilipaswa kuanza mwezi Novemba. Alhamisi iliyopita, alihukumiwa kifungo cha mwaka mmoja na nusu katika Mahakama ya Hove Crown. Jaji Shani Barnes alimwambia Brown: 'Rafiki yako wa muda mrefu alipoteza mumewe, na wewe ulianza kumwibia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho. Ulimnyang'anya hadhi yake, afya yake, pesa zake na uaminifu wake.' Jaji alisema Brown angepata kifungo kirefu zaidi kama angekuwa mdogo. Mpelelezi Tracey Dixon alisema: 'Nimeshangazwa sana kwamba rafiki wa muda mrefu angekuwa mkatili kiasi hiki. Nafurahi na adhabu aliyopokea Marilyn Brown.'

article_content: Bayer Leverkusen moved closer to the Champions League group stage after a lively 3-2 victory against FC Copenhagen. Stefan Kiessling opened the scoring for Leverkusen early, but the Danish side fought back with quick goals from Mathias Jorgensen and Daniel Amartey. Leverkusen didn't stay behind for long—Karim Bellarabi equalized and Heung-Min Son netted the winner before halftime, putting the German team in control ahead of the return fixture. Red Bull Salzburg claimed a narrow 2-1 win over Swedish club Malmo in Austria. Franz Schiemer and Jonathan Soriano scored for Salzburg, but Emil Forsberg managed to snag an important away goal for Malmo late in the match, keeping their hopes alive for the second leg. Steaua Bucharest took a 1-0 advantage over Ludogrets Razgrad in their tie, with Alexandru Chipciu scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute after missing a penalty earlier. The win gives Steaua a slim lead heading to Bulgaria. In the CONCACAF Champions League, Chorrillo earned a 1-0 victory over Cruz Azul.

Franz Schiemer na Jonathan Soriano waliifungia Salzburg, lakini Emil Forsberg alifanikiwa kupata goli la ugenini muhimu kwa Malmo sekunde za mwisho, na kuwapa matumaini kwenye mchezo wa pili. article_content: With the New Year comes resolutions: exercising more, skipping doughnuts, and sometimes, saying goodbye to a partner. New research shows that January is the leading month for break-ups, with 20% of surveyed individuals reporting it as the most common time to end a relationship. The main reasons given for break-ups during this period were the stress brought on by Christmas and the desire for a fresh start in the New Year. December was identified as the second most common month for break-ups, followed by March. Among those who ended relationships in January, 62% said the time of year influenced their decision. The top five reasons cited were ongoing Christmas stress, wanting a fresh beginning in January, financial difficulties, gloomy weather, and family pressures. The study found that 48% of respondents were already involved in a new relationship. A spokesperson for Vouchercloud, the company behind the research, explained: 'Christmas is a stressful period that can cause tension in relationships. Combined with the January blues, many couples struggle to get through this time. As distractions fade, people often reflect on their relationship and may decide they’re not content. The start of a new year encourages some to take the “out with the old, in with the new” approach and look for new beginnings. While there’s no ideal time to break up, at least January offers the opportunity for a fresh start, even if it’s not easy at first.' Top reasons for January break-ups: Christmas-related stress, desire for a fresh start, financial concerns, bad weather, and family tensions.

Laura Barker, a 32-year-old former executive at National Grid, alleges that her career suffered after she refused the alleged sexual advances of her former boss, Steven Holliday. Barker held the role of vice-president of marketing at National Grid's US operations, with Holliday, who also sits on the board of Marks & Spencer, as her superior. According to her parents, Holliday pressed Barker for a relationship, and her rejection ultimately led to her losing her job and struggling to find employment. 

Barker reportedly left National Grid in 2010 and later worked briefly at Imperial College London before becoming unemployed. Her father, Keith Barker, confronted Holliday at a Marks & Spencer annual general meeting, accusing him of unethical behavior and blaming him for damaging Barker's career. Barker continues to look for work amid concerns for her future prospects. National Grid stated that an internal investigation in 2010 found no foundation for the allegations. Holliday has not commented publicly on the accusations.

Barker alikuwa makamu wa rais wa masoko katika shughuli za National Grid Marekani chini ya usimamizi wa Holliday, ambaye pia ni mkurugenzi asiye mtendaji wa Marks & Spencer. Kwa mujibu wa wazazi wake, Holliday alimlazimisha na alipokataa, alikumbana na mazingira magumu kazini na hatimaye akapoteza kazi. 

Inasemekana Barker aliachia kazi National Grid mwaka 2010 na kisha akafanya kazi kwa muda mfupi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Imperial London kabla ya kukosa ajira tena. Baba yake, Keith Barker, alimkabili Holliday hadharani katika mkutano mkuu wa mwaka wa Marks & Spencer, akimshutumu kwa kutenda kinyume na maadili ya kikazi na kumlaumu kwa kuharibu mustakabali wa binti yake. Barker bado anatafuta kazi na ana wasiwasi kuhusu mustakabali wake wa kikazi. National Grid ilisema kuwa uchunguzi wake wa ndani uliofanywa mwaka 2010 haukupata ushahidi wa kutosha kuhusu madai hayo. Holliday hadi sasa hajatoa maoni yake hadharani kuhusu tuhuma hizi.

On Monday, approximately 268 companies listed on Dalal Street are set to announce their earnings for the quarter and half-year ending September 2023. Among the prominent firms scheduled are Divi's Laboratories, FSN E-Commerce (Nykaa), Varun Beverages, and Adani Energy Solutions. Other major companies releasing results include Max Healthcare Institute, NHPC, Bharat Forge, Hindustan Petroleum, Gland Pharma, Emami, Exide Industries, R R Kabel, Bajaj Electricals, Bikaji Foods International, Sun Pharma Advanced Research, Sobha Ltd, Ujjivan Financial Services, Quess Corp, Fusion MicroFinance, Gateway Distriparks, Heidelberg Cement, Va Tech Wabag, and Paras Defence and Space Technologies.

Analysts expect strong performances from several companies:

FSN E-Commerce (Nykaa) is projected to deliver double-digit year-on-year (YoY) revenue growth in the September quarter, driven by the beauty, personal care, and fashion segments—which could grow between 21% and 31%. Nuvama Institutional Equities predicts a 25% YoY increase in overall gross merchandise value (GMV) for Nykaa. Despite industry-wide subdued discretionary spending due to a delayed festive season, Nykaa has seen robust growth across all segments. Kotak Institutional Equities also anticipates an improvement in operating margin to 5.9%, up both YoY and quarter-on-quarter, supported by positive operating leverage.

Divi’s Laboratories is expected to post moderate overall revenue growth, with double-digit expansion in its generics and nutraceuticals divisions. However, this will be offset by zero revenue from the COVID-19 treatment drug Molnupiravir. Estimates vary; Motilal Oswal Securities anticipates a 4.3% revenue increase, while Kotak Equities projects 7%. Watchers are also focused on pricing in the API segment and updates on capacity expansion at the Kakinada facility.

Varun Beverages is forecasted to report a 17% YoY growth in sales, driven by expanded distribution, higher realisation from the Sting brand, and the impact of unseasonal rains. Operating margins are likely to benefit from greater gross margins, favorable raw material costs, and an improved product mix. Investors will monitor margin trends, Sting and Foods portfolio growth, expansion in international markets, and capital investment plans.

Bharat Forge is expected by brokerage Prabhudas Lilladher to deliver a robust 30% YoY increase in revenue, attributed to strong performance across automotive and industrial segments. Operating margins are predicted to rise to 17%, bolstered by lower commodity costs and operational efficiencies. Shipment tonnage is expected to grow by over 15%, reflecting solid demand both domestically and in exports.

Other recent financial headlines include:
- India’s approval of Saab’s 100% foreign direct investment project in defence manufacturing.
- State Bank of India (SBI) posting an 8% rise in net profit for the second quarter, driven by steady credit demand and reduced provisions.
- Byju’s releasing select FY22 audited results, showing 2.3x growth in standalone business revenue to ₹3,569 crore and an EBITDA loss of ₹2,253 crore, reduced from the previous year.

(Disclaimer: Analyst recommendations and opinions are their own and do not reflect the views of The Economic Times.)
