article_content: Shannon Wilcox, a prolific actress known for her roles in Dallas, several Garry Marshall films, and dozens of other movies and TV shows, has passed away at the age of 80. According to a post on Legacy.com, she died on September 2 in Los Angeles. Wilcox accumulated over 75 credits during her 45-year career. Her television guest appearances ranged from Hawaii Five-O, Cagney & Lacey, Magnum, P.I., and L.A. Law to NCIS, The Neighborhood, and Grey’s Anatomy. Her film work includes Garry Marshall’s Frankie and Johnny, Exit to Eden, Dear God, The Other Sister, Raising Helen, The Princess Diaries and its sequel. Other notable film credits include Runaway Bride, Seven, For the Boys, Legal Eagles, and portraying the mother of Elisabeth Shue’s character in The Karate Kid. She also co-starred alongside Willie Nelson and Kris Kristofferson in the 1984 musical film Songwriter. Among her prominent television roles, she recurred as Anita in five episodes of the original Dallas and was a regular on Buck James, a medical drama starring Dennis Weaver that aired on ABC during the 1987-88 season.

Kulingana na chapisho kwenye Legacy.com, alifariki tarehe 2 Septemba huko Los Angeles. Wilcox alipata zaidi ya mikopo 75 katika maisha yake ya uigizaji ya miaka 45. Alionekana kama mgeni kwenye vipindi vya televisheni kama Hawaii Five-O, Cagney & Lacey, Magnum, P.I., L.A. Law, NCIS, The Neighborhood, na Grey’s Anatomy. Filamu alizoshiriki ni pamoja na Frankie and Johnny, Exit to Eden, Dear God, The Other Sister, Raising Helen, The Princess Diaries na mwendelezo wake, zote chini ya Garry Marshall. Filamu nyingine maarufu ni pamoja na Runaway Bride, Seven, For the Boys, Legal Eagles, na kucheza kama mama wa mhusika wa Elisabeth Shue kwenye The Karate Kid. Alishirikiana pia na Willie Nelson na Kris Kristofferson kwenye filamu ya muziki ya mwaka 1984, Songwriter. Katika televisheni, alicheza kama Anita katika sehemu tano za Dallas na alikuwa mmoja wa wahusika wakuu kwenye Buck James, tamthilia ya kitabibu iliyoongozwa na Dennis Weaver, iliyorushwa na ABC msimu wa 1987-88.

article_content: A Thai web editor has been convicted for hosting comments critical of the country's monarchy on her website. Chiranuch Premchaiporn was found guilty for allowing content deemed illegal under Thailand's strict 'lese-majeste' law to remain on Prachatai, an independent news site, for 20 days before it was removed. At her trial in Bangkok, Judge Kampol Rungrat told Chiranuch, 'As a webmaster you cannot deny your role in monitoring content.' She was fined 20,000 baht (about $628) and given an eight-month prison sentence, suspended for a year, dependent on good behavior. Her original one-year sentence was reduced due to her cooperation during the trial. Chiranuch faced ten charges under the 2007 Computer Crime Act, which includes lese-majeste violations, for posts made by others between April and November 2008. Had she been found guilty on all counts, she could have faced up to 20 years in prison. Speaking after the verdict, Chiranuch told CNN, 'The verdict is acceptable, but I cannot say I’m totally satisfied as I’m still being convicted.' She said she would consult her lawyers before deciding whether to appeal. Meanwhile, a petition signed by 27,000 people calling for reform of the lese-majeste law was submitted to the Thai parliament. The Campaign Committee for the Amendment of Section 112 stated the petition aims to prevent abuse of the law. International rights organizations, including Human Rights Watch, argue that the law is widely abused to criminalize peaceful expression. John Sifton, Asia advocacy director at Human Rights Watch, said, 'Thailand’s lese-majeste laws are overused and abused.' He added, 'The government’s actions against internet service providers send a threatening message to webmasters and companies: censor others’ content or risk severe penalties.' Earlier this month, Ampon Tangnoppakul, a 61-year-old man serving a 20-year sentence for lese-majeste and computer offenses, died in a Bangkok prison hospital. Known as Uncle SMS, Ampon was jailed last November for sending offensive text messages, according to the Bangkok Post. His death led to public outcry. Hundreds of protesters, mostly from the red-shirt movement supportive of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, gathered at the hospital with funeral wreaths, red roses, and lilies. At the criminal court, they tied black ribbons on fences to protest his sentence, and displayed banners criticizing lese-majeste, or Section 112 of the Criminal Code. CNN’s Licia Yee and Kocha Olarn contributed to this report.
translated_content: Mhariri wa wavuti nchini Thailand amehukumiwa kwa kuendesha maoni yanayokosoa utawala wa kifalme kwenye tovuti yake. Chiranuch Premchaiporn alipatikana na hatia kwa kuruhusu maudhui yaliyozuiwa chini ya sheria kali ya 'lese-majeste' ya Thailand kubaki kwenye Prachatai, tovuti huru ya habari, kwa siku 20 kabla ya kuondolewa. Katika kesi yake mjini Bangkok, Jaji Kampol Rungrat alimwambia Chiranuch, 'Kama msimamizi wa tovuti huwezi kukataa jukumu lako la kufuatilia maudhui.' Alitozwa faini ya baht 20,000 (takriban dola 628 za Marekani) na kuhukumiwa kifungo cha miezi minane jela, kimesitishwa kwa mwaka mmoja iwapo atakuwa na tabia nzuri. Adhabu yake ya awali ya mwaka mmoja ilipunguzwa kutokana na ushirikiano wake wakati wa kesi. Chiranuch alikabiliwa na mashtaka kumi chini ya Sheria ya Uhalifu wa Kompyuta ya 2007, inayojumuisha makosa ya lese-majeste, kwa maoni yaliyowekwa na wengine kati ya Aprili na Novemba 2008. Kama angepatikana na hatia kwa makosa yote, angeweza kuhukumiwa hadi miaka 20 gerezani. Akizungumza baada ya hukumu, Chiranuch aliiambia CNN, 'Hukumu ni ya kukubalika, lakini siwezi kusema nimeridhika kabisa kwani bado nimepatikana na hatia.' Alisema atashauriana na wanasheria wake kabla ya kuamua kama atakata rufaa. Wakati huohuo, ombi lililotiwa saini na watu 27,000 la kutaka marekebisho ya sheria ya lese-majeste liliwasilishwa kwa bunge la Thailand. Kamati ya Uhamasishaji ya Marekebisho ya Kifungu cha 112 ilisema ombi hilo linakusudia kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya sheria hiyo. Mashirika ya kimataifa ya haki za binadamu, ikiwemo Human Rights Watch, yanadai kuwa sheria hiyo inatumiwa vibaya kuadhibu maoni ya amani. John Sifton, mkurugenzi wa utetezi wa Asia wa Human Rights Watch, alisema, 'Sheria za lese-majeste nchini Thailand zinatumiwa kupita kiasi na vibaya.' Aliongeza, 'Hatua za serikali dhidi ya watoa huduma za mtandao zinawapa waendeshaji tovuti na kampuni ujumbe wa vitisho: dhibiti maudhui ya wengine au ukabiliane na adhabu kali.' Mapema mwezi huu, Ampon Tangnoppakul, mwanaume mwenye umri wa miaka 61 aliyekuwa akitumikia kifungo cha miaka 20 kwa makosa ya lese-majeste na ya kompyuta, alifariki katika hospitali ya gereza mjini Bangkok. Anajulikana pia kama Uncle SMS, Ampon alifungwa Novemba iliyopita kwa kutuma ujumbe wa simu wenye taarifa za matusi, kwa mujibu wa Bangkok Post. Kifo chake kiliibua hasira za umma. Mamia ya waandamanaji, wengi kutoka harakati za 'red-shirt' wanaomuunga mkono Waziri Mkuu wa zamani Thaksin Shinawatra, walikusanyika hospitalini na mashada ya mazishi, maua mekundu na lilies. article_content: A lengthy flight delay at Hong Kong International Airport led to a tense standoff on Wednesday when dozens of passengers refused to exit their plane, demanding better compensation from Hong Kong Airlines. The ordeal began after flight 752 arrived from Singapore almost nine hours late. Around 80 mostly mainland Chinese package tourists initially declined to disembark, saying the original offer of $50 per person was insufficient. A core group of 21 passengers stayed on board for five hours, seeking reimbursement for hotel rooms they’d missed out on. Airline representatives called police to help mediate, and the protest finally ended at 10:25 a.m. once the airline agreed to provide $150 each. While the money mattered, some passengers expressed that the airline’s approach was just as important in fueling their frustration. These standoffs over flight delays are not new to Hong Kong; The Standard newspaper had previously reported a similar protest by mainland tourists earlier in the year. Eva Chan, a spokesperson for Hong Kong Airlines, attributed the situation to different cultural expectations, clarifying that their staff did not act improperly and attempted to explain the company’s policies, which differ from those of mainland Chinese carriers. Globally, compensation regulations vary: the European Union generally requires airlines to pay passengers $330 to $800 for delays over two hours, while the United States doesn’t mandate compensation for delays, but does penalize airlines if travelers are stuck on the tarmac for more than three hours. Recently, a U.S. carrier was fined $900,000 by the Department of Transportation for such an incident.

Tatizo lilianza baada ya safari namba 752 kutoka Singapore kuwasili ikiwa imechelewa kwa karibu saa tisa. Takriban abiria 80, wengi wao wakiwa watalii wa makundi kutoka China bara, walikataa kushuka wakisema malipo ya dola 50 kwa mtu mmoja hayakutosha. Dunia nzima, sheria za fidia hutofautiana: Umoja wa Ulaya hutoa fidia ya dola 330 hadi 800 kwa kuchelewa zaidi ya saa mbili, lakini Marekani haina sheria kama hiyo, bali hutoza faini mashirika yanapowashikilia abiria kwenye ndege kwa zaidi ya saa tatu. Hivi majuzi, shirika la ndege la Marekani liliadhibiwa kwa faini ya dola 900,000 na Idara ya Usafiri ya Marekani kwa tukio kama hilo.

article_content: At the start of the season, questions were raised about Alabama’s football prowess when quarterback Jalen Milroe was sidelined following a loss to Texas. However, Alabama responded by winning eight consecutive games and locking up the SEC West with two matches remaining. Milroe emerged as a key player, producing six touchdowns—three passing, three rushing—against Kentucky, a first in Alabama history. His recent form has sparked talk of him entering the Heisman Trophy conversation. Alabama’s next big test will be Georgia in the SEC Championship. Georgia, fresh off dominating Mississippi and with tight end Brock Bowers returning from injury, also clinched their division and are vying for a third straight national championship. Meanwhile, Michigan has maintained an undefeated record despite head coach Jim Harbaugh's suspension due to an ongoing NCAA inquiry. Sherrone Moore, serving as acting head coach, led the team to a victory over Penn State. The coaching staff, supported by athletic director Warde Manuel, has kept the team focused and competitive in Harbaugh’s absence. Other college football highlights feature undefeated seasons for both Washington and Florida State. Washington extended its streak with a narrow win over Utah. Texas won against TCU with the return of quarterback Quinn Ewers, though the victory was hard-fought. Auburn, led by first-year coach Hugh Freeze, became bowl eligible with a strong showing versus Arkansas. Colorado, under Coach Deion Sanders, has faced setbacks and now faces long odds for bowl eligibility after a close loss to Arizona. Oklahoma State stumbled against UCF but remains in Big 12 title contention. James Madison preserved their unbeaten record, and Northwestern hit .500 under interim head coach David Braun. A notable milestone came from Missouri’s Cody Schrader, who set an SEC record with 200-plus rushing yards and 100-plus receiving yards in a single game against Tennessee.

Uchezaji wake umemuweka kwenye mazungumzo ya Heisman Trophy. Mchezo mkubwa unaofuata kwa Alabama ni dhidi ya Georgia kwenye fainali ya SEC, baada ya Georgia kuwafunga Mississippi kwa kishindo na kumbakisha uwanjani nyota wao Brock Bowers baada ya kupona majeraha. Wote wawili wamejihakikishia nafasi kwenye fainali na Georgia wanatafuta ubingwa wa taifa mara ya tatu mfululizo. Kwa upande mwingine, Michigan bado haijashindwa licha ya kukosekana kwa kocha mkuu Jim Harbaugh anayesimamishwa wakati NCAA ikiendelea na uchunguzi. Habari nyingine ni kwamba Washington na Florida State bado hawajapoteza msimu huu. Washington wameshinda dhidi ya Utah kwa mara nyingine kwa ushindi mwembamba. Texas waliishinda TCU huku quarterback Quinn Ewers akirudi uwanjani, ingawa ilikuwa mechi ngumu. Auburn chini ya kocha Hugh Freeze, wamefuzu kucheza bowl baada ya kuwashinda Arkansas. Colorado, chini ya kocha Deion Sanders, wameendelea kuangukia pua, na nafasi yao kupata bowl ni finyu baada ya kushindwa na Arizona. Oklahoma State pia walipoteza kwa UCF licha ya ushindi mkubwa wiki iliyotangulia. Lakini bado wana nafasi kwenye Big 12. article_content: Federal prosecutors on Long Island have brought new criminal charges against Representative George Santos, intensifying the investigation into his campaign activities. The expanded indictment alleges Santos stole identities, made unauthorized credit card transactions from donors, and lied to federal election officials. Prosecutors are charging Santos with wire fraud, submitting false information to the Federal Election Commission (FEC), obstructing the FEC by falsifying records, aggravated identity theft, and access device fraud. They allege he misrepresented campaign loans and reported fake or stolen contributions to exaggerate the financial strength of his campaign. Breon Peace, the U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of New York, stated that Santos is accused of exploiting the election system for personal gain and stressed a commitment to prosecuting electoral fraud. Nancy Marks, formerly the campaign finance chief for Santos, also faces related charges. Prosecutors claim that Santos and Marks named ten relatives as donors without their consent to meet requirements for party funding. It is alleged that Santos reported lending $500,000 to his own campaign when his available funds were only $8,000. Santos’ lawyer would not comment on the new charges. Speaking to reporters, Santos said he does not plan to resign and declined further comment. Previously, Santos was indicted for wire fraud, money laundering, theft of public funds, and providing false statements to Congress, to which he has pleaded not guilty. He is scheduled to return to court on October 27.

Mashtaka haya yanamlaumu Santos kwa kuiba vitambulisho, kutumia malipo ya kadi za mkopo za wafadhili bila ruhusa, na kusema uongo kwa maafisa wa uchaguzi wa shirikisho. Waendesha mashtaka wanamtuhumu Santos kwa udanganyifu wa miamala ya mtandao, kutoa taarifa za uongo kwa Tume ya Uchaguzi ya Shirikisho (FEC), kuzuia FEC kupitia kughushi rekodi, wizi mkubwa wa vitambulisho, na udanganyifu wa vifaa vya malipo. Wanadai alionyesha mikopo ya bandia na michango iliyobuniwa au kuibwa ili kuonekana kampeni yake ina nguvu kifedha kuliko ilivyokuwa. Breon Peace, Mwanasheria wa Marekani wa Wilaya ya Mashariki ya New York, alisema Santos anashutumiwa kutumia mfumo wa uchaguzi kujinufaisha na akaahidi kusimamia sheria dhidi ya udanganyifu wa uchaguzi. Nancy Marks, aliyewahi kuwa mkuu wa fedha wa kampeni ya Santos, pia anashitakiwa kwa makosa yanayofanana. Waendesha mashtaka wanadai Santos na Marks waliwataja jamaa zao kumi kama wafadhili bila kuwataarifu ili kufikia vigezo vya fedha za chama. Pia, inadaiwa Santos alidai alikopesha dola 500,000 kwenye kampeni yake ilhali alikuwa na dola 8,000 tu. Mwanasheria wa Santos hakutoa maoni kuhusu mashtaka mapya. Santos aliwaambia waandishi wa habari kuwa hana mpango wa kujiuzulu na hakutoa taarifa nyingine. Hapo awali, Santos alishtakiwa kwa udanganyifu wa kimtandao, utakatishaji fedha, wizi wa fedha za umma na kutoa taarifa za uongo kwa Bunge, huku akikana mashtaka yote. Anatarajiwa kufikishwa mahakamani Oktoba 27.

article_content: Luanda, Angola (CNN) — Angola, Africa’s second-largest oil producer, has launched a $5 billion sovereign wealth fund to diversify its economy—a step more typically associated with wealthy Gulf states like Qatar and the UAE. The Fundo Soberano de Angola, which is state-owned, will invest both at home and abroad, focusing on infrastructure development and the hospitality industry—sectors expected by the Angolan government to show significant growth. In an interview with CNN, Jose Filomeno de Sousa dos Santos, son of Angola’s long-standing president and a board member of the fund, said, 'Now is a very good time.' He noted that the country has experienced about five years of steady, mostly oil-driven growth and plans to diversify the economy. 'The best way to do that is to intervene directly through investments.' More than 90% of Angola’s revenue comes from oil production, which amounts to roughly 1.9 million barrels per day. Angola is second only to Nigeria in oil exports. Despite oil wealth, much of the population still lives in poverty. Dos Santos said the fund aims to invest oil profits in ways that promote social development. 'It is easy to have oil money and spend it, but it’s much harder to have a positive impact on people’s daily lives,' he said. 'That’s an area where we intend to focus with the sovereign wealth fund.' Critics maintain that Angola’s oil wealth has enriched only a small elite, mainly allies of President Dos Santos, his relatives, and senior military officials from the civil war era. Elias Isaac, country director for the Open Society Initiative for Southern Africa, said, 'We don’t see the money generated from oil improving ordinary people’s lives. Look at the state of schools, hospitals, water, electricity. Angola earns a lot from oil—enough to fund its national budget without donor support—but the real question is where the money goes.' Isaac points to a $135 million development on Luanda’s waterfront as evidence of misplaced spending priorities. The capital’s once dilapidated waterfront has been transformed through land reclamation, now featuring manicured lawns and offices, but many Angolans still struggle in makeshift homes nearby. Outside Luanda, much of the country remains underdeveloped and the income gap is widening. Only about a third of Angolans are literate, and more than half drop out before finishing primary school. Angola has faced significant challenges since wars for independence and a long civil conflict devastated the country. Civil society and human rights groups say institutionalized corruption is widening the gulf between rich and poor. Critics also note the fund’s board is dominated by cabinet members close to the president. Jose Filomeno de Sousa dos Santos argues that, despite being the president’s son, he is qualified due to his financial background. Transparency International ranked Angola 168 out of 182 countries on its Corruption Perceptions Index. Still, Dos Santos insists that the new fund will adhere to international best practices and will be fully transparent, with annual audits by independent auditors. Angola’s oil receipts have typically been managed with little transparency, protected by confidentiality agreements with international oil companies. Economist Manuel Jose Alves da Rocha from the Catholic University of Angola said, 'We believe there’s still a lot of corruption in the management of oil revenues, and the lack of transparency is a major reason why oil income doesn’t benefit the majority.' Sonangol, the state oil company, has long invested in areas beyond oil, sometimes acting like a sovereign wealth fund—for example, taking stakes in Millennium BCP, Portugal’s biggest bank by assets. Angola’s president first announced plans for a formal fund, but falling oil prices during the global financial crisis hit Angola’s economy hard. The government secured a $1.4 billion Stand By Arrangement from the IMF to cope with the downturn. With new offshore oil finds, Angola hopes to surpass Nigeria and become Africa’s top oil producer. However, oil revenues will not last forever, and the government hopes the sovereign wealth fund will help secure Angola’s future by diversifying its earnings.
translated_content: Luanda, Angola (CNN) — Angola, nchi ya pili kwa uzalishaji wa mafuta barani Afrika, imezindua mfuko wa taifa wa uwekezaji (sovereign wealth fund) wenye thamani ya dola bilioni 5 ili kupanua uchumi wake—hatua ambayo mara nyingi huelezewa na nchi tajiri za Ghuba kama Qatar na UAE. Fundo Soberano de Angola, ambao unamilikiwa na serikali, utawekeza ndani na nje ya nchi, kwa kuzingatia maendeleo ya miundombinu na sekta ya malazi—sekta ambazo serikali ya Angola inatarajia zitakua kwa kasi. Katika mahojiano na CNN, Jose Filomeno de Sousa dos Santos, mtoto wa rais wa muda mrefu wa Angola na mjumbe wa bodi ya mfuko huo, alisema, 'Sasa ni wakati mzuri sana.' Alisema nchi imepata ukuaji thabiti wa uchumi, hasa unaotokana na mafuta, kwa miaka takriban mitano na inataka kupanua uchumi wake. 'Njia bora ya kufanya hivyo ni kuingilia moja kwa moja kupitia uwekezaji.' Zaidi ya asilimia 90 ya mapato ya Angola yanatokana na uzalishaji wa mafuta, takriban mapipa milioni 1.9 kwa siku. Angola ni ya pili baada ya Nigeria kwa uuzaji wa mafuta nje ya nchi. Licha ya utajiri wa mafuta, watu wengi bado wanaishi katika umaskini. Dos Santos alisema lengo la mfuko ni kutumia faida ya mafuta kuboresha maendeleo ya kijamii. 'Ni rahisi kupata pesa za mafuta na kuzitumia, lakini ni vigumu sana kuleta mabadiliko chanya katika maisha ya watu kila siku,' alisema. 'Hilo ndilo eneo tutakalolipa kipaumbele kupitia mfuko huu.' Wakosoaji wanasema utajiri huo wa mafuta umefaidi watu wachache tu—hasa washirika wa Rais Dos Santos, familia yake na maafisa wakuu wa kijeshi kutoka enzi ya vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe. Elias Isaac, mkurugenzi wa Open Society Initiative for Southern Africa nchini Angola, alisema, 'Hatuoni pesa za mafuta zikiwanufaisha wananchi wa kawaida. Tazama hali ya shule, hospitali, huduma za maji na umeme. Angola inapata fedha nyingi za mafuta—za kutosha kufadhili bajeti yake bila msaada wa wahisani—lakini swali ni hizi pesa zinaenda wapi.' Isaac alitaja mradi wa dola milioni 135 wa kuboresha fukwe za Luanda kama mfano wa vipaumbele visivyo sahihi. Fukwe za mji mkuu zilizokuwa zimeharibika zilibadilishwa na sasa zina nyasi vizuri na ofisi, lakini Waangola wengi bado wanaishi katika makazi duni karibu na eneo hilo. Nje ya Luanda, sehemu kubwa ya nchi haijaendelezwa na pengo la kipato linazidi kupanuka. Takriban mmoja kati ya Waangola watatu tu anaweza kusoma na kuandika, na zaidi ya nusu huacha shule kabla ya kumaliza elimu ya msingi. Angola imepitia changamoto kubwa tangu vita vya uhuru na vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe vilipoathiri nchi. Mashirika ya kiraia na ya haki za binadamu yanasema rushwa ya kimfumo inazidi kuongeza tofauti kati ya matajiri na maskini. Wakosoaji pia wanasema bodi ya mfuko huo inatawaliwa na mawaziri waliokaribu na rais. Jose Filomeno de Sousa dos Santos anasisitiza kwamba, licha ya kuwa mtoto wa rais, ana sifa stahiki kutokana na uzoefu wake wa kifedha. Transparency International iliiorodhesha Angola nafasi ya 168 kati ya nchi 182 kwenye ripoti yake ya viwango vya rushwa. Hata hivyo, Dos Santos anasisitiza kwamba mfuko mpya utafuata viwango bora vya kimataifa na utakuwa na uwazi kamili, ukifanyiwa ukaguzi wa kila mwaka na wakaguzi huru. Mapato ya mafuta ya Angola kawaida yamesimamiwa kwa siri nyingi kupitia mikataba na kampuni za kimataifa za mafuta. Mwanauchumi Manuel Jose Alves da Rocha kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Katoliki cha Angola alisema, 'Bado tunaamini kuna rushwa nyingi katika usimamizi wa mapato ya mafuta, na ukosefu wa uwazi ni sababu kubwa kwa nini mapato hayo hayanufaishi wananchi walio wengi.' Kampuni ya mafuta ya serikali, Sonangol, kwa muda mrefu imewekeza kwenye sekta nyingine, ikifanya kazi kama mfuko wa taifa wa uwekezaji—mfano ikiwa ni kununua hisa kwenye Millennium BCP, benki kubwa zaidi nchini Ureno. Rais wa Angola alitangaza mpango wa kuanzisha mfuko rasmi, ila bei ya mafuta iliposhuka wakati wa mdororo wa uchumi duniani, uchumi wa Angola ulitetereka. Serikali ililazimika kukopa dola bilioni 1.4 kutoka IMF kupitia mkopo wa Stand By Arrangement. Kwa kugundua mafuta zaidi baharini, Angola inatarajia kuzidi Nigeria na kuwa nchi inayoongoza kwa uzalishaji wa mafuta Afrika. Hata hivyo, mapato ya mafuta hayataendelea milele, na serikali inatumaini mfuko huu wa taifa utasaidia kulinda mustakabali wa Angola kupitia upanuzi wa vyanzo vya mapato.

article_content: Ade Olowopopo has taken his two sons, Adekunle and Mayowa Olowopopo, to court for allegedly assaulting their sister, Adebisi Olowopopo, and stealing his property in Lakwe, Lekki, Lagos State. The brothers were arraigned on Monday before Magistrate O. M. Ajayi at the Ebute Metta Magistrate’s Court, facing five counts including breach of peace, assault, breaking and entry, stealing, and threat to life. Prosecutor Paul Ugorji told the court that the defendants committed the alleged offences in 2019 while Ade Olowopopo was out of the country. He stated that the defendants broke into their father's premises, assaulted their elder sister by beating and chasing her out, and then stole a Toyota 4Runner Jeep valued at N7 million and a block moulding machine without permission. Court testimony revealed that the defendants are children from Mr. Olowopopo’s second marriage, and lingering family disputes—including questions about the boys' paternity—have led to ongoing conflict. According to Mr. Ugorji, the alleged crimes violate Sections 411, 172, 287, 56, and 168(d) of the Criminal Laws of Lagos State, 2015. The charge sheet includes conspiracy to commit felony, assault, theft, breaking and entry, and conduct likely to cause a breach of peace. Adekunle and Mayowa Olowopopo pleaded guilty to the charges. Following their plea, Magistrate Ajayi granted them bail set at N40,000 each, with one responsible surety required. She advised the family to work towards an amicable settlement and adjourned the trial to December 12, 2023.
translated_content: Ade Olowopopo amewapeleka wanawe wawili, Adekunle na Mayowa Olowopopo, mahakamani kwa tuhuma za kumpiga dada yao, Adebisi Olowopopo, na kuiba mali yake huko Lakwe, Lekki, Jimbo la Lagos. Ndugu hao walifikishwa mahakamani Jumatatu mbele ya Hakimu O. M. Ajayi katika Mahakama ya Ebute Metta, wakikabili mashtaka matano ikiwemo uvunjifu wa amani, shambulio, uvamizi, wizi, na tishio la maisha. Mwendesha mashtaka Paul Ugorji aliieleza mahakama kuwa watuhumiwa walitenda makosa hayo ya kudaiwa mwaka 2019 wakati Ade Olowopopo alikuwa nje ya nchi. Alisema watuhumiwa walivunja nyumba ya baba yao, wakampiga na kumfukuza dada yao mkubwa, kisha wakaiba gari la Toyota 4Runner lenye thamani ya Naira milioni 7 na mashine ya kutengeneza tofali bila idhini. Ushahidi mahakamani ulibainisha kuwa watuhumiwa ni watoto wa mke wa pili wa Bwana Olowopopo, na migogoro ya kifamilia—ikiwemo masuala kuhusu ubaba wao—imesababisha mgogoro unaoendelea. Kulingana na Bwana Ugorji, makosa yaliyodaiwa yanakiuka Sehemu za 411, 172, 287, 56, na 168(d) za Sheria ya Jinai ya Jimbo la Lagos, 2015. Kesi inahusisha mashtaka ya kula njama kutenda kosa, shambulio, wizi, uvamizi, na vitendo vinavyoweza kusababisha uvunjifu wa amani. Adekunle na Mayowa Olowopopo walikiri makosa yanayowakabili. Baada ya kukiri, Hakimu Ajayi aliwapatia dhamana ya Naira 40,000 kila mmoja na mdhamini mmoja anayeaminika. Pia alishauri familia kusuluhisha suala hili kiamani na akaahirisha kesi hadi Desemba 12, 2023.

article_content:
Scientists are closer than ever to developing a global vaccine against E. coli, the leading cause of food poisoning and diarrhoea. Researchers have collected detailed data on the E. coli bacteria, responsible for millions of diarrhoea cases each year, and have discovered that its strains group into closely related clusters. This indicates that the bacteria causing illness in South America are remarkably similar to those found in Africa and Asia. According to experts, this close genetic relationship between strains means a single, worldwide vaccine is possible.

E. coli is responsible for approximately 400,000 deaths and 400 million cases of diarrhoea annually in low and middle-income countries, and also causes illness among many travellers to these regions. The study, the largest of its kind, analysed 362 E. coli strains collected over 30 years from 20 countries. Researchers from Cardiff University and the University of Gothenburg compared how the various strains attach to the human stomach lining. They found these strains fell into related groups, suggesting a vaccine could offer global protection.

Professor Gordon Dougan from the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute stated, "This research strengthens our belief that it is possible to target a broad range of enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (Etec) groups with one vaccine." Etec is the most common strain causing diarrhoea in developing countries.

Lead author Astrid von Mentzer, from the University of Gothenburg and the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute, described the data gathered as "exceptional," noting that researchers worldwide can use it to understand how each E. coli strain causes disease and what traits they share.

Most E. coli strains are harmless and beneficial in the human gut, but some produce toxins leading to diarrhoea, stomach cramps, nausea, and vomiting, and severe cases can result in complications like haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS), which is associated with kidney failure, anaemia, and bleeding. Symptoms usually appear three to four days after infection and may last up to two weeks or longer.

Most food poisoning cases come from consuming undercooked beef or unpasteurized milk. According to the researchers, their work has helped identify weaknesses in Etec bacteria that vaccines can exploit.

Dr Thomas Connor of Cardiff University highlighted that whole genome sequencing gave them the necessary insight to understand Etec and move toward new treatments. The challenge, he said, is to extract from the vast dataset the essential information needed to develop new vaccines. 

While Etec was once thought to vary greatly around the world, this study found that many of the 21 different strains can be traced back to a single bacterium, spread globally through travel. The emergence of these E. coli strains likely occurred between 51 and 170 years ago, suggesting they remain stable and are unlikely to develop vaccine resistance quickly.

Dr Åsa Sjöling from the University of Gothenburg and Karolinska Institutet added, "This research gives us confidence that a global, future-proof vaccine solution is achievable."

Entering a department store in China means stepping into vibrant cosmetics sections, filled with energetic staff promoting everything from French creams to Korean and Japanese products. These beauty counters are now the main stage in the fight for sales. Studies reveal cosmetics have surpassed groceries as Chinese department stores’ top seller. Consumers in China spent about $26 billion on cosmetics in 2013, experiencing over 13% annual growth. Although Japan’s beauty sector still leads the region at around $50 billion yearly, China’s swiftly expanding middle class—set to reach 500 million within ten years—is closing in fast.

Korean beauty has taken the spotlight in China, largely thanks to the influence of K-pop dramas and famous stars like Song Hye-kyo and Yoona. Korea’s cosmetic market is smaller, but its brands, notably Laneige by AmorePacific, attract Chinese buyers with chic French-inspired looks and affordable prices. Industry analysts say South Korea drives beauty trends in Asia, with innovative products like BB creams, and stores quickly stock the styles seen on Korean celebrities.

Yet, international giants like L'Oréal still dominate brand recognition in China. Even so, both Korean and domestic Chinese brands are aggressively growing—labels like Shanghai Jahwa are particularly strong in smaller cities. Some local companies give their products French-sounding names for added prestige. The strong appetite for skincare and cosmetic products continues in China, with fierce competition between global brands and rising Asian innovators.

article_content: Oxidation is a process where atoms lose electrons during chemical reactions. Among radioactive elements, neptunium and plutonium are more difficult to oxidize than uranium. To study these elements, scientists have designed donor ligands—molecules that provide electron density to metal centers. This helps stabilize these metals as they reach higher oxidation states, making their oxidation potentials (the energy required to remove an electron) more accessible. As a result, researchers can study unusual complexes of cerium, uranium, and neptunium, particularly observing how high oxidation states affect their structures and chemical behaviors. Accessing and studying the high oxidation states of uranium, neptunium, and plutonium complexes allows scientists to better understand their chemical reactivity and redox properties—the conditions where these metals gain or lose electrons, and the resulting chemical products. These studies offer insights into the behavior of radioactive materials in nuclear waste streams and storage. Additionally, the magnetic properties of these elements can influence the development of quantum information science and quantum materials. However, these radioactive elements are difficult to handle, making their molecular chemistry challenging to develop. The ligands and electrochemical research described here help address some of these nuclear waste challenges. Researchers have developed a symmetry-breaking ligand that has enabled detailed synthesis and characterization of non-aqueous uranium, neptunium, and plutonium complexes in high oxidation states. The findings are published in the journals Inorganic Chemistry and Angewandte Chemie International Edition. Across the actinide series, the energy barrier for oxidation increases greatly after uranium, often making it hard to characterize these complexes. The new ligand's lower symmetry lets scientists collect better crystallographic data and conduct more comprehensive spectroscopic and theoretical studies of these complexes' structures and electronic properties. Strong electron-donating abilities from the ligand support otherwise unstable high-oxidation-state complexes. This research establishes synthetic strategies and non-aqueous electrochemical methods to characterize radioactive neptunium and plutonium complexes. Electrochemical studies of complexes with cerium, uranium, and neptunium show that this ligand makes oxidation potentials more accessible. These results are supported by theoretical calculations and inform scientists about the chemical reactivity and physical properties of these systems. This work paves the way for isolating and studying new high-oxidation-state neptunium and plutonium complexes.
translated_content: Oksidishaji ni mchakato ambapo atomi hupoteza elektroni wakati wa athari za kemikali. Kati ya elementi za mionzi, neptunium na plutonium ni vigumu zaidi kuoksidisha kuliko uranium. Kwa uchunguzi wa elementi hizi, wanasayansi wametengeneza ligandi zinazotoa msongamano wa elektroni kwenye vituo vya metali. Hii husaidia kuhimili metali hizi zinapofikia hali za juu za oksidishaji, na kufanya potentiali zao za oksidishaji (nishati inayohitajika kutoa elektroni) zipatikane kwa urahisi zaidi. Kwa hiyo, watafiti wanaweza kuchunguza viambatanisho maalum vya cerium, uranium, na neptunium na kuona jinsi hali za juu za oksidishaji zinavyoathiri miundo na tabia zao za kikemikali. Kufikia na kuchunguza hali za juu za oksidishaji za viambatanisho vya uranium, neptunium, na plutonium kunawasaidia wanasayansi kuelewa vyema uwezo wao wa kufanya kemikali na mali za redoksi—hali ambazo metali hizi hupata au kupoteza elektroni, pamoja na bidhaa zinazotokana na athari hizo. Utafiti huu hutoa mwanga kuhusu tabia ya malighafi za mionzi katika upitishaji na uhifadhi wa taka za nyuklia. Zaidi ya hayo, mali za umagneti za elementi hizi zinaweza kuathiri maendeleo ya sayansi ya quantum na vifaa vya quantum. Hata hivyo, elementi hizi za mionzi ni ngumu kushughulikia, na kufanya maendeleo ya kemia yao kuwa changamoto. Ligandi na utafiti wa umeme wa kemikali ulioelezwa hapa unasaidia kutatua baadhi ya matatizo ya taka za nyuklia. Watafiti wametengeneza ligandi inayovunja usawa ambayo imewezesha usanisi na uchambuzi wa kina wa viambatanisho vya uranium, neptunium, na plutonium katika hali za juu za oksidishaji. Matokeo haya yamechapishwa kwenye majarida ya Inorganic Chemistry na Angewandte Chemie International Edition. Katika safu ya actinide, kizuizi cha nishati kwa oksidishaji huongezeka sana baada ya uranium, mara nyingi kikifanya kuwa vigumu kuchanganua viambatanisho hivyo. Ligandi mpya yenye usawa mdogo inawaruhusu wanasayansi kupata data bora ya fuwele na kufanya uchambuzi wa kina wa spectroskopi na nadharia kuhusu miundo na sifa za kielektroniki za viambatanisho hivi. Utoaji mkubwa wa elektroni wa ligandi unasaidia viambatanisho vya hali za juu za oksidishaji ambavyo vinginevyo visingeweza kudumu. Utafiti huu umeanzisha mikakati ya usanisi na mbinu za umeme zisizo na maji kwa ajili ya kutambua viambatanisho vya neptunium na plutonium vyenye mionzi. Uchunguzi wa umeme wa viambatanisho vya cerium, uranium, na neptunium unaonyesha kuwa ligandi hii imefanya potentiali zao za oksidishaji zipatikane zaidi. Matokeo haya yanathibitishwa na hesabu za kinadharia na huwasaidia wanasayansi kuelewa tabia za kikemikali na sifa za kimwili za mifumo hii. Kazi hii inafungua njia kwa upatikanaji na uchunguzi wa viambatanisho vipya vya neptunium na plutonium katika hali za juu za oksidishaji.

article_content: Karin Williams, a 50-year-old lollipop lady, shielded children from an out-of-control car outside Rhoose Primary School near Cardiff. She stepped in front of the vehicle with her lollipop sign, pushing five children out of harm’s way. The driver, 62-year-old retired computer consultant Robert Bell from Fontygarry, Vale of Glamorgan, attributed the incident to a coughing fit while driving in flip flops. His black Audi A3 hit a bollard and overturned. Williams and several children, along with three adults, suffered serious injuries. Williams endured broken legs, an elbow, shoulder, and ribs. One ten-year-old girl spent three days on life support and still has limited use of her left arm. Bell was found guilty of driving without due care and attention after a three-day hearing at Cardiff Magistrates' Court. District Judge Bodfan Jenkins stated that Bell failed to manage his coughing fit safely, leading to a major accident. Bell was fined £100, ordered to pay a £20 victim surcharge and £1,130 court costs, and received four penalty points on his license. The fine considered his weekly pension. Williams called the punishment 'pathetic,' expressing disbelief at the low fine compared to the consequences. Civil proceedings are ongoing. Bell’s lawyer said the incident has weighed heavily on him. The overturned car was towed away, and police responded at the scene.

Alisimama mbele ya gari hilo akiwa na ishara yake, na kuwavuta watoto watano mbali na hatari. Dereva, Robert Bell mwenye umri wa miaka 62 na mstaafu wa ushauri wa kompyuta kutoka Fontygarry, Vale of Glamorgan, alidai kuwa ajali hiyo ilitokana na kukohoa ghafla wakati akiendesha akiwa amevaa ndala. Gari lake aina ya Audi A3 liligonga nguzo na kupinduka. Williams na watoto kadhaa pamoja na watu wazima watatu walipata majeraha makubwa. Williams alivunjika miguu, kiwiko, bega na mbavu. Msichana mwenye umri wa miaka kumi alikaa kwenye mashine ya kumsaidia kupumua kwa siku tatu na bado hawezi kutumia mkono wake wa kushoto. Bell alipatikana na hatia ya kuendesha bila uangalifu baada ya kusikizwa kwa siku tatu katika Mahakama ya Hakimu ya Cardiff. Jaji Bodfan Jenkins alisema Bell alishindwa kudhibiti kikohozi chake salama, na kupelekea ajali hiyo kubwa. Williams aliita adhabu hiyo 'ya kusikitisha,' akishangazwa na kiwango kidogo cha faini ikilinganishwa na madhara yaliyotokea. Mashauri ya madai bado yanaendelea. Wakili wa Bell alisema tukio hili limemuumiza kisaikolojia. Gari lililoanguka lilichukuliwa na gari la uokoaji, na polisi walifika eneo la tukio.

article_content: French authorities have confirmed that the stabbing of Private Cedric Cordier, a 23-year-old French soldier on patrol in Paris’s La Defense, appears to be motivated by the recent killing of British soldier Lee Rigby in London. Cordier, on anti-terror duty under the Vigipirate program, was attacked by an unknown man described as tall, of North African origin, and wearing a djellaba, who later changed into European attire and remains at large. The assailant stabbed Cordier in the throat and neck before escaping. Cordier, who sustained significant injuries, is recuperating at Percy military hospital. Officials, including France’s Interior Minister and Defence Minister, have noted clear similarities with the rigby killing. With past attacks, such as Mohamed Merah’s murders in Toulouse in 2012 as context, France continues to step up its anti-terror measures. The police are pursuing the suspect using surveillance footage as part of ongoing heightened security efforts.

Cordier, aliyekuwa doria chini ya mpango wa kupambana na ugaidi wa Vigipirate, alishambuliwa na mtu asiyejulikana ambaye alielezwa kuwa mrefu, mwenye asili ya Afrika Kaskazini, na aliyevaa djellaba, kisha kubadilika kuvaa mavazi ya kawaida ya Ulaya na bado hajakamatwa. Mshambuliaji alimchoma Cordier shingoni na kooni kabla ya kutoroka. Cordier, ambaye alipata majeraha makubwa, anaendelea kupata matibabu katika hospitali ya kijeshi ya Percy. Maafisa akiwemo Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani na Waziri wa Ulinzi wa Ufaransa wameeleza kuwa tukio hili linafanana sana na mauaji ya Rigby. article_content: Marc Wroe, 44, was jailed for 18 weeks at Preston Magistrates Court after a seven-year stalking campaign targeting his married colleague, Heather Kendall. Wroe, an office worker from Preston, persistently harassed Kendall—who is a mother and his colleague at Tom Parker Ltd—with suggestive emails and unsolicited gifts, including women’s underwear and flowers. He also mailed Valentine’s cards to her husband and turned up at her home uninvited, often while her husband was away. Kendall’s ordeal escalated when she noticed her sparkling water bottle at work smelled foul. Tests later confirmed it was contaminated with urine. CCTV footage captured Wroe taking her water bottle from her desk and returning it. As a result, police were called, and Wroe was subsequently sacked from his job. Between July 2007 and April 2014, Wroe repeatedly contacted Kendall despite her requests to stop and warnings from both her and the police. Kendall described feeling anxious, mistrustful, and fearful to do everyday activities. In court, District Judge Jane Goodwin highlighted the seriousness of Wroe’s actions, noting that he ignored multiple warnings and admitted to harassment. Wroe, represented by lawyer Greg Earnshaw, expressed remorse and shame, and acknowledged the consequences, including loss of employment. In addition to his custodial sentence, Wroe is banned from contacting Kendall for three years and must stay at least 100 meters from Tom Parker Ltd. Kendall said she was pleased with the outcome.

Wroe, ambaye ni mfanyakazi wa ofisi kutoka Preston, alimnyanyasa Kendall—mama na mfanyakazi mwenzake katika Tom Parker Ltd—kwa kumtumia barua pepe zenye mapenzi na zawadi zisizotarajiwa kama vile nguo za ndani za wanawake na maua. Kabul, Afghanistan (CNN) — Two Americans and three Afghan soldiers were killed in a firefight that may have involved insurgents, the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) reported Sunday. According to U.S. officials, the American casualties included one soldier and one civilian. Initial statements described the Saturday clash as part of a recent series of insider attacks by Afghan forces, which have resulted in over 50 NATO fatalities this year. However, subsequent updates from the coalition cast doubt on this, suggesting insurgent fire might have provoked the confrontation in Wardak province’s Sydabad district, west of Kabul, according to ISAF Deputy Commander Lt. Gen. Adrian Bradshaw. The incident occurred at a temporary checkpoint operated by ISAF, with an Afghan National Army (ANA) unit positioned nearby. Bradshaw said that after a brief conversation between ANA and ISAF personnel, gunfire erupted, fatally wounding an ISAF soldier and killing his civilian colleague. Neither Bradshaw nor ISAF specified who fired the fatal shots. Investigations by ISAF and the Afghan army are underway to determine whether insurgent fire initiated the clash, but details remain unclear. ISAF called the event 'tragic.'

This incident raises the confirmed U.S. death toll in Afghanistan to 2,002, including four U.S. civilians, according to CNN. White House spokesperson Josh Earnest expressed condolences from President Barack Obama and the First Lady to the families affected by the conflict in Afghanistan.

Insider attacks—sometimes conducted by Afghan soldiers, police officers, or militants disguised in uniforms—have increased in recent months, raising concerns as international forces prepare for a transition in 2014. These attacks, known as 'green-on-blue' incidents, refer to Afghan (green) forces targeting NATO (blue) troops. Despite these challenges, Earnest reaffirmed the administration’s commitment to a successful transition.

General John Allen, the top U.S. commander in Afghanistan, voiced outrage over the insider attacks but emphasized the continued support of most Afghans. 'We’re willing to sacrifice a lot for this campaign, but we’re not willing to be murdered for it,' Allen told CBS' '60 Minutes.' Afghan President Hamid Karzai, also on '60 Minutes,' described the attacks as 'sad' and pointed to ongoing threats from terrorism in Afghanistan, suggesting that new strategies may be needed. NATO forces continue to train Afghan soldiers and police as the combat mission’s end nears. Some joint operations were recently suspended due to the increase in insider attacks. Additional reporting by CNN’s Ben Farmer, Amir Ahmed, Michael Pearson, and Josh Levs.

Kabul, Afghanistan (CNN) — Wamarekani wawili na wanajeshi watatu wa Afghanistan waliuawa katika mapigano ya risasi yaliyoweza kuhusisha waasi, ripoti ya International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) ilisema Jumapili. Kulingana na maafisa wa Marekani, waliopoteza maisha ni askari mmoja wa Marekani na raia mmoja. Taarifa za awali zilieleza tukio hilo la Jumamosi kama sehemu ya mlolongo wa mashambulio ya ndani kutoka kwa majeshi ya Afghanistan, ambayo tayari yamesababisha vifo vya wanajeshi zaidi ya 50 wa NATO mwaka huu. Hata hivyo, taarifa za baadaye kutoka kwa muungano huo zilibainisha uwezekano kwamba huenda tukio hilo lilichochewa na mashambulizi ya waasi katika eneo la Wilayani Wardak, kata ya Sydabad, magharibi mwa Kabul, kulingana na Naibu Kamanda wa ISAF Luteni Jenerali Adrian Bradshaw. Tukio hilo lilitokea kwenye kituo cha ukaguzi cha muda kilichoendeshwa na ISAF, na kikosi cha Jeshi la Kitaifa la Afghanistan (ANA) kilikuwapo karibu. Bradshaw alisema kuwa baada ya mazungumzo mafupi baina ya wanajeshi wa ANA na ISAF, risasi zililia na kusababisha majeraha ya kufa kwa askari wa ISAF na kifo cha mfanyakazi mwenzake raia. Bradshaw wala ISAF hawakutaja ni nani aliyefyatua risasi zilizoua. Uchunguzi unafanywa na ISAF na jeshi la Afghanistan ili kubaini iwapo mashambulizi ya waasi yaliibua mapigano haya, lakini bado haijathibitishwa. ISAF ililiita tukio hilo kuwa 'la kusikitisha.'

Kisa hiki kimeongeza idadi ya vifo vya Wamarekani waliothibitishwa Afghanistan hadi 2,002, wakiwemo raia wanne, kwa mujibu wa CNN. Msemaji wa Ikulu ya White House, Josh Earnest, alitoa pole kutoka kwa Rais Barack Obama na Mama wa Taifa kwa familia zilizoathiriwa na mgogoro huo.

Mashambulizi ya ndani—ambayo wakati mwingine hufanywa na wanajeshi wa Afghanistan, polisi, au magaidi waliovaa sare—yameongezeka katika miezi ya hivi karibuni, na kuibua wasiwasi wakati vikosi vya kimataifa vikijiandaa kuondoka mwaka 2014. Mashambulizi haya yanayojulikana kama 'green-on-blue' ni kutaja hali ambapo jeshi la Afghanistan ('green') linashambulia vikosi vya NATO ('blue'). Licha ya changamoto hizi, Earnest alisisitiza kuwa serikali bado imejizatiti kuhakikisha mpito wa mafanikio.

Jenerali John Allen, kamanda mkuu wa Marekani Afghanistan, alionyesha kukerwa na mashambulizi ya ndani lakini akasisitiza kwamba Waafghani wengi bado waunga mkono juhudi za kimataifa. 'Tuko tayari kujitolea mengi kwa kampeni hii, lakini hatuko tayari kuuawa kwa sababu ya hilo,' Allen aliiambia kipindi cha '60 Minutes' cha CBS. Rais wa Afghanistan Hamid Karzai, pia akizungumza kwenye '60 Minutes,' alielezea mashambulizi hayo kama 'ya kusikitisha' na akaeleza kuhusu tishio endelevu la ugaidi nchini Afghanistan, akipendekeza mbinu mpya zinaweza kuwa zinahitajika. Vikosi vya NATO vinaendelea kutoa mafunzo kwa wanajeshi na polisi wa Afghanistan huku operesheni za kijeshi zikielekea ukingoni. Baadhi ya operesheni za pamoja zimesitishwa hivi karibuni kutokana na kuongezeka kwa mashambulizi ya ndani. Ripoti hii pia imechangiwa na Ben Farmer, Amir Ahmed, Michael Pearson, na Josh Levs wa CNN.

article_content: A grieving grandmother has paid tribute after her daughter and two grandsons died in a house fire in North Wingfield, Derbyshire. Lynn Leighton lost her daughter Josie, 32, and grandchildren Tyler and Jordan Green, aged nine and twelve, in the blaze, along with their family friend Claire James, 27. The fire occurred in a terraced home on Wednesday morning. Claire James's seven-year-old daughter, Tia, was the only person to escape when the fire broke out. Today, mourners left flowers outside the property, and police officers stood guard as investigators looked into the cause of the blaze. While there is speculation that a portable heater may have been involved, authorities have not confirmed this. In a statement through police, Lynn Leighton described Josie as a loving daughter with many friends, Tyler as a happy boy who loved life and school, and Jordan as a real character who cherished his family, especially his grandmother. Leighton said the family is devastated and requested privacy to grieve. Josie Leighton was a care home worker and had recently separated from her partner. She and her sons were staying with Claire James while searching for a new place to live. The two mothers, both single, had known each other for many years and shared childcare responsibilities. Post-mortems are being carried out to determine the victims' causes of death. Neighbor Ian Smith and his wife Emma expressed their concern for Tia, who was treated for minor smoke inhalation and then released from the hospital. Emma Smith said they were collecting donations of clothes and toys for Tia and supporting a fundraising campaign for her. The fire brigade responded within eight minutes of receiving an alert at 4:58 a.m. Firefighters found Tia in the back garden and brought her to safety before fighting difficult conditions to rescue the others. Josie Leighton and Claire James were pronounced dead at the scene, while Tyler and Jordan died at Chesterfield and District Royal Hospital. Outside the house, signs of the fire remain, such as children's shoes in the porch and broken glass in the garden. Fire safety officers are conducting community checks, and police family liaison officers are supporting relatives. Chief Inspector Rick Gooch described the tragedy as having a significant impact on the local community. This is the fourth fatal house fire involving children in Derbyshire in the past three and a half years. Previous incidents include fatalities in Buxton and Hulland Ward, and the 2012 Derby fire in which several children died.

Moto huo ulitokea katika nyumba ya kupanga asubuhi ya Jumatano. Binti wa Claire James mwenye umri wa miaka saba, Tia, ndiye alikuwa pekee aliyenusurika wakati moto ulipoanza. Uchunguzi wa miili unaendelea ili kubaini chanzo cha vifo vya marehemu. Josie Leighton na Claire James walithibitishwa kufariki eneo la tukio, huku Tyler na Jordan wakifariki baadaye hospitali ya Chesterfield and District Royal. Nje ya nyumba, dalili za moto bado zipo, kama vile viatu vya watoto kwenye baraza na vipande vya vioo vilivyovunjika bustanini. Huu ni moto wa nne wa nyumba uliosababisha vifo vya watoto huko Derbyshire ndani ya kipindi cha miaka mitatu na nusu. Matukio ya nyuma yalijumuisha vifo huko Buxton na Hulland Ward, na moto wa Derby wa 2012 ambapo watoto kadhaa walipoteza maisha.

article_content: Voters in the UK may soon be required to show a passport or driving licence at polling stations to help prevent electoral fraud, according to a new recommendation by the Electoral Commission. The watchdog argues that photographic ID should be mandatory across the country, following the example set by Northern Ireland where voters already prove their identity before casting a ballot. The Electoral Commission considers the introduction of photo ID an essential measure to combat 'personation' fraud—where someone votes by pretending to be another person. It has called for legislative changes to ensure the system is in place by 2019, at the latest. However, sources close to Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg, who is responsible for electoral reform, say he opposes the idea, warning it could lead to an ID card system in disguise. In Parliament, Mr Clegg dismissed a call by Conservative MP Nick de Bois for voter identification cards, instead highlighting individual voter registration. Under that system, voters must provide details such as their date of birth and National Insurance number, a move Mr Clegg claims will address fraud concerns. 'We do not believe that UK voters should be required to carry an ID card to vote,' a source said. 'Our government abolished ID cards, and while this proposal is not identical, it is a similar step.' The new individual registration system replaces the traditional method, in which the head of the household registered all members. However, the Electoral Commission notes that while this improves security for postal ballots, it could inadvertently increase the risk of in-person 'personation' fraud. The Commission's report states that polling station voting in Great Britain remains susceptible to this type of fraud due to limited identity checks. To counter this, the watchdog recommends requiring voters to show a passport or driving licence at the polling station. Those lacking these documents would be eligible for a free 'electoral identity card'. Toby James, an electoral specialist at the University of East Anglia, warns that mandatory ID could discourage people from voting. He explained that requiring documents such as passports may seem sensible, but could result in voters being turned away if they forget them, leading to lower turnout. Dr James also argued that more evidence on the scale of electoral fraud is necessary before making such significant changes. However, the Electoral Commission said there is little evidence to suggest that introducing voter ID reduces turnout.

Imetaka sheria ibadilishwe ili mfumo huu uanze ifikapo 2019, au mapema zaidi. Hata hivyo, vyanzo karibu na Naibu Waziri Mkuu Nick Clegg, anayesimamia mageuzi ya uchaguzi, wanasema anapinga wazo hilo akihofia linaweza kuanzisha mfumo wa vitambulisho kwa njia nyingine. Bungeni, Bw. Clegg alikataa wito wa Mbunge wa Conservative Nick de Bois wa vitambulisho maalum vya wapiga kura, badala yake akasisitiza usajili wa mpiga kura mmoja mmoja. Kwenye mfumo huo, wapiga kura wanatakiwa kutoa taarifa kama tarehe ya kuzaliwa na namba ya Bima ya Taifa, hatua ambayo Bw. Clegg anasema itatatua tatizo la udanganyifu. 'Hatuamini kwamba wapiga kura wa Uingereza wanapaswa kubeba kitambulisho ili kupiga kura,' chanzo kilisema. 'Serikali yetu ilifuta vitambulisho hivyo, na ingawa pendekezo hili sio sawa kabisa, linafanana katika baadhi ya vipengele.' Mfumo mpya wa usajili wa mtu mmoja mmoja umechukua nafasi ya njia ya zamani ambapo mkuu wa kaya alikuwa akisajili wanakaya wote. Hata hivyo, Tume ya Uchaguzi inasema ingawa hii imeimarisha usalama wa kura za posta, inaweza kuongeza hatari ya udanganyifu wa ‘personation’ wakati wa kura ana kwa ana. Ripoti ya Tume inasema kuwa upigaji kura katika vituo vya kura bado una hatari ya udanganyifu huu kutokana na ukosefu wa ukaguzi wa utambulisho. Kupambana na hili, chombo hicho kinapendekeza wapiga kura waonyeshe pasi ya kusafiria au leseni ya udereva katika kituo cha kura. Wale wasiokuwa na nyaraka hizi watapewa ‘kadi ya utambulisho ya uchaguzi’ bila malipo. Toby James, mtaalamu wa uchaguzi kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha East Anglia, anaonya kwamba kitambulisho cha lazima kinaweza kuwafanya watu wasipige kura. Anasema kwamba kuhitaji nyaraka kama pasi ya kusafiria kunaweza kuonekana sawa, lakini watu wakisahau wataikosa fursa ya kupiga kura, hivyo kupunguza idadi ya wapiga kura. Dkt James pia anasema ushahidi zaidi unahitajika kuhusu kiwango cha udanganyifu kabla ya kufanya mabadiliko makubwa. Hata hivyo, Tume ya Uchaguzi imesema hakuna ushahidi madhubuti kwamba kuanzisha kitambulisho cha mpiga kura kunapunguza watu wanaopiga kura.

article_content: Recent figures indicate that vehicle damage claims caused by potholes have sharply increased over the past year, especially in areas that experienced significant flooding. Motorists lodged more than 26,000 compensation claims last financial year—a 13% jump from the year before—with flood-impacted regions seeing claim increases of up to 26%. Most claims are for damage to tyres, wheel rims, or suspension, all due to potholes. Over the past two years, local councils have paid out more than £5 million in compensation, based on data from 143 highway authorities, collected via Freedom of Information laws. Wiltshire led in payouts, disbursing almost £155,000 to settle 770 claims this year. Other councils with high compensation totals include Vale of Glamorgan (over £152,000), Surrey (£134,000), and Devon (£91,000). Heavily trafficked roads such as the A509 in Milton Keynes and Fir Tree Road in Banstead have each had more than 100 compensation claims since 2012. Severe storms last winter resulted in major flooding, further deteriorating road surfaces. According to LV= Road Rescue, one in six UK drivers have suffered car damage due to potholes in the last 12 months, paying an average of £118 per repair. Most frequently reported problems are tyre damage (49%), suspension issues (34%), and cracked wheel rims (28%). Some 16% of drivers have narrowly avoided accidents while swerving to dodge potholes. The process of pothole formation is accelerated by water filling cracks in tarmac—rain and flooding last winter made the problem much worse. For example, Kingston upon Thames saw compensation claims rise by 26%, Kent by 23%, and Wiltshire by 21%. Although efforts to address potholes have increased, UK road repair budgets remain tight—on average, just £63 per driver is spent annually. Many councils opt for patching rather than full repaving, with major resurfacing only happening on average every 58 years (compared to every 12 years in the 1980s and about 25 years now). The Local Government Association seeks an extra £1 billion a year to tackle the estimated £12 billion backlog of repairs, warning that another difficult winter could devastate Britain's roads. Last year's flooding left many highways crumbling, straining council budgets amid rising compensation costs. Government officials counter that they have increased funding, allocating £168 million in April for emergency pothole work and £10 billion over 2010-2021 for local maintenance. However, experts like Professor Stephen Glaister from the RAC Foundation warn that resources are still inadequate, and councils face competing spending priorities. Consensus is growing that the UK urgently needs longer-term, higher-level investment in its roads to prevent further decay and limit financial liability.

Madereva walitoa zaidi ya madai 26,000 ya fidia mwaka wa kifedha uliopita — ongezeko la asilimia 13 ukilinganisha na mwaka uliotangulia — huku maeneo yaliyoathirika zaidi na mafuriko yakiona ongezeko la madai hadi asilimia 26. Madai mengi yanahusu uharibifu wa matairi, magurudumu, au mfumo wa kusimamisha gari kutokana na mashimo. Katika miaka miwili iliyopita, halmashauri za mitaa zimelipa zaidi ya pauni milioni 5 kama fidia, kulingana na data kutoka mamlaka 143 za barabara iliyopatikana chini ya sheria ya Uhuru wa Habari. Halmashauri ya Wiltshire imetuma malipo ya juu kabisa, ikilipa karibu pauni 155,000 kwa madai 770 mwaka huu. Halmashauri nyingine zenye malipo makubwa ni pamoja na Vale of Glamorgan (zaidi ya pauni 152,000), Surrey (pauni 134,000), na Devon (pauni 91,000). Barabara zenye msongamano kama A509 huko Milton Keynes na Fir Tree Road huko Banstead zimepokea zaidi ya madai 100 kila moja tangu 2012. Dhoruba kali za msimu wa baridi uliopita zilisababisha mafuriko makubwa na kuharibu zaidi nyuso za barabara. Kulingana na LV= Road Rescue, mmoja kati ya madereva sita nchini Uingereza amepata uharibifu wa gari kutokana na mashimo ndani ya miezi 12 iliyopita, akitumia wastani wa pauni 118 kwa matengenezo. Tatizo linaloongoza ni uharibifu wa tairi (asilimia 49), matatizo ya mfumo wa kusimamisha gari (asilimia 34), na magurudumu yaliyopasuka (asilimia 28). Takribani asilimia 16 ya madereva karibu wapate ajali wakikwepa mashimo. Mashimo barabarani huongezeka haraka baada ya maji kujaza nyufa kwenye lami—mvua na mafuriko ya msimu uliopita yalisababisha hali kuwa mbaya zaidi. Kwa mfano, Kingston upon Thames iliona ongezeko la madai ya fidia kwa asilimia 26, Kent asilimia 23, na Wiltshire asilimia 21. Ingawa juhudi za kutengeneza mashimo zimeongezeka, bajeti za ukarabati wa barabara bado ni kidogo nchini Uingereza—wastani wa pauni 63 tu hutumika kwa kila dereva kila mwaka. Halmashauri nyingi huchagua kutengeneza mashimo kwa muda badala ya kuweka lami upya, huku ukarabati mkubwa ukifanyika kila baada ya wastani wa miaka 58 (ikilinganishwa na kila baada ya miaka 12 miaka ya 1980 na karibu miaka 25 sasa). Chama cha Halmashauri za Mitaa kinataka pauni bilioni 1 zaidi kila mwaka ili kukabiliana na deni la ukarabati wa barabara linalokadiriwa kuwa pauni bilioni 12, kikiashiria kwamba msimu mwingine mgumu wa baridi unaweza kufanya hali kuwa mbaya zaidi. Mafuriko ya mwaka jana yalisababisha uharibifu mkubwa barabarani, na kuongeza mzigo kwenye bajeti za halmashauri huku gharama za fidia zikipanda. Serikali inasema imeongeza ufadhili, ikitoa pauni milioni 168 mnamo Aprili kwa kazi za dharura za kutengeneza mashimo na pauni bilioni 10 kati ya 2010-2021 kwa ukarabati wa barabara za mitaa. Hata hivyo, wataalam kama Profesa Stephen Glaister kutoka RAC Foundation wanaonya kuwa rasilimali bado hazitoshi na halmashauri zinapaswa kugawa bajeti kwenye mahitaji mengine muhimu pia. Kuna makubaliano yanayoongezeka kwamba Uingereza inahitaji uwekezaji wa muda mrefu na wa kiwango kikubwa zaidi katika barabara zake, ili kuzuia hali kuendelea kuwa mbaya na kupunguza mzigo wa kifedha kwa halmashauri.

article_content: Taylor Swift has proven herself a business mastermind, understanding exactly what her fans want and how to deliver it. The high demand for Swift’s groundbreaking Eras Tour concert led to significant issues with Ticketmaster, making ticket buying challenging for millions of eager fans hoping to experience her three-hour musical journey. Fans who missed the live tour will soon get another chance: Starting in October, the concert film 'Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour' will debut in theaters worldwide. Even before its official release, Swift’s fan base demonstrated massive buying power by breaking global box office presale records for a musical artist. According to AMC, the film grossed $92.8 million domestically in its opening weekend, beating Justin Bieber’s previous concert film opening weekend record of $73 million. Globally, the film earned another $30.7 million, totaling $123.5 million and achieving the biggest global opening weekend for a concert film ever. Industry estimates suggest 4.8 million Swifties attended showings over the weekend, with 80% of the audience being women. Swift self-produced the film and opted to partner directly with AMC Theaters for distribution, bypassing traditional Hollywood studios — a significant achievement possible for someone of her popularity. Reports from Variety state Swift met with major studios but ultimately chose this unique route, allowing her to control the project. The film will also be screened in Cinemark, Regal, and more than 8,000 theaters globally. The New York Times reports that Swift invested about $15 million to produce the film and is expected to earn at least another $60 million overseas in its opening weekend. Swift’s partnership with AMC is lucrative, as she and her team will reportedly receive around 57% of ticket sales, while theaters keep the remainder and AMC takes a small distribution fee — much lower than studio fees for blockbuster movies like those from Marvel. Advance ticket sales surpassed $100 million before the film’s opening weekend. Swift also broke the single-day advance sales record, previously held by 'Spider-Man: No Way Home', by earning $26 million in one day. The film is projected to make about $125 million in its opening weekend in the U.S. alone. Swift was able to promote the movie during the ongoing SAG-AFTRA strike due to complying with union strike rules. With advance sales, 'The Eras Tour' film became the second highest-grossing concert film pre-release, after Michael Jackson's 'This Is It'. Due to high demand, the North American premiere was moved up by a day. The movie will play in theaters for at least four weeks, and demand is expected to sustain it even longer. This success comes as more audiences return to theaters post-pandemic, with cultural events driving significant box office results. Recent mega-hits include 'Top Gun: Maverick' and 'Avatar: The Way of Water', both earning over $1 billion globally. 'Barbie' and 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie' have also led 2023’s box office, with 'Barbie' earning $1.4 billion and 'Super Mario Bros.' garnering $1.3 billion worldwide. Based on current projections, the 'Eras Tour' film is expected to debut around the number 20 spot in the 2023 global box office after its opening weekend, with potential to climb even higher.

Kutokana na uhitaji mkubwa, tarehe ya ufunguzi Amerika Kaskazini ilisogezwa mbele kwa siku moja. Filamu itaonyeshwa kwenye sinema angalau kwa wiki nne, na uhitaji unatarajiwa kuendelea. Mafanikio haya yanaonekana huku waenda sinema wakirudi baada ya janga, na matukio haya muhimu ya kitamaduni yakileta mafanikio makubwa ya box office. Filamu zilizofanikiwa sana ni kama 'Top Gun: Maverick' na 'Avatar: The Way of Water'—zote zimeingiza zaidi ya dola bilioni moja duniani. Vile vile, 'Barbie' na 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie' zimeongoza kwa mapato ya 2023, ambapo 'Barbie' imepata dola bilioni 1.4 na 'Super Mario Bros.' dola bilioni 1.3 ulimwenguni. Kulingana na makadirio, 'Eras Tour' inatarajiwa kushika nafasi ya 20 kwa mapato ya kimataifa kwa mwaka 2023 baada ya wikiende ya kwanza, na huenda ikapanda zaidi baadaye.

Boehm, who teaches tantra seminars and is a yogi and psychologist, discussed ways to build 'wild passion and deep intimacy' through the ancient Indian practice of tantra. The conversation emphasized the importance of re-establishing sexual polarity—sometimes called sexual tension—in relationships.

Boehm explained that couples can foster intimacy and connection by letting go of tension and engaging in techniques such as making relaxed eye contact. She suggests that maintaining eye contact while remaining open and unguarded can feel both intimate and challenging, but it helps strengthen the bond between partners. According to Boehm, spending time in this state of vulnerability can be as fulfilling as sex itself.

The discussion also touched on modern relationship dynamics, noting that many women spend their workday in a 'masculine' role, making decisions and directing others, which can impact sexual chemistry at home. Boehm recommends that women reconnect with their 'feminine' aspect after work by relaxing activities, while men may need quiet time to recharge their 'masculine' energy. Often, these differing needs can lead to frustration between partners.

To restore sexual tension, Boehm suggests embracing traditional gender roles in some situations, such as having a man take charge of planning dates. She notes that a husband guiding his wife to relax or unwind upon arriving home can help re-establish polarity, which she sees as essential for intimacy.

The blog post draws a parallel to musician Sting and his wife, Trudie Styler, who are known for discussing their experience with tantra. article_content: The 2023 Judo Grand Slam began in Abu Dhabi with high-energy matches as elite athletes vied for gold on day one. In the women’s -48kg competition, Italy’s Assunta Scuto, ranked world number one, secured the top spot by beating Turkey’s Sila Ersin with a well-executed ippon in the final. Marius Vizer, President of the International Judo Federation (IJF), awarded the medals. In the men’s -60kg finale, France’s Revol claimed his first Grand Slam gold, overcoming Brazil’s Takaki with a decisive waza-ari. Medals were given out by Balazs Furjes, International Olympic Committee member from Hungary. Revol remarked, 'This is my first Grand Slam title, and with three medals from four participations, I have good memories of this place. Maybe next time I’ll come here for a vacation.' Italian judoka Odette Giuffrida shined in the -52kg class, achieving her fifth Grand Slam victory with a smart counter-attack. She received her medal from IJF Vice President Obaid Al Anzi. Giuffrida shared, 'I always enjoy coming here. It’s hot, which helps with weight control. I think this is my third medal here, and I hope for more in the future!' The -66kg final was a tense contest that went into golden score, ultimately won by Georgia’s Vazha Margvelashvili with a waza-ari. UAE Judo Federation President Mohammed Bin Thaaloob Alderei presented the medals. Canada’s Klimkait and Deguchi battled for gold in the women’s -57kg category, with Klimkait emerging victorious due to penalties in a tactical duel. UAE Minister of State Jabr Al Suwaidi awarded the medals. UAE’s Narmandakh Bayanmunkh thrilled the home fans with a series of impressive displays, earning the bronze medal. Day two of the Abu Dhabi Judo Grand Slam is set to continue tomorrow, promising more world-class action.

article_content: After a night out dancing in high heels, women often wake up with sore feet or a twisted ankle. However, it’s claimed that wearing heels may also help tone the bottom and slim the thighs. While high heels are widely considered to have negative effects on health—causing joint problems and bunions—some fitness enthusiasts now argue that they help sculpt the body.  The catch? For full benefit, you actually need to exercise in high heels. This trend is growing in the U.S., with workout classes like 'The Heel Hop Workout' and 'Stiletto Strength' available in Los Angeles and New York gyms. The trend is also reaching the UK, with celebrities like Victoria Beckham spotted exercising in high heels.  The article’s author, Anna Magee—a 45-year-old who hadn’t worn high heels regularly in years—tries a high-heel workout guided by British personal trainer Nikki Manashe. Nikki, who’s developed a high-heel workout to tone legs, hips, thighs, bottom, and core, emphasizes that wearing heels of at least 3-inches increases the challenge and targets muscles differently. Nikki began creating her routine 18 months ago after trying pole-dancing workouts that required heels.  Clients report narrower hips and tighter muscles after regular high-heel workouts. Despite anecdotal benefits, medical professionals remain skeptical. The College of Podiatry has found that many British women experience joint problems, arthritis, and bunions due to wearing heels.  Anna’s own experience highlights the unusual challenge—regular squats were significantly harder in heels, targeting new muscle groups, and balance-intensive moves like kickboxing and lunges were even more demanding. The class attracted attention from bystanders and left Anna sore, but she found the workout fun and confidence-boosting.  However, physiotherapist Tim Allardyce strongly advises against high-heel workouts. He warns that exercising in heels increases stress on feet and joints, potentially worsening bunions, back, and knee problems. He cautions that heels do not adequately absorb impact during exercise, increasing the risk of injury.  While high-heel workouts can strengthen the calves and require greater balance, Tim recommends safer alternatives using supportive athletic shoes. In summary, high-heeled workouts are an emerging trend, but carry significant risks according to health professionals.  Anna Magee is the editor of healthista.com. For more on Nikki Manashe’s personal training, see fitnessbird.co.uk.

article_content: Renowned financial author and analyst Robert Prechter notes that earning profits in the market is never easy and requires significant education, much like mastering any craft or business. 'If you have the time, drive, and the right psychological makeup, you can enter the elite realm of successful traders,' he writes. Who is Robert R. Prechter? Robert Prechter is a prominent figure in global investment circles. He is an American financial author and market analyst, recognized for his forecasts using the Elliott Wave Principle. Prechter shares insights in 'The Elliott Wave Theorist', one of the longest-running financial publications, and has developed a social causality theory called socionomics. He has edited several academic papers and written 18 books on finance and socionomics. Requirements for successful trading: Prechter shares important lessons he has learned as an investor and analyst, listing key needs for investors who want to become successful traders: 1. Get a method: Investors need an objectively defined approach to financial market analysis. 'It must be thoroughly developed, so you can explain your decision-making process consistently. While methods can improve over time, they must be implemented as a complete system,' Prechter advises. He adds that perfection is unattainable and chasing it is a waste of time. For his strategy, he chose the Wave Principle, but acknowledges that different methods can work. 2. Be disciplined: All trading experts understand the necessity of discipline, but sometimes undervalue its importance. Without discipline, a method is useless. The pressures of trading are intense, and without discipline, success is unlikely. 3. Gain experience: Trading is both intellectual and emotional. Many challenges arise from managing personal emotions. The only shortcut to gaining experience is to find a mentor who has proven success, although such mentors are rare. 4. Take responsibility for losses and manage them: Investors must accept losses as a regular part of trading and avoid blaming external forces. Prechter believes using an objective money management system is key. Methods like stops are useful, but risking only a small percentage of capital on each trade is better, letting analysis guide decisions. Handling losses well can become a trader’s greatest achievement. 5. Accept gains wisely: Major market moves happen rarely, perhaps only once or twice a year. Investors should be ready to make the most of these opportunities. Prechter warns that many investors unconsciously limit themselves by narrowly defining normal profits and losses, so when big trades come, they may abandon their method. Understanding your purpose and method is essential to long-term success. (Disclaimer: This article is based on Robert Prechter's report in The Elliott Wave Theorist.)

'Ukiwa na muda, ari na mtazamo sahihi wa kisaikolojia, unaweza kufikia kiwango cha juu cha wafanyabiashara waliofanikiwa,' anaandika. Robert R. Prechter ni nani? Robert Prechter ni jina maarufu katika sekta ya uwekezaji duniani. Yeye alichagua Wave Principle kama mbinu yake, lakini anakubali kuwa zipo mbinu nyingine nyingi zenye mafanikio. 2. Kuwa na nidhamu: Wataalamu wote wa biashara wanajua umuhimu wa nidhamu lakini mara nyingine wanapuuza. Bila nidhamu, mbinu haina maana. Njia ya haraka ya kupata uzoefu ni kupata mshauri ambaye amethibitisha mafanikio yake, ingawa si rahisi kumpata. 4. Kubali na dhibiti hasara: Wawekezaji wanatakiwa kukubali hasara kama sehemu ya kawaida ya biashara na waepuke kulaumu mambo ya nje. Kubali faida kwa busara: Mienendo mikubwa sokoni hutokea mara chache tu, labda mara moja au mbili kwa mwaka. Wawekezaji wanapaswa kuwa tayari kutumia fursa hizi muhimu. article_content: During renovations at the train station in Schwäbisch Gmünd, Germany, ten asylum seekers were employed as porters, assisting travelers with their luggage. The group, consisting of individuals from African nations, Afghanistan, and Pakistan, was paid €1.05 per hour—the maximum wage permitted for asylum seekers under German law. These refugees, residents of the town’s 250-person shelter, volunteered for the job without any effect on their benefits. Wearing red 'Service' t-shirts and straw hats for sun protection, they worked in teams of two, with shifts running from early morning to early evening. The program was launched in anticipation of Baden-Württemberg’s State Garden Festival, after complaints from passengers about difficulties crossing a temporary steel bridge during station construction. In addition to their hourly wage, the porters received free transport to and from work, and passengers were encouraged to leave tips. Town spokesperson Markus Hermann stated the wage was set by law and is not designed as an incentive. Mayor Richard Arnold advocated the initiative, highlighting its role in encouraging interaction and integration between refugees and the local community.

Wakimbizi hawa, wanaoishi kwenye makazi yenye watu 250 mjini hapo, walijitolea kazi hii bila kuguswa kwa mafao yao. Meya Richard Arnold alipongeza mpango huo akisisitiza kwamba unasaidia kukuza ushirikiano na ujumuishaji kati ya wakimbizi na jamii ya wenyeji.
