Premier League clubs are pursuing numerous players from abroad, making transfer news difficult to follow at times. One notable target is Mattia Destro, a 23-year-old Italian forward who plays for AS Roma. Destro has attracted interest from both Tottenham and Chelsea. 

Destro is known for his pace, power, skill, and goal-scoring ability — last season, he scored 13 goals in 20 appearances for Roma, with seven coming in the last eight matches. Despite his strong form, he was unexpectedly left out of Italy’s World Cup squad in 2014.

His career includes stints at Internazionale’s youth team (2005–10), Genoa (16 appearances, 2 goals in 2010–11), Siena (30 appearances, 12 goals in 2011–12), and Roma (41 appearances, 19 goals from 2012–14). Internationally, Destro has five senior caps for Italy, scoring once. He has also played at several youth levels for his country.

Tottenham are seeking a new forward due to Roberto Soldado’s struggles last season. Manager Mauricio Pochettino is looking to strengthen the squad’s attack after the team scored only 30 goals at home during the previous campaign — a record that must improve to challenge for a top-four spot.

Roma is reportedly open to selling Destro but would expect a fee close to £20 million. They have also discussed a possible loan move for Chelsea’s Fernando Torres, which could involve Destro heading to Stamford Bridge as part of the deal. Earlier this summer, German club Wolfsburg also showed interest in Destro.

There are some risks associated: Destro’s reported wage demands are around £90,000 a week, and he has a reputation for a fiery temperament — he received a three-match Serie A ban in April for striking Cagliari defender Davide Astori in the face.

In addition to his senior international experience, Destro has been capped at Italy’s Under-16, 17, 18, 19, and 21 levels. Roma’s interest in a potential player swap involving Fernando Torres remains ongoing. 

Separately, the MailOnline Fantasy Football competition offers a weekly £1,000 prize to top managers, and Tottenham manager Pochettino’s philosophy is to always believe.

article_content: Baltimore (CNN) -- In an unusual move for city mayors, the U.S. Conference of Mayors passed a resolution on Monday urging an early end to the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. Newly elected president, Los Angeles Mayor Antonio Villaraigosa, emphasized that the measure was intended to support returning troops, particularly by helping them find jobs, rather than to directly oppose the wars. Outgoing president, Burnsville Mayor Elizabeth Kautz, commented that the resolution is asking Congress to redirect military spending to domestic needs. Some mayors, however, objected to the measure, warning it could send the wrong message to troops and that such statements might be inappropriate in this setting. Auburn Mayor Peter Lewis argued against making political statements about war policy in the forum, recalling concerns from the Vietnam era. Despite this, some mayors insisted that economic difficulties in American cities demand more pressing attention than continued war spending. Madison Mayor Paul Soglin clarified that the resolution does not call for immediate withdrawal, but for an accelerated effort to end the wars. After amendments expressing support for U.S. troops and urging a carefully planned withdrawal, the resolution passed, calling for 'bringing these U.S. war dollars home.' The revised resolution notes the annual $126 billion cost of the wars and acknowledges that over 6,000 U.S. service members and at least 120,000 civilians have died since the conflicts began. It calls on Congress and the president to end the wars when strategically possible and to use the funds to address vital needs at home, create jobs, rebuild infrastructure, help local governments, and invest in a renewable and sustainable economy.

article_content: A team of American scientists has recreated Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa on a canvas so tiny, it's just 30 microns wide—far thinner than a strand of human hair. Using a sophisticated technique called ThermoChemical NanoLithography (TCNL), the Georgia Tech researchers, including lead scientist Jennifer Curtis and PhD student Keith Carroll, used an atomic force microscope and a heated cantilever to "paint" the image on a molecular scale. By adjusting the heat at each step, they altered the concentration of molecules and thus produced light and dark shades, recreating the famous artwork pixel by pixel. This cutting-edge process allows for highly precise manipulation of molecular structures and opens up new opportunities in fields like nanomanufacturing, nanoelectronics, optoelectronics, and bioengineering. The method is made more accessible by using commonly available laboratory tools, and recent advancements like multi-cantilever arrays could help make large-scale nanoscale patterning both fast and efficient.

Kwa kutumia mbinu ya kisasa iitwayo ThermoChemical NanoLithography (TCNL), watafiti wa Georgia Tech wakiongozwa na Jennifer Curtis pamoja na mwanafunzi wa shahada ya uzamivu Keith Carroll, walitumia hadubini maalum na kifaa cha joto kuchora picha hiyo katika kiwango cha molekuli. Kwa kubadilisha joto kwa kila hatua, waliweza kudhibiti mkusanyiko wa molekuli na hivyo kutengeneza vivuli tofauti vya rangi, na kuunda picha maarufu hatua kwa hatua. Mbinu hii ya hali ya juu inaruhusu upangaji wa molekuli kwa usahihi mkubwa na kufungua fursa mpya kwenye sekta kama vile utengenezaji wa vifaa vidogo, nanoelektroniki, opotoelektroniki na uhandisi wa kibaiolojia. article_content: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad has sent a message via intermediaries to Pope Francis, stating that his government is ready to participate in upcoming peace talks. Assad emphasized, however, that progress hinges on other countries stopping their support for groups he described as terrorists, as reported by Syria's state media, SANA. Assad also thanked the Pope for his Christmas appeal to end violence and suffering in Syria. In his letter, Assad claimed that stopping terrorism requires ending all forms of external military, logistical, or training support from certain neighboring and international countries to armed groups operating in Syria. He reiterated that a solution to the crisis should be achieved through internal dialogue among Syrians, under Syrian leadership and without foreign intervention, allowing Syrians to determine their own leadership and future through democratic elections. The message was delivered during a meeting between Syrian Minister Joseph Sweid and the Vatican's Secretary of State, Archbishop Pietro Parolin. Archbishop Parolin told Sweid that Pope Francis is following Syria’s situation and affirms the need for Syrians to resolve the crisis through dialogue, free from outside interference. The Vatican confirmed that it received Assad's message, and reported that the Syrian delegation outlined their government’s position. The Syrian presidency's Twitter account also provided details, reiterating that the future of Syria should be decided solely by its people through elections. This message comes ahead of the Geneva II peace conference, a United Nations-backed meeting aiming to bring the Syrian government and opposition together to seek a solution to the conflict, which began in March 2011 and has resulted in over 100,000 deaths. The upcoming talks follow the Geneva I meeting in 2012, which proposed a transitional government but did not resolve Assad’s role. Separately, a joint UN mission indicated it will likely miss the December 31 deadline to remove key chemical materials from Syria, due to ongoing security problems, logistical challenges, and adverse weather. Still, the mission noted progress toward eliminating Syria’s chemical weapons by the target date of June 2014. Violence persists inside Syria: at least 25 people, including women and children, were killed in a government airstrike on a rebel-controlled area of Aleppo, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. The attack allegedly involved barrel bombs, a method for which Assad’s government has frequently been accused. Local activists say hundreds have been killed recently in Aleppo, though CNN cannot independently verify these casualty figures.

Hata hivyo, ujumbe huo umeonyesha maendeleo katika juhudi za kuondoa silaha za kemikali Syria ifikapo Juni 2014. article_content: Although the government shutdown has ended, debates over the Affordable Care Act—commonly known as Obamacare—remain intense. Republicans are ramping up scrutiny of the Act, launching oversight hearings focused on the troubled debut of Healthcare.gov, the federal website for health insurance enrollment. Rep. Fred Upton of Michigan, chair of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, says Americans deserve answers about the website’s problems, which include widespread delays and technical failures. He has called on officials from the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to testify and is requesting records of their communications with website contractors. Other leading lawmakers, such as Rep. Darrell Issa and Sen. Lamar Alexander, have demanded more information from HHS Secretary Kathleen Sebelius regarding the rollout challenges. Many users, especially those who registered early, have experienced login difficulties. Senior officials state that these issues are actively being addressed. Moreover, there is confusion over whether some passwords from the initial launch period were inadvertently deleted. Secretary Sebelius has admitted that the website’s launch did not meet expectations but emphasized that improvements continue, allowing more people to enroll successfully. Despite ongoing fixes, some Republican lawmakers, including Sen. Pat Roberts and Rep. John Fleming, are pushing for Sebelius to resign, arguing that there has been sufficient time to prepare for the rollout. White House spokesperson Jay Carney said President Obama continues to support Sebelius. He reiterated that fixing the website is a priority, but the primary goal remains expanding access to affordable health insurance. Former White House spokesman Robert Gibbs criticized the website failures on national television and suggested that those responsible should be held accountable once repairs are complete. With attention shifting from the government shutdown, Republicans highlight the website’s problems as evidence of wider weaknesses in the law, with some proposing a delay to the mandate requiring individuals to get health insurance. Nevertheless, HHS spokeswoman Joanne Peters maintains that the online enrollment process is active and that many Americans are still seeking information about their coverage options.

article_content: Kabaddi, once a niche sport familiar to some through Trans World Sport, is preparing for a global spotlight with the launch of the World Kabaddi League (WKL) at London’s O2 Arena this weekend. The WKL aims to modernize and popularize kabaddi, blending elements of rugby, tag, and wrestling. The game, which originates from South Asia, involves teams sending a 'raider' into the opposing half. To win a point, the raider must tag opponents and return to their half without inhaling, all while chanting 'kabaddi' to prove they haven’t taken a breath. Defenders and raiders must follow strict boundaries, and additional points are available through specific plays such as reaching the bonus line or eliminating an entire opposing team. With a global following estimated at 100 million—mainly in South Asia and among the Asian diaspora—kabaddi is now poised to reach a new audience. The WKL features eight teams competing in 14 cities across five countries over the next five months, culminating in the crowning of the first World Kabaddi League champions. The league’s London launch will feature singers and dancers from Bollywood, with Akshay Kumar, Bollywood actor and co-owner of the Khalsa Warriors team, among its supporters. Notable backers include Labour MP for Ealing Southall Virendra Sharma, who hopes kabaddi will become part of the Commonwealth and Olympic Games, and businessman Talwinder Hayre, co-owner of the United Singhs, who envisions kabaddi becoming as popular as cricket’s IPL. Following its debut in London, the WKL roadshow will stop in Birmingham, New York, and other major cities. Tickets are available for the grand opening at the O2 Arena. Kabaddi has been described as ‘tag for grown-ups’ or ‘rugby without the ball,’ and enjoys high-profile attention, with Bollywood celebrities such as Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan attending professional matches.

WKL inalenga kuiboresha na kuitangaza kabaddi, ikichanganya vipengele vya rugby bila mpira, tag na mieleka. Mchezo huu kutoka Asia Kusini, unahusisha timu kutuma ‘raider’ upande wa wapinzani. Ili kupata pointi, raider lazima awaguse wapinzani na kurudi upande wake bila kuvuta pumzi, huku akiimba 'kabaddi' ili kuthibitisha hajatulia. Wazuiaji na raider wanapaswa kufuata mipaka maalum, na pointi za ziada hupatikana kwa hatua maalum kama kugusa mstari wa bonasi au kuwatoa timu nzima ya wapinzani. Uzinduzi wa ligi jijini London utapambwa na waimbaji na wacheza dansi kutoka Bollywood, wakiwemo Akshay Kumar, mwigizaji wa Bollywood na mmiliki mwenza wa timu ya Khalsa Warriors. article_content: The Victorian Labor opposition is calling for the legalization of medicinal cannabis oil to assist individuals facing severe illnesses like cancer, multiple sclerosis, HIV/AIDS, glaucoma, and Parkinson’s disease. Leader Daniel Andrews emphasized that the proposal is strictly for medical purposes in exceptional situations, explicitly excluding recreational legalization. He pointed out that current laws often force parents into difficult positions, sometimes having to choose between legal compliance and alleviating their child’s pain. Supporters argue that outdated laws are contributing to suffering among families. Momentum for reform follows stories of Victorian families whose children benefited from medicinal cannabis when standard treatments failed. If Labor is successful in the upcoming election, they plan to consult the Victorian Law Reform Commission on regulating the prescription, production, and supply of medical cannabis. Importantly, the proposal does not allow for smoking marijuana as a medical treatment.

Amesema sheria zilizopo sasa zinawalazimu wazazi kufanya maamuzi magumu, mara nyingine kuvunja sheria ili kupunguza mateso ya watoto wao. Wito wa mabadiliko umeongezeka baada ya baadhi ya familia huko Victoria kufanikiwa kutumia bidhaa za bangi kwa watoto wao wagonjwa baada ya tiba za kawaida kushindwa. article_content: Channel 4 is facing pressure to explain why it aired 'Big Fat Quiz of the Year 2012' just after the 9pm watershed. Viewers expressed outrage after comedians made crude jokes about the Queen and other public figures. The quiz, hosted by Jimmy Carr and featuring Jack Whitehall, James Corden, Jonathan Ross, Richard Ayoade, Russell Howard, and Gabby Logan, led to complaints being filed with Ofcom. Jack Whitehall and James Corden made many offensive jokes on the program and appeared to be drinking throughout. Their remarks targeted the Queen, the Duke of Edinburgh, Barack Obama, Usain Bolt, and Susan Boyle. Channel 4's chairman, Lord Burns, declined to comment on the broadcast. Chief executive David Abraham was reportedly on holiday and unavailable for comment. Tory MP Conor Burns, a member of the Commons culture, media, and sport select committee, condemned the decision to air the show so soon after the watershed, calling the humor 'distasteful.' He said he will ask Channel 4 for an editorial explanation. Comedian Billy Connolly expressed his concern about the state of modern stand-up, criticizing 'Channel 4-style' comedy and saying panel shows have hurt traditional stand-up. Negative reactions filled social media, with viewers calling the show disrespectful, especially regarding comments made about the Queen and the use of explicit language. During the program, James Corden and Jack Whitehall were seen drinking red wine and eating pizza. Corden, after a joke about Susan Boyle, acknowledged he may have crossed a line. Comedians like Rory Bremner and Jo Brand have also criticized the competitive and exclusive nature of modern comedy panel shows.

article_content:
A U.S. federal judge has ordered the military to stop enforcing the 'don't ask, don't tell' policy, effectively removing the ban on openly gay personnel serving in the armed forces. The ruling by Judge Virginia Phillips, who was appointed during the Clinton administration, was welcomed by gay rights advocates including the Log Cabin Republicans— the group that sued the military. Judge Phillips previously found the policy violated the Constitution's guarantees of due process and freedom of speech, but only now has she directed the military to cease all related investigations and discharges. 

The Justice Department and Department of Defense are currently reviewing the ruling and have up to 60 days to appeal, though they are not required to do so. President Obama has publicly advocated for ending the policy, while Congress is weighing legislation that could repeal it after an ongoing Pentagon review concludes in December. Since its inception, 'don't ask, don't tell' led to the discharge of more than 12,500 service members based on their sexual orientation. The policy also prevented the military from directly inquiring about a servicemember’s sexuality.

Many LGBTQ+ organizations have hailed the decision as a victory for equality and military readiness but advised caution for service members considering coming out until the case is fully resolved. Conversely, some opponents, like Representative Howard 'Buck' McKeon, warn that a sudden policy shift might negatively affect military operations. Legal experts and activists note that the future of the policy depends on whether the administration appeals or Congress acts first.

article_content: Niger State Commissioner for Information and Strategy, Binta Mamman, described the transformation of Niger State as a challenging but achievable task. She emphasized that for Governor Mohammed Umar Bago to realize his vision of a “New Niger,” both he and his team must be willing to make sacrifices and step out of their comfort zones. At a press conference on Monday, Mamman outlined the governor's achievements in his first four months in office. She stated, “It is clear that developing and transforming Niger State into the envisioned ‘New Niger’ under Governor Bago’s leadership is not only a significant challenge but also possible to achieve. These first four months, coinciding with our nation’s Independence anniversary, have been eventful. His Excellency has worked tirelessly to deliver on his policy goals and campaign promises.” The commissioner noted that while setting the state on a path to sustainable development is complex, there are early signs of steady progress and hope. Among the achievements listed for Bago’s first four months are: construction of a new divisional police station in Chanchaga, replacing an old structure that blocked water supply to over 200 residents; improved order and traffic flow on the Suleja-Abuja highway by stopping traders from displaying goods and preventing indiscriminate parking during the weekly Madalla Market; a standing order for monthly payment of N30 million to the National Examination Council (NECO) to settle a cumulative state debt of N500 million. The state also sponsored many citizens for pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia and issued Sallah welfare packages of N100,000 each to Government House staff, the SSG’s office, and key state officials. Respect for traditional institutions was reinforced as the governor paid Sallah homage to all eight emirs in Niger State. Farmers received thousands of bags of fertilizer and farm inputs at subsidized rates for the 2023 wet season. To combat crime, 20 operational vehicles were supplied to the Nigeria Police and related agencies such as the DSS, NSCDC, NDLEA, and other non-conventional security agencies. Additionally, food items worth N3 billion were distributed across the state's 25 Local Government Areas to help offset the effects of the petroleum subsidy removal. Mamman concluded by emphasizing these achievements are in addition to the governor's ongoing national and international engagement with private and governmental organizations, aimed at fostering development and partnership.

Mamman amesisitiza kwamba mafanikio haya yanakuja pamoja na juhudi za gavana kushirikiana na mashirika binafsi na ya serikali ndani na nje ya nchi kwa ajili ya maendeleo na ushirikiano.

article_content: Former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi is urging against a third-party presidential campaign supported by the political group No Labels, expressing concern that such a candidacy could jeopardize President Biden’s chance of winning in 2024. No Labels, established in 2010, was intended to foster bipartisan cooperation and reduce political polarization in the United States. Thirteen years later, the organization has drawn criticism from many Democrats in Washington. Earlier this month, The New York Times reported that No Labels is considering putting forward a moderate Republican as its presidential candidate for 2024. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Pelosi argued that No Labels is not as nonpartisan as it claims and suggested that its donors and leadership are pushing for Republican policies. 'I think that our democracy is at risk, and I think that No Labels is perilous to our democracy,' she said. 'I say that without any hesitation.' Pelosi made these remarks at Third Way, a centrist think tank in Washington, D.C., which also warns against a potential No Labels candidacy. In response, No Labels co-founder and former Democratic vice presidential nominee Joe Lieberman disagreed with Pelosi’s assessment. 'Do you know what is 'perilous' to democracy?' he said in a statement. 'When leaders try to tell Americans what they are allowed to think and when they try to prevent competition from participating in the political process.' Reports indicate the White House shares concerns that a No Labels campaign could help elect Donald Trump. Former House Democratic Leader Dick Gephardt has even started a super PAC specifically aimed at countering No Labels. When No Labels was founded, co-founders William Galston and David Frum—former aides to Presidents Bill Clinton and George W. Bush—sought to encourage citizens to monitor elected officials and promote bipartisan cooperation. Over time, however, No Labels has shifted toward possibly running its own candidate. In 2023, the group has worked to secure ballot access in all 50 states and has described its goal as 'building a data vault to target and turnout the commonsense majority.' Polling indicates both Biden and Trump are unpopular, with net-negative favorability ratings. No Labels argues that voters could benefit from an alternative candidate. It remains uncertain whether a third-party candidate would serve as a spoiler and which party would be most affected. An NPR/PBS NewsHour/Marist poll showed a tie between Trump and Biden when generic third-party options were included. William Galston, a co-founder of No Labels, left the group this year over worries it could aid Trump's reelection but notes the environment is complicated by other independent candidates like Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Cornel West. Pelosi distinguishes between independent candidates and a No Labels-backed candidate, maintaining that No Labels promotes a conservative agenda under the guise of bipartisanship. No Labels counters by highlighting that its leadership includes Democrats and that it promotes bipartisan initiatives.

No Labels, iliyoanzishwa mwaka 2010, ililenga kukuza ushirikiano wa pande mbili na kupunguza mvutano wa kisiasa nchini Marekani. Mwaka 2023, kundi hili limekuwa likifanya jitihada kupata nafasi kwenye karatasi za uchaguzi katika majimbo yote 50 na wameeleza lengo lao kama ‘kujenga hazina ya data ili kulenga na kuwashawishi walio wengi wenye maadili ya kawaida.’ Uchunguzi wa maoni unaonyesha Biden na Trump hawapendwi sana, wote wakiwa na viwango hasi vya umaarufu. According to researchers in the Netherlands, the world's catchiest song is the Spice Girls' 1996 debut single "Wannabe." A team from the University of Amsterdam, in partnership with the Manchester Museum of Science and Industry, studied what makes certain songs especially memorable. They created 'Hooked on Music,' an interactive online game that asks participants to identify songs as quickly as possible from short clips.

Research showed that listeners recognized "Wannabe" in an average of just 2.29 seconds, as reported by the BBC. This phenomenon—where a song repeatedly plays in your mind—is known as an "earworm." Scientists are still working to understand why earworms occur and how they affect the brain.

More than 20,000 people have played 'Hooked on Music.' Early findings from the study will be shared at the Manchester Science Festival. The researchers hope this work will contribute to therapies for dementia and Alzheimer's patients. Computational musicologist John Ashley Burgoyne told the BBC that music with strong personal meaning can be therapeutic, but the challenge lies in finding the right piece for each person.

According to the 'Hooked on Music' experiment, the top 10 catchiest songs are:
1. Spice Girls, "Wannabe"
2. Lou Bega, "Mambo No. 5"
3. Survivor, "Eye of the Tiger"
4. Lady Gaga, "Just Dance"
5. ABBA, "SOS"
6. Roy Orbison, "Pretty Woman"
7. Michael Jackson, "Beat It"
8. Whitney Houston, "I Will Always Love You"
9. The Human League, "Don't You Want Me"
10. Aerosmith, "I Don't Want to Miss a Thing"

article_content: Secretary of Defense Chuck Hagel, a former enlisted soldier who served in Vietnam, is instituting a 20% budget cut for the Pentagon's top leadership offices, including his own department. According to Pentagon press secretary George Little, the move is projected to save between $1.5 and $2 billion. Most of the savings will result from reducing personnel among Department of Defense leaders, though the exact number of job losses has yet to be determined. "Personnel reductions associated with these savings will be determined during the development of detailed execution plans," Little explained. The cost-cutting measures will take effect in October 2014 and continue through 2019. Budget reductions have been a priority within the Defense Department for several years, even before Hagel took office. The Pentagon emphasized that these cuts will proceed regardless of whether Congress lifts sequester-level budget caps. "These cuts will be implemented even if Congress lifts sequester-level budget caps," Little stated.

Kwa mujibu wa msemaji wa Pentagon George Little, hatua hii inatarajiwa kuokoa kati ya dola bilioni 1.5 hadi 2. Sehemu kubwa ya akiba hii itapatikana kupitia kupungua kwa idadi ya wafanyakazi miongoni mwa viongozi wa Wizara ya Ulinzi, ingawa idadi kamili ya watakaoathiriwa haijajulikana bado. "Upunguzaji wa wafanyakazi utabainika wakati wa maandalizi ya mipango ya utekelezaji," Little alieleza. Hatua hizi za kupunguza gharama zitaanza Oktoba 2014 na kuendelea hadi 2019. Kupunguza bajeti ilikuwa kipaumbele Wizara ya Ulinzi kwa miaka mingi, hata kabla ya Hagel kuchukua nafasi hiyo. Pentagon imesisitiza kuwa mikato hii itaendelea kutekelezwa hata kama Bunge litaondoa kikomo cha bajeti ya sequestration. "Mikato hii itatekelezwa hata kama Bunge litaondoa kikomo cha bajeti ya sequestration," Little alisema.

article_content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to chair the Central Zonal Council meeting in Narendra Nagar, Uttarakhand this Saturday. Participating will be chief ministers and officials from Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand, who will address pressing issues like transportation infrastructure, electricity distribution, and river water sharing. Established in 1956, the Central Zonal Council seeks to enhance cooperation and development among its member states, with key representatives from NITI Aayog present for this 24th session. A government official noted that the number of such council meetings has increased threefold over the last eight years under the BJP’s leadership. While in Uttarakhand, Amit Shah also plans to meet with state BJP leaders and join the All India Police Science Congress in Dehradun. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, currently on a three-day visit, will participate in the council meeting before heading to the Badrinath and Kedarnath temples. In Maharashtra, opposition members from the Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance—including Congress, the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena, and Sharad Pawar’s Nationalist Congress Party—have created a panel to coordinate their strategy for the 2024 general elections, focusing mainly on seat-sharing. Beginning Saturday, Congress will conduct a comprehensive review of its performance in all 48 Lok Sabha constituencies in Maharashtra, a step that is anticipated to influence larger coalition negotiations within the INDIA alliance, which has not met since last gathering in Mumbai. Meanwhile in Uttar Pradesh, influential ex-MLA Imran Masood is making his return to the Congress after time spent with the Samajwadi Party and the Bahujan Samaj Party. Characterizing the move as a homecoming, Masood hopes to strengthen Congress’s prospects in western UP, especially ahead of seat divisions within the INDIA alliance. With a reputation for openness and advocacy for West UP’s statehood, Masood’s shifting affiliations reflect a broader search for political impact. He departed Congress initially due to disagreements over ticket distribution, later joining the SP and then moving to the BSP, but was expelled from the latter for calling for broader opposition unity. In another development, the Haryana government will host a function on Saturday at Haryana Bhawan in New Delhi to commemorate Emperor Hemchandra Vikramaditya’s coronation. The celebration will include the release of a special postage stamp and feature Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar and Union Minister Devusinh Chauhan as chief guests to honor the emperor’s military achievements. The day’s news also spotlights an opinion column by journalist Neerja Chowdhury reflecting on election history, and an interview with Sanjay Nishad of the NISHAD Party about how a planned caste census in Uttar Pradesh could differ from Bihar’s approach.

Baraza hili lilianzishwa mwaka 1956 kwa lengo la kuongeza ushirikiano na maendeleo kati ya majimbo wanachama. Wawakilishi muhimu kutoka NITI Aayog pia watakuwepo kwenye kikao hiki cha 24. Amazon is set to join the competitive music streaming market this summer, according to a recent BuzzFeed report citing five anonymous music industry sources. The company plans to introduce on-demand music streaming as part of its Prime service by June or July. Initially, the service is expected to feature only tracks and albums that are at least six months old.

Despite a $20 price increase in March, raising the annual Prime membership to $99, many users still consider Amazon Prime a top-value web service. For $8.25 per month, members receive benefits such as two-day shipping, Kindle book lending, and free streaming of movies and TV shows. The Prime subscription fee had not changed since its inception nine years ago, until this recent adjustment.

Adding music streaming is seen as another incentive for consumers to join Prime and, importantly for Amazon, to keep customers within its online ecosystem. The shift aligns with broader industry trends as consumers increasingly favor streaming over purchasing music outright. According to Nielsen, digital music sales dropped about 13% in the first quarter, while subscription streaming revenues surged by 51% in 2013.

Currently, Pandora dominates as the most popular internet radio platform in the United States, and Spotify holds a large user base in Europe. Major web companies such as Google, Microsoft, and Apple are also expanding their streaming offerings. This week, Apple confirmed its acquisition of Beats Electronics and Beats Music, enhancing its portfolio with both well-known headphones and a subscription music service praised for its recommendation engine, which blends algorithmic suggestions with human curation.

Amazon declined to comment for this report.

Kampuni hiyo inakusudia kuanzisha huduma ya utiririshaji wa muziki kwa mahitaji kama sehemu ya huduma yake ya Prime kufikia Juni au Julai. Mwanzoni, huduma hii itapatikana tu kwa nyimbo na albamu zilizotolewa si chini ya miezi sita iliyopita.

Licha ya ongezeko la bei la dola 20 mwezi Machi, na kufanya uanachama wa Prime kufikia $99 kwa mwaka, watumiaji wengi bado wanaona Amazon Prime kama mojawapo ya huduma bora mtandaoni. Kwa $8.25 kwa mwezi, wanachama wanapata usafirishaji wa siku mbili, kukopa vitabu vya Kindle na kutazama bure filamu pamoja na vipindi vya televisheni. Ada ya Prime haikuwahi kubadilika tangu ilipoanza miaka tisa iliyopita hadi sasa.

Kuongeza utiririshaji wa muziki kunahesabiwa kama sababu zaidi ya watu kujiunga na Prime na, muhimu zaidi kwa Amazon, kuwafanya wabaki kwenye mfumo wao wa mtandaoni. Mtazamo huu unaratibiana na mwenendo wa soko ambapo watumiaji wanapendelea utiririshaji kuliko kununua muziki. Kulingana na Nielsen, mauzo ya muziki kidijitali yameshuka kwa karibu asilimia 13 katika robo ya kwanza, wakati mapato ya utiririshaji wa usajili yaliongezeka kwa asilimia 51 mwaka 2013.

Kwa sasa, Pandora inaongoza kama jukwaa kuu la redio ya mtandaoni Marekani, na Spotify ina umaarufu mkubwa barani Ulaya. Makampuni makubwa kama Google, Microsoft na Apple pia yameongeza huduma zao za utiririshaji. Wiki hii, Apple imethibitisha kununua Beats Electronics na Beats Music, jambo linaloongeza vifaa vyake maarufu vya headphones pamoja na huduma ya utiririshaji wa muziki inayosifiwa kwa mfumo wa mapendekezo unaochanganya algoriti na ushauri wa kibinadamu.

AMC Networks has announced its newest Walking Dead series, 'The Ones Who Live,' will debut on both AMC and AMC+ on February 25. The series stars Andrew Lincoln and Danai Gurira, reprising their iconic roles as Rick Grimes and Michonne. The first glimpse of this spinoff was shared during the finale of 'Fear the Walking Dead.'

In 'The Ones Who Live,' Rick and Michonne attempt to reunite despite great obstacles, including long separation and the burdens of their pasts. The narrative explores themes of love, survival, and self-discovery against the backdrop of a world where danger comes from both the dead and the living. It raises the question: Can these characters find each other and themselves again, or will they remain lost in a world overrun by chaos?

Pollyanna McIntosh returns as Jadis, joined by Terry O’Quinn (Beale), Matt Jeffries (Matt), and Lesley-Ann Brandt (Pearl). The show is led by showrunner and executive producer Scott M. Gimple, with Lincoln, Gurira, Denise Huth, and Brian Bockrath also producing. Viewers can look forward to a new take on relationships and survival in the Walking Dead universe.

The new series launches February 25 on AMC and AMC+. (Disclosure: The opinions in this article belong to the original authors and not The Economic Times.)

article_content: Company culture doesn’t happen by accident—it must be intentionally created. Organizational expert Josh Bersin suggests, 'To change the culture, don’t start with the culture. Start with the problem you’re trying to solve, define what success looks like, and understand why it matters to your company.' At Headspace, this philosophy is embraced by Chief Operating Officer and Chief People Officer Karan Singh, whose motto is 'less but better'. Headspace, a leading mental health care platform, provides resources ranging from mindfulness and meditation to clinical support, coaching, therapy, psychiatry, and employee assistance programs. Singh describes Headspace’s culture as rooted in authenticity and aspiration. The company sustains its culture by aligning daily initiatives with its mission and core values. To maintain a healthy culture and workforce, Headspace conducts quarterly employee engagement surveys. Singh believes engagement and team capacity are closely linked—lower engagement leads to reduced productivity. Measuring engagement every quarter allows for effective planning and quick responses, helping to retain talent in a dynamic job market. In leadership development, Singh and his team focus on quality over quantity, supporting managers to prevent stress and burnout, especially in high-growth environments. One recent initiative, the 'Superhuman' Program—developed with neuroscientists and faculty from the University of California, Berkeley—helps employees succeed in a remote-first environment. The program emphasizes working smarter by prioritizing important tasks and scheduling focused work time. Every Headspace employee completed this program. Additionally, the article features Kevin Kruse, CEO of LEADx and author of several bestselling books on leadership and employee engagement.

Anza na tatizo unalojaribu kulitatua, fafanua mafanikio yako yanavyomaanisha nini, na elewa kwa nini ni muhimu kwa kampuni yako.' Katika Headspace, falsafa hii imekuwa sehemu muhimu ya uongozi wa Karan Singh, Afisa Mkuu wa Uendeshaji na Afisa Mkuu wa Watu, ambaye anaamini katika kauli mbiu ya 'kidogo lakini bora'. Headspace ni jukwaa mashuhuri la afya ya akili, linalotoa huduma kuanzia mazoezi ya kutafakari, ushauri nasaha, tiba, magonjwa ya akili hadi msaada wa wafanyakazi. Singh anaona utamaduni wa Headspace umejengwa kwenye uhalisia na malengo. Kampuni inadumisha utamaduni wake kwa kuhakikisha shughuli za kila siku zinaendana na dhamira na maadili yao. Katika ukuzaji wa viongozi, Singh na timu yake wanaweka mkazo kwenye ubora zaidi kuliko wingi na kuunga mkono wasimamizi ili kupunguza msongo na kuchoka, hasa katika mazingira ya kazi yanayokua kwa kasi. Mpango wa hivi karibuni, unaoitwa 'Superhuman', ulitengenezwa kwa ushirikiano na wanasayansi wa neva na wahadhiri kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha California, Berkeley. Mpango huu unalenga kusaidia wafanyakazi kufanikiwa katika mazingira ya kazi ya mbali kwa kuweka kipaumbele kwenye kazi muhimu na kupanga muda wa kufanya kazi kwa umakini. Kila mfanyakazi wa Headspace alishiriki kwenye programu hii. Zaidi ya hayo, makala inamtaja Kevin Kruse, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa LEADx na mwandishi maarufu wa vitabu vya uongozi na ushiriki wa wafanyakazi.

Cazorla, who joined Arsenal from Malaga two years ago, has been pivotal for Arsene Wenger’s side. However, with the arrival of Alexis Sanchez for £30 million and stiff competition from Mesut Ozil, Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, Lukas Podolski, and Theo Walcott, playing positions in the midfield are increasingly competitive.

Although Cazorla recently agreed to a one-year contract extension, Atletico are hopeful they can negotiate his transfer. Arsenal is understood to want at least £15 million for the Spanish playmaker.

Additionally, Atletico Madrid are monitoring Arsenal left-back Nacho Monreal as a possible replacement for Filipe Luis, who has joined Chelsea. Monreal has struggled for regular starts behind Kieran Gibbs and is open to a move for more playing time in Spain.

article_content: Edward Snowden has leaked documents revealing that the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) is undertaking a project to build a quantum computer capable of breaking the world’s strongest encryption tools. These documents, provided by Snowden, indicate that the NSA’s initiative could have far-reaching consequences for nearly every form of encryption protecting government, banking, and hospital records. The NSA’s $79.7 million research project—called 'Penetrating Hard Targets'—involves building a 'cryptologically useful quantum computer' through classified contracts, reportedly taking place at a laboratory in College Park, Maryland, according to The Washington Post. One internal NSA document reportedly states: 'The application of quantum technologies to encryption algorithms threatens to dramatically impact the U.S. government's ability to both protect its communications and eavesdrop on foreign governments.' Quantum computers are expected to far exceed the speed of conventional computers, completing tasks in seconds that would take ordinary computers years. Comparisons between the NSA’s top-secret progress and advancements by civilian quantum labs have been ongoing among computer scientists and physicists. The agency is reportedly motivated to keep pace with quantum computing initiatives supported by the Swiss government and the European Union, which have made significant advances in recent years. Another leaked document notes, 'The geographic scope has narrowed from a global effort to a discrete focus on the European Union and Switzerland.' Quantum computers, in theory, can solve problems far faster and more efficiently than classical computers by skipping unnecessary calculations. Such power could break commonly used encryption standards like RSA, which protect much of today’s secure financial, web, and email communications. To safeguard sensitive research, the NSA conducts some work in 'Faraday cages'—metal structures that block electromagnetic energy—to maintain the integrity of quantum computing experiments. In related developments, Google recently acquired a D-Wave Two quantum computer, built by Canadian company D-Wave, which can perform many tasks thousands of times faster than conventional machines. Google aims to use this technology in its Quantum Artificial Intelligence Lab at NASA's Ames Research Center to pursue breakthroughs in disease research, climate modeling, and improving robots’ comprehension of human speech.

Nyaraka hizi, zilizotolewa na Snowden, zinaonyesha kuwa mpango wa NSA unaweza kuwa na athari kubwa kwa karibu kila aina ya usimbaji fiche unaolinda rekodi za serikali, benki, na hospitali. Mradi wa utafiti wa dola milioni 79.7 wa NSA uitwao 'Penetrating Hard Targets' unahusisha ujenzi wa 'kompyuta ya quantum inayoweza kutumiwa katika usimbaji fiche' kupitia mikataba ya siri, inasemekana kufanyika kwenye maabara huko College Park, Maryland, kwa mujibu wa The Washington Post. Waraka mmoja wa ndani wa NSA unaripotiwa kusema: 'Matumizi ya teknolojia za quantum kwenye algorithimu za usimbaji fiche yanaweza kuathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa uwezo wa serikali ya Marekani kulinda mawasiliano yake na kusikiliza mawasiliano ya serikali za kigeni.' Kompyuta za quantum zinatarajiwa kuwa haraka zaidi kuliko kompyuta za kawaida, zikiweza kufanya kazi ndani ya sekunde ambazo kwa kawaida zingechukua miaka kwa kompyuta za kawaida. Ulinganisho kati ya maendeleo ya siri ya NSA na yale ya maabara za kiraia za kompyuta za quantum huendelea kufanywa na wanasayansi wa kompyuta na fizikia. Inasemekana shirika hilo lina lengo la kufikia kiwango sawa na miradi ya quantum inayoungwa mkono na serikali ya Uswisi na Umoja wa Ulaya, ambao wamepiga hatua kubwa miaka ya hivi karibuni. Waraka mwingine uliovuja unasema, 'Lengo limebadilika kutoka juhudi za kimataifa hadi mkazo maalum kwenye Umoja wa Ulaya na Uswisi.' Kiteoriti, kompyuta za quantum zina uwezo wa kutatua matatizo haraka na kwa ufanisi zaidi kuliko kompyuta za kawaida kwa kuruka mahesabu yasiyo ya lazima. Uwezo huu unaweza kuvunja viwango vya usimbaji fiche kama RSA, vinavyotumika kulinda mawasiliano mengi ya kifedha, tovuti, na barua pepe za kisasa. Ili kuhakikisha utafiti wa siri uko salama, NSA inafanya baadhi ya kazi zake ndani ya 'Faraday cages'—miundo ya chuma inayozuia mionzi ya umeme— ili kulinda majaribio ya quantum computing. Katika matukio yanayohusiana, Google hivi karibuni imenunua kompyuta ya quantum iitwayo D-Wave Two, iliyotengenezwa na kampuni ya Kanada D-Wave, inayoweza kufanya kazi nyingi kwa kasi mara elfu kadhaa kuliko vifaa vya kawaida. article_content: One of the most unusual arrest warrants in US history was issued yesterday when a federal judge authorized the Department of Homeland Security to seize a dinosaur skeleton from an art company. The US government is working to have the auction house return the skeleton of a Tyrannosaurus bataar, which lived in Mongolia 70 million years ago, to the Asian country. The nearly complete fossil is believed to have been unearthed between 1995 and 2005, and is one of several specimens first discovered in the Gobi Desert in 1946. This 70-million-year-old Tyrannosaurus bataar skeleton is at the center of a legal battle demanding it be handed over to the US government so it can be returned to Mongolia. The skeleton is 24 feet (7.31 meters) long and eight feet (2.43 meters) tall, with an estimated weight of about a ton. Although Mongolian law declares fossils to be property of the state and bans their export, the skeleton arrived in Gainesville, Florida, in March 2010. It was sold at a New York auction on May 20 for $1.05 million by Heritage Auctions. According to documents filed Monday in US District Court in New York, the skeleton is alleged to have been illegally imported from Britain through false claims that it was worth $15,000. US authorities are now demanding that it be handed over so it can be returned to Mongolia. The government of Mongolia had obtained an injunction from a judge in Texas, where the auction house is based, to prevent the sale, but the sale went ahead anyway. Jim Halperin, co-chairman of Heritage Auctions, said, 'We auctioned the Tyrannosaurus bataar conditionally, subject to future court rulings, so this matter is now in the hands of lawyers and politicians.' US Attorney Preet Bharara stated the remains are 'of tremendous cultural and historic significance to the people of Mongolia and provide a connection to the country's prehistoric past.' 'When the skeleton was allegedly looted, a piece of the country's natural history was stolen with it, and we look forward to returning it to its rightful place,' he said. Mongolia's President Tsakhia Elbegdorj, in a statement, thanked the US for efforts to recover the skeleton, calling it 'an important piece of the cultural heritage of the Mongolian people.' An examination by three experts on June 5 concluded that the Tyrannosaurus bataar skeleton almost certainly originated in the Nemegt Basin in Mongolia. Heritage Auctions states the consignor purchased the fossil in good faith and spent a year and considerable expense restoring, mounting, and preparing what was previously a collection of unassembled bones. A statement at the auction noted it was 'the first time a fully prepared Tyrannosaur has been made available at public auction.'
translated_content: Moja ya hati za kukamatwa zisizo za kawaida katika historia ya Marekani ilitolewa jana pale jaji wa shirikisho alipoidhinisha Idara ya Usalama wa Ndani kuchukua fuvu la dinosaur kutoka kwa kampuni ya sanaa. Serikali ya Marekani inajaribu kufanya kampuni ya mnada irudishe mifupa ya Tyrannosaurus bataar, aliyekuwa akiishi Mongolia miaka milioni 70 iliyopita, irudishwe nchini humo. Fosili hiyo karibu nzima inaaminika kuchimbuliwa kati ya 1995 na 2005, na ni moja kati ya masalia yaliyogunduliwa kwanza katika Jangwa la Gobi mwaka 1946. Mfupa huu wa miaka milioni 70 wa Tyrannosaurus bataar uko katikati ya kesi ya kisheria inayotaka ukabidhiwe kwa serikali ya Marekani ili urudishwe Mongolia. Mfupa huu una urefu wa futi 24 (mita 7.31) na urefu wa futi nane (mita 2.43), na unakadiriwa kuwa na uzito wa karibu tani moja. Ingawa sheria za Mongolia zinatamka mabaki hayo kuwa mali ya serikali na kupiga marufuku usafirishaji wake, mfupa huo uliwasili Gainesville, Florida, Machi 2010. Uliuuzwa kwenye mnada mjini New York Mei 20 kwa dola milioni 1.05 kupitia Heritage Auctions. Kulingana na nyaraka zilizowasilishwa Jumatatu katika Mahakama ya Wilaya ya Marekani mjini New York, mfupa huo unadaiwa kuingizwa Marekani kinyume cha sheria kutoka Uingereza kwa kudai thamani ya $15,000 kinyume na uhalisia. Mamlaka za Marekani sasa zinadai ufossili huo ukabidhiwe ili urudishwe Mongolia. Serikali ya Mongolia ilipata zuio kutoka kwa jaji Texas, ambako kampuni ya mnada iko, kuzuia mnada, lakini mnada uliendelea. Jim Halperin, mwenyekiti mwenza wa Heritage Auctions, alisema, 'Tulipiga mnada Tyrannosaurus bataar kwa masharti, tukisubiri maamuzi ya mahakama, hivyo sasa jambo hili liko mikononi mwa wanasheria na wanasiasa.' Wakili Mkuu wa Marekani Preet Bharara alisema mabaki hayo yana umuhimu mkubwa kiutamaduni na kihistoria kwa watu wa Mongolia na yanaunganisha na historia ya taifa hilo. 'Fosili ilipochukuliwa kinyume cha taratibu, sehemu ya historia ya asili ya nchi nayo ilipotea, tunatarajia kuirudisha nyumbani,' alisema. Rais wa Mongolia Tsakhia Elbegdorj, katika taarifa, alishukuru Marekani kwa juhudi za kurejesha mafupa hayo, akiyaita 'sehemu muhimu ya urithi wa kitamaduni wa watu wa Mongolia.' Uchunguzi wa wataalamu watatu Juni 5 ulibaini kuwa mifupa ya Tyrannosaurus bataar ina asili yake Nemegt Basin, Mongolia. Heritage Auctions wanasema mteja wao alinunua mabaki hayo kwa nia njema na alitumia mwaka mzima na gharama kubwa kuyatambua, kurejesha, kuyaunganisha na kuandaa masalia hayo. Taarifa wakati wa mnada ilieleza kuwa 'hii ilikuwa mara ya kwanza kwa Tyrannosaur aliyeandaliwa kikamilifu kuuzwa hadharani.'

article_content: Google continues to advance accessibility across its products, introducing new features to make their apps and services more inclusive for users with disabilities. Recent efforts include updates aimed at supporting individuals with visual and cognitive impairments. Among the company's latest releases are the Lookout app, which uses AI to assist people who are blind or have low vision in navigating spaces, and the Magnifier app on the Pixel 8 series which enhances text and image clarity. Building upon progress, Google has also announced a host of new accessibility features on Maps, Search, and Chrome. Notably, Google worked with disability advocacy groups to develop an 'identity attribute' that lets businesses identify as disabled-owned within Maps and Search, making it more visible to customers. Additionally, Maps now offers the option to request wheelchair-accessible walking directions, in addition to existing accessible transit features. Users can enable this in their transit preferences or directly when seeking directions. To aid navigation for users with impaired vision, Maps is adding a screen reader tool that works alongside Search with Live View, simplifying the process of finding nearby locations. Chrome has introduced an address bar that detects typos and offers website suggestions, benefitting people with dyslexia and those learning new languages. Assisted Routines have also adopted functionalities from Action Blocks, giving users, particularly those with cognitive disabilities, the ability to further customize their routines and shortcuts. These new features are already available or will soon roll out across Android and iOS devices. The Maps screen reader is currently on iOS with Android to follow, wheelchair-accessible walking routes are expanding globally, and Chrome’s upgraded address bar is available on both Android and iOS.

Jitihada za hivi karibuni zinajumuisha masasisho yanayosaidia watu wenye uoni hafifu au ulemavu wa utambuzi. Miongoni mwa uzinduzi mpya wa kampuni ni programu ya Lookout, inayotumia AI kusaidia watu wasioona au wenye uoni hafifu kuzunguka maeneo, na programu ya Magnifier kwenye simu za Pixel 8 inayoboresha wazi wa maandishi na picha. Kuendeleza mafanikio haya, Google sasa imetangaza vipengele vipya vya upatikanaji kwenye ramani ya Maps, Search na Chrome. Muhimu zaidi, Google imefanya kazi na vikundi vya watetezi wa watu wenye ulemavu kuunda 'alama ya utambulisho' inayoruhusu wafanyabiashara kujitambulisha kuwa ni biashara inayomilikiwa na watu wenye ulemavu kupitia Maps na Search, hivyo kuwa rahisi kuonekana kwa wateja. Aidha, Maps sasa inatoa chaguo la kuomba njia za kutembea zinazofikika kwa viti mwendo, mbali na huduma za usafiri wa umma zinazofikika zilizopo. Watumiaji wanaweza kuwezesha kipengele hiki kwenye mapendeleo yao ya usafiri au moja kwa moja wanapotafuta maelekezo. Ili kusaidia watumiaji wenye uoni hafifu kujielekeza, Maps inaongeza zana ya msomaji wa skrini inayoshirikiana na Search kwa Live View, ikirahisisha kupata maeneo ya karibu. Chrome imeongeza sehemu ya anuani (address bar) inayogundua makosa ya tahajia na kutoa mapendekezo ya tovuti, ikisaidia sana watu wenye dyslexia na wanaojifunza lugha mpya. article_content: Despite advances in gender equality, recent research shows that many people in Britain still hold traditional views about which jobs men and women should do. In a survey of more than 2,000 adults conducted by WorldPay Zinc, about 40% said there are careers—like soldier, mechanic, and surgeon—that women should not take. At the same time, many believe roles such as beautician, florist, or nurse are not fit for men. Two-thirds of those asked think men are better suited to hands-on trades like plumbing, mechanics, and electrical work. Only 3% believe women excel over men as pilots or surgeons, even though there’s no supporting evidence for that belief. These attitudes are common among men and women alike—just 2% of women felt they surpassed men in technical fields, while 21% felt men were better. There’s also a belief that men are less capable in jobs considered 'feminine.' For example, 64% said women make better florists, 76% said women are better nannies, and only 3% thought men made better nurses. The Vision Critical survey, using the Springboard UK panel, also found that trust in professionals is influenced by their gender. Nineteen percent wouldn’t trust a male nanny, 18% said the same for a male beautician, and 16% for a male midwife. Most respondents were fine with male nurses, but 11% admitted discomfort and 5% would specifically ask for a female nurse. About 17% said they'd be bothered if a female mechanic worked on their car, while 2% would outright leave the garage. Surprisingly, 3% claimed they’d refuse to fly or complain if their pilot was a woman. Charlotte Keene, a 25-year-old gas engineer from Egham, Surrey, has faced discrimination in her field for six years. 'Training was rigorous and some expected me to be less capable than a male engineer,' she said. 'At times, the pressure almost made me leave, but I noticed many women feel safer with a female engineer in their home.' She now runs her own business called Gas Girl. Geraldine Wilson, managing director of WorldPay Zinc, said she was disappointed stereotypes still exist and highlighted the company’s support for businesses run by any gender. She added that, while things are improving, it will take time to reach true equality in the workplace.

Katika utafiti wa WorldPay Zinc ukiwahusisha watu zaidi ya 2,000, karibu asilimia 40 waliamini kuna kazi—kama askari, fundi magari, na daktari wa upasuaji—ambazo wanawake hawapaswi kufanya. The U.S. Navy is optimistic about improving operational communications with China’s military amid ongoing regional tensions, though further work is needed to solidify future steps, a senior U.S. naval official said on Friday. Admiral Lisa Franchetti, the U.S. Chief of Naval Operations, told the media during her visit to Busan, South Korea, that maintaining open lines of communication between the two militaries is crucial to avoid misunderstandings and miscalculations that could escalate into conflict.

“I’m very excited and I welcome the announcement,” Franchetti said, referring to China’s recent agreement to resume telephone communications between theatre commands—an initiative U.S. officials have long supported. She noted, “These agreements were reached just recently, and we know that we have work with the PRC military to do to solidify the next steps.” This was Franchetti’s first visit to the region since beginning her role on November 2.

Her comments followed agreements earlier in the month between U.S. President Joe Biden and China’s President Xi Jinping to resume military contacts, which Beijing had suspended after then-Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s visit to Taiwan in August 2022. Improved military communication was a topic during their recent four-hour discussion in San Francisco, which also included talks on Taiwan, Iran, and efforts to curb the flow of fentanyl to the United States.

The U.S. and several regional militaries have reported incidents of near misses and unsafe interactions with Chinese aircraft and ships in disputed areas such as the South China Sea and across East Asia, sparking concern that tensions could lead to open conflict. “We expect all navies in international waters to uphold rules and norms of appropriate military behavior on, under, and above the sea,” Franchetti emphasized.

Asked about recent Chinese military advancements, particularly in submarines and undersea surveillance, Franchetti said she remained confident in U.S. naval superiority, even as China continues to expand its capabilities across various domains. The U.S. will continue strong cooperation with allies and partners, which Franchetti described as a key strategic advantage.

Separately, India is seeing a rise in women holding senior leadership roles and making their presence felt in boardroom disputes, signaling growing gender diversity at top levels. In business, Tesla is prepared to invest up to $2 billion in a local factory if India’s government approves a reduced import duty of 15% on vehicles for the first two years of operations. Additionally, India’s next Finance Commission may adjust the resource-sharing formula to give greater weight to the human development index (HDI) and sustainable development goals (SDGs).

Other headlines include the BCCI’s economic benefit from the 2023 Cricket World Cup, Tata Technologies' IPO, and updates on investment and market trends.

article_content: Decentralized finance (DeFi) has become a flagship use case for blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. DeFi uses smart contracts and decentralized systems to facilitate financial transactions without relying on traditional intermediaries, promoting transparency and equitable participation. With over $40 billion locked in DeFi protocols, the sector is expanding rapidly. However, this growth brings significant risks—beyond the technological—that can challenge conventional finance. Among these, economic risk stands out as an underrecognized threat. Economic risk in DeFi is multifaceted and insidious, often arising from untested or poorly designed models. One example is the Mango Markets incident, where an attacker exploited vulnerabilities in market mechanisms and price feeds, resulting in substantial user losses. In 2022, economic risks contributed to over $1 billion in losses—often in tandem with smart contract bugs—highlighting a need for robust safeguards. DeFi lending platforms, holding more than $18 billion in assets, are especially vulnerable. Automated collateral systems and a lack of traditional checks like underwriters increase risk. For instance, during a crisis involving Curve Finance, the value of collateral backing certain loans plummeted, nearly resulting in millions of dollars in bad debt due to illiquidity. Automated protocols sometimes hinder quick fixes, as seen with Blizz Finance during the Terra stablecoin de-peg, where protocol updates were blocked and bad debt accumulated. There are strategies to mitigate these risks: comprehensive economic modeling, continuous risk assessments, closer monitoring of loan-to-value ratios, and prudent collateral policies. Still, challenges persist, including governance issues, information asymmetry, and dependence on external data sources (like oracles), which can introduce new failure points. Building a resilient ecosystem requires more than models. User education, clear communication, and community forums are crucial for transparency and empowering users. Protocols should establish strict criteria for acceptable collateral and consider emergency tools like freeze mechanisms. Incorporating economic risks into bug bounty programs further enhances collective defense. Ultimately, combining rigorous asset policies, education, and community engagement can better protect DeFi platforms and users from economic risk. As DeFi grows—seeking to realize a more accessible and equitable financial future—it must heed the lessons of both traditional and uniquely decentralized finance, integrating hard-won insights to build a safer, stronger ecosystem.

DeFi hutumia mikataba ya smart na mifumo ya kidigitali iliyogatuliwa kuwezesha miamala ya kifedha bila kuhitaji wapatanishi wa jadi, hivyo kukuza uwazi na haki kwa washiriki. Zaidi ya dola bilioni 40 zimefungwa katika itifaki za DeFi na sekta hii inakua kwa kasi. Hata hivyo, ukuaji huu unaleta hatari kubwa zaidi ya kiteknolojia tu ambazo zinaweza kuchanganya mifumo ya kifedha ya kawaida. Kati ya hizi, hatari za kiuchumi zipo na hazielezewi vya kutosha. Hatari za kiuchumi katika DeFi zina sura nyingi na ni ngumu kugundua, mara nyingi zikitokea kutokana na mifano mibaya au isiyojaribiwa ipasavyo. Mfano ni tukio la Mango Markets, ambapo mdukuzi alitumia udhaifu katika mifumo ya bei na masoko, na kusababisha hasara kubwa kwa watumiaji. Mwaka 2022, hasara za zaidi ya dola bilioni 1 zilitokana na hatari hizi—mara nyingi na mapungufu ya mikataba ya smart—ikiashiria hitaji la ulinzi madhubuti. Majukwaa ya mikopo ya DeFi, yenye zaidi ya dola bilioni 18 katika mali, yako katika hatari kubwa hasa. Mifumo ya dhamana ya kiotomatiki na ukosefu wa ukaguzi wa jadi kama waandishi wa mikopo huongeza hatari. Kwa mfano, wakati wa tatizo la Curve Finance, thamani ya dhamana ilishuka sana, karibu kusababisha mamilioni ya dola za madeni kutokana na ukosefu wa ukwasi. Mifumo ya kiotomatiki mara nyingine huzuia hatua za haraka, kama ilivyotokea Blizz Finance wakati wa kuporomoka kwa stablecoin ya Terra, ambapo maboresho yalizuiwa na deni baya likaendelea kukua. Kuna mikakati ya kupunguza hatari hizi: uundaji wa kina wa mifano ya kiuchumi, tathmini endelevu ya hatari, ufuatiliaji wa karibu wa viwango vya mkopo dhidi ya dhamana, pamoja na sera thabiti za dhamana. Hata hivyo, changamoto kama utawala, upungufu wa taarifa, na utegemezi kwenye vyanzo vya nje (oracles) bado zipo na huaongeza hatari. Kujenga mfumo imara wa DeFi kunahitaji zaidi ya mifano; elimu kwa mtumiaji, mawasiliano wazi na majukwaa ya jamii ni muhimu kwa uwazi na kuwawezesha watumiaji. Itifaki zinapaswa kuweka vigezo maalum vya dhamana inayokubalika na kufikiria kutumia zana za dharura kama mfumo wa kugandisha. Kujumuisha hatari za kiuchumi kwenye mpango wa tuzo ya makosa (bug bounty) kunaimarisha ulinzi wa pamoja. Hatimaye, kuchanganya sera madhubuti za mali, elimu na ushiriki wa jamii kunaweza kulinda majukwaa na watumiaji wa DeFi dhidi ya hatari za kiuchumi. Kadri DeFi inavyokua—ikilenga kujenga mfumo wa kifedha wenye uwazi na usawa—ni lazima ijifunze kutoka kwa fedha za jadi na masomo ya kipekee ya kidigitali ili kujenga mfumo salama na thabiti.

article_content: Researchers at the University of Texas are cautioning the public about Tawny crazy ants, an invasive species from South America that could significantly alter the ecological balance in the southeastern United States. These ants can eliminate colonies of fire ants, previously considered harmful invasive insects in the region. Tawny crazy ants are omnivores and take over areas by both directly killing other species and outcompeting others for resources, according to Ed LeBrun, a research associate in the Texas invasive species research program at the Brackenridge Field Laboratory. LeBrun explained, 'Perhaps the most significant impact is the displacement of the fire ant, which has become a dominant force in Texas ecosystems. The environment has changed due to fire ants—species unable to tolerate them have disappeared, while others have thrived. Now, replacing fire ants with a species that behaves very differently will bring major changes.' In addition to environmental concerns, crazy ants can become a major nuisance for people due to their sheer numbers. They nest in walls, crawl spaces, house plants, and even empty containers in yards. Although they do not sting like fire ants, LeBrun noted they can be more bothersome, requiring frequent pest control. 'There are videos online of people having to sweep up entire dustpans full of these ants from their bathrooms. Regular pest control visits may be necessary just to manage the infestation, making it costly,' LeBrun said. Some residents have even expressed a preference for fire ants, because they tend to stay outdoors and only interact with humans if disturbed. In contrast, crazy ants may invade homes in large numbers. Scientists are unsure how far crazy ants—which are native to Argentina and Brazil—will spread in the U.S. Since being first observed in Houston in 2002, they have primarily populated wetter areas with mild winters in parts of Texas, Florida, Louisiana, and Mississippi. The crazy ants' reproductive members do not fly, so long-distance spread relies on hitchhiking in human belongings. LeBrun advised that people in invaded areas should carefully check for ants when moving or traveling to help slow their spread.
translated_content: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Texas wanatoa tahadhari kuhusu siafu aina ya Tawny crazy ants, spishi vamizi kutoka Amerika Kusini ambazo zinaweza kubadilisha sana usawa wa ikolojia kusini mashariki mwa Marekani. Siafu hawa wanaweza kutokomeza makundi ya siafu moto, ambao hapo awali walionekana kuwa hatari katika eneo hilo. Tawny crazy ants ni walajimlo wa aina zote na wanachukua maeneo kwa kuua wadudu wengine na pia kwa kuwazidi kwenye mashindano ya rasilimali, kwa mujibu wa Ed LeBrun, mtafiti mshiriki wa mpango wa utafiti wa viumbe vamizi wa Texas katika Maabara ya Brackenridge Field. LeBrun alieleza, 'Labda athari kubwa zaidi ni kupungua kwa siafu moto, ambao wamekuwa na nguvu kubwa kwenye mifumo ya ikolojia ya Texas. Mazingira yamebadilika kwa sababu ya siafu moto—spishi zisizoweza kuvumilia zimepotea, zingine zimefanikiwa. Sasa, kubadili siafu moto na kuweka spishi yenye tabia tofauti kabisa kutaleta mabadiliko makubwa.' Mbali na wasiwasi wa mazingira, siafu hawa pia ni kero kubwa kwa watu kutokana na idadi yao kubwa. Wanatengeneza makazi kwenye kuta, chini ya nyumba, kwenye mimea ya ndani, na hata kwenye vyombo tupu vilivyopo uwanjani. Ingawa hawachomi kama siafu moto, LeBrun alisema wanaweza kuwa kero zaidi kwani wanahitaji udhibiti wa mara kwa mara. 'Kuna video mtandaoni za watu wakifagia vyungu vizima vya siafu hawa kutoka bafuni. Unahitaji kuwaita wataalamu wa kudhibiti wadudu mara kwa mara ili kushughulikia maambukizi yao, jambo linaloongeza gharama,' alisema LeBrun. Baadhi ya wakaazi hata wamekiri wanapendelea siafu moto, kwa sababu mara nyingi hukaa uwanjani na humuingilia mtu tu akikanyaga kiota chao. Kwa upande wake, siafu crazy ants wanaweza kuvamia nyumba kwa idadi kubwa. Wanasayansi bado hawajui ni umbali gani siafu crazy ants—ambao asili yao ni Argentina na Brazil—wataenea Marekani. Tangu walipoonekana kwa mara ya kwanza Houston mwaka 2002, wamepatikana zaidi maeneo yenye unyevu na baridi kiasi Texas, Florida, Louisiana na Mississippi. Siafu crazy ants hawana mabawa, kwa hiyo kusambaa kwao umbali mrefu kunategemea usafiri kupitia mizigo ya watu. LeBrun aliwashauri watu wa maeneo yaliyoathirika wahakikishe wanakagua mizigo yao wanaposafiri ili kusaidia kupunguza usambazaji.

A fourth installment in the Millennium series is set to be released in 2015, even though the original author, Stieg Larsson, passed away in 2004. The new novel will continue the story of journalist Mikael Blomkvist and Lisbeth Salander, the protagonists from 'The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo.' The original Millennium trilogy, published after Larsson's death, gained widespread international success and inspired film adaptations in both Sweden and Hollywood.

Swedish publisher Norstedts announced that David Lagercrantz, most known for co-authoring Zlatan Ibrahimovic's biography 'I am Zlatan,' has been chosen to write the new book, which is planned to come out on the tenth anniversary of the first novel.

Eva Gedin, Norstedts' publishing manager, stated, 'There will be a new novel. We have considered this for some time.'

However, Eva Gabrielsson, Larsson's partner of 32 years, has voiced strong objections, calling the project 'greedy' and 'distasteful,' given the existing commercial success of Larsson’s work. Gabrielsson says she has Larsson’s original script for a fourth book on his laptop and emphasizes that the publisher has no access to it, so the upcoming book will be entirely new.

Larsson and Gabrielsson were together for more than three decades after meeting as teenagers in Umea during a Vietnam War protest. Due to security threats related to Larsson’s journalism and work with the anti-fascist magazine Expo, they never officially registered their partnership as a precaution.

Following Larsson’s sudden death from a heart attack in 2004, legal and financial conflicts arose over his estate. His estranged father and brother inherited his rights, as his only will, written in the 1970s, was ruled invalid.

David Lagercrantz expressed that continuing the Millennium series is a way to honor Larsson’s legacy, stating, 'Blomkvist and Salander are so full of life. They deserve to live. Continuing the story is a form of respect to Larsson’s authorship.'

The fourth Millennium novel is scheduled for publication in Swedish in August 2015.

Mfululizo asilia wa Millennium, uliotolewa baada ya kifo cha Larsson, ulipata umaarufu mkubwa duniani na kuchochea utengenezaji wa filamu nchini Uswidi na Hollywood.

Mchapishaji kutoka Uswidi, Norstedts, ametangaza kwamba David Lagercrantz, anayejulikana zaidi kwa kuandika wasifu wa Zlatan Ibrahimovic, 'I am Zlatan,' amechaguliwa kuandika kitabu kipya kitakachotolewa ikiwa ni maadhimisho ya miaka kumi tangu kitabu cha kwanza kilipotoka.

Meneja wa uchapishaji wa Norstedts, Eva Gedin, alisema, 'Kutakuwa na riwaya mpya. Tumekuwa na wazo hili kwa muda.'

Hata hivyo, Eva Gabrielsson, mwenzi wa Larsson kwa miaka 32, amepinga vikali mpango huo akiita kuwa 'tamaa' na 'haistahili,' kwa sababu kazi za Larsson tayari zimefanikiwa kibiashara. Gabrielsson anadai anao muswada asilia wa Larsson wa kitabu cha nne kwenye kompyuta yake na anasisitiza kuwa wachapishaji hawatautumia, hivyo kitabu kipya kitakuwa tofauti.

Larsson na Gabrielsson walikaa pamoja kwa zaidi ya miaka thelathini baada ya kukutana wakiwa vijana mjini Umea wakati wa maandamano ya kupinga Vita ya Vietnam. Kwa sababu ya vitisho kutokana na kazi ya Larsson katika jarida la Expo, hawakuandikisha rasmi uhusiano wao kama tahadhari.

Baada ya kifo cha Larsson mwaka 2004 kutokana na mshtuko wa moyo, kulizuka migogoro ya kisheria kuhusu urithi wake. Baba na kaka wa Larsson walipokea haki zote, kwa kuwa wosia wake pekee uliandikwa miaka ya 1970 na haukutambuliwa kisheria.

David Lagercrantz amesema kuendeleza mfululizo wa Millennium ni namna ya kuheshimu urithi wa Larsson, akisema, 'Blomkvist na Salander ni wahusika wenye uhai mwingi. Wanastahili kuendelea kuwepo. Kuendelea simulizi ni heshima kwa kazi ya uandishi ya Larsson.'

article_content: Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg has predicted 'sharp disagreement' as the Supreme Court prepares to release decisions on several notable cases by the end of the month, including the constitutionality of President Obama's health care law. Speaking at a legal conference in Washington on Friday evening, the court's eldest member gave hints about coming decisions. 'The term has been more than usually taxing—some have called it the term of the century,' Ginsburg said at the American Constitution Society's annual review. (The ACS is a progressive legal advocacy group.) In the next two weeks, the Supreme Court will rule on issues including health care, Arizona's debated immigration law, television broadcast indecency, and a federal law criminalizing false claims of significant military honors. Ginsburg described the court's rush to complete about 15 pending rulings as 'flood season.' She noted, 'many of the most controversial cases remain pending, so it is likely that the sharp disagreement rate will go up next week and the week after.' While Ginsburg, a liberal justice, discussed health care legal issues, she did not reveal anything about internal deliberations or the court's possible stance. She noted her colleagues are fully aware of the intense public scrutiny the health care case has received. She compared the public's attention to that seen in the Citizens United campaign finance case, observing the unprecedented level of protests and publicity during the health care hearings. Ginsburg, injecting a touch of humor, outlined four health care questions being considered—including the main issue concerning the constitutionality of the individual mandate requiring most Americans to buy health insurance or pay a penalty. She wondered if, should the mandate be ruled unconstitutional, the entire law must fall or just the mandate itself—likening this to cutting a head of broccoli. She referenced whether federal courts can consider pre-enforcement challenges to the mandate based on the Anti-Injunction Act of 1867, which typically blocks lawsuits intending to prevent tax collection. Legal analysts believe the court may focus on broader constitutional issues instead. Another key issue is whether the Affordable Care Act's Medicaid expansion exceeds Congress's authority. Ginsburg discussed the impact of dissenting Supreme Court opinions, recalling her 2007 dissent in a pay discrimination case that helped prompt Congress to pass the Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act, signed by President Obama in 2009. The Supreme Court plans to issue opinions starting Monday, with many observers expecting a decision on health care during the week of June 25, just before the summer recess. Ginsburg reminded listeners, 'At the Supreme Court, those who know don’t talk, and those who talk don’t know.'

Akizungumza kwenye mkutano wa kisheria Washington Ijumaa jioni, mjumbe mzee zaidi wa mahakama hiyo alitoa dokezo kuhusu maamuzi yajayo. 'Muda huu umekuwa mgumu kuliko kawaida—wengine wameuita muda wa karne,' alisema Ginsburg kwenye mkutano wa mwaka wa American Constitution Society. (ACS ni kikundi kinachotetea sheria kwa mtazamo wa maendeleo.) Katika wiki mbili zijazo, Mahakama ya Juu itatoa maamuzi kuhusu huduma ya afya, sheria ya uhamiaji yenye utata ya Arizona, adabu kwenye matangazo ya runinga, na sheria ya shirikisho inayofanya udanganyifu kuhusu heshima kubwa za kijeshi kuwa kosa. Ginsburg alielezea haraka ya mahakama kufikisha uamuzi kuhusu kesi zipatazo 15 kama 'msimu wa mafuriko.' Alisema, 'kesi nyingi zenye utata bado zinasubiriwa, hivyo kuna uwezekano kiwango cha tofauti kali kitaongezeka wiki ijayo na inayofuata.' Ingawa Ginsburg, jaji kutoka upande wa mrengo wa kushoto, alijadili masuala ya kisheria ya huduma ya afya, hakufichua lolote kuhusu mijadala ya ndani au msimamo wa mahakama. Alitaja kwamba wenzake wanajua vizuri umakini wa umma kuhusu kesi hiyo ya huduma ya afya. Alilinganisha umakinifu huo na ule wa kesi ya Citizens United kuhusu fedha za kampeni, akisema kiwango cha maandamano na umaarufu wakati wa vikao vya huduma ya afya hakijawahi kutokea hapo awali. Ginsburg, kwa utani, alielezea maswali manne ya huduma ya afya yanayozingatiwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na suala kuu la uhalali wa agizo la mtu binafsi linalotaka Wamarekani wengi kununua bima ya afya au kulipa faini. Alijiuliza iwapo agizo hilo likitangazwa kinyume na katiba, kama sheria nzima itabatilishwa au ni sehemu hiyo tu—akifananisha na kung’oa brokoli kichwani. Alitaja pia iwapo mahakama za shirikisho zinaweza kusikiliza malalamiko kabla ya utekelezaji kufuatia Sheria ya Anti-Injunction ya 1867, ambayo kawaida huzuia kesi za kuzuia ukusanyaji kodi. Wachambuzi wa sheria wengi wanaamini mahakama italenga zaidi masuala makubwa ya kikatiba. Jambo jingine muhimu ni kama upanuzi wa Medicaid kupitia Sheria ya Huduma ya Afya Nafuu (Affordable Care Act) unapita mipaka ya mamlaka ya Congress. Ginsburg alizungumzia athari ya maoni ya upinzani ya Mahakama ya Juu, akirejea upinzani wake wa 2007 kuhusu kesi ya ubaguzi wa mishahara kazini uliosaidia Congress kupitisha Sheria ya Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act, iliyosainiwa na Rais Obama mwaka 2009. Mahakama ya Juu inapanga kutoa maamuzi kuanzia Jumatatu, na watazamaji wengi wanatarajia uamuzi wa huduma ya afya wiki ya Juni 25, kabla ya mapumziko ya kiangazi. Ginsburg aliwakumbusha wasikilizaji, 'Katika Mahakama ya Juu, wanaojua hawazungumzi, na wanaozungumza hawajui.'

Manchester United defenders Luke Shaw and Phil Jones believe that the passionate home support at Old Trafford will be vital in helping the team return to winning form against Sunderland this weekend. Shaw and Jones are eager to make amends for United’s recent 2-1 Premier League defeat to Swansea City. So far this season, United have lost just twice at Old Trafford—against Swansea and Southampton—a record both players attribute to the strength of the club’s fan base.

Shaw told Manchester United’s official website: “We always get an extra push from our fans at home, and they’ve been incredible away too. But at Old Trafford, the atmosphere is different. Visiting teams feel it, and it can be intimidating. United have a strong home record and have won many games here, making it a significant advantage for us. We’re working hard to make sure we get the win on Saturday—it’s hugely important.”

Despite taking the lead through Daley Blind, United suffered their fifth league defeat of the season against Swansea. Jones added: “You have to stick together and work hard in training. That’s what we’ve focused on this week because this is an important match for us. Sunderland are a tough side, so it won’t be easy, but we’ve performed well at home lately and need to bounce back. We thought we played fairly well, especially in the second half against Swansea, but this will also be a challenging game we have to win.”

Both Shaw and Jones are expected to start when United host Sunderland, as manager Louis van Gaal looks to move ahead of top-four rivals Arsenal.
