London, England (CNN) -- When people say that Charles Dickens' 'A Christmas Carol' is as relevant today as it was in 1843, they usually think of Ebenezer Scrooge’s transformation. He shifts from a miserly man who believes those unable to support themselves should die 'and decrease the surplus population,' to someone almost extravagantly generous. Many especially recall his change of heart toward his poor, underpaid clerk Bob Cratchit, promising to help pay for the medical treatment needed by Cratchit’s son, Tiny Tim—a detail that resonates today given ongoing struggles with healthcare in America.

Less often remembered is a haunting scene where Scrooge encounters two terrified children—a boy and a girl, 'yellow, meagre, ragged, scowling, wolfish'—who emerge from the robe of the Ghost of Christmas Present. The boy is Ignorance and the girl is Want. The ghost warns Scrooge to beware them both, especially Ignorance, on whose brow is written 'doom, unless the writing be erased.' Dickens created these figures during Britain’s 'Hungry Forties,' a period of economic hardship and fears of social collapse, but his message resonates across eras and cultures.

Today, with U.S. unemployment at 10 percent or higher in some areas, and concerns about rising crime, intolerance (including toward immigrants), and political extremism, these themes are timely. It may seem unusual to include such bleak reminders in a Christmas tale, but Dickens knew poverty firsthand: his childhood changed dramatically when his father’s debts sent most of the family to prison. Dickens spent about a year working long hours in a factory, an experience he later used in 'David Copperfield.' When not working, he wandered the streets of London—streets he would later vividly describe in 'Bleak House' and other novels.

For Dickens, national education reform and public health improvements were urgent needs. He remained concerned about the dangers symbolized by Ignorance, who appears again in his last Christmas story, 'The Haunted Man' (1848), as a street-child whom the protagonist, Redlaw, tries and fails to help. Over time, things improved for Britain; economic growth in the 1850s and 1860s lessened fears of chaos. Dickens removed Ignorance and Want from his popular public readings of 'A Christmas Carol' after 1858, yet he continued speaking out about neglected city children—an issue partly addressed with the first Education Act in the year of his death.

Still, urban areas today face challenges such as gang activity and rising extremism. Dickens, who campaigned against sensational and degrading media, would likely be alarmed by today's levels of violence and explicit content in TV, magazines, and video games. He would have seen this as a failure of public education. Similarly, as the author of 'Edwin Drood,' which depicts a character succumbing to crime under addiction, Dickens would be troubled by the prevalence of youth drug use today.

The new Disney adaptation of 'A Christmas Carol' powerfully depicts Ignorance as a threatening figure and Want as a troubled youth, demonstrating that Dickens’ warnings from 1843 remain urgent. The story’s broader message about generosity and empathy is still as relevant as ever.

The views expressed are solely those of Michael Slater.

London, England (CNN) -- Watu wanaposema kwamba 'A Christmas Carol' ya Charles Dickens bado ni muhimu leo kama ilivyokuwa mwaka 1843, mara nyingi wanamaanisha mabadiliko ya Ebenezer Scrooge. Anabadilika kutoka kuwa mchoyo anayeamini wasioweza kujisaidia wanapaswa kufa 'ili kupunguza idadi ya watu,' hadi mtu anayetoa kwa ukarimu uliopitiliza. Wengi hukumbuka hasa jinsi alivyoamua kumsaidia karani wake maskini, Bob Cratchit, kwa kugharamia matibabu ya mtoto wake, Tiny Tim—kipengele kinachogusa maisha ya watu wengi Marekani leo kutokana na changamoto za huduma za afya.

Mara chache hukumbukwa ni tukio la kusikitisha ambapo Scrooge anakutana na watoto wawili—mvulana na msichana, 'wa rangi ya manjano, wembamba, wamevaa matambara, wenye nyuso za kukunja uso kama mbwa-mwitu'—wanaotokea kwenye joho la Ghost of Christmas Present. Mvulana anaitwa Ignorance (Ujinga) na msichana Want (Uhaba). Jini linamwonya Scrooge awahofiele wote, hasa Ignorance, ambaye paji la uso limeandikwa 'hatari, isipofutwa.' Dickens aliunda hawa wahusika wakati wa 'Hungry Forties' ya Uingereza, kipindi cha shida za kiuchumi na hofu ya machafuko ya kijamii, lakini ujumbe wake unaendelea kuwa muhimu katika nyakati na tamaduni tofauti.

Kwa sasa, huku Marekani ukiwa na kiwango cha ukosefu wa ajira cha asilimia 10 au zaidi maeneo mengine, na wasiwasi kuhusu uhalifu, chuki dhidi ya wahamiaji na misimamo mikali, mada hizi bado ni muhimu mno. Ingawa inaonekana ajabu kuweka ujumbe mzito namna hii kwenye hadithi ya Krismasi, Dickens alishuhudia umasikini mwenyewe: utoto wake uligeuka baada ya baba yake kufungwa kwa madeni. Dickens alifanya kazi kiwandani takriban mwaka mmoja, uzoefu alioutumia baadaye ndani ya 'David Copperfield.' Akiwa hana kazi, alitangatanga mitaani London—mitaa aliyoielezea sana ndani ya 'Bleak House' na riwaya nyingine.

Kwa Dickens, mageuzi ya elimu na afya ya umma yalikuwa muhimu sana. Aliendelea kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya hatari zinazoashiriwa na Ignorance, ambaye anaonekana tena kwenye hadithi yake ya mwisho ya Krismasi, 'The Haunted Man' (1848), kama mtoto wa mtaani ambaye Redlaw anajaribu kusaidia bila mafanikio. Kwa muda, hali iliimarika Uingereza; uchumi ulipokua miaka ya 1850 na 1860, hofu za machafuko zilipungua. Dickens aliwatoa Ignorance na Want kwenye usomaji wa hadhara wa 'A Christmas Carol' baada ya 1858, lakini aliendelea kugusia suala la watoto wa mtaani ambalo lilianza kushughulikiwa kupitia Sheria ya kwanza ya Elimu mwaka wa kifo chake.

Lakini hata sasa, miji bado inakumbana na changamoto kama uhalifu wa magenge na misimamo mikali. Dickens, aliyepinga vyombo vya habari vya kusisimua na vilivyokuwa na maadili duni, bila shaka angejawa na wasiwasi na ukatili na maudhui yasiyofaa kwenye runinga, magazeti na michezo ya video ya leo. Angeona hili kama dalili ya kushindwa kwa elimu ya umma. Vivyo hivyo, kama mwandishi wa 'Edwin Drood,' ambacho mhusika anageuka kuwa mhalifu kutokana na uraibu, Dickens angehuzunika na matumizi makubwa ya dawa za kulevya kwa vijana wa sasa.

Toleo jipya la Disney la 'A Christmas Carol' linaonyesha kwa namna yenye nguvu Ignorance kama tishio na Want kama kijana aliyepotea, likionyesha kuwa onyo la Dickens la mwaka 1843 bado lina umuhimu. Ujumbe wa hadithi kuhusu ukarimu na huruma bado unabaki halisi.

Maoni yaliyotolewa ni ya Michael Slater pekee.

article_content: Alex Ratner is the co-founder and CEO of Snorkel AI and an Affiliate Assistant Professor of Computer Science at the University of Washington. The advent of large language models (LLMs) and generative AI has sparked enthusiasm among business leaders. However, organizations looking to deploy their own LLMs encounter significant challenges in moving from initial interest to developing solutions that provide real, sustained business value. Foundation models have rapidly become commoditized. Developers can now build on APIs from Google Bard or OpenAI, and more advanced organizations can run models like Llama 2 in their secure environments. However, if competitors also utilize Llama 2, there is little competitive differentiation. Proprietary data—and expertise in developing and leveraging it—offer the most sustainable advantage in enterprise AI. As generative AI hits the peak of the Gartner AI Hype Cycle, businesses are realizing that off-the-shelf LLMs can't address every need, especially those involving unique and high-value problems. Properly curated proprietary data bridges this gap. Off-the-shelf LLMs are suitable for experiments and demos but seldom achieve the precision required for business objectives. Businesses need highly specialized, accurate AI solutions, not just general-purpose chatbots. Proprietary data can serve as a competitive moat. By leveraging unique data and subject matter expertise, companies can build models that perform better for their specific domains, tasks, and customers. There are three main strategies for achieving this: 1) Retrieval augmentation; 2) Fine-tuning with tailored prompts and responses; 3) Self-supervised pre-training. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables the generative AI system to access proprietary databases or archives, typically resulting in more accurate responses. However, even with access to high-quality information, AI systems may falter if not properly guided, highlighting the need for further customization. Through fine-tuning with curated prompts and responses, organizations can further refine model performance on key tasks. This targeted training enables models to excel in the most important areas for the business. A helpful parallel: a doctor requires both a patient's medical chart and specialized training to provide an accurate diagnosis. Organizations may choose to build models from scratch for greater customization, though this can be resource-intensive. Often, fine-tuning on proprietary data is sufficient to reach needed performance levels. Should an organization choose to build new models, the usual process is to first select an architecture, train on a large, diverse dataset, then further train on proprietary data, and finally on task-specific prompts and responses. Deploying all three approaches is ideal, but requires significant data labeling. Research from McKinsey and Appen indicates that lack of high-quality labeled data is the most common barrier to enterprise AI adoption. All methods—retrieval augmentation, fine-tuning, and pre-training—depend on careful data labeling and curation. Fine-tuning requires identifying and labeling appropriate prompts and responses. Pre-training with self-supervised learning requires a carefully curated selection of unstructured training data. Label accuracy is also crucial for retrieval systems to ensure information is current and relevant. Using proprietary data as a foundation for AI delivers value but requires major investment in data-centric approaches, particularly labeling and preparation. Some firms can outsource simple labeling tasks, but much data annotation is too intricate or sensitive for external providers and therefore requires input from internal experts; this process is expensive and time-consuming. To maximize impact, teams can employ active learning and programmatic labeling. Researchers at Snorkel AI have employed these methods to improve LLMs. Well-prepared proprietary data is the most important asset for organizations seeking to extract value from AI. Focused investment in data preparation yields the greatest benefits. Forbes Technology Council is an exclusive community for top CIOs, CTOs, and technology executives.

Kuibuka kwa mifano mikubwa ya lugha (LLMs) na AI jenereta kumeamsha hamasa miongoni mwa viongozi wa biashara. Hata hivyo, mashirika yanayolenga kutekeleza LLM zao hukutana na changamoto kubwa katika kusonga kutoka wazo hadi kutengeneza suluhisho linalotoa thamani ya kweli na endelevu kwa biashara. Mifano ya msingi sasa imekuwa bidhaa ya kawaida haraka. Watengenezaji wanaweza kutumia API kutoka Google Bard au OpenAI, na mashirika yaliyo na maendeleo zaidi yanaweza kuendesha mifano kama Llama 2 kwenye mazingira yao salama. Hata hivyo, ikiwa washindani nao wanatumia Llama 2, hakuna tofauti kubwa ya ushindani. Takwimu za kipekee za kampuni—na utaalamu wa kuzitumia—ndizo zinabaki kuwa faida ya muda mrefu kwenye AI ya kibiashara. AI jenereta inapopanda katika kilele cha Gartner AI Hype Cycle, biashara zinatambua kuwa LLM za kuuziwa haziwezi kutatua kila tatizo, hasa yale ya kipekee na yenye thamani kubwa. Takwimu zilizochakatwa vyema za kampuni zinaweza kuziba pengo hili. LLM za kuuziwa zinafaa kwa majaribio na maonyesho, lakini mara nyingi haziwezi kufikia usahihi unaohitajika kwa malengo ya biashara. Biashara zinahitaji AI zilizobobea na za uhakika, si tu chatbots za matumizi ya jumla. Takwimu za kipekee zinaweza kuwa ukuta wa ushindani. Kwa kutumia takwimu za pekee na utaalamu wa ndani, kampuni zinaweza kujenga mifano inayofanya kazi bora zaidi kwa sekta, majukumu, na wateja wao. Kuna mbinu kuu tatu za kufanikisha hili: 1) Kuongeza kupitia utafutaji; 2) Kutunza mfano kwa kutumia midokezo na majibu maalum; 3) Kujifunza bila kusimamiwa. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) inaruhusu mfumo wa AI kupata taarifa kutoka kwenye hifadhidata au nyaraka za kampuni, ambacho mara nyingi huleta majibu sahihi zaidi. Hata hivyo, hata ukiwa na taarifa bora, mfumo wa AI unaweza kufanya makosa ikiwa haujaelekezwa vyema—hivyo mahitaji ya kurekebisha zaidi. Kupitia kutunza mfano kwa midokezo na majibu yaliyokusanywa, mashirika yanaweza kuboresha uwezo wa mfano kwenye majukumu muhimu. Mafunzo haya yanaruhusu mifano kutekeleza vyema maeneo muhimu ya biashara. Mfano mzuri: daktari anahitaji charti ya mgonjwa pamoja na mafunzo maalum ili kutoa utambuzi sahihi. Mashirika yanaweza kuchagua kujenga mifano mipya toka mwanzo ili kupata ubinafsishaji zaidi, ingawa ni shughuli inayotumia rasilimali nyingi. Mara nyingi, kutunza mfano kwa kutumia takwimu maalumu pekee inatosha kufikia matokeo yanayotakiwa. Iwapo shirika litachagua kujenga mfano mpya, huanza kuchagua usanifu, kufundisha kwenye data seti kubwa na mseto, kisha kwenye takwimu za pekee na hatimaye kwenye midokezo na majibu mahususi ya kazi. Kutekeleza mbinu zote tatu ni bora, lakini kunahitaji kazi kubwa ya kuweka lebo kwenye data. Utafiti wa McKinsey na Appen unaonyesha kukosekana kwa data zenye lebo bora ndicho kikwazo kikubwa kwenye AI ya kibiashara. Mbinu zote—kuongeza kupitia utafutaji, kutunza mfano, na kujifunza bila kusimamiwa—zinategemea kuweka lebo na kuchambua takwimu kwa umakini. Kutunza mfano kunahitaji kuchagua midokezo na majibu kwa uangalifu. Kujifunza bila kusimamiwa kunahitaji uteuzi makini wa data isiyo na muundo. Usahihi wa lebo pia ni muhimu kuhakikisha taarifa zinazorejeshwa ni za sasa na sahihi. Kutumia takwimu za kipekee kama msingi wa AI huleta thamani lakini kunahitaji uwekezaji mkubwa kwenye mbinu zinazoegemea data, hasa kuweka lebo na maandalizi. Baadhi ya mashirika yanaweza kuhamisha kazi rahisi za kuweka lebo kwa watu wa nje, lakini sehemu kubwa ya kuweka lebo ni ngumu mno au nyeti kwa wengine kushughulikia, hivyo inahitaji wataalamu wa ndani—mchakato huu ni gharama na unachukua muda. Ili kupata matokeo makubwa, timu zinaweza kutumia mbinu za active learning na kuweka lebo kwa programu. Watafiti wa Snorkel AI wametumia mbinu hizi kuboresha LLM. Takwimu zako zilizotayarishwa vyema ndizo hazina bora zaidi unayoweza kuleta kwenye AI. Uwekezaji makini kwenye maandalizi ya data utaleta matokeo bora zaidi. Forbes Technology Council ni jukwaa maalum kwa maafisa wakuu wa IT, CTO, na viongozi wa teknolojia wa kiwango cha juu.

Harbor Beach in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, is a renowned waterfront community known for its upscale homes, luxury marinas, and convenient access to the Atlantic Ocean. The neighborhood features a mix of traditional and modern architecture, with many properties offering private docks for large yachts and sport boats. Residents and visitors enjoy proximity to fine and casual dining, private schools, golf courses, shopping venues, and vibrant local culture.

Recently, a Laguna Drive waterfront estate in Harbor Beach set a new Broward County record by selling for $30 million, or $3,174 per square foot. Significant investment is ongoing in the area, including the redevelopment of Pier Sixty-Six Resort, which will add 91 private residences across four buildings, as well as a superyacht marina, multiple dining options, a spa, fitness center, and more than 300 rooms and suites. Pier Sixty-Six holds historical significance as a former Phillips 66 Petroleum fuel dock.

Tavistock Development Company reports that over $1 billion is being invested in new projects within Harbor Beach, with 22 homes sold this year at an average price of $6 million. The neighborhood is a thriving hub for boating and water sports, and has hosted the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show for over 60 years. Marinas such as Lauderdale Marina and Bahia Mar Marina, along with seafood restaurants like Boatyard and 15th Street Fisheries, are notable local attractions.

Harbor Beach is located near Las Olas Boulevard, known for upscale shopping and entertainment, and close to the Fort Lauderdale Aquatic Center, which recently underwent a $44 million renovation. The area is expected to grow further with the upcoming $1 billion redevelopment of the Bahia Mar site, set to include a five-star hotel.

Local leaders highlight Harbor Beach's strong appeal for affluent residents and travelers, pointing to its marina facilities, luxury resorts, proximity to major events, and continued economic influence in Fort Lauderdale.

article_content: A family had a narrow escape when their dog accidentally started a fire after turning on the oven in an attempt to reach some freshly baked pies. Tia, a seven-year-old Dogue de Bordeaux, caused the emergency after trying to get to the meat-filled pastries late at night. The dog smelled two corned beef pies, baked earlier by her owner Adam Spurr from Hartlepool, which had been placed at the back of the hob. While trying to reach the pies by jumping up at the oven, Tia accidentally pushed one of the hob switches with her paw, igniting a ring. The family first became aware of the incident when smoke drifted up the stairs and into their bedroom around 2:30 am on Tuesday. Emma Llewellyn, 25, noticed the smoke and woke her partner Adam, 31. Emma quickly got their children, Kai, 7, and Theo, 3, out of bed, while Adam went to investigate. When Adam opened the kitchen door, he found thick smoke coming from the pies on the oven. He managed to remove the smouldering pies, clearing the source of the smoke. The family called emergency services, and fire brigade and ambulance crews arrived within minutes. Paramedics checked on Adam, who had inhaled smoke. Adam remarked on how lucky the family had been, saying, 'We were really shocked when we realised what was happening. I’m just so glad that we’re all alright because it could have been much worse.' He added that the kitchen smoke was so thick it was impossible to see, and he was surprised that Tia had not been harmed. Adam admitted he was disappointed about losing the pies and explained that Tia often tries to reach food on the workbenches, which is why the pies had been left at the back and covered with tea towels. Emma explained that their cooker only requires pressing and turning the knob to turn it on, which Tia managed to do accidentally. Firefighters checked the house and replaced a smoke alarm that had stopped working two weeks earlier. Adam and Emma now plan to remove the cooker knobs when it is not in use to avoid similar incidents in the future.

Mbwa huyo alipata harufu ya pai mbili za nyama ya ng’ombe zilizookwa mapema na mmiliki wake Adam Spurr kutoka Hartlepool, na kuwekwa nyuma ya jiko. Akiwa anajaribu kufikia pai hizo kwa kuruka juu ya jiko, Tia alisukuma kwa bahati mbaya kitufe cha jiko kwa mbwao wake, na kuwasha moto. Familia ilitambua tukio hilo mara ya kwanza baada ya moshi kujaa ghorofani na kufika chumbani kwao majira ya saa 8:30 usiku wa manane Jumanne. Emma Llewellyn, mwenye umri wa miaka 25, alihisi harufu ya moshi na kumwamsha mwenzi wake Adam, 31. Emma aliwatoa haraka watoto wao, Kai (miaka 7) na Theo (miaka 3), huku Adam akienda kuchunguza kilichotokea. Adam alipofungua mlango wa jikoni, alikuta moshi mzito ukitoka kwenye pai zilizokuwa jikoni. Aliweza kutoa pai zilizokuwa zikiunguza na hivyo kuondoa chanzo cha moshi. Aliendelea kusema kuwa moshi jikoni ulikuwa mzito kiasi kwamba haukuweza kuona, na alishangaa Tia hakupatwa na madhara. Adam na Emma sasa wanasema wataondoa vishikio vya jiko wakati halitumiki ili kuepusha tukio kama hilo kutokea tena.

article_content: This adorable moment unfolded when Seattle Mariners pitcher Felix Hernandez's playful son, Jeremy, picked up a reporter's voice recorder and began interviewing his father during a press conference. Hernandez was answering questions after finishing second in voting for the American League (AL) Cy Young Award. Five-year-old Jeremy, sitting beside his dad, grew restless and grabbed a voice recorder, holding it up to Hernandez's face to mimic the journalists. He even tried again with another recorder from the pile on the desk. Hernandez laughed as Jeremy continued his impromptu interviews, picking up several devices. The press conference took place after Corey Kluber of the Cleveland Indians was announced as the Cy Young Award winner. Hernandez admitted to reporters that losing was tough: 'I don't know what to say. That was tough. A little disappointed. Just gives me more motivation to work harder and be better next year.' Although he previously won the award in 2010, Hernandez said he felt he pitched even better this season but finished ten points behind Kluber in the voting. 'I had a great year,' Hernandez said. 'Health-wise, I felt fine the whole year. I think I pitched way better than in 2010.'

Ian Bell produced a stellar 167 on day two of the third Test against India at the Ageas Bowl, moving into England’s top 10 all-time Test run scorers. Passing Andrew Strauss, Bell now has 7,068 runs and 21 Test centuries, overtaking Graham Gooch and Ken Barrington. He reached the 7,000 milestone with a straight six off Ravindra Jadeja—the first six for England in the series. Bell and debutant Jos Buttler each struck three sixes in the afternoon, tallying six for England, compared to India’s seven across the initial two Tests.

Moeen Ali’s difficulties with the short ball continued as he was dismissed by a bouncer for the third time in the series, caught at second slip by Bhuvneshwar Kumar after mistiming a pull shot.

England enjoyed some luck in this Test. Gary Ballance was unlucky to be given out caught behind, but the hosts benefited from missed catches and close umpiring calls: Alastair Cook was dropped on 15, Bell narrowly avoided an lbw on zero, Ballance survived a possible catch on 10, and Buttler got away with a slip catch appeal before he had scored.

Gary Ballance’s 156 runs took his series total to 364 at an average of 91, leading all scorers. Murali Vijay follows with 328, and Joe Root is third with 236.

Indian opener Shikhar Dhawan’s poor run continued as he was caught at first slip by Cook off James Anderson for six. Anderson has now dismissed Dhawan cheaply in three consecutive first innings. England ended the day with significant individual and team achievements.

Baada ya kumpita Andrew Strauss, Bell sasa ana jumla ya alama 7,068 na karne 21 za Test, akiwazidi Graham Gooch na Ken Barrington. Alifikia alama 7,000 kupitia sita safi dhidi ya Ravindra Jadeja–ikiwa ndio sita ya kwanza England kwenye msururu huu. Bell na mchezaji mpya Jos Buttler walipiga sita tatu kila mmoja mchana, na kufanya England kupata sita sita, ikilinganishwa na saba za India kwenye mechi mbili zilizopita.

Moeen Ali aliendelea kuwa na ugumu dhidi ya mipira mifupi aliposhikwa slip ya pili na Bhuvneshwar Kumar baada ya kushindwa vizuri kupiga pull – hili likiwa ni mara ya tatu kwenye mfululizo huu.

England waliambulia bahati kwenye Test hii. Gary Ballance alitolewa kwa bahati mbaya baada ya kuonekana kugusa mpira nyuma, ila wenyeji walisalimika na mipira iliyoachwa na uamuzi wa waamuzi kwenye baadhi ya nyakati: Alastair Cook aliachwa akiwa na alama 15, Bell aliponea kupewa LBW akiwa na sufuri, Ballance aliponea kukamatwa akiwa na 10, na Buttler alipona appeal ya slip kabla hajafunga.

article_content: Drop has launched the CSTM80, the first in a new series of customizable keyboards. The 'CSTM' branding highlights the keyboard's flexibility: not only can you easily swap out keycaps and switches using a puller tool, but the top part of the case, attached magnetically, can also be quickly replaced for a new look. While changing a keyboard's appearance by replacing keycaps is common, Drop makes it simpler to match both your keycaps and the case for a unified design. If you prefer a custom setup, Drop offers a barebones version of the CSTM80 for $99. This kit does not include switches, keycaps, stabilizers, or the top case—these are purchased separately. Polycarbonate top cases are available in white, black, purple, orange, and green for $25. Aluminum cases come in silver or black and are priced at $59. Artist-designed cases, initially made with OSHETART and Chasing Artwork, cost $39 each, and Drop plans to collaborate with more designers in the future. The fully assembled version costs $149 and comes with a black polycarbonate top case, laser-etched shine-through keycaps, and your choice of tactile Gateron Brown Pro 3.0 or linear Gateron Yellow KS3 switches. The CSTM80 is a tenkeyless keyboard—meaning it lacks a numpad—and features a standard layout. The keyboard supports 5-pin switches, includes sound-dampening foam, PCB-mount stabilizers, a polycarbonate plate, and an aluminum weight. It can be customized via Drop's configuration software or VIA. Users can further upgrade with stainless steel or brass weights, and plates made from carbon fiber, brass, or POM. The keyboard employs a gasket-mount design, providing a more flexible and premium typing feel compared to traditional fixed plate designs. While Drop has produced gasket-mount keyboards before (like the Sense75, priced at $350), the CSTM80 offers similar features and customization at a much more accessible $149 entry point.

President Barack Obama is urged to use the time gained from the fiscal-cliff deal to address important issues left unresolved from his previous term—particularly child labor on American farms. Child farm workers represent one of the least protected and most underpaid labor groups in America. Farms frequently rely on children, some as young as six, to cut costs, since U.S. Department of Labor regulations allow paying workers under 20 years old as little as $4.25 per hour, compared to the federal minimum wage of $7.25. Unlike in retail and service sectors, child farm workers can legally work unlimited hours at any time of day or night.

Estimates suggest about 400,000 children, via direct employment, contractors, or informal cash arrangements, are weeding and harvesting on commercial farms. According to a 2010 Human Rights Watch study, these children often work more than 10 hours per day. Few safety regulations apply; those 14 and older can work lengthy hours at most farm jobs without parental consent if they stay in school, while those as young as 12 can do the same with parental approval. Agricultural workers 16 and older may operate hazardous machinery and work during school hours, privileges not granted to teens in other sectors.

Human Rights Watch also reports that child farm workers face dangerous pesticide exposure, lack sufficient access to water and bathrooms, suffer from heat illness, are exposed to sexual harassment, sustain repetitive-motion injuries, rarely have proper safety equipment, and are usually paid below minimum wage—sometimes receiving no pay at all. Enforcement is minimal. In 2011, Secretary of Labor Hilda Solis proposed stricter regulations for children under 16, but these were withdrawn by the Obama administration eight months later, following opposition from farm parents, the American Farm Bureau, and others concerned about family farm traditions and youth agricultural training programs, like 4-H and FFA. However, most at-risk child workers are not family members and remain unprotected.

The scarcity of enforcement staff means violations often go unchecked. A 2010 Human Rights Watch report found only 36 child labor and two serious safety violations in agriculture nationwide, despite widespread reports. The consequences are severe: last July, 15-year-old Curvin Kropf died in Illinois after being crushed by heavy farm equipment, the fifth child in less than two years to die working in area farms. Each year, at least 100 children under 18 die in farm accidents, and 23,000 are injured severely enough to require hospital care. CDC data shows agriculture is among the most dangerous industries for children, accounting for about half of all child worker deaths.

While working on family farms is a longstanding American tradition, with more than 500,000 children helping out today, most vulnerable child workers are not family members and do not benefit from this protected environment. The author calls on President Obama to revisit stronger child labor regulations, and for the Department of Labor to harmonize wage, hour, and safety standards with those in retail and service sectors, to prevent children in agriculture from facing greater risks and lower pay. Further, effective enforcement through adequate funding is necessary if these rules are to protect the nearly one million children working on U.S. farms. Agriculture should remain a source of national pride, not tragedy for America’s youth. The views in this commentary are solely those of Cristina Traina.

Watoto wanaofanya kazi mashambani ni kati ya wafanyakazi wasiokuwa na ulinzi na wanaolipwa kidogo zaidi Amerika. Inakadiriwa kuwa watoto wapatao 400,000, aidha kwa kuajiriwa moja kwa moja, kupitia wakandarasi au kazi isiyo rasmi, hupalilia na kuvuna kwenye mashamba ya kibiashara. Human Rights Watch inaonyesha pia watoto wa mashambani hukumbana na viuadudu hatari, ukosefu wa maji na vyoo vya kutosha, magonjwa ya joto, kunyanyaswa kingono, majeraha yanayotokana na harakati zinazorudiwa, mara chache hupata vifaa vya kujikinga, na hulipwa chini ya kiwango cha chini—wakati mwingine hawalipwi kabisa. Udhibiti ni mdogo. Mnamo 2011, Waziri Hilda Solis alipendekeza sheria kali zaidi kwa watoto chini ya miaka 16, lakini ziliondolewa na serikali ya Obama baada ya miezi nane kutokana na upinzani kutoka kwa wazazi wa mashamba, American Farm Bureau na wengine walio na wasiwasi kwa jadi ya mashamba ya familia na programu za vijana kama 4-H na FFA. Hata hivyo, wengi wa watoto wanaopatwa na hatari si wanafamilia na hivyo hawalindwi.

Upungufu wa wasimamizi wa sheria husababisha matendo mengi haramu kutochunguzwa. Ripoti ya Human Rights Watch ya 2010 ilibaini ukiukwaji 36 wa ajira ya watoto na mikubwa miwili ya usalama tu katika sekta ya kilimo nchini, licha ya taarifa nyingi. Madhara ni makubwa: Julai iliyopita, Curvin Kropf mwenye umri wa miaka 15 alifariki Illinois baada ya kukandamizwa na mashine nzito, akiwa mtoto wa tano chini ya miaka miwili kufariki akifanya kazi mashambani katika eneo hilo. Kila mwaka, angalau watoto 100 walio chini ya miaka 18 hufa kutokana na ajali mashambani na 23,000 hujeruhiwa vibaya kiasi cha kulazwa hospitali. Takwimu za CDC zinaonyesha kilimo ni sekta hatari zaidi kwa watoto, ikifanya karibu nusu ya vifo vya wafanyakazi watoto kila mwaka.

Kufanya kazi mashambani kwa familia ni desturi ndefu nchini Marekani, takriban watoto 500,000 husaidia leo, lakini wengi wa walio hatarini zaidi si wa familia na hawapati ulinzi huo. Mwandishi anamtaka Rais Obama afufue sheria kali zaidi za ajira ya watoto, na Idara ya Kazi ilinganishe viwango vya mishahara, saa na usalama na sekta nyingine, ili kulinda watoto wa kilimo dhidi ya hatari na mishahara midogo. Aidha, utekelezaji bora na ufadhili wa kutosha ni muhimu ili kulinda karibu watoto milioni moja wanaofanya kazi mashambani Marekani. Kilimo ni fahari ya taifa, kisije kikawa majonzi kwa watoto wa Marekani. Maoni haya ni ya Cristina Traina pekee.

article_content: Recent speculation in Central European newspapers suggests that Prince Charles, the current heir to the British throne, could be considered as a candidate to become King of Romania if the country’s monarchy were to be restored. This follows his remarks in a recent interview revealing his ancestral connection to Vlad the Impaler, the historical Romanian ruler who inspired the Dracula legend. The last monarch of Romania, King Michael, reigned from 1927 to 1930 and from 1940 to 1947, before being forced to abdicate by the nation’s communist leaders. These leaders threatened violence if he did not step down, after which Romania endured decades of communist government, especially under Nicolae Ceausescu, whose rule stretched from 1965 until his overthrow and execution in 1989. While King Michael, now elderly, and his family are still alive, public discussion about restoring the monarchy has grown in recent years. Prince Charles’s profile in Romania has gained attention, particularly after he publicly acknowledged his familial ties to Vlad the Impaler and met privately with Romanian tourism minister Elena Udrea at Clarence House. Local media have emphasized not only Charles’s historic connection but also the British royal family’s ties to Romania, as Queen Elizabeth II is a third cousin of King Michael. Some Romanian newspapers have even speculated that Charles might give up his claim to the British throne in favor of his son, Prince William, to become King of Romania, a notion met with skepticism from the British royal household. Prince Charles’s fondness for Romania is well documented: he owns an 18th-century farmhouse in the Transylvanian village of Viscri, purchased in 2005 with support from the Mihai Eminescu Trust, which works to preserve historic Saxon villages. Charles regularly visits Viscri, appreciating its rural lifestyle, and makes his home available to tourists when he is not there. While Clarence House confirmed his meeting with Minister Udrea and his affectionate regard for Romania, senior royal officials have dismissed suggestions of his becoming King of Romania as unfounded.

Baadaye Romania iliishi chini ya utawala wa kikomunisti kwa miongo kadhaa, hasa wakati wa utawala wa Nicolae Ceausescu kuanzia 1965 hadi kuangushwa kwake na kuuawa mwaka 1989. article_content: This story originally appeared on Hakai and is part of the Climate Desk collaboration. There was a time when humans put animals on trial for their supposed crimes against people. The earliest known case in the Western legal tradition was against moles in Valle d’Aosta, Italy, in 824 AD, and these prosecutions continued into the 1900s. Over the centuries, remarkable cases included a pig dressed in human clothing and hanged in Falaise, France; dolphins put on trial in Marseille for unspecified crimes; and a rooster, which was burned at the stake in Basel, Switzerland, after laying an egg (an act considered witchcraft, especially for a male bird). E.P. Evans’s 1906 book, The Criminal Prosecution and Capital Punishment of Animals, suggests these trials were not intended for humor, but rather were conducted with grave seriousness. However, the proceedings could become quite bizarre. In 1522, ‘some rats of the diocese’ of Autun, France, were prosecuted for destroying barley crops. A lawyer named Barthélemy de Chasseneuz defended the rats, and the case is remembered for its unusual legal arguments. When the rats failed to appear in court, de Chasseneuz argued that the summons only addressed ‘some rats’ instead of specifying which ones. The court later required that all rats in Autun be summoned. When the rodents did not show up again, the lawyer claimed the rats were too dispersed for easy travel, so they needed more time. Once more, the proceedings were delayed, but the rats still did not attend, which de Chasseneuz said was due to the dangers posed by locals and their cats. Arguing his clients needed safe passage, the lawyer challenged the court’s process. Ultimately, with no resolution possible, the court ruled in favor of the rats by default, and they were acquitted.
translated_content: Hadithi hii ilichapishwa awali kwenye Hakai na ni sehemu ya ushirikiano wa Climate Desk. Kulikuwa na wakati ambapo binadamu waliwashtaki wanyama kwa makosa yaliyodaiwa kufanywa dhidi yao. Kesi ya kwanza inayojulikana katika sheria za Magharibi ilikuwa dhidi ya moles huko Valle d’Aosta, Italia, mwaka 824 BK, na mashitaka kama haya yaliendelea hadi miaka ya 1900. Katika karne zilizofuata, kesi za kushangaza zilijumuisha nguruwe kuvalishwa nguo za binadamu na kuning’inizwa Falaise, Ufaransa; dolphin kushtakiwa Marseille kwa makosa yasiyoelezwa; na jogoo, aliyeteketezwa Basel, Uswisi baada ya kutaga yai (kitendo kilichochukuliwa kuwa uchawi, hasa kwa jogoo dume). Kitabu cha E.P. Evans cha mwaka 1906, The Criminal Prosecution and Capital Punishment of Animals, kinaonyesha mashitaka haya hayakukusudiwa kuwa ya mzaha, bali yalifanywa kwa umakini mkubwa. Hata hivyo, mashitaka haya yangeweza kuwa ya ajabu sana. Mwaka 1522, ‘panya kadhaa wa dayosisi’ ya Autun, Ufaransa, walishtakiwa kwa kuharibu mazao ya shayiri. Wakili aitwaye Barthélemy de Chasseneuz aliwatetea panya hao, na kesi hii inakumbukwa kwa hoja zake za kipekee kisheria. Panya waliposhindwa kuhudhuria kortini, de Chasseneuz alidai kwamba wito uliwataja tu ‘panya kadhaa’ bila kubainisha ni gani hasa. Mahakama iliamuru wito utumiwe kwa panya wote wa Autun. Walipoendelea kutoonekana, wakili alidai kuwa panya wameenea sana hivyo wanahitaji muda zaidi wa kusafiri. Mara nyingine tena, mashitaka yalicheleweshwa, lakini bado panya hawakufika, de Chasseneuz akasema ni kwa sababu ya hatari kutoka kwa wenyeji na paka zao. Akitetea wateja wake wahakikishwe usalama, wakili alipinga mwenendo wa mahakama. Hatimaye, kutokana na kukosekana kwa suluhu, mahakama iliwapa ushindi panya kwa msingi wa kutoweka, na walikuwa huru.

article_content: British International Investment (BII), the UK’s development finance institution, has committed $26.5 million to AFEX, a leading African commodities platform. According to AFEX, this significant investment is intended to support structural improvements in Africa’s agricultural sector. On Monday, a signing ceremony formalized the collaboration between BII and AFEX, attended by notable figures such as the British deputy high commissioner in Lagos, Jonny Baxter, BII chief executive Nick O’Donohoe, and AFEX Group CEO Ayodeji Balogun. AFEX currently operates over 200 warehouses across Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda, serving more than 450,000 farmers. The new funding is expected to bring transformative changes, mainly benefiting smallholder farmers, promoting food security, and encouraging sustainable growth in the region. According to the statement, 'BII’s investment will be used to build 20 modern warehouses in strategic locations across Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda. It will also help expand warehouse technology and next-generation software for post-harvest pricing. Smart storage solutions can extend the shelf life of harvested crops, thereby increasing available food supply. The additional warehouses will offer 230,000 metric tons of storage, giving up to 200,000 more farmers access to affordable storage and maximizing sales from harvests, which could increase farmer incomes by over 200 percent. Supporting smallholder farmers to earn a fair wage is vital for ongoing operations and production of higher-quality crops for local consumption.' BII’s funding will also contribute to the development of a soybean processing plant in Ibadan, Nigeria, and a drying facility in Uganda. Construction is expected to create more than 700 temporary jobs and over 80 permanent positions. BII CEO Nick O’Donohoe commented, 'The World Bank estimates that Africa’s food import bill has reached $30 billion in recent years. We must support technology-driven companies like AFEX, as they help reduce import costs by empowering smallholder farmers to increase local food production and improve their incomes.' AFEX Group CEO Ayodeji Balogun added, 'This investment from British International Investment marks a significant step in AFEX’s mission to revolutionize agriculture and elevate food security across Africa. By directing capital to advanced warehouses and essential infrastructure, we are improving market access and income opportunities for smallholder farmers. Aligning with the UN SDGs, we aim to help Africa achieve efficient and sustainable food production. Today’s investment propels our growth and creates a more secure future for the continent.' Jonny Baxter said, 'I am proud that British International Investment’s support will boost agricultural productivity and strengthen food security in Nigeria. Agriculture is a vital part of Nigeria’s economy, contributing significantly to job creation and investment opportunities.'

Kwa mujibu wa AFEX, uwekezaji huu mkubwa unalenga kusaidia maboresho ya kimfumo katika sekta ya kilimo Afrika. Tunatakiwa kuzisaidia kampuni binafsi kama AFEX, kwani zinasaidia kupunguza gharama hizi kwa kuwawezesha wakulima wadogo kuongeza uzalishaji wa chakula nchini na kupandisha mapato yao.' Kwa kuelekeza mtaji kwenye maghala yaliyo na teknolojia ya kisasa na miundombinu muhimu, tunaboresha upatikanaji wa soko na uwezo wa mapato kwa wakulima wadogo. Kwa kuendana na Malengo ya Maendeleo Endelevu (SDGs) ya Umoja wa Mataifa, tunalenga kusaidia Afrika ijitosheleze kwa chakula kwa tija na uendelevu. Uwekezaji huu ni nguzo ya ukuaji wa AFEX na bara zima.' Jonny Baxter alisema, 'Ninajivunia msaada wa BII ambao utaongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo na kuimarisha usalama wa chakula nchini Nigeria. Sekta ya kilimo ni nguzo kuu ya uchumi wa Nigeria, inachangia sana kwenye ajira na fursa za uwekezaji.'

article_content: Doug Gregory, age 90, has finally retired from aerobatic flying after decades of being advised to stop. Known as Britain’s oldest stunt pilot, Gregory has reluctantly given up daring stunts, but insists he will keep flying. The former RAF and commercial pilot is selling his homemade replica of a 1917 stunt plane, admitting it has become too challenging to operate. Gregory said giving up aerobatics was a hard decision, as flying has been his lifelong passion. He commented, 'I will miss it terribly and it is very sad to see it go. It is hard to get in and out of and very difficult to start.' The World War I replica aircraft, which cost £5,000 to build between 1983 and 1987, was, according to him, excellent for stunts and aerobatics. 'It was quite special when it was completed, and I was very pleased. It has brought me a lot of joy and fun over the years,' Gregory recalled. Gregory survived 67 missions flying into occupied Germany during World War II and suffered a brain hemorrhage in 1947, after which he was told he would never fly again. Defying that prognosis, he continued flying, though commercial flying was off the table. 'The inspiration to build my own plane came from being told I would never fly again,' he said. 'It was clear I could no longer fly commercially after my illness, but it wasn’t long before I was back in the cockpit, and I never stopped.' He spent four years building his own aircraft, which he flew for nine years with the Great War Display Team, performing at World War I memorial events in France. 'I joined the Air Force at 18 when I was old enough. Flying has always been my favorite thing, especially aerobatics. I don’t play any other sport – flying is enough for me,' said Gregory, a former schoolteacher who has held all the necessary licenses during his seven-decade-long flying career. While Gregory is giving up stunts, he says he intends to keep flying every week and doesn’t plan to stop until he dies. 'My family think I’m nuts, but I must be doing something right to still be flying. I love it as much now as I did when I was young. For me, there’s nothing better than being up in the air.'
translated_content: Doug Gregory, mwenye umri wa miaka 90, hatimaye amestaafu kufanya mazoezi hatari angani baada ya kushauriwa aache kwa miongo kadhaa. Anajulikana kama rubani mkongwe zaidi wa mazoezi ya hatari Uingereza, Gregory ameamua kuacha mazoezi hayo yenye hatari, lakini amesisitiza kuwa ataendelea kuruka. Rubani huyo wa zamani wa RAF na rubani wa biashara anauza ndege aliyojitengenezea mwenyewe inayofanana na ile ya mwaka 1917, akisema sasa ni ngumu sana kutumia ukiwa na umri mkubwa. Gregory alisema kuacha mazoezi ya akrobatiki ilikuwa uamuzi mgumu, kwani kuruka ni shauku yake ya maisha yote. Alisema, 'Nitaikosa sana na ni huzuni kuona imeondoka. Ni vigumu kuingia na kutoka na pia ni ngumu sana kuiwasha.' Ndege hii ya mfano wa Vita ya Kwanza ya Dunia, iliyogharimu pauni 5,000 kujenga kati ya 1983 na 1987, ilikuwa bora kwake kufanya mazoezi ya hatari na akrobatiki. 'Ilikuwa hisia ya pekee ilipokamilika, na nilifurahi sana. Imeniletea furaha na msisimko kwa miaka mingi,' Gregory alikumbuka. Gregory alinusurika safari 67 kwenda Ujerumani wakati wa Vita ya Pili ya Dunia na alipopata ugonjwa wa damu kuganda kwenye ubongo mwaka 1947, alipewa ushauri kuwa hataweza kuruka tena. Lakini alikaidi ushauri huo na akaendelea na urubani, ingawa hakurudi tena kwenye kazi za rubani wa biashara. 'Msukumo wa kutengeneza ndege yangu mwenyewe ulitokana na kuambiwa sitaweza kuruka tena,' alisema. 'Ilikuwa wazi siwezi kurudi kwenye urubani wa biashara baada ya kuugua, lakini haikuchukua muda mrefu kabla sijaingia tena kwenye ndege, na sikuwahi kuacha.' Aliitumia miaka minne kutengeneza ndege yake mwenyewe, na akaiongoza kwa miaka tisa na kikosi cha maonesho cha Great War Display Team, akishiriki kwenye hafla za kumbukumbu za Vita ya Kwanza ya Dunia nchini Ufaransa. 'Nilijiunga na Jeshi la Anga nikiwa na miaka 18 tu nilipofikisha umri huo. Kuruka imekuwa kitu ninachokipenda zaidi maishani, hasa akrobatiki. Sichezi michezo mingine yoyote – kuruka kinanitosha,' alisema Gregory, ambaye pia alikuwa mwalimu wa shule na ameshikilia leseni zote zinazohitajika katika zaidi ya miaka sabini ya urubani wake. Ingawa Gregory ameacha mazoezi ya hatari, anasema ataendelea kuruka kila wiki na hana mpango wa kuacha hadi atakapofariki dunia. 'Familia yangu wanaona nimechanganyikiwa, lakini lazima nikubali nafanya jambo sahihi kwa sababu bado nipo hai na naruka. Bado naipenda kama nilivyokuwa mdogo. Kwangu, hakuna kitu bora zaidi kuliko kuwa angani.'

article_content: As Scotland nears its referendum, the rise in political engagement is seen by many as a revival of a spirit absent in the UK for decades. The September 18 vote is widely viewed as a triumph for social democracy, and like many, I hope the result is a strong 'Yes.' Much confusion exists between nationalism and independence, but the central issue for many is advancing social democracy rather than promoting nationalism. If Scotland achieves independence, it would gain the power to establish its own laws, embrace new political ideas, and strive for a society built on social equality, leaving outdated ways behind. Major British parties like Labour, Conservative, and Liberal Democrats have lost distinct identities in their pursuit of power. As a Labour Party member, I've been disappointed to watch the party repeatedly compromise its socialist roots, particularly since its New Labour transformation in the 1990s. This attempt at renewal may have cost the party its foundational ideals. Decisions under Tony Blair—especially taking part in the Iraq War—created deep divisions within Labour that have yet to heal. As Westminster's leaders oppose Scottish independence with aggressive tactics, they seem only to further reinforce Scotland's sense of identity and determination. Environmental advocate George Monbiot has said that a 'No' vote would mean accepting a political system marked by deep inequality, neglect of public services and the environment, and policies that favor the wealthy. Through the independence campaign, I have been frustrated by colleagues' lack of insight into Scotland's situation, and their arguments often rely on fear rather than reason. Casting your vote is ultimately an act of personal faith, with the only certainty being your own conviction. Additional perspectives can be found in public discussions, such as those between Brian Cox and Rory Stewart, as well as views from opponents like Eddie Izzard.
translated_content: Kadri Scotland inavyokaribia kura ya maoni, ongezeko la ushiriki wa kisiasa linaonekana na wengi kama ufufuo wa ari ambayo haijaonekana Uingereza kwa miongo kadhaa. Kura ya Sepemba 18 inaonwa kama ushindi wa demokrasia ya kijamii, na kama ilivyo kwa wengi, natumaini matokeo yatakuwa 'Ndiyo' thabiti. Kuna mkanganyiko mkubwa kati ya utaifa na uhuru, lakini kwa wengi, hoja kuu ni kuendeleza demokrasia ya kijamii badala ya kukuza utaifa. Ikiwa Scotland itapata uhuru, itakuwa na uwezo wa kutunga sheria zake, kukaribisha mawazo mapya ya kisiasa na kujenga jamii yenye usawa, na kuacha fikra za zamani. Vyama vikuu vya siasa vya Uingereza kama Labour, Conservative na Liberal Democrats vimepoteza tofauti zao katika mbio za kutafuta madaraka. Kama mwanachama wa Labour, nimesikitishwa na chama hiki kujitenga na misingi ya ujamaa, hasa tangu mabadiliko ya kuwa New Labour miaka ya 1990. Jaribio hili la kujiboresha labda limesababisha kupoteza misingi muhimu ya chama. Maamuzi yaliyochukuliwa chini ya uongozi wa Tony Blair—hasa uamuzi wa kushiriki Vita vya Iraq—yalizua mgawanyiko mkubwa katika Labour na bado haujaponywa. Marais na viongozi wa Westminster wanapopinga kwa bidii uhuru wa Scotland, wanaonekana kuongeza zaidi ari na dhamira ya Wascotland. Mtetezi wa mazingira George Monbiot amesema kupiga kura ya 'Hapana' ni kukubali mfumo wa kisiasa uliojaa ukosefu wa usawa, kupuuza huduma za umma na mazingira, na sera zinazowalinda matajiri. Katika kampeni ya uhuru, nimevunjika moyo na jinsi wenzangu hawajaelewa hali ya Scotland, na hoja zao mara nyingi zinategemea hofu zaidi kuliko mantiki. Kuweka kura ni tendo la imani yako binafsi—kwa upande wowote utakaochagua. Unaweza kupata mitazamo zaidi kwenye mijadala kama ule kati ya Brian Cox na Rory Stewart, pamoja na maoni ya wapinzani kama Eddie Izzard.

article_content:
From a shattered village to the first light of a new day’s assault, here’s an inside look at life on four front lines. In October, Al Jazeera’s Alex Gatopoulos visited four such locations. This is the first in a series of four dispatches.

Our determined driver, Denis, takes us to Huliaipole, a front-line town in southeastern Ukraine that has endured intense fighting. In the car are correspondent Zein, cameraman Alasdair, our security consultant Luke, and Dimi, our invaluable fixer. We are soon stopped by a weary soldier at a checkpoint. The police arrive, then a small car escorts us the rest of the way to meet the town’s mayor.

We reach a door set into a ruined apartment block—this is the entrance to the town’s aid center, less than a kilometer from the first Ukrainian trenches. For those who have stayed, life has moved underground.

Down a long, dark staircase, we find corridors fitted with water filtration systems, hot water boilers for a row of showers—some with chairs for people who cannot stand. A laundromat hums away. There is even a small salon, where elderly women chat as they wait for their hair to be done. In a makeshift cinema, a keyboard and speakers sit to the side. The walls are covered with children’s drawings of forests, flowers, and Ukrainian flags. Balloons have been strung up. At the back, a canteen serves coffee and biscuits.

We interview Mayor Sergiy Yarmark, who helped create the center and is proud of what has been done. While people sleep in basements scattered across Huliaipole, they come here to wash, do laundry, and hold on to elements of their past lives. Zein asks the mayor about the most painful day he remembers. He tears up as he recalls losing his best friend nearly a year ago. The place is friendly, but tinged with sadness; almost everyone here shares similar stories of hardship and loss.

Above ground, only animals are seen. Pigeons circle over blackened, gutted buildings. Only the sign remains of a burned-out children’s clothing shop. We shelter in the shadow of a building. Dogs bask in the grass beneath trees with falling leaves. The ever-present hum of generators—the town’s sole source of electricity—signals people are still here, tucked away in basements. Most of the shelling happens at night. During the day, a man nervously takes laundry to the aid center. Outside, villagers gather by the entrance, chatting with policemen around a tub full of old coffee cups. Occasionally, soldiers stop to chat with canteen workers who take a break for a smoke.

We cross the main boulevard on foot into eerie silence. A recent blast has destroyed a building and damaged another across the street, tearing through trees. Amid the wreckage stands a tourist sign that survived: “I Love Huliaipole.”

We then visit an animal sanctuary, its windows covered with United Nations-supplied polythene sheeting. The building also serves as a local pet clinic. We interview the owner of a dog being prepared for neutering. Feeling squeamish, I step outside. The smallest dog in the world trots by, unaware of what’s happening. The generator hums—life carries on. As outgoing artillery fire from nearby batteries increases, we decide to leave. The vet interview wraps up. An elderly woman emerges from the sanctuary and cycles home, showing us her bag with her neutered dog cowering inside.

Kutoka kijiji kilichoharibiwa hadi mwanzo wa mashambulizi kabla ya alfajiri, hapa kuna mwangaza wa maisha kwenye mistari minne ya mbele. Mwezi Oktoba, Alex Gatopoulos wa Al Jazeera alitembelea maeneo manne kama haya. Hii ni sehemu ya kwanza kati ya ripoti nne.

Dereva wetu jasiri, Denis, anatuchukua hadi Huliaipole, mji wa mstari wa mbele kusini mashariki mwa Ukraine uliokumbwa na mapigano makali. Ndani ya gari wako mwandishi Zein, mpiga kamera Alasdair, mshauri wa usalama Luke, na Dimi, msaidizi wetu muhimu. Tunapofika, askari mwenye uchovu anatusimamisha kwenye kituo cha ukaguzi. Polisi wanafika na gari dogo linatusindikiza hadi tukutane na meya wa mji.

Tunawasili kwenye mlango wa jengo lililoharibiwa—hapo ndipo mlango wa kituo cha msaada cha mji, kilicho chini ya kilomita moja kutoka mahandaki ya kwanza ya Waukraine. Kwa waliopo hapa, maisha yamehamia chini ya ardhi.

Tunashuka ngazi ndefu na giza na kupita kwenye korido zilizo na mifumo ya kuchuja maji, majiko ya maji moto kwa mabafu—mengine yakiwa na viti kwa walio na uhitaji. Mashine za kufua zinafanya kazi. Kuna pia saluni ndogo ambapo akina mama wazee wanapiga stori wakisubiri nywele zao kufanywa. Kwenye sinema ya muda, kibodi na vipaza sauti vimehifadhiwa pembeni. Kuta zimepambwa kwa michoro ya watoto ya misitu, maua, na bendera za Ukraine. Baluni zimewekwa kusherehekea. Nyuma kabisa, mkahawa mdogo unatolewa kahawa na biskuti.

Tunamhoji Meya Sergiy Yarmark, aliyeanzisha kituo hiki na kujivunia mafanikio. Watu wanalala kwenye vyumba vya chini vya ardhi kote Huliaipole lakini huenda hapa kuoga, kufua nguo na kuhifadhi mambo ya zamani. Zein anamuuliza siku iliyomuumiza zaidi. Anatoa machozi akimkumbuka rafiki aliyepotea karibu mwaka mmoja uliopita. Mahali hapa ni pa urafiki lakini pia huzuni; karibu kila mtu ana simulizi za huzuni na maumivu.

Juu ya ardhi, ni wanyama pekee wanaoonekana. Njiwa huruka juu ya majengo yaliyochomeka. Kibao tu kimebaki kwenye duka la watoto lililoungua. Tunajikinga kwenye kivuli cha jengo. Mbwa wamelala kwenye majani chini ya miti inayotupa majani. Mlio wa jenereta—chanzo pekee cha umeme—unaonesha bado kuna watu hapa, wamejificha chini ya ardhi. Mashambulizi mengi hutokea usiku. Mchana, mwanaume mmoja anaenda kwa haraka na nguo chafu kwenye kituo cha msaada. Wakazi wanakusanyika karibu na mlango wakiongea na polisi karibu na ndoo iliyojaa vikombe vya kahawa. Mara kwa mara, askari huja kuongea na wafanyakazi wa mkahawa walio nje kupumzika na kuvuta sigara.

Tunavuka barabara kuu kwa miguu kwenye utulivu wa kutisha. Bomu lililoanguka hivi karibuni limebomoa jengo na kuharibu jingine, likichana miti. Kwenye magofu, bango la “Ninapenda Huliaipole” bado limesimama.

Tunaenda kwenye hifadhi ya wanyama, madirisha yamefunikwa plastiki kutoka Umoja wa Mataifa. Jengo hili pia ni kliniki kwa wanyama wa eneo. Tunamhoji mmiliki wa mbwa anayeshughulikiwa kufanyiwa upasuaji wa kizazi. Ninatoka nje kidogo, nikisikia kutojisikia vizuri. Mbwa mdogo kabisa duniani anapita, hajui kinachoendelea. Mlio wa jenereta unaendelea - maisha yanaendelea. Risasi za mizinga kutoka karibu zikiongezeka, tunaamua kuondoka. Mahojiano na daktari wa mifugo yanafika mwisho. Mwanamke mzee anatoka kwenye hifadhi na kwenda nyumbani kwa baiskeli, akitutolea mfuko wake na mbwa aliyefanyiwa upasuaji akiwa amejiinamia ndani.

article_content: Last July at Muirfield's short-game practice area during Open Championship week, a boy who looked around 14 was hitting from the bunker beside Rory McIlroy and Luke Donald. Only his girlfriend was watching – the cameras were focused on the two British stars. Two children waited for autographs from every player leaving the practice ground. When it was his turn, the young man paused, smiled, and signed. As he walked away, one of the children called out, 'Excuse me, Mr....' – he stopped and turned – '...but who are you?' With a shy smile, he replied, 'Matt Fitzpatrick.' Fitzpatrick was sometimes mistaken for Tiger Woods' ball boy during practice sessions at Muirfield, but that won't happen at Augusta National this week. Despite appearing younger than his 19 years, Fitzpatrick has made a name for himself since those days. His modest, polite demeanor remains, but his on- and off-course accomplishments have spoken volumes about his talent and determination. Fitzpatrick, a young British Open qualifier from Sheffield, made the cut at Muirfield and won the Silver Medal for best amateur. The following month, he traveled to Boston and became the first Englishman in 102 years to win the U.S. Amateur. He also made headlines by leaving his U.S. college golf scholarship at Northwestern after just one term. Northwestern and coach Pat Goss had helped guide former world No. 1 Luke Donald, but Fitzpatrick felt the Illinois university wasn’t a good fit and did not return after his Christmas break. Speaking to CNN’s Living Golf at Hallamshire golf club in Sheffield, Fitzpatrick said, 'During the last weeks at university, I had a lot of time to think. I found myself just studying in my room and wasn’t doing much else. I wanted to take my golf as far as I could, and it was hard to keep progressing. I was doing more school work than golf.' His decision was shaped by his focus and by timing. After signing his letter of intent with Northwestern following his British Boys' Championship win in 2012, Fitzpatrick hadn’t yet qualified for the Open or won the Silver Medal and U.S. Amateur. When these achievements came, his life changed and so did his plans. His U.S. Amateur victory opened many doors: invitations to three of the four majors, including The Masters, starts on the PGA Tour, and a place at the Scottish Open. He began building a schedule many young pros would envy and attracted interest from top agents, including Tiger Woods'. Those who've watched Fitzpatrick succeed at every level highlight his dedication, ability to thrive under pressure, and strategic course management. He credits his dad, Russell, for this skill, remembering post-tournament discussions about club choices. Despite discussions with agents and top players, Fitzpatrick hasn't decided when to turn professional. He wants to accept invitations to the Masters, U.S. Open, and his home Open as an amateur. 'I don't know if I'm ready yet. I think I have a lot of room to improve. But with a top-10 in the U.S. Open or British Open, I guess you'd have to re-evaluate,' he said. His immediate goal: be the lowest amateur in all three majors. At Augusta, he’ll stay at the Crow’s Nest, the traditional accommodation for invited amateurs. Having played a few practice rounds, Fitzpatrick is eager to get started. With Augusta’s demands for patience, strategy, and short-game skill, Fitzpatrick stands a good chance of making the cut, similar to last year's 14-year-old Guan Tianlang of China. If he succeeds, it would cap a remarkable nine months. Fitzpatrick remains quiet about his achievements, letting family and supporters from Hallamshire do the celebrating, as he stays focused on taking his next step in the game.
translated_content: Julai iliyopita katika eneo la mazoezi ya short-game Muirfield wakati wa wiki ya Mashindano ya Open, kijana aliyekuwa anaonekana kama ana miaka 14 alikuwa akipiga mpira kwenye bunkani karibu na Rory McIlroy na Luke Donald. Ni mpenzi wake tu ndiye aliyekuwa akimwangalia – kamera zote zilikuwa zimewaelekea nyota wawili wa Uingereza. Watoto wawili walikuwa wanasubiri kupata saini kutoka kwa kila mchezaji anayemaliza mazoezi. Ilipofika zamu yake, kijana alisimama, akatabasamu na kusaini. Alipokuwa anaondoka, mmoja wa watoto alimuita, 'Samahani, Bwana....' – akasimama na kugeuka – '...lakini wewe ni nani?' Kwa tabasamu la aibu alijibu, 'Matt Fitzpatrick.' Fitzpatrick mara nyingine alikosewa kama kijana wa kubeba mipira wa Tiger Woods wakati wa mazoezi Muirfield, lakini hilo halitatokea wiki hii Augusta National. Licha ya kuonekana kijana zaidi ya miaka 19, Fitzpatrick amejiweka kwenye ramani tangu siku hizo. Tabia yake ya unyenyekevu imeendelea kuonekana, ila mafanikio yake ndani na nje ya uwanja yamesimulia kipawa na nia yake ya kweli. Fitzpatrick, kijana kutoka Sheffield aliyefuzu Open, alipita mchujo Muirfield na kushinda Medali ya Fedha kama mchezaji bora wa ridhaa. Mwezi uliofuata, alisafiri Boston na akawa Mwingereza wa kwanza kwa miaka 102 kushinda taji la U.S. Amateur. Alijulikana pia kwa kuachana na ufadhili wake wa chuo cha gofu Northwestern baada ya muhula mmoja pekee. Northwestern na kocha Pat Goss waliwasaidia nyota kama Luke Donald, lakini Fitzpatrick aliona chuo cha Illinois hakimfaidii na hakurudi baada ya likizo ya Krismasi. Akizungumza na CNN Living Golf kwenye klabu ya Hallamshire huko Sheffield, Fitzpatrick alisema, 'Wiki za mwisho chuoni nilipata muda wa kutafakari. Nilijikuta ninasoma tu chumbani bila kufanya mengi. Nilikuwa natamani kufika mbali na gofu lakini ilikuwa vigumu kusonga. Nilijikuta nafanya kazi nyingi za shule kuliko kucheza gofu.' Uamuzi wake uliathiriwa na umakini na muda. Baada ya saini mkataba na Northwestern baada ya ushindi wa British Boys' Championship mwaka 2012, Fitzpatrick alikuwa bado hajashinda Medali ya Fedha wala U.S. Amateur. Mafanikio hayo yalipokuja, maisha na mipango yake vikalazimika kubadilika. Ushindi wa U.S. Amateur ulimfungulia milango–alikaribishwa katika mashindano makubwa matatu, ikiwemo The Masters, akaanza kwenye PGA Tour na kupata nafasi Scottish Open. Alianza kupanga ratiba wanaopenda gofu wengi wangependa, huku akivutia mawakala wakubwa akiwemo wa Tiger Woods. Waliomshuhudia Fitzpatrick akishinda kila ngazi wanasema anayo bidii, hushinda shinikizo na ana akili ya kupanga mpangilio wa mchezo. Anaeleza kuwa baba yake, Russell, ndiye aliyemjenga kiufundi, akiendelea kuzungumzia matokeo baada ya mashindano kuhusu sababu ya kuchagua klabu fulani. Licha ya kuyajadili na mawakala na wachezaji wakubwa, Fitzpatrick hajamua lini atakuwa mtaalamu. Anapenda kuchukua mialiko ya Masters, U.S. Open na Open ya nyumbani akiwa bado mchezaji wa ridhaa. 'Sijui kama niko tayari… naona bado nina mengi. Lakini ukiwa top-10 U.S. Open au British Open labda utabadilisha mawazo,' alisema. Lengo lake kwa sasa: awe mchezaji wa ridhaa wa chini zaidi kwenye majors zote tatu. Augusta atalala Crow’s Nest, malazi maalum ya waalikwa wa ridhaa. Tayari amecheza practice rounds na anasubiri kwa hamu anzishe mashindano. Augusta inahitaji subira, mkakati na ustadi wa mchezo mfupi, Fitzpatrick ana nafasi nzuri ya kufuzu, kama kijana wa miaka 14 Guan Tianlang wa China miaka iliyopita. Akifanikiwa, itakuwa mafanikio makubwa ndani ya miezi tisa. Fitzpatrick anaendelea kuwa mtulivu kuhusu mafanikio yake, akiachilia familia na wafuasi wake wa Hallamshire waendelee kusherehekea, wakati yeye akijikita kuchukua hatua nyingine kwenye mchezo huo.

article_content: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd will open its Initial Public Offering (IPO) on November 22, with subscriptions closing on November 24. The anchor book will open for one day on November 21, as detailed in the Red Herring Prospectus (RHP). This is the third IPO scheduled for the upcoming week, following those of the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency and Tata Technologies. The IPO includes a fresh issue of equity shares worth Rs 302 crore and an Offer for Sale (OFS) of 1.17 crore shares by promoters and existing shareholders. The OFS aims to raise approximately Rs 500 crore, according to market sources. The promoters offering shares in the OFS are Ramesh Babulal Parekh, Kailash Parekh, and Gulab Parekh, joined by shareholders like Fleet Line Shipping Services LLC, Denver Bldg Mat & Decor TR LLC, and Green Desert Real Estate Brokers. Proceeds from the fresh issue will go towards debt repayment, new equipment, and expansion works at the company’s Silvassa automotive oil plant. Additional funds will support increasing capacity for petroleum jelly and cosmetic products at the Taloja plant and boosting white oil production and working capital. Gandhar Oil Refinery is a leading manufacturer of white oils, increasingly focused on consumer and healthcare sectors. As of June 30, 2022, its product range included over 350 items under the Divyol brand, such as personal care, healthcare, performance oils, lubricants, and process and insulating oils. Nuvama Wealth Management (formerly Edelweiss Securities) and ICICI Securities are acting as the book-running lead managers for this IPO. The IPO for Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency will open on November 21, while Tata Technologies’ share sale opens to the public on November 22.
translated_content: Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd itafungua Mnada wa Awali wa Hisa (IPO) tarehe 22 Novemba, na usajili utafungwa tarehe 24 Novemba. Kitabu cha anchor kitafunguliwa kwa siku moja tarehe 21 Novemba, kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye Red Herring Prospectus (RHP). Huu ni mnada wa tatu wa awali wa hisa uliopangwa kufunguliwa wiki ijayo, baada ya ule wa Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency na Tata Technologies. IPO inajumuisha utoaji mpya wa hisa zenye thamani ya Rs 302 crore na Uuzaji wa Hisa (OFS) wa hisa milioni 1.17 kutoka kwa wachangiaji na wanahisa waliopo. OFS inalenga kukusanya karibu Rs 500 crore, kulingana na vyanzo vya soko. Wachangiaji wanaouza hisa kupitia OFS ni Ramesh Babulal Parekh, Kailash Parekh, na Gulab Parekh, pamoja na wanahisa kama Fleet Line Shipping Services LLC, Denver Bldg Mat & Decor TR LLC, na Green Desert Real Estate Brokers. Mapato kutoka utoaji mpya wa hisa yatatumika kulipa deni la kampuni, kununua vifaa vipya, na kupanua kiwanda cha mafuta ya magari huko Silvassa. Fedha za ziada zitatumika kuongeza uzalishaji wa petroleum jelly na bidhaa za vipodozi kwenye kiwanda cha Taloja, pamoja na kuongeza uzalishaji wa mafuta meupe na mahitaji ya mtaji wa kazi. Gandhar Oil Refinery ni mtengenezaji mkuu wa mafuta meupe, anayelenga zaidi sekta za walaji na afya. Kufikia Juni 30, 2022, kampuni ilikuwa na zaidi ya bidhaa 350 chini ya chapa ya Divyol, ikiwa ni pamoja na bidhaa za utunzaji binafsi, afya, mafuta ya utendaji, vilainishi, pamoja na mafuta ya usindikaji na ya kuhami. article_content: A Mexican diplomat and his wife are being questioned by New York police after the death of their four-month-old son, who was found with cuts and bruises on his body. Eduardo Rocha Bracamontes, 36, an employee at the Mexican consulate, and his wife Gina Ximena, 26, brought their unconscious baby, Eduardo Rocha Ovalle, to NYU Langone Medical Center on Tuesday evening. The infant was pronounced dead at 9:36 p.m. Hospital staff notified the NYPD, and authorities are treating the case as suspicious due to bruises on the child's hands, feet, back, and genital area, as well as a scalp wound and cuts on the thumb and toe, according to the New York Daily News. Both parents are being questioned at the Midtown South Precinct, but have not provided an explanation for their son’s injuries. NYPD Commissioner Ray Kelly confirmed the father's employment with the Mexican consulate and stated an investigation is underway pending results from the medical examiner. Police have previously been called twice to the family's apartment on 32nd Street since September for verbal disputes, with no arrests made. Building superintendent Wanda Hernandez reported the couple had lived there for about a year, were behind on rent, and planned to return to Mexico on December 31. She recounted an earlier incident where the mother claimed her husband had bruised her and refused to let her have the child. Hernandez noted there were no visible signs of blood or violence in the apartment when police entered. The Mexican Consulate has not yet commented on the incident.

Eduardo Rocha Bracamontes, mwenye umri wa miaka 36, mfanyakazi wa ubalozi wa Mexico, na mke wake Gina Ximena, 26, walimpeleka mtoto wao asiye na fahamu, Eduardo Rocha Ovalle, katika Hospitali ya NYU Langone Jumanne jioni. Mtoto huyo alitangazwa kuwa amefariki saa 3:36 usiku. Wafanyakazi wa hospitali walitoa taarifa kwa NYPD, na mamlaka zinachukulia kifo hiki kuwa cha kutatanisha kutokana na michubuko kwenye mikono, miguu, mgongo, na sehemu za siri za mtoto, pamoja na jeraha la ngozi ya kichwa na vidonda kwenye dole gumba na kidole cha mguu, kulingana na taarifa ya New York Daily News. Wazazi wote wawili wanahojiwa katika Kituo cha Midtown South, lakini hawajatoa maelezo juu ya jinsi mtoto wao alivyojeruhiwa. Kamishna wa NYPD Ray Kelly alithibitisha kuwa baba ni mfanyakazi wa ubalozi wa Mexico na akasema uchunguzi unaendelea wakati matokeo ya daktari wa uchunguzi wa maiti yakisubiriwa. Polisi wamewahi kuitwa mara mbili hapo awali kwenye nyumba ya familia hiyo kwenye Mtaa wa 32 Manhattan tangu Septemba kutokana na mabishano ya maneno, lakini hakuna aliyekamatwa. Msimamizi wa jengo hilo, Wanda Hernandez, alisema wanandoa hao wameishi hapo kwa takriban mwaka mmoja, walikuwa nyuma kwenye malipo ya kodi, na walipanga kurejea Mexico Disemba 31. Alisimulia tukio la awali ambapo mama alidai mume wake alimchubua na kumzuia asiwe na mtoto. Hernandez alisema hakukuwa na dalili za damu au vurugu katika nyumba hiyo polisi walipoingia. article_content: Congressional Democrats are increasing pressure on President Barack Obama to address the challenges facing the Affordable Care Act (ACA), his signature healthcare reform. Some Democrats have warned they might support a Republican-led House proposal if the White House does not introduce an alternative by the end of the week. A senior Democratic source told CNN that the party 'needs to get out of the bunker and fix these problems,' referring to issues with the ACA’s rollout that have fueled Republican efforts to weaken the policy. The White House has until Friday to propose a solution to the problematic launch of the ACA. That same day, House Republicans will vote on a bill aimed at allowing individuals to keep their existing insurance plans, even if those plans do not meet the stricter requirements of the ACA. This comes despite President Obama’s earlier promises that Americans could keep their plans if they wished. The House bill would permit these insurance policies to continue into the following year and allow anyone to purchase them, effectively altering a core aspect of the law. Under the ACA, insurers are prohibited from denying coverage due to preexisting conditions and are required to cover mental health, prenatal care, and other services. These new requirements are a primary reason some existing insurance policies are being canceled by providers. A Democratic source indicated that without a viable White House-backed solution, more Democrats may vote for the Upton bill, authored by House Energy and Commerce Committee Chairman Fred Upton. Reports suggest fewer than 50,000 people have enrolled via the ACA website, and many policy cancellations are increasing concern among lawmakers. The troubled website launch and expected low early enrollment figures are embarrassing for the President and Congressional Democrats, who passed the ACA in 2010 without Republican support. However, policy cancellations have intensified the pressure on the White House. President Obama has apologized to those losing coverage, acknowledging the mismatch between his promises and the law’s outcomes. Recent polls indicate his approval rating has fallen to its lowest point in Quinnipiac University polling during his presidency, with questions about trustworthiness on the rise. Tensions could escalate further when White House Chief Technology Officer Todd Park testifies before a congressional committee led by House Oversight Chairman Darrell Issa regarding the HealthCare.gov site’s difficulties. House Democrats, including Rep. Steny Hoyer and Rep. Steve Israel, emphasized the need for a timely solution, with some voicing concerns that the Upton bill could increase premiums and reduce consumer protections. Rep. John Larsen acknowledged he had not reviewed the full bill but suggested it might 'make sense' depending on the details. Although Rep. Hoyer previously was open to the Upton bill, he now opposes it as no changes were made by its sponsors. Former President Bill Clinton added to the pressure by stating that President Obama should honor his original commitment, even if the law needs to be changed, so people can keep their existing plans. Many Democrats, especially those facing reelection, are calling for changes or delays to the ACA. Senator Richard Durbin has expressed openness to improvements, and Senator Mary Landrieu is promoting a more limited bill allowing current individual policyholders—estimated at about 5% of the market—to keep their insurance, requiring insurers to inform customers when plans do not meet minimum standards. Landrieu reinforced the importance of the ACA’s promise, while arguing that persistent Republican attempts to overturn or defund the law are misguided. White House spokesperson Jay Carney affirmed that President Obama agreed with Clinton’s suggestion and is seeking options for individuals who lost coverage. Carney said the President’s team is actively working on solutions, but rejected the Upton bill as ineffective because it allows any individual to purchase the grandfathered plans, not just those whose plans were canceled. Enrollment numbers for the ACA are expected to be released soon, though the administration cautions they will be lower than initially anticipated due to technical issues with the federal website. Deputy Assistant Chris Jennings said efforts are ongoing to have the website function properly for users by the end of November. Consumers have until December 15 to pay for coverage that begins January 1, 2014, and the final sign-up deadline for 2014 is March 31.
translated_content: Wademokrasia wa Bunge la Marekani wanaongeza shinikizo kwa Rais Barack Obama kutatua changamoto zinazokumba Sheria ya Huduma ya Afya Nafuu (ACA), mageuzi yake makuu ya huduma ya afya. Baadhi ya Wademokrasia wameonya kuwa wanaweza kuunga mkono pendekezo la Warepublican la Baraza la Wawakilishi iwapo Ikulu haitawasilisha mbadala bora ifikapo mwishoni mwa wiki. Chanzo kimoja kikuu cha Kidemokrasia kiliiambia CNN kuwa chama kinahitaji 'kutoka mafichoni na kutatua matatizo haya,' kikirejelea matatizo katika utekelezaji wa ACA ambayo yamezidisha juhudi za Warepublican kudhoofisha sera hiyo. Ikulu ya Marekani inayo hadi Ijumaa kuwasilisha suluhisho kwa uzinduzi wa ACA uliokuwa na matatizo. Siku hiyo hiyo, Warepublican wa Baraza la Wawakilishi watapiga kura kuhusu mswada utakaoruhusu watu kuendelea na bima zao za awali, hata kama hazikidhi masharti magumu zaidi ya ACA. Hii inakuja licha ya ahadi za awali za Rais Obama kwamba Wamarekani wangeweza kubaki na bima zao ikiwa wangependa. Mswada huo wa Baraza la Wawakilishi ungeruhusu bima hizo ziendelee hadi mwaka ujao na mtu yeyote kununua, jambo ambalo lingebadilisha kipengele muhimu cha sheria. Chini ya ACA, makampuni ya bima hayaruhusiwi kunyima watu bima kwa sababu ya magonjwa ya awali na yanatakiwa kutoa bima ya afya ya akili, huduma za wajawazito, na huduma nyingine. Masharti haya mapya ndiyo sababu kuu ya baadhi ya sera za zamani za bima kufutwa na makampuni. Chanzo cha Kidemokrasia kilisema kwamba bila suluhisho kutoka kwa Ikulu, Wademokrasia zaidi wanaweza kupigia kura mswada wa Upton, uliopendekezwa na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Nishati na Biashara, Fred Upton. Ripoti zinaonyesha chini ya watu 50,000 wamesajiliwa kupitia tovuti ya ACA, na kufutwa kwa sera nyingi za bima kumezua wasiwasi mkubwa miongoni mwa wabunge. Uzinduzi wenye matatizo wa tovuti na takwimu za chini za usajili wa awali ni aibu kwa Rais na Wademokrasia wa Bunge ambao walipitisha ACA mwaka 2010 bila msaada wa Warepublican. Hata hivyo, kufutwa kwa sera za bima kumemfanya Ikulu kuzidiwa na shinikizo. Rais Obama ameomba radhi kwa wale waliopoteza bima zao, akitambua tofauti kati ya ahadi zake na matokeo ya sheria. Uchunguzi wa sasa unaonyesha uungwaji mkono kwake umeshuka hadi kiwango cha chini kabisa kwenye kura za maoni za Chuo Kikuu cha Quinnipiac wakati wa urais wake, huku maswali kuhusu uaminifu yakiongezeka. Tensheni inaweza kuongezeka zaidi pale Mkuu wa Teknolojia wa Ikulu, Todd Park, atakaposhuhudia mbele ya kamati ya Bunge inayoongozwa na Mwenyekiti wa Usimamizi, Darrell Issa, kuhusu matatizo ya tovuti ya HealthCare.gov. Wabunge wa Baraza, kama vile Steny Hoyer na Steve Israel, wameeleza umuhimu wa kupata suluhisho haraka, huku baadhi yao wakisema mswada wa Upton unaweza kuongeza bei za bima na kupunguza ulinzi wa watumiaji. John Larsen alikiri hajauona mswada wote lakini alisema huenda ukawa na mantiki kulingana na maelezo yake. Ingawa Hoyer hapo awali alikuwa wazi kuunga mkono mswada wa Upton, kwa sasa hauungi mkono kwa vile haujafanyiwa mabadiliko. Rais wa zamani, Bill Clinton, ameongeza shinikizo akisema Rais Obama anapaswa kutimiza ahadi yake ya awali, hata kama sheria italazimika kubadilishwa, ili watu wabaki na bima zao za zamani. Wademokrasia wengi, hasa walio kwenye ushindani mkali wa uchaguzi, wanataka mabadiliko au ucheleweshaji wa utekelezaji wa ACA. Seneta Richard Durbin anaunga mkono maboresho, na Seneta Mary Landrieu anashinikiza mswada mdogo zaidi utakao ruhusu wenye bima binafsi—takriban 5% ya soko—kudumisha bima zao, huku makampuni yakitakiwa kuwataarifu wateja ikiwa sera zao hazikidhi viwango vya chini. Landrieu amesisitiza umuhimu wa ahadi ya ACA, huku akisema juhudi za Warepublican kudhoofisha au kufuta sheria hiyo si sahihi. Msemaji wa Ikulu Jay Carney alisema Rais Obama anakubaliana na wazo la Clinton na anatafuta njia za kusaidia waliorudishwa nyuma na mabadiliko. Carney alisema timu ya Rais inafanya kazi kutafuta suluhisho, lakini alikataa mswada wa Upton akisema sio suluhisho bora kwani unaruhusu mtu yeyote kununua bima hizo za zamani, si tu wale ambao bima zao zimefutwa. Takwimu za usajili wa ACA zinatarajiwa kutolewa hivi karibuni, lakini serikali imesema zitakuwa chini ya matarajio ya awali kwa sababu ya matatizo ya kiufundi kwenye tovuti ya serikali. Naibu Msaidizi Chris Jennings amesema juhudi zinaendelea kuhakikisha tovuti hiyo inafanya kazi vizuri kwa watumiaji kabla ya mwisho wa Novemba. Watumiaji wana hadi Desemba 15 kulipa bima ya huduma itakayoanza Januari 1, 2014, na mwisho wa usajili kwa mwaka 2014 ni Machi 31.
