article_content: Cricket legend and former Indian captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni has invested in Bengaluru-based fitness startup Tagda Raho, the company announced on Friday. The amount of the investment and the company’s valuation were not disclosed. Tagda Raho, which currently operates training centers in Bangalore, plans to open a new center in Maharashtra next month. The startup aims to expand into four to five more states next year, according to its statement. Tagda Raho claims to be the world’s first fitness program to combine traditional Indian equipment with modern training methods. Their specially designed regimen uses equipment like the gada, mugdar, vajra, and sumtola. On his investment, Dhoni commented, “When I came across Tagda Raho, the concept really appealed to me. The equipment is deeply rooted in traditional Indian strength training. Tagda Raho has skillfully adapted both the equipment and the exercises into a modern format.” Dhoni added, “I believe in investing in startups and homegrown brands that I can help develop from the grassroots. I am excited to support the brand’s vision and to help expand Tagda Raho’s workouts nationwide.” Tagda Raho stated that its equipment and training programs are already used by professional teams and institutions such as the Lucknow SuperGiants, Haryana Steelers, and the National Cricket Academy. Founder Rishabh Malhotra said, “Dhoni’s commitment to fitness and support for Indian brands aligns with our mission to empower people toward healthier lives and enrich India’s fitness culture. We aim to expand Tagda Raho’s presence across India and in global markets, believing in the global potential of Indian fitness traditions.”

Kiasi cha uwekezaji na thamani ya kampuni havikufichuliwa. Tagda Raho, yenye vituo vya mazoezi tayari Bangalore, inatarajia kufungua kituo kipya Maharashtra mwezi ujao. Startup hii inalenga kupanuka hadi majimbo manne au matano zaidi mwakani, kulingana na taarifa yao. Tagda Raho inadai kuwa programu ya kwanza duniani ya mazoezi inayochanganya vifaa vya jadi vya Kihindi na mbinu za kisasa za mazoezi. Mafunzo yao maalum hutumia vifaa kama gada, mugdar, vajra, na sumtola. Kuhusu uwekezaji wake, Dhoni alisema, “Nilipokutana na Tagda Raho, wazo lilinivutia sana. Vifaa vinatokana na mazoezi ya nguvu ya jadi ya India. Tagda Raho imefanikiwa kubuni na kurekebisha vifaa na mazoezi hayo kwa mtindo wa kisasa.” Dhoni aliongeza, “Ninaamini kuwekeza kwenye startup na chapa za asili ambazo naweza kusaidia kukua kutoka chini. Nimefurahishwa kuunga mkono maono ya chapa na kusaidia kupanua mazoezi ya Tagda Raho nchini kote.” Tagda Raho imesema vifaa na mpango wake wa mafunzo tayari vinatumiwa na timu na taasisi za kitaalamu kama Lucknow SuperGiants, Haryana Steelers, na Chuo cha Taifa cha Kriketi. Mwanzilishi Rishabh Malhotra alisema, “Dhamira ya Dhoni kwa mazoezi na kusaidia chapa za asili za India inaendana na azma yetu ya kuwawezesha watu kuishi maisha bora zaidi na kuboresha utamaduni wa mazoezi nchini India. French telecom provider Iliad reported a 5.1% increase in core profit over the first nine months of the year, driven by strong subscriber growth in both France and Italy. This trend was mirrored by Iliad’s main French competitors—Orange, Bouygues Telecom, and SFR—which also saw modest year-on-year profit increases. Iliad’s earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA), after leases, rose to 2.55 billion euros ($2.73 billion) for the January–September period. The company did not release quarterly earnings figures.

Free, Iliad’s brand in France, added 324,000 new subscribers in the third quarter—a record for the company. In Italy, the group gained 382,000 new subscribers over the same period, marking its best performance there in three years. CEO Thomas Reynaud attributed these results to the company’s investment choices and efforts to protect subscribers’ purchasing power.

While most European telecom operators have raised prices in response to inflation, Iliad introduced a five-year price cap on its two base plans earlier this year but faced criticism for increasing prices on optional add-ons. The unlisted group has also expanded into Italy—where it is now the fourth-largest telecom operator by subscribers—and into Poland, acquiring two of the nation’s main mobile and internet providers.

Reynaud said Iliad intends to play an active role in any consolidation of the Italian market. Vodafone is reportedly considering a sale or joint venture for its Italian operations; sources say Iliad is among the potential candidates for a deal. Last year, Iliad attempted unsuccessfully to acquire Vodafone’s Italian business. Commenting on the proposed sale of Italy’s telecom grid to U.S. private equity firm KKR, Reynaud insisted that Iliad’s access to Italy’s fibre optic network "must not be compromised."

Mwelekeo huu umeonekana pia kwa washindani wakuu wa Iliad nchini Ufaransa—Orange, Bouygues Telecom, na SFR—ambao pia wamerekodi ongezeko dogo la faida mwaka hadi mwaka. Mapato ya Iliad kabla ya riba, kodi, uchakavu na malipo ya kukodisha (EBITDA), yalifikia euro bilioni 2.55 ($2.73 bilioni) kwa kipindi cha Januari hadi Septemba. Kampuni haikutangaza matokeo ya robo mwaka.

Free, chapa ya Iliad nchini Ufaransa, iliongeza wateja wapya 324,000 katika robo ya tatu—hii ikiwa rekodi kwa kampuni hiyo. Nchini Italia, walipata wateja wapya 382,000 katika kipindi hicho, mafanikio bora zaidi katika miaka mitatu. Reynaud alisema Iliad inakusudia kushiriki kikamilifu katika muunganiko wowote wa soko la mawasiliano nchini Italia. Vodafone inafikiria kuuza au kufanya ubia wa biashara zake za Italia; vyanzo vinasema Iliad ni mmoja wa wagombea wa mpango huo. Mwaka jana, Iliad ilijaribu bila mafanikio kununua biashara ya Vodafone nchini Italia. Kuhusu mpango wa kuuza mtandao wa mawasiliano wa Italia kwa kampuni ya uwekezaji ya Marekani KKR, Reynaud alisisitiza kuwa mikataba ya Iliad ya kupata mtandao wa fibre optic nchini Italia "haipaswi kuathirika."

article_content:
Saurabh Mukherjea, Founder & CIO of Marcellus Investment Managers, shared insights regarding recent portfolio adjustments after Q2 results. The firm reduced its stake in Bajaj Finance while increasing holdings in HDFC Bank within its large-cap portfolio (CCB). Despite reallocating funds, Marcellus remains a major shareholder in Bajaj Finance.

In the 'Little Champs' smallcap portfolio, Marcellus exited Amrutanjan in recent months after holding it for nearly four years, noting ongoing challenges in its balms and sanitary napkins business following COVID-19. They added positions in PDS, a sourcing platform that helps Western retailers like Walmart, Matalan, and Primark procure apparel from countries such as Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The firm also invested in Cera Sanitaryware, recognizing improvements in its cash flow and expecting gains from a recovering real estate sector.

Mukherjea addressed the regulatory changes affecting Bajaj Finance, stating that the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) move to increase risk weights on unsecured personal loans will likely impact only about 2% of Bajaj’s loan book, with less than a 1% effect on annual profits if the issue is addressed promptly. He praised the RBI’s intervention to temper the rapid growth of personal credit, noting that Bajaj Finance had already begun to slow personal loan activity ahead of these measures.

Regarding Trent, another portfolio company, Mukherjea highlighted its diverse business strengths and long-term growth potential. He argued the market undervalues Trent due to accounting rules that reduce reported earnings and expects strong performance from its grocery (Star Bazaar) and value fashion (Zudio) divisions. Mukherjea compared Trent's outlook to Titan’s impressive growth over the last 20 years.

These portfolio decisions exemplify Marcellus’s strategy to adjust to evolving market trends, regulatory actions, and sectoral developments.

Saurabh Mukherjea, Mwanzilishi na CIO wa Marcellus Investment Managers, alishiriki maoni kuhusu mabadiliko ya hivi karibuni kwenye uwekezaji baada ya matokeo ya robo ya pili. Kampuni ilipunguza umiliki wake katika Bajaj Finance na kuongeza hisa zake kwenye HDFC Bank katika mfuko wake mkubwa (CCB). Licha ya mabadiliko, Marcellus bado ni mwekezaji mkubwa wa Bajaj Finance.

Katika mfuko wa kampuni ndogo 'Little Champs', Marcellus iliuzia kabisa Amrutanjan miezi ya karibuni baada ya miaka minne ya uhodhi, ikitaja changamoto zilizoendelea kwenye biashara ya balm na taulo za kike baada ya COVID-19. Badala yake, wameongeza uwekezaji kwenye PDS, kampuni inayowaunganisha wauzaji wa Magharibi kama Walmart, Matalan na Primark na wazalishaji nguo nchini Bangladesh na Sri Lanka. Pia waliwekeza kwenye Cera Sanitaryware, wakivutiwa na ongezeko la mtiririko wa fedha na matarajio mema ya sekta ya ujenzi inayorejea.

Mukherjea alizungumzia mabadiliko ya kanuni yanayoathiri Bajaj Finance, akieleza kuwa hatua ya Benki Kuu ya India (RBI) kuongeza kiwango cha hatari kwenye mikopo binafsi isiyokuwa na dhamana itaathiri takribani asilimia 2 ya mikopo ya Bajaj, na chini ya asilimia 1 kwenye faida ya mwaka iwapo uongozi utashughulikia haraka. Alisifu hatua ya RBI kuiweka sekta katika njia sahihi, akibainisha kuwa Bajaj Finance tayari ilianza kupunguza utoaji wa mikopo binafsi kabla ya kanuni hizo mpya.

Kuhusu Trent, kampuni nyingine kwenye uwekezaji wao, Mukherjea alionyesha imani juu ya uwezo na ukuaji wa muda mrefu wa kampuni hiyo. High mortgage rates have discouraged many Americans from purchasing homes, as seen in a 15.4% drop in existing home sales compared to last year, based on National Association of Realtors data. However, new-construction homes might have an advantage for buyers seeking more affordable financing.

Tawn Kelley, president of financial services at homebuilder Taylor Morrison, notes that buyers of newly built homes can sometimes secure mortgage rates as low as 4.8%, while the current typical rate is over 7%, according to Freddie Mac. Kelley suggests that buyers take full advantage of every mortgage option and incentive builders provide, such as interest rate buydowns, rate locks, and other financial assistance. These offerings can significantly cut monthly payments.

However, Kelley also warns that buyers must examine these incentives closely. Temporary rate reductions or similar perks could result in higher payments down the line if not planned for—an issue that contributed to the financial difficulties seen during the 2008 housing crisis. It's important for buyers to anticipate and budget for future costs to avoid unexpected financial strain.

article_content: An island community has successfully saved its only shop and post office after organizing a community-funded buyout. The Lismore store was under threat of closure earlier this year when the schoolteacher who had been running it returned to teaching. To prevent this, the Lismore Community Trust (LCT) launched a share issue campaign, attracting more than 230 supporters and raising over £80,000 in donations. The community now plans to use the shop as a central hub for the Inner Hebrides island's 160 permanent residents. Initially, the trust aimed to raise £70,000 to purchase stock, refurbish the shop, and keep the business running for about five years. However, thanks to donations from holiday home owners, regular visitors, and local residents, the final total surpassed £82,000 and is still growing. LCT chair Andy Hough said that keeping the store open is crucial to sustaining the island’s self-sufficiency, preventing residents from needing to make a three-hour round trip to Oban. He added, 'If the store had closed, it would have been devastating for several services. Our population is already fragile, and closure could have led to more isolation or even depopulation. It was heartening to see permanent residents and second homeowners come together for the community spirit. Now, people can access groceries on their doorstep, saving them ferry trips off the island.' Nearly half of Lismore’s population, which lies north-east of Mull off Scotland’s west coast, attended the recent ribbon-cutting ceremony. The shop will be run by full-time staff and supported by volunteers for business operations. Mr Hough, 66, who moved to Lismore from the Isle of Wight in 2018, hopes the store will become a community gathering place, including plans to install WiFi. He also emphasized that the Trust wants the business to stay profitable: 'It’s not just a place to buy groceries—it’s a place for people to chat and connect. We've employed a manager with young children, and their income supports the local economy. It’s a service to the community, but we want to ensure it remains financially sustainable.'

Sasa watu wanaweza kupata bidhaa muhimu karibu na makazi yao, na hawalazimiki kutumia feri kuondoka kisiwani.' Pia alisisitiza kuwa LCT inataka biashara ibaki na faida: 'Si mahali pa kununua bidhaa tu—ni mahali pa watu kukutana na kuzungumza. Tumeajiri meneja mwenye watoto wachanga, na mshahara wao unaendelea kubaki ndani ya jamii. Ni huduma kwa jamii lakini tunataka kuhakikisha haitaleta hasara.'

article_content: This summer, about 6.8 million students are graduating from universities across China, bringing pride and excitement to families nationwide. Graduation traditions in China have transformed from simple group photos, like those at Peking University in 1981, to grand ceremonies with gowns and red carpets. More recently, some graduates have been defying convention, expressing their individuality with unique and sometimes provocative graduation photos. A notable example comes from Jinan University in Guangzhou, where advertising majors posed with a bold banner about their university experience and held up personalized wishes, such as aspirations for wealth and success. These images quickly spread online, eliciting a mix of praise for creativity and criticism for being attention-seeking. This trend underlines a growing generational divide. Many older people in China, who lived through the strict and difficult years of the Cultural Revolution, see these displays as excessive. In contrast, today’s university graduates — mainly born in the 1990s, the 'jiu ling hou' generation — are used to greater freedom, prosperity, and connectedness thanks to decades of economic reform. While critics sometimes stereotype these young people as spoiled or self-centered, recent surveys and the reflections of students themselves offer a more nuanced view. Horizon Research Group found that urban youth born in the 1990s have more spending power and influence but still keep practical attitudes about consumption. Many students say they want to express themselves in creative, even daring ways. Social media has played a big role, with playful or rebellious graduation photos — ranging from dramatic backdrops to unusual stunts — quickly going viral. Experts note that this mirrors graduation traditions in many countries, and signals the growing personal freedom young Chinese now enjoy as they leave their school years behind. Despite these freedoms, many graduates have also faced pressure to delete their more controversial photos, balancing the desire for self-expression with traditional expectations.

article_content: Three variations of the AR-15 assault rifle were displayed at the California Department of Justice in Sacramento, California, in 2012. On Thursday, October 19, 2023, a federal judge who previously overturned California's ban on assault weapons once again ruled that the state’s attempts to prohibit sales of semiautomatic guns violate the constitutional right to bear arms. U.S. District Judge Roger Benitez of San Diego acknowledged that AR-15 rifles and similar weapons are sometimes used in crimes, but also noted that these firearms are commonly owned by law-abiding people who feel they need them for self-defense. Judge Benitez wrote, 'The State of California argues its 'assault weapon' ban serves an important public interest in deterring mass shootings, even though it makes criminals out of law-abiding residents seeking these firearms for self-defense. However, more than that is needed to uphold a ban.' This ruling closely repeats his 2021 opinion, in which he described California’s ban on assault weapons as a 'failed experiment.' Judge Benitez has repeatedly struck down various California gun laws. Last month, he ruled the state cannot prohibit gun owners from having detachable magazines with more than 10 rounds. His latest decision would overturn multiple state statutes related to assault weapons. The judge gave California 10 days to seek a stay on the ruling as it appeals to the U.S. 9th Circuit Court of Appeals. California Attorney General Rob Bonta said his office has already filed a notice of appeal. 'Weapons of war have no place on California's streets,' Bonta said in a statement. 'This has been state law for decades, and we will continue to fight for our authority to keep citizens safe from firearms that can cause mass casualties. For now, assault weapons remain illegal for purchase, transfer, or possession in California.' John Dillon, an attorney for the plaintiffs who challenged the law, praised the judge’s decision. 'The Court's decision is constitutionally sound and addresses the flaws in the state’s arguments for this ban,' Dillon said in a statement. 'We will continue to fight for our clients’ Second Amendment rights through any appeal.' Bonta had appealed the judge’s 2021 ruling, but prior to a decision by the 9th Circuit, the U.S. Supreme Court announced a ruling in a New York case that established a new standard for evaluating gun restrictions. The 9th Circuit vacated Benitez’s previous decision and returned the case to him to apply the new standard. Benitez again found the ban unconstitutional. Judge Benitez compared 'assault weapons' to Bowie knives carried in the 1800s, stating that while dangerous, they are also useful, and referenced the long tradition of lawful gun ownership in the United States. California first restricted assault weapons in 1989, with several updates to the law since then. The state argues that assault weapons are more dangerous than other firearms and are disproportionately used in crimes and mass shootings. The attorney general’s office argues that banning them serves important public safety interests. The lawsuit was filed by several gun advocacy groups: the San Diego County Gun Owners Political Action Committee, California Gun Rights Foundation, Second Amendment Foundation, and Firearms Policy Coalition. They represent gun owners who want to use high-capacity magazines in their legal rifles or pistols but say doing so would make them illegal under California law. Plaintiffs emphasize that, unlike military weapons, these semi-automatic rifles fire one round per trigger pull and are legal in 41 states.
translated_content: Aina tatu za bunduki ya AR-15 zilionyeshwa katika Idara ya Sheria ya California huko Sacramento, California, mwaka 2012. Alhamisi, Oktoba 19, 2023, jaji wa shirikisho ambaye hapo awali alifuta marufuku ya California dhidi ya silaha za kivita ameamua tena kwamba jitihada za serikali kupiga marufuku mauzo ya bunduki za nusu-otomatiki zinakiuka haki ya kikatiba ya kumiliki silaha. Jaji wa Wilaya ya Marekani Roger Benitez wa San Diego alikiri kuwa bunduki za AR-15 na silaha nyingine kama hizo zinatumika wakati mwingine katika uhalifu, lakini pia alibainisha kuwa silaha hizi zinamilikiwa na watu wanaofuata sheria ambao wanahisi wanazihitaji kwa kujilinda. Jaji Benitez aliandika, 'Serikali ya California inasema kwamba marufuku ya 'silaha za kivita' inalinda maslahi ya umma kwa kupunguza mashambulizi makubwa, ingawa inawafanya raia waaminifu kuwa wahalifu wanapotaka kununua silaha hizi kwa kujilinda. Hata hivyo, zaidi ya hapo inahitajika kupitisha marufuku kama hiyo.' Uamuzi huu unafanana na uamuzi wake wa 2021, ambapo aliita marufuku ya California dhidi ya silaha za kivita 'jaribio lililoshindwa.' Jaji Benitez mara kadhaa amepinga sheria mbalimbali za silaha za California. Mwezi uliopita, aliamua kuwa serikali haiwezi kupiga marufuku wamiliki wa bunduki kuwa na magazini zinazoondolewa zinazobeba zaidi ya risasi 10. Uamuzi wake wa hivi karibuni utabatilisha sheria kadhaa za serikali zinazohusu silaha za kivita. Jaji aliipa California siku 10 kutafuta kusitisha uamuzi huu huku rufaa ikiendelea kwenye Mahakama ya Rufaa ya Marekani Kanda ya 9. Mwanasheria Mkuu wa California Rob Bonta alisema ofisi yake imeshafungua notisi ya rufaa. 'Silaha za kivita hazina nafasi katika mitaa ya California,' Bonta alisema katika taarifa. 'Hii imekuwa sheria ya serikali kwa miongo kadhaa, na tutaendelea kupigania mamlaka yetu ya kuwalinda wananchi dhidi ya silaha zinazosababisha maafa makubwa. Kwa sasa, silaha za kivita bado ni haramu kununua, kuhamisha, au kumiliki nchini California.' John Dillon, wakili wa walalamikaji waliopinga sheria hiyo, alisifu uamuzi wa jaji. 'Uamuzi wa Mahakama ni wa kikatiba na unaonyesha mapungufu katika hoja za serikali kuhusu marufuku hii,' Dillon alisema kwenye taarifa. 'Tutaendelea kupigania haki za wateja wetu chini ya Marekebisho ya Pili la Katiba hadi mwisho wa rufaa.' Bonta alikuwa amekata rufaa dhidi ya uamuzi wa jaji wa 2021, lakini kabla ya Mahakama ya Rufaa kufanya uamuzi, Mahakama Kuu ya Marekani ilitoa uamuzi kwenye kesi ya New York ulioweka viwango vipya vya jinsi mahakama zinavyopaswa kushughulikia vizuizi vya silaha. Mahakama ya Rufaa ilifuta uamuzi wa awali wa Benitez na kuurudisha kwa jaji huyo aupitie kwa kutumia viwango vipya. Benitez alihitimisha tena kuwa marufuku hiyo ni kinyume cha katiba. Jaji Benitez alilinganisha 'silaha za kivita' na visu vya Bowie vya karne ya 19, akisema pamoja na kwamba ni hatari, vina matumizi, na alirejea jadi ya muda mrefu ya watu binafsi kumiliki silaha kwa halali nchini Marekani. California ilianza kupiga marufuku silaha za kivita mwaka 1989, ikiwa na mabadiliko kadhaa kwa sheria tangu wakati huo. Serikali inasema kuwa silaha hizo ni hatari zaidi kuliko nyingine na zinatumika mara nyingi zaidi katika uhalifu na mashambulizi makubwa. Ofisi ya Mwanasheria Mkuu inadai kwamba marufuku yao inalinda usalama wa umma. Kesi hiyo iliwasilishwa na makundi kadhaa ya kutetea haki za umiliki silaha wakiwemo San Diego County Gun Owners Political Action Committee, California Gun Rights Foundation, Second Amendment Foundation, na Firearms Policy Coalition. Wanawakilisha wamiliki wa bunduki wanaotaka kutumia magazini zenye uwezo mkubwa kwenye bunduki zao za kisheria au bastola, lakini wanasema kufanya hivyo kunawafanya kuwa wahalifu chini ya sheria za California. Walalamikaji wanasema, tofauti na silaha za jeshi, bunduki hizi za nusu-otomatiki hupiga risasi moja kila unapobonyeza kitufe, na ni halali katika majimbo 41.

article_content: A new undersea Internet cable, SEACOM, has officially launched, connecting East and Southern Africa to high-speed broadband for the first time. Until now, most Africans depended on slow and pricey satellite connections, making activities like watching YouTube or using Facebook difficult. The SEACOM cable stretches 17,000 kilometers, linking Africa to Europe and Asia, and boasts the ability to transfer up to 1.28 terabytes of data per second. SEACOM, which is privately funded and majority African-owned, gives retail carriers affordable, open access to bandwidth. The cable lands in several key coastal cities, including South Africa, Kenya, and Madagascar. In less than three years, the ambitious infrastructure project was completed. While SEACOM’s arrival is expected to reduce the cost of doing business both within Africa and internationally, some analysts suggest only those with existing Internet connections will benefit in the short term. They add that bigger socioeconomic shifts are likely to take years. The project’s deployment faced challenges, including a launch delay caused by increased pirate activity along parts of Africa’s coast, which required extra security for the cable-laying operations. Neotel, a major communications company in South Africa, is partnering with SEACOM and serves as the main landing partner in the country, handling both the coastal station and Johannesburg data center. Neotel’s managing director, Ajay Pandey, expressed excitement about expanding Internet access at potentially lower costs. Brian Herlihy, CEO of SEACOM, said the real test of the project will be measured by tangible changes across the continent over time. South Africa has been hampered by slow and expensive Internet, limiting its digital growth. There is widespread hope that SEACOM will help Africa keep pace with global connectivity trends, bringing faster, cheaper, and more flexible Internet to the region. Tanzanian President Jakaya Kikwete, speaking during a live address at the launch event from Dar es Salaam, described the new cable as a significant symbol of progress and modernity.
translated_content: Kebo jipya la chini ya bahari, SEACOM, limezinduliwa rasmi, likiunganisha Afrika Mashariki na Kusini na mtandao wa kasi kubwa kwa mara ya kwanza. Hapo awali, Waafrika wengi walitegemea mitandao ya setilaiti ambayo ni polepole na ghali, hivyo kufanya shughuli kama vile kutazama YouTube au kutumia Facebook kuwa ngumu. Kebo ya SEACOM inanyoosha kilomita 17,000, ikiunganisha Afrika na Ulaya na Asia, na ina uwezo wa kusafirisha hadi terabaite 1.28 za data kwa sekunde. SEACOM, ambayo inamilikiwa binafsi na kumilikiwa kwa sehemu kubwa na Waafrika, inatoa upatikanaji wa urahisi wa bendi pana kwa wauzaji wa huduma za mtandao. Kebo hii inatua katika miji muhimu ya pwani kama Afrika Kusini, Kenya, na Madagascar. Mradi huu wa miundombinu kabambe ulikamilika ndani ya miaka mitatu tu. Ingawa ujio wa SEACOM unatarajiwa kupunguza gharama za kufanya biashara ndani na nje ya Afrika, baadhi ya wachambuzi wanasema ni wale tu waliokuwa na muunganisho wa mtandao awali watakaoona manufaa katika muda mfupi. Wanasisitiza kuwa mabadiliko makubwa ya kiuchumi na kijamii yatachukua miaka. Utekelezaji wa mradi huo ulikumbana na changamoto, ikiwa ni pamoja na kucheleweshwa kwa uzinduzi kutokana na shughuli za uharamia kuongezeka katika baadhi ya maeneo ya pwani ya Afrika, ambazo zilitaka usalama zaidi kwa timu za kuweka kebo. Neotel, kampuni kubwa ya mawasiliano nchini Afrika Kusini, inashirikiana na SEACOM kama mshirika mkuu wa kupata kebo hiyo nchini, ikisimamia kituo cha ufukweni na kituo cha data cha Johannesburg. Mkurugenzi mtendaji wa Neotel, Ajay Pandey, alionyesha furaha yake kuhusu fursa za kuongeza upatikanaji wa mtandao kwa bei nafuu. Afisa Mtendaji Mkuu wa SEACOM, Brian Herlihy, alisema kipimo halisi cha mradi huu kitaonekana kwenye mabadiliko halisi yatakayopatikana barani humo kwa muda. Afrika Kusini imekuwa ikikabiliwa na mtandao wa gharama kubwa na polepole, jambo ambalo limezuia maendeleo ya kidijitali. Kuna matumaini makubwa kuwa SEACOM itasaidia Afrika kwenda sawa na mwelekeo wa kimataifa wa mtandao, ikileta mtandao wa kasi, nafuu na rahisi zaidi. article_content: Suryakumar Yadav is expected to lead the Indian cricket team in the upcoming five-match T20I series against Australia, with Hardik Pandya sidelined due to an ankle injury suffered during the World Cup. The series will start on November 23 in Vizag and conclude on December 3 in Hyderabad. The BCCI's senior national selection committee is set to convene soon to finalize the squad. Given the series' proximity to the World Cup, selectors are likely to field a second-string team. Yadav, currently the top-ranked T20 batsman in the world, was appointed vice-captain during India's recent tour of the West Indies and USA. With Pandya's recovery expected to take at least two months, Yadav is the front-runner for captaincy. The selection committee, led by Ajit Agarkar, is also likely to rest most World Cup players, giving opportunities to others such as Ishan Kishen and Prasidh Krishna, who saw little World Cup action. Rahul Dravid’s coaching contract is set to expire after the World Cup, so VVS Laxman has been asked to serve as interim head coach, along with support staff from the National Cricket Academy overseeing the team. Yadav, aged 33, has leadership experience with the Mumbai team and India Under-23 side. His dynamic 360-degree batting style has earned him significant recognition in T20 cricket. Pandya’s injury may also see him miss India’s upcoming matches against South Africa. It is not yet confirmed if he will require surgery.

Kwa kuwa Pandya anatarajiwa kuwa nje kwa miezi miwili, Yadav ana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuchukua unahodha. Kamati ya uchaguzi inayoongozwa na Ajit Agarkar pia inatarajiwa kuwapa mapumziko wachezaji wengi wa kikosi cha Kombe la Dunia, na kutoa nafasi kwa wachezaji kama Ishan Kishen na Prasidh Krishna ambao hawakupata nafasi kwenye Kombe la Dunia. Mkataba wa kocha mkuu Rahul Dravid unatarajiwa kumalizika baada ya Kombe la Dunia, hivyo VVS Laxman ameombwa kuchukua nafasi ya ukocha kwa muda, akisaidiwa na wafanyakazi wa National Cricket Academy. article_content: Authorities near Paris launched an intensive search today after locals reported spotting a large feline—possibly a tiger—roaming close to a supermarket parking lot in the Seine-et-Marne region. The sighting, which took place around five miles from Disneyland Paris, prompted police, including animal specialists equipped with tranquilizers, as well as helicopter support, to respond to the situation. Residents in Montevrain, where the creature was first seen, have been urged to stay inside for their safety. A blurry photo taken in the village appears to show a big cat wandering off into fields, and a paw print believed to be from the animal has been found. Officials stated that capturing the animal alive is the priority, but lethal action may be taken if it becomes dangerous. Areas with sports facilities have been secured, and authorities, including police and firefighters, are searching parks and woods. Investigations into the animal's origin revealed that all circus animals are present and accounted for, and Disneyland Paris confirmed it has no tigers. Focus has shifted to the Parc des Félins big cat park, located approximately 18 miles away, although there is no evidence of an escape from there either. Experts note that there are no wild tigers living in Europe except within managed facilities, and the search is ongoing as residents are reminded to stay informed and avoid the affected area.

article_content: Police seized cannabis plants valued at $1.5 million in an early morning raid on Thursday in Penrith, western Sydney. Officers were called at around 6am to a commercial building on Henry Street after reports of cannabis cultivation. Inside the large warehouse, officers discovered 500 cannabis plants spread across six rooms, with a seventh room used as a seedling nursery. A commercial-grade air filtration system and sophisticated lighting equipment were also found during the operation. This western Sydney seizure follows another major bust earlier in the week, where police discovered $3 million worth of cannabis in Bexley, Sydney's south, after reports of an electrical fire. About 1000 cannabis plants were located in a hydroponic set-up across a three-level commercial premises. Both investigations are ongoing.

article_content: Biomanufacturing in space could improve the sustainability of deep space exploration. To achieve this, specialized bioprocessing systems for space applications are needed. In a recent report published in npj Microgravity, Mathangi Soundararajan and researchers from the NASA Ames Research Center in California describe the development of commercial technologies for designing space bioprocessing systems. These systems deliver a liquid amine carbon dioxide scrubber with active recombinant carbonic anhydrase enzyme. The workflow utilized a 1-liter biomass of Escherichia coli cultures for recombinant protein purification. The team compared three system designs, each differing in how they handle biomass dewatering and protein purification. Using metrics like system complexity, technology readiness, and integration readiness, the team identified a bioprocessing design that minimized complexity while maximizing versatility. Liquid amine scrubbing is an established carbon capture technology on Earth and is a promising solution for removing CO2 during crewed space missions. The International Space Station uses a thermal amine scrubber, which is one of three candidate methods for CO2 removal in space. The process involves passing cabin air with elevated CO2 levels over an organic liquid amine, where the CO2 is absorbed as carbamate or bicarbonate, depending on the solvent. Long-duration missions near Earth can be supplied with stored carbonic anhydrase enzyme, but this approach is unfeasible for Mars missions due to extended travel times. Instead, space biomanufacturing systems capable of producing enzymes and other biological materials are necessary. These systems must minimize costs, especially crew time, and ensure astronaut safety amidst higher radiation and reduced gravity. The study detailed bioprocessing systems integrating selected methods for dewatering, cell lysis, and protein purification. The designs included components such as peristaltic pumps, centrifuge cartridges, bead beaters, affinity resin reservoirs, and various buffer solutions. Diagrams indicated steps requiring crew assistance. Previous research on space biomanufacturing has focused on large-scale mission designs, microbial growth, and bioreactor engineering. In this work, Soundararajan's team compared commercial methods and potential designs for in-space enzyme production using E. coli. They developed operational scenarios for bioprocessing during a Mars mission, considering variables like crew involvement and workflow efficiency. Five workflow options were examined, all beginning with standard cell growth. Steps included biomass processing (with or without dewatering), protein extraction (cell lysis, purification), and storage. Dewatering helped reduce volumes needed for further processing, and flow-through methods were enabled. Lysis and purification were analyzed using several commercial affinity purification strategies. To integrate these processes, the team designed systems using a counterflow centrifugation step for biomass dewatering and batch resin methods for protein purification. Material flow was mediated with a peristaltic pump. Variants of these workflows were compared for optimal performance. Finally, the team used design metrics to assess complexity by counting components and subsystems in each workflow. Each design featured key subsystem interfaces, such as dewatering-lysis and lysis-protein purification. Looking forward, the integration of carbonic anhydrase with liquid amine CO2 capture systems could make deep space missions more efficient. The use of biomanufacturing in space may also lead to improved industrial processes on Earth. The NASA Space Synthetic Biology Project continues to develop prototype bioprocessing systems and identify effective methods for efficient space and terrestrial biomanufacturing.
translated_content: Utengenezaji wa kibaolojia angani unaweza kuboresha uendelevu wa safari ndefu za anga za mbali. Ili kufanikisha hili, mifumo maalum ya kuchakata kibayolojia kwa ajili ya matumizi ya angani inahitajika. Katika ripoti mpya iliyochapishwa kwenye npj Microgravity, Mathangi Soundararajan na watafiti kutoka NASA Ames Research Center, California, wameelezea jinsi teknolojia za kibiashara zimeandaliwa kwa kubuni mifumo ya kuchakata kibayolojia angani. Mifumo hii hutengeneza scrubber ya kaboni dioksidi ya amini kioevu iliyo na kimeng’enya hai cha carbonic anhydrase kilichozalishwa kwa njia ya kibaolojia. Utaratibu huu ulitumia lita 1 ya mzigo wa Escherichia coli kwa ajili ya kusafisha protini ya kibaolojia. Timu ililinganisha miundo mitatu ya mifumo, kila moja ikiwa na njia tofauti za kuondoa maji kwenye mizigo na kusafisha protini. Kwa kutumia viwango kama ugumu wa mfumo, kiwango cha utayari wa teknolojia, na kiwango cha utayari wa ujumuishaji, timu ilitambua mfumo wa kuchakata kibayolojia uliopunguza urasimu huku ukipa umuhimu kubadilika. Amini kioevu kwa sasa ni teknolojia inayotumika duniani kunasa kaboni na ni suluhisho linaloahidiwa kuondoa CO2 wakati wa safari za anga za mbali zinazobebwa na wanadamu. Kituo cha Kimataifa cha Anga kina kutumia scrubber ya amini ya joto, mojawapo ya njia tatu kuu za kuondoa CO2 angani. Utaratibu huu unajumuisha kupitisha hewa yenye CO2 nyingi kwenye amini ya kioevu kikaboni, ambapo CO2 hunaswa kama carbamate au bicarbonate kulingana na aina ya kimumunyisho. Misheni za muda mrefu karibu na Dunia zinaweza kupata kimeng’enya cha carbonic anhydrase kilichohifadhiwa, lakini njia hii haiwezekani kwa safari za kwenda Mars kutokana na umbali. Badala yake, mfumo wa kuchakata kibaolojia angani unaoweza kutengeneza vimeng’enya na bidhaa nyingine za kibaolojia unahitajika. Mifumo hii inapaswa kupunguza gharama, hasa muda wa wafanyakazi, na kuhakikisha usalama wa wanaanga dhidi ya mionzi na mvuto mdogo. Utafiti umefafanua mifumo ya kuchakata kibaolojia inayojumuisha mbinu za kuondoa maji, kulipuka kwa seli, na kusafisha protini. Miundo ilijumuisha vipengele kama pampu za peristaltiki, karatasi za sentrifuji, 'bead beaters', vipochi vya resin ya kunyonya protini, na suluhisho mbalimbali za buffer. Michoro ilionyesha hatua zinazohitaji usaidizi wa wanaanga. Utafiti wa awali kuhusu utengenezaji wa kibaolojia angani ulilenga miundo ya misheni mikubwa, ukuzaji wa vimelea, na miundo ya bioreactor. Katika kazi hii, timu ya Soundararajan ililinganisha mbinu za kibiashara na miundo inayowezekana ya uzalishaji wa vimeng’enya angani kwa kutumia E. coli. Waliunda mazingira ya kazi kwa procesu za kibayolojia wakati wa misheni ya Mars, wakizingatia mambo kama ushiriki wa wafanyakazi na ufanisi wa kazi. Chaguzi tano za utaratibu zilichunguzwa, zote zikianza na ukuzaji wa seli wa kawaida. Hatua zilijumuisha uchakataji wa mzigo (kwa au bila kuondoa maji), uchukuaji wa protini (kulipuka kwa seli, kusafisha), na uhifadhi. Kuondoa maji kulisaidia kupunguza kiasi cha mzigo kinachohitajika kwa hatua zaidi, na mbinu za mtiririko wa moja kwa moja zilifanikishwa. Kulipuka kwa seli na kusafisha protini kulichambuliwa kwa kutumia mbinu mbalimbali za kisasa za kibiashara. Ili kuunganisha michakato hii, timu ilibuni mifumo ikitumia hatua ya sentrifuji ya mtiririko wa kupishana kuondoa maji kwenye mzigo na mbinu za resin ya 'batch' kwa kusafisha protini. Mtiririko wa malighafi uliendeshwa na pampu ya peristaltiki. Tofauti mbalimbali za utaratibu huu zililinganishwa ili kupata utendaji bora. Mwishoni, timu ilitumia viwango vya muundo kupima urasimu kwa kuhesabu sehemu na mifumo ndogo katika kila utaratibu. Kila muundo ulihusisha interface muhimu kama vile uondoaji maji na kulipuka kwa seli, na kulipua seli-kusafisha protini. Kwa kuangalia mbele, kuchanganya carbonic anhydrase na mfumo wa kunasa CO2 kwa amini kioevu kunaweza kufanya misheni za anga za mbali kuwa bora zaidi. Pia, matumizi ya uchakataji wa kibaolojia angani yanaweza kuboresha michakato ya viwandani hapa duniani. Mradi wa NASA Space Synthetic Biology unaendelea kubuni mifumo ya prototype na kutambua mbinu bora kwa ajili ya uchakataji bora wa kibaolojia angani na duniani.

article_content:
Dubai has set another world record with its sprawling Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, covering about 122 square kilometers in the desert. The park, named after the Emirate’s ruler, represents a multibillion-dollar investment as Dubai aims to become carbon-neutral by 2050.

Dubai, known for its rapid transformation from a creekside village to a glamorous global city, is leveraging its upcoming role as host of the United Nations’ COP28 climate talks. While the event offers Dubai another opportunity to shine, it also carries the risk of reputational damage, especially as the UAE remains a major oil producer planning to expand production from 4 million to 5 million barrels per day.

Kristian Coates Ulrichsen, a regional expert from Rice University, points out that critics may focus on UAE’s oil expansion and frame the country as contributing to the climate crisis. The UAE government insists it is committed to human rights and making progress in that field, and states that COP28 will welcome constructive dialogue toward impactful climate action.

Dubai’s impressive skyline can make it easy to forget the city only got its first electrical generator in 1952. Today, it is increasingly shifting toward renewables, converting plans for a coal-fired power plant into a natural gas facility. The solar park—about 50 kilometers from downtown—leverages the UAE’s sunny climate and aims to generate 5 gigawatts of electricity by 2030, enough to power about 1.3 million homes. Peak power demand in Dubai is around 10 gigawatts.

The UAE’s carbon neutrality plan relies on renewable projects like the solar park and Abu Dhabi’s Barakah nuclear plant. However, the country’s ongoing oil expansion and export plans have drawn activist criticism. COP28’s president-designate Sultan al-Jaber, who also leads significant renewable investments, has dismissed such critiques.

COP28 will take place at Dubai’s $7 billion Expo City, originally built for the delayed 2020 World’s Fair. The reliance on large numbers of low-paid foreign workers for Expo City and other construction has raised concerns from advocacy group Equidem about labor conditions and safety, with at least three reported worker deaths.

High-profile attendees such as King Charles and Pope Francis have confirmed participation in COP28, highlighting the event’s prominence even as conflict such as the Israel-Hamas war continues in the region.

In other business news: India’s securities regulator approved a framework for fractional real estate ownership; multinationals’ manufacturing-led capability centers are expected to increase engineering job prospects in India; and the Indian smartphone market anticipates growth in 2024 driven by affordable 5G handsets and pre-election giveaways.

Dubai imeweka rekodi mpya tena kupitia Hifadhi ya Umeme wa Jua ya Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, inayofunika zaidi ya kilomita za mraba 122 jangwani. Hii ni mradi mkubwa wenye uwekezaji wa mabilioni ya dola huku Dubai ikilenga kutokuwa na uzalishaji wa kaboni kabisa ifikapo 2050.

Dubai, iliyogeuka haraka kutoka kijiji cha ufukweni hadi kuwa jiji la kifahari duniani, sasa inajiandaa kuandaa mkutano wa COP28 wa Umoja wa Mataifa kuhusu mabadiliko ya tabianchi. Tukio hili ni nafasi muhimu kwa Dubai, lakini pia kuna hatari yake, hasa kwa kuwa UAE ni muzalishaji mkuu wa mafuta na inapanga kuongeza uzalishaji kutoka mapipa milioni 4 hadi 5 kwa siku.

Mtaalamu wa eneo la Mashariki ya Kati, Kristian Coates Ulrichsen kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Rice, anaonya kuwa upanuzi wa uzalishaji wa mafuta wa UAE unaweza kukosolewa na kuifanya nchi ionekane kama sehemu ya tatizo la tabianchi. Serikali ya UAE inasisitiza kujitolea kwake katika haki za binadamu na mafanikio yake kwenye eneo hilo, ikisema COP28 utakuwa jukwaa la majadiliano na kuchukua hatua za maana kuhusu tabianchi.

Mandhari ya kisasa ya Dubai inaweza kufanya watu wasahau kuwa hadi 1952 jiji hili lilikuwa linategemea mishumaa na chemli. Sasa Dubai inahamia zaidi kwenye nishati mbadala, ikiwa imebadilisha mpango wa kiwanda cha makaa ya mawe kuwa wa gesi asilia. Hifadhi hii ya jua—takriban kilomita 50 kutoka katikati ya jiji—inatumia jua kali la UAE na inalenga kuzalisha megawati 5,000 za umeme ifikapo 2030, nguvu inayotosha kuwasha nyumba milioni 1.3. Mahitaji ya umeme wa juu kabisa ni takriban megawati 10,000.

Mpango wa UAE wa kutokuwa na kaboni unategemea miradi kama hifadhi ya jua na kiwanda cha nyuklia cha Barakah huko Abu Dhabi. Hata hivyo, upanuzi wao wa mafuta umeendelea kuzua ukosoaji kutoka kwa wanaharakati. Rais mtarajiwa wa COP28, Sultan al-Jaber, kiongozi pia wa uwekezaji mkubwa wa nishati mbadala, amepuuza wakosoaji.    

COP28 itafanyika katika Expo City ya Dubai yenye thamani ya dola bilioni 7, iliyojengwa kwa ajili ya Maonesho ya Dunia ya 2020 yaliyocheleweshwa. Kutegemea wafanyakazi wa kigeni wasiolipwa vizuri katika Expo City na miradi mingine kumezua maswali kuhusu usalama na mazingira ya kazi; kundi la Equidem linaripoti vifo vya wafanyakazi watatu na changamoto za wafanyakazi.   

Viongozi wakubwa kama Mfalme Charles na Papa Francis wameahidi kuhudhuria COP28, jambo linaloonyesha ukubwa wa tukio hili hata wakati kuna mvutano kwenye eneo la Gaza kati ya Israel na Hamas.

Kwa habari zingine za biashara: mdhibiti wa sekta ya masoko nchini India umeidhinisha mfumo wa umiliki wa pamoja wa mali zisizohamishika; makampuni ya kimataifa yanatarajiwa kuongeza ajira za wahandisi nchini India; na soko la simu janja India linatarajia kuimarika 2024 kutokana na simu za bei nafuu za 5G na zawadi kutoka kwa vyama vya kisiasa wakati wa uchaguzi.

article_content: Beer has a rich history in the United States, beginning with the colonial era when soldiers were sometimes paid in spruce beer and cider. Over the centuries, beer experienced major changes, surviving the American Revolution, Prohibition, and industry reforms. In the early 1980s, deregulation sparked a surge in the craft beer movement. Today, Americans are more engaged with beer than ever, experimenting and innovating in nearly every town. Not all cities have the same beer culture, however. Some cities have distinguished themselves by pioneering new brewing styles, hosting vibrant festivals, and supporting strong brewery communities. Others have longstanding traditions in beer. This article ranks the top eight American cities for beer enthusiasts, rating each city on history, breweries, bars, and beer-related events.  1. Portland, Oregon History: 6 | Breweries: 10 | Bars: 10 | Events: 7 Portland has more breweries (52) than any other city in the world and is the largest craft beer market in the U.S., with 69 breweries in its metro area. Favorable state regulations allow small brewers to thrive. Notable breweries include Hopworks Urban Brewery, Alameda Brewing Company, Cascade Brewing, and Hair Of The Dog. Major events include The Oregon Brewer's Festival, Portland International Beer Festival, and Portland Beer Week, while Biketobeerfest celebrates both biking and beer. Five of Draft magazine’s top 100 craft bars are in Portland. Top picks: Hopworks Urban Crosstown Pale, Deschutes Hop Trip Ale.  2. San Francisco, California History: 8 | Breweries: 9 | Bars: 9 | Events: 7 The Bay Area is filled with micro- and nanobreweries that often experiment with innovative ingredients, like Almanac (which uses local produce) and Moonlight Brewing Company. The Anchor Steam Brewery’s sale in the 1960s led to a resurgence of signature beers. article_content: A 16-year-old bull rider, Brooke Ann Coats, died after being kicked in the chest during a rodeo event in Florida, authorities reported Saturday. Coats was injured Friday evening at the 301 Rodeo on U.S. 301S, east of Tampa. According to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office, after the 8:30 p.m. incident, Coats managed to walk out of the ring but soon experienced difficulty breathing and collapsed. An off-duty paramedic provided medical assistance before she was transported to Tampa General Hospital. Coats died during surgery. Investigators do not suspect foul play, but the investigation is ongoing.

Coats alipata majeraha Ijumaa jioni katika 301 Rodeo kwenye U.S. 301S, mashariki mwa Tampa. Kwa mujibu wa Ofisi ya Sheriff wa Kaunti ya Hillsborough, baada ya tukio lililotokea saa 2:30 usiku, Coats aliweza kutoka kwenye ulingo kwa miguu yake mwenyewe lakini baadaye alipata matatizo ya kupumua na akazimia. Paramedic aliye nje ya zamu alitoa msaada wa kwanza kabla ya Coats kupelekwa Hospitali Kuu ya Tampa. Coats alifariki dunia wakati wa upasuaji. Wachunguzi hawashuku mchezo mchafu, lakini uchunguzi unaendelea.

article_content: The U.S. military has doubled the number of aircraft in Italy, preparing to evacuate Americans from the U.S. Embassy in Tripoli amid escalating violence in Libya's capital, according to CNN. Decisions on evacuation are being made continuously, a defense official stated Monday. Heavy fighting erupted in Tripoli on Sunday as armed men stormed the interim Parliament, with sporadic gunfire and explosions continuing on the city's outskirts by Monday evening. This marks some of the fiercest unrest since the 2011 uprising that removed Muammar Gadhafi. Tensions rose further after the interim parliament speaker, Nuri Abu Sahmain—supported by Islamist groups—ordered Central Libya Shield Forces, largely from Misrata, to move into Tripoli. These powerful Islamist-aligned militias have a long-standing rivalry with the Zintan groups, both previously based in the capital. Amid the turmoil, Saudi Arabia closed its embassy and consulate in Tripoli on Monday and evacuated its staff, promising to reopen when conditions improve. Similarly, Turkey temporarily shut down its consulate in Benghazi, Turkish media reported. Four more U.S. V-22 Osprey aircraft landed at the Sigonella Naval Base in Italy, joining four others and around 200 Marines already stationed there. The Ospreys can lift off vertically and carry over two dozen passengers, standing ready to act within six hours if an evacuation is called for. This rapid response team was established after the 2012 Benghazi attack to better respond to crises. Sunday’s violence left at least four dead and 90 injured, according to Libya’s Health Ministry. Armed attackers targeted the General National Congress during a session, prompting the evacuation of its members and igniting clashes in other city areas. Libya’s political scene remains deeply divided between Islamists and liberals, stalling government functions and undermining parliamentary legitimacy. Heavily armed Zintan militias, aligned with liberal factions, accuse Islamists of dominating the government and impeding new elections.

Uamuzi wa uokoaji unafanywa kila wakati, afisa wa ulinzi alisema Jumatatu. Mapigano makali yalizuka Tripoli Jumapili baada ya wanaume wenye silaha kuvamia Bunge la mpito, huku milio ya risasi na milipuko ikiendelea pembezoni mwa jiji hadi jioni ya Jumatatu. Haya ni miongoni mwa machafuko makubwa zaidi tangu maandamano ya 2011 yaliyomwondoa Muammar Gaddafi. Hali ilizidi kuwa tete baada ya spika wa bunge la mpito, Nuri Abu Sahmain—anayeungwa mkono na vikundi vya Kiislamu—kuamuru Vikosi vya Central Libya Shield, wengi wao kutoka Misrata, waingie Tripoli. Makundi haya yenye nguvu yenye mwelekeo wa Kiislamu yamekuwa na uhasama wa muda mrefu na vikundi vya Zintan, vyote vikiwa vilikuwa na makao yao mjini humo. Katika hali hii ya misukosuko, Saudi Arabia ilifunga ubalozi na ofisi yake ya ubalozi mdogo Tripoli Jumatatu na kuwahamisha wafanyakazi wake, ikiahidi kufungua tena endapo hali itatengemaa. Vilevile, Uturuki ilifunga kwa muda ubalozi wake mdogo Benghazi, kwa mujibu wa vyombo vya habari vya Uturuki. Ndege nne zaidi za Marekani aina ya V-22 Osprey zilitua katika Kituo cha Jeshi la Majini cha Sigonella, Italia, na kuungana na nyingine nne pamoja na takriban wanamaji 200 tayari waliopo. Osprey zina uwezo wa kuruka wima na kubeba abiria zaidi ya ishirini, zikiwa tayari kuhamasishwa ndani ya saa sita iwapo uokoaji utahitajika. Kikosi hiki cha haraka cha kukabiliana na dharura kiliundwa baada ya shambulio la Benghazi mwaka 2012. Machafuko ya Jumapili yalisababisha vifo vya watu wanne na kuwajeruhi wengine 90, kwa mujibu wa Wizara ya Afya ya Libya. Washambuliaji wakiwa na silaha nzito walishambulia Bunge la Kitaifa wakati kikao kikiendelea, wakalazimika wanachama kuhamishwa na mapigano kuenea sehemu nyingine za jiji. Siasa za Libya zimegawanyika sana kati ya makundi ya Kiislamu na ya kiliberali, hali ambayo imevuruga utendaji wa serikali na kudhoofisha uhalali wa bunge. Militia za Zintan, zinazounga mkono waliberali na zenye silaha nzito, zinavituhumu vikundi vya Kiislamu kwa kudhibiti serikali na kusitisha uchaguzi mpya.

After ending their underwhelming 2023 campaign, the New York Yankees' top executives—GM Brian Cashman and managing partner Hal Steinbrenner—spoke publicly for the first time since their 82-win season concluded in October. Cashman, during the Major League Baseball general managers’ meetings, firmly defended the team's reliance on analytics and addressed public criticism. Steinbrenner commented briefly on the organization's internal discussions, but left uncertainty about the team’s future direction.

Though the current situation is troublesome, the Yankees have undergone harsher periods, such as their dramatic playoff eliminations in 2004, 2012, and the 2022 sweep by the Astros. The introduction of a more analytics-driven approach under manager Aaron Boone in 2017 has become a focal point for debate among fans and media, especially due to recent questionable trades and signings—like Aaron Hicks’ seven-year deal.

Star player Aaron Judge has suggested the team may not be prioritizing the right data. Questions about leadership communication and strategy have increased, particularly amid injuries to key players such as Judge, Anthony Rizzo, and Giancarlo Stanton, and underwhelming returns from additions like Josh Donaldson, Joey Gallo, and Frankie Montas.

With fan patience wearing thin, the Yankees need improvements on the field, healthier rosters, and better decision-making to shift the narrative and restore support.

Cashman, kwenye mkutano wa mameneja wa Ligi Kuu ya Baseball, alitetea kwa nguvu utegemezi wa klabu kwenye takwimu na alikabiliana na ukosoaji kutoka kwa umma. Steinbrenner aliashiria mazungumzo ya ndani ya timu lakini hakuweka wazi mustakabali wa Yankees. 

Ingawa hali ya sasa ni ngumu, Yankees wamepitia nyakati mbaya zaidi hapo zamani, kama kufungwa kwenye mechi za mtoano mwaka 2004, 2012, na kusafishwa na Astros mwaka 2022. Mikakati inayozingatia takwimu zaidi chini ya kocha Aaron Boone tangu 2017 sasa inapigiwa kelele, hasa kutokana na mikataba isiyoleta matokeo ya kuridhisha—kama ule wa miaka saba wa Aaron Hicks. 

Nyota wa timu Aaron Judge amependekeza huenda timu haizingatii takwimu bora. Maswali juu ya mawasiliano na mkakati wa uongozi yameongezeka, hasa wakati wachezaji muhimu kama Judge, Anthony Rizzo, na Giancarlo Stanton wanapoumia na usajili mpya kama Josh Donaldson, Joey Gallo na Frankie Montas wakishindwa kung'ara.

Fujifilm is reviving instant photography by introducing the Instax mini 90 Neo Classic. This new camera instantly prints card-sized photos, bringing back the nostalgia of classic Polaroid cameras. In the UK, it is expected to cost around £135, while a 10-shot film pack is set at about £4.50. The camera features include the ability to capture multiple exposures and a fast shutter speed of up to 1/400 second, making it adaptable to different lighting conditions.

Announced in Tokyo, the Instax mini 90 will launch in Japan on August 23 and worldwide on September 20. The Japanese price is approximately ¥20,000, with each 10-shot film pack priced at ¥700. Fujifilm has been making film since 1934 and began producing instant cameras in the 1980s, inspired by the instant photography concept introduced by Polaroid founder Edwin Land.

According to Masato Yamamoto from Fujifilm, the allure of tangible, one-of-a-kind photographs remains strong despite the digital era. Photographer Mikiya Takimoto believes the instant format encourages thoughtful photography. With this launch, Fujifilm aims to boost its instant camera sales, which declined in 2002.

Instant film development involves chemical layers within each film sheet. Before exposure, a reagent is held at the border. When a picture is taken, the film emerges and the reagent spreads between layers, setting off reactions that form the image. Colors blend and become visible as chemicals alter the opacity, ultimately displaying the final photograph. (Source: HowStuffWorks)

Inatarajiwa kugharimu takribani pauni 135 nchini Uingereza, huku pakiti ya filamu ya picha 10 ikiuzwa kwa karibu pauni 4.50. Kamera hii ina uwezo wa kuchukua picha za matokeo mbalimbali na kasi ya shutter hadi 1/400 ya sekunde, hivyo inaweza kutumika mahali penye mwangaza tofauti tofauti.

Kamera hii ilitangazwa Tokyo na itanza kuuzwa Japan tarehe 23 Agosti, kisha duniani kote tarehe 20 Septemba. Bei nchini Japan ni yen 20,000, na pakiti ya filamu ni yen 700. Fujifilm imekuwa ikizalisha filamu tangu 1934 na ilianza kutengeneza kamera za papo hapo miaka ya 1980, kwa kuhamasishwa na wazo la upigaji picha wa papo hapo lililoanzishwa na mwanzilishi wa Polaroid, Edwin Land.

Kwa mujibu wa Masato Yamamoto kutoka Fujifilm, bado watu wengi wanapenda picha za kweli na za kipekee hata katika ulimwengu wa kidijitali. Mpiga picha Mikiya Takimoto anasema mfumo huu wa papo hapo huwafanya watu kufikiria zaidi kabla ya kupiga picha. Filamu ya papo hapo inatengenezwa kwa tabaka za kemikali kwenye kila karatasi ya filamu. Kabla ya kupigwa picha, kemikali maalumu hukusanywa ukingoni. Ukipiga picha, filamu hutoka na kemikali husambazwa, ikianza mchakato wa mabadiliko ya kemikali unaounda picha. Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently commended the optimism of Indian-American entrepreneur and investor Balaji S Srinivasan. In a post on X, PM Modi expressed his admiration, saying, "I appreciate your optimism, and I must add that the people of India are pioneers and trailblazers in innovation. We invite the world to invest in our nation, and India will not disappoint." This was in response to Srinivasan's earlier post urging the investment community to increase investments in India. Srinivasan described India as an "ancient civilization that's also like a startup country," emphasizing that investing in India helps drive its improvement, similar to the growth of startups. He provided a detailed explanation alongside a graph comparing the economic growth of India and the United Kingdom since the 1600s, highlighting India's developmental dynamics.

Who is Balaji S Srinivasan? He is a prominent Silicon Valley investor and entrepreneur, having served as the Chief Technology Officer at Coinbase and as a general partner at Andreessen Horowitz. Srinivasan played key roles in early investments in various technology companies and cryptocurrency protocols. He co-founded several companies, including Earn.com (acquired by Coinbase), Counsyl (acquired by Myriad), Teleport (acquired by Topia), and Coin Center. Srinivasan holds degrees in Electrical Engineering (BS/MS/PhD) and Chemical Engineering (MS) from Stanford University and was a lecturer there in the Statistics and Computer Science departments. He is the author of "The Network State," where he discusses building what he calls a "network state" as a successor to the nation-state. In 2017, he was considered as a candidate to lead the FDA under the Trump administration. Srinivasan has also invested in Koo, an Indian microblogging platform, alongside Naval Ravikant. With a large following on X, Srinivasan remains active on the platform.

In other business news: Leading consumer electronics firms such as Apple, Samsung, Dixon Technologies, and Havells have significantly reduced imports as a percentage of sales over the past five years, according to recent regulatory data. PepsiCo India is likely to appoint George Kovoor as president, with Ahmed ElSheikh expected to move to a global role. Banks are asking for clarity regarding board involvement in loan renewals for related parties. Additional updates discuss financial sector regulations, food delivery companies' GST notices, and trends in value investing.

article_content:
Olivia Rodrigo has surprised fans by announcing a new song, "Can't Catch Me Now," for the upcoming soundtrack of "The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes." Despite her recent focus on promoting her sophomore album "Guts," Rodrigo took to social media on November 1 to share the news, expressing her excitement to be part of the franchise. The song is scheduled for release on November 3, ahead of the full soundtrack’s debut on November 17, which coincides with the film's premiere.

"Can't Catch Me Now" serves as the lead single from the soundtrack, which also features contributions from artists such as Sierra Ferrell and Molly Tuttle. The project stands out for its focus on Americana and folk genres—a shift from Rodrigo’s usual alternative rock style. This move has sparked curiosity about whether Rodrigo is experimenting musically for this release alone or considering a new direction for her future work.

Rodrigo’s announcement comes after the success of her album "Guts," which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart and produced hit singles like "Get Him Back!" "The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes" is the fifth film in the franchise and serves as a prequel. The movie received an interim agreement from SAG-AFTRA, allowing its promotion during the ongoing actors' strike.

article_content: A series of coordinated car bomb explosions struck various parts of Baghdad on Monday evening, killing at least 28 people and injuring more than 100, according to police officials. Nine car bombs went off, targeting several predominantly Shiite neighborhoods in the Iraqi capital. Police reported that 106 people were wounded in addition to the fatalities. Police Captain Ali al-Lami described the incident as another day of coordinated attacks in Baghdad. The responsible party for these bombings was not immediately clear. Monday’s attacks followed a weekend of violence across Iraq, during which more than 88 people were killed and over 300 injured in bombings and other assaults. These attacks led a United Nations envoy to urge the country’s leaders to take immediate steps to stop the increasing violence and bloodshed. The United Nations Mission in Iraq reported last month that more than 5,000 civilians have been killed and 12,000 wounded this year in terrorist attacks and other violence. The Baghdad region remains the hardest hit area. In just the past month alone, 979 Iraqis were killed and 2,133 wounded in such incidents, according to the UN. UN Special Representative for Iraq, Nickolay Mladenov, called on political, religious, and civil leaders to work with security forces to end the violence, emphasizing that recent attacks have indiscriminately targeted pilgrims, schoolchildren, journalists, and ordinary citizens. Iraq continues to face deep sectarian rifts, mainly between its Shiite majority and Sunni minority, as well as ongoing ethnic tensions involving Kurds and other minorities. Tensions have markedly increased since April, following security force raids against Sunni protesters who were demonstrating against the Shiite-led government. Many Sunnis, a minority group in Iraq, report feelings of political marginalization since the ouster of Saddam Hussein in 2003, while Shiites, who are the majority, now control the government. Reporting contributed by CNN's Jason Hanna.

Mabomu tisa ya magari yalilipuka, yakilenga hasa maeneo yenye Waislamu wa madhehebu ya Shia katika mji mkuu wa Iraq. Polisi wameripoti kuwa watu 106 walijeruhiwa pamoja na waliofariki. Mashambulizi ya Jumatatu yalifuatia wikiendi yenye machafuko kote Iraq, ambako watu zaidi ya 88 waliuawa na zaidi ya 300 kujeruhiwa kwenye milipuko na mashambulizi mengine. Mashambulizi haya yalimfanya mwakilishi wa Umoja wa Mataifa kuwataka viongozi wa taifa kuchukua hatua za haraka kukomesha ongezeko la vurugu na umwagaji damu. Ujumbe wa Umoja wa Mataifa nchini Iraq umeripoti mwezi uliopita kuwa zaidi ya raia 5,000 wameuawa na 12,000 kujeruhiwa mwaka huu kutokana na mashambulizi ya kigaidi na vurugu nyingine. Eneo la Baghdad limeathirika zaidi. Mwezi uliopita pekee, Wairaqi 979 waliuawa na 2,133 kujeruhiwa kutokana na matukio kama hayo, kwa mujibu wa UN. Mwakilishi Maalum wa UN kwa Iraq, Nickolay Mladenov, aliwataka viongozi wa kisiasa, kidini na kiraia kushirikiana na vikosi vya usalama kumaliza vurugu, akisisitiza kuwa mashambulizi ya karibuni yamelenga kiholela mahujaji, wanafunzi, waandishi wa habari na raia wa kawaida. Iraq inaendelea kukabiliwa na migawanyiko mikubwa ya kimadhehebu, hasa kati ya Waislamu wa Shia walio wengi na Waisuni walio wachache, pamoja na mvutano wa kikabila unaohusisha Wakurdi na makundi mengine madogo. Wengi wa Kisunni, ambao ni wachache nchini Iraq, wanasema wamesukumwa pembeni kisiasa tangu kung’olewa madarakani kwa Saddam Hussein mwaka 2003, huku Washia wakiwa sasa ndio wanaotawala serikali. Ripoti hii imetayarishwa kwa ushirikiano na Jason Hanna wa CNN.

article_content: Elon Musk, billionaire owner of X (formerly known as Twitter), is facing a defamation lawsuit as a result of allegedly making false accusations online about Ben Brody, a 22-year-old from California. The lawsuit, filed in Texas and first reported by HuffPost, claims Musk’s posts triggered widespread harassment against Brody. The case arises from an incident in June during a pride festival in Oregon, where two far-right groups became involved in a fight. The event was filmed, and the footage spread online, leading to numerous false claims about the individuals involved. Brody was misidentified as one of the men in the video. Musk responded to and amplified several misleading posts regarding Brody to his more than 147 million followers, including a specific post on June 27th suggesting Brody was participating in a 'false flag' operation. Musk has not removed these posts. Brody’s attorney, Mark Bankston, has said that being falsely accused by such a prominent figure has deeply affected Brody, causing him distress and concern for his future. Bankston previously represented the parents of Sandy Hook victims in a successful defamation lawsuit against conspiracy theorist Alex Jones. The lawsuit alleges that the resulting attacks forced Brody and his family to leave their home due to widespread belief, amplified by Musk’s posts, that he was a neo-Nazi or involved in a staged political act. Musk has faced defamation claims before, including a 2018 case in which he called diver Vernon Unsworth 'pedo guy.' Musk prevailed in that case. He has also been known to engage in sharing conspiracy theories and controversial opinions on X, such as questioning the motives behind the attack on Paul Pelosi, husband of Representative Nancy Pelosi.

Kesi hiyo, iliyofunguliwa Texas na kuripotiwa kwanza na HuffPost, inadai kwamba machapisho ya Musk yalisababisha Brody kupata bughudha kubwa mtandaoni. Kesi hii inatokana na tukio la Juni kwenye tamasha la fahari Oregon, ambapo makundi mawili ya siasa kali ya kulia yalipigana. Musk alijibu na kusambaza machapisho kadhaa yenye kupotosha kuhusu Brody kwa wafuasi wake milioni 147+, ikiwa ni pamoja na chapisho la Juni 27 lililodai Brody alikuwa kwenye 'operesheni ya bendera bandia.' Bankston hapo awali aliwakilisha wazazi wa wahanga wa Sandy Hook kwenye kesi ya kashfa iliyofanikiwa dhidi ya Alex Jones. Kesi inadai kuwa Brody na familia yake walilazimika kuhama nyumbani kwao kutokana na mashambulizi na imani iliyochochewa na machapisho ya Musk kuwa Brody ni neo-Nazi au anashiriki njama ya kisiasa. Musk amewahi kukabiliwa na madai ya kashfa kabla, akiwemo kwenye kesi ya 2018 alipomuita mwokoaji wa mapango Vernon Unsworth 'pedo guy,' ambapo alishinda. Pia anajulikana kwa kuchapisha nadharia za njama na maoni yenye utata kwenye X, kama vile shaka kuhusu shambulio dhidi ya Paul Pelosi, mume wa Nancy Pelosi.

article_content: A baby orangutan at Dortmund Zoo lost an arm after being bitten by an adult male orangutan named Walter. Walter, who is well known in Germany for predicting football scores, bit the one-year-old, Yenko, after the infant reached into Walter’s enclosure through a wire fence. Yenko had only been at the zoo for a few weeks and was living with his adoptive mother, Toba. Following the incident, Yenko underwent emergency surgery and survived, but veterinarians were unable to reattach his arm. Zoo keepers had separated Walter from Yenko and Toba with a wire fence. However, Yenko managed to put his arm through the mesh, leading to the attack. Zoo officials believe Walter may have been motivated by jealousy, feeling that Yenko was receiving more attention from Toba. Walter is famous for his football predictions. He makes his selections by picking items bearing the clubs’ logos from identical footballs. He attracted attention in May when he chose Borussia Dortmund to win the cup final against Bayern Munich by putting a Dortmund shirt on his head, although Borussia Dortmund lost the match 2-0.

Yenko alikuwa amekuwa Dortmund kwa wiki chache tu na alikuwa akiishi na mama mlezi wake, Toba. Baada ya tukio hilo, Yenko alifanyiwa upasuaji wa dharura na alinusurika, lakini madaktari hawakuweza kuunganisha mkono wake tena. Walezi wa zoo walikuwa wamemtenganisha Walter na Yenko pamoja na Toba kwa uzio wa waya. Hata hivyo, Yenko aliweza kuingiza mkono kupitia wavu, jambo lililosababisha shambulio hilo. article_content: Booster, an Alaskan Malamute from Plymouth, was rushed to the vet after eating a tin of Quality Street chocolates, wrappers included. Vets discovered he had also swallowed five rubber toys along with the chocolates. His owners, Guy and Jackie Kelly, found him severely bloated and in pain after Booster consumed the leftover holiday sweets. X-rays revealed the five rubber balls in his stomach, which required surgical removal. Adam Coulson from Plymouth Veterinary Hospital explained that gas from the chocolates was restricting blood flow to Booster's heart. After surgery to remove the toys, Booster recovered and returned to his normal behavior. It remains unclear how long the toys were in his stomach. Booster's treatment was covered by pet insurance, and his owners are thankful for his recovery.

Madaktari waligundua pia alikuwa amemeza mipira mitano ya mpira pamoja na chokoleti hizo. Wamiliki wake, Guy na Jackie Kelly, walimpata akiwa na tumbo lililovimba na maumivu makali baada ya kula peremende zilizobaki za sikukuu. Vipimo vya X-ray vilionyesha mipira mitano ya mpira tumboni mwake, na ilihitajika kuondolewa kwa upasuaji. Adam Coulson kutoka Hospitali ya Wanyama ya Plymouth alieleza kuwa gesi kutoka kwa chokoleti zilizuia mtiririko wa damu kwenda kwenye moyo wa Booster. Baada ya upasuaji wa kuondoa mipira hiyo, Booster alipona na akarudi kwenye tabia yake ya kawaida. Bado haijulikani ni muda gani mipira hiyo ilikuwa tumboni mwake. article_content:
Sri Lanka cricket captain Kusal Mendis has expressed concern over the International Cricket Council's (ICC) suspension of the country’s cricket board, hoping it will not disrupt the national team's fixtures or preparations for the upcoming Men’s U19 World Cup in early 2024. Sri Lanka is set for a busy schedule, starting with a home series against Zimbabwe in January–February, followed by hosting the U19 World Cup with 16 teams participating from January 13.

Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) has faced significant turmoil since the national team, led by Mendis, exited the recent Men's World Cup after losing seven of nine games in India. Upon returning, Mendis told the media that he hopes the suspension will be lifted soon, enabling the team to prepare as planned, especially for the Under-19 World Cup.

The ICC suspended Sri Lanka’s full membership after observing government interference: The Sri Lankan parliament unanimously passed a resolution for the dismissal of the cricket board, an act which the ICC deemed sufficient grounds for suspension. Recent heavy defeats to India—including being bowled out for under 100 runs three times in 2023—further highlighted performance issues. Mendis remarked that, despite their struggles, the team had shown resilience.

Following their poor World Cup showing, Sports Minister Roshan Ranasinghe dismissed the SLC management on November 6, appointing an interim committee led by former captain Arjuna Ranatunga. However, the court of appeal reinstated the previous management the next day.

High-performance coach Mahela Jayawardene noted that players struggled with executing the strategies discussed, and aims to address the deficiencies for future improvements. Team manager Mahinda Halangoda added that the ongoing administrative issues are concerning, but they are working to keep players focused.

The future of Sri Lanka cricket remains uncertain as the team and its management await further developments related to the ICC suspension and ongoing governance challenges.

Nahodha wa kriketi wa Sri Lanka, Kusal Mendis, ameonyesha wasiwasi kuhusu kusimamishwa kwa bodi ya kriketi na Baraza la Kimataifa la Kriketi (ICC), akitumai kuwa haitavuruga ratiba ya timu ya taifa wala maandalizi ya Kombe la Dunia la U19 linalotarajiwa mapema 2024. Sri Lanka ina ratiba ndefu, ikianza na mfululizo wa mechi za nyumbani dhidi ya Zimbabwe mwezi Januari hadi Februari, halafu kuwa mwenyeji wa Kombe la Dunia la U19 litakaloshirikisha timu 16 kuanzia Januari 13.

Kriketi ya Sri Lanka (SLC) imeingia katika mtikisiko tangu timu ya taifa chini ya Mendis kutolewa kwenye Kombe la Dunia baada ya kupoteza mechi saba kati ya tisa nchini India. Mendis aliporejea alisema anatumai kusimamishwa huko kutaondolewa haraka, ili timu iweze kujiandaa vizuri, hasa kwa Kombe la Dunia la U19.

ICC ilisimamisha uanachama wa Sri Lanka kufuatia kuingiliwa na serikali: Bunge la Sri Lanka lilikubaliana kumwondoa uongozi wa bodi ya kriketi, jambo lililofanya ICC kusimamisha uanachama. Kushindwa mara nyingi na India—ikiwa ni pamoja na kubowldiwa chini ya alama 100 mara tatu mwaka 2023—kumeonesha matatizo kwenye kikosi. Mendis alisema, licha ya changamoto, timu imeonesha ustahimilivu.

Baada ya matokeo mabaya, Waziri wa Michezo Roshan Ranasinghe alifukuza uongozi wa SLC Novemba 6 na kumteua nahodha wa zamani Arjuna Ranatunga kuongoza kamati ya mpito. Hata hivyo, mahakama ilirejesha uongozi wa zamani siku iliyofuata.

Kocha wa maendeleo Mahela Jayawardene alisema wachezaji hawakutekeleza mikakati ipasavyo na anataka kurekebisha kasoro hizi. Meneja wa timu Mahinda Halangoda alisema masuala ya uongozi yanaathiri wachezaji, lakini wamekuwa wakiwahamasisha wabakie makini.

Mustakabali wa kriketi ya Sri Lanka bado upo shakani timu ikisubiri hatua zaidi kuhusu kusimamishwa na changamoto za uongozi.

article_content: A new study finds that over one in five people (more than 20%) treated with the antiviral COVID-19 medication Paxlovid experienced a return of the virus after initially testing negative. These patients were also found to be shedding live, potentially contagious virus, which could infect others. The study suggests that patients treated with Paxlovid may experience 'viral rebound' and could be contagious after apparent recovery. In contrast, only about 2% of people who did not take Paxlovid experienced this viral rebound phenomenon, according to researchers at Mass General Brigham Hospital in Boston, US. Paxlovid, an oral therapy combining nirmatrelvir and ritonavir, is known for reducing hospitalizations and deaths in severe COVID-19 cases. "We conducted this study to clarify questions about Paxlovid and viral rebound in COVID-19 treatment," said corresponding author Dr. Mark Siedner, an infectious disease specialist at Massachusetts General Hospital. "We discovered that viral rebound was much more common than expected—seen in over 20% of people treated with Paxlovid. These individuals shed live virus during rebound, indicating a potential risk of transmission after initial recovery." The research was observational and not a randomized clinical trial, so it cannot be concluded that Paxlovid alone caused the higher rebound rate. The study was published in the Annals of Internal Medicine. Researchers emphasized that these findings should not deter clinicians from prescribing Paxlovid, but that patients should be advised of the possibility of viral rebound and contagiousness. Patients should be counseled to re-test and isolate if rebound occurs. "Paxlovid remains a life-saving drug I prescribe for high-risk patients," said co-senior author Dr. Jonathon Li. "This study doesn’t change that fact. Instead, it gives useful information to Paxlovid patients about what to expect and how long they might be contagious." For this study, 142 individuals between March 2022 and May 2023 were selected based on positive COVID-19 tests, prescriptions, or physician referrals. Participants were categorized based on whether they took a standard five-day Paxlovid regimen, and their viral loads, symptoms, and viral cultures were tracked and analyzed. The research team defined 'viral rebound' as patients who tested positive again after a negative test, or whose viral loads increased twice after an initial decline. The group experiencing rebound also had longer periods of viral shedding—an average of 14 days compared to less than 5 days for those who did not experience rebound, raising concerns about prolonged contagiousness. Researchers plan further studies to determine the biological reasons for the rebound effect and whether changes in treatment duration might help. The World Health Organization recently recommended nirmatrelvir-ritonavir for non-severe COVID-19 patients at high or moderate risk of hospital admission. Wagonjwa hawa pia walionekana kutoa virusi hai vinavyoweza kuambukiza wengine. Kundi hili pia lilitoa virusi kwa kipindi kirefu— wastani wa siku 14 ukilinganisha na chini ya siku 5 kwa wasiopata kurudi kwa virusi, jambo linalozua wasiwasi juu ya muda wa kuambukiza.
