Kiongozi wa Wengi katika Seneti, Harry Reid, alitangaza Jumanne kwamba atawasilisha hoja wiki hii kuhusu iwapo kufungua mjadala wa sheria kali zaidi za umiliki wa bunduki, akilenga kuongeza shinikizo kwa wabunge wa vyama vyote viwili. Baadhi ya Warepublican wametishia kuzima hatua hiyo kwa kutumia filibuster, jambo linalomlazimu Reid kupata angalau kura 60 Alhamisi ili kuanza mjadala wa kifurushi cha mageuzi ya sheria za bunduki, kilichotokana na mapendekezo ya Rais Obama baada ya tukio la kusikitisha la shule ya Newtown mwezi Desemba.

Rais Obama ametilia mkazo mageuzi ya sheria za umiliki wa silaha, akisafiri nchi nzima kuhamasisha Bunge kuunga mkono muswada huo. Alisoma Connecticut Jumatatu—eneo la tukio la Newtown—na Makamu wa Rais Biden pia alitoa wito White House Jumanne.

Reid alieleza matumaini ya kupata makubaliano ya vyama kabla ya kura kuu. Mazungumzo kati ya Seneta Joe Manchin (Democrat) na Seneta Pat Toomey (Republican) yanalenga kupanua ukaguzi wa nyuma kwa wanunuzi wa silaha. Manchin alisema wako karibu kukubaliana, na mkutano wa waandishi umeandaliwa Jumatano asubuhi.

Zaidi ya hayo, viongozi wa Democratic wanaamini wanaweza kupata Warepublican wa kutosha kushinda filibuster hiyo. Inawezekana hadi Warepublican 12 wakaunga mkono, hivyo kufidia upotevu wa baadhi ya wanachama wao wanaounga mkono silaha. Warepublican watano, pamoja na Mitch McConnell, wamelalamikia filibuster na kuonyesha utayari wa mazungumzo.

Seneta Kelly Ayotte wa New Hampshire aliunga mkono mjadala mradi marekebisho yaruhusiwe, akisema, "Ni mjadala muhimu na sioni sababu ya kuzuia hoja hii." Bila makubaliano ya pamoja, filibuster inaweza kukwaza upigaji kura wa vifungu vya sheria za silaha.

Viongozi wa Democratic wako tayari kuruhusu mijadala ya kina na marekebisho mengi, hata baada ya mapumziko ya mwezi Mei ili kuongeza uwezekano wa mafanikio. "Ushirikiano wa kupitisha mswada unapatikana kwa kuruhusu kura nyingi za marekebisho. Tuko tayari kujitolea muda huo," alisema afisa wa Democratic kwa CNN.

Hotuba za karibuni za Obama zinaonyesha hali isiyotabirika ya kisiasa, mara nyingine akitumilia lugha ya kibinafsi kuwakosoa Warepublican kwa kuzima hatua zinazopewa uungwaji mkono na umma lakini ambazo zinakataliwa na NRA. Msemaji wa White House Jay Carney alisema, "Iwapo maseneta hawatakuwa na ujasiri wa kupiga kura kwa misingi ya wanaamini, hiyo itakuwa aibu na kutoitendea huduma jamii zao."

Katika tukio binafsi White House, Makamu wa Rais Biden alikosoa Warepublican kwa juhudi zao za kuzuia sheria kali za bunduki, akisema uungwaji mkono wa umma kwa ukaguzi mpana umeongezeka. Rais wa NRA David Keene alionya kuwa mapendekezo hayo yanavuruga haki za kikatiba na hayatatua tatizo la matumizi ya silaha, akielezea mjadala huu kama mgawanyiko wa kitamaduni.

Kutojadili muswada katika Seneti inayoongozwa na Democrats kutakuwa pigo kwa Obama na wanaounga mkono sheria kali, huku pingamizi dhidi ya mapendekezo maarufu, kutenegeneza ukaguzi mpana zaidi, kunaweza kuathiri chaguzi zijazo kwa Republican. Siasa zimekuwa kali; NRA na Mayors Against Illegal Guns wameanzisha kampeni za scorecard na matangazo ya runinga kujaribu kushawishi wabunge.

Kifurushi cha Kamati ya Mahakama kinajumuisha ukaguzi wa nyuma ulioimarishwa, sheria kali dhidi ya usafirishaji haramu, vizuizi vya ununuzi kwa wahusika wasio sahihi na hatua za usalama mashuleni. Marufuku ya silaha za kivita, iliyolingana na ile ya 1994, imeondolewa kwenye mswada mkuu, lakini Reid ameahidi kura ya marekebisho. Reid na White House wanasukuma ukaguzi wa nyuma kwa kila uuzaji ili kuziba mianya ya mauzo binafsi.

Reid pia alitoa mtazamo wake binafsi, akisema kipindi cha kusubiri cha siku tatu kwenye jimbo lake kimezuia visa vya kujiua, na kudai ukaguzi wa nyuma kwa mauzo yote ya silaha ni "hekima ya kawaida." Iwapo kifurushi kikuu kitapigwa chini, Reid alisema atatafuta kura kwenye vipengele kimoja kimoja.

Biden alishangaa jinsi Warepublican wanavyoweza kuzuia mjadala kuhusu sheria inayopewa uungwaji mkono na umma. Wapinzani kama Keene wana wasiwasi ukaguzi mpana unaweza kusababisha daftari la kitaifa la silaha na kuwa mzigo kwa wamiliki halali, huku wafuasi wakituhumu NRA kueneza taarifa potofu na baadhi ya majimbo tayari yamepitisha sheria kali tangu Newtown.

Mfumo wa sasa wa ukaguzi wa nyuma ulianzishwa 1989, ukitumika kwa wauzaji walioidhinishwa na serikali na ukiacha mauzo binafsi. Wauzaji huweka rekodi lakini serikali haina tarifa za utambulisho. Kuanzia 1998 hadi 2009, chini ya asilimia 2% ya ununuzi wa silaha ulikataliwa kutokana na ukaguzi huo, inavyoonyesha Idara ya Sheria. Wapinzani wanasema mfumo haujasaidia; wafuasi wanaona kuboresha na kupanua mfumo ni muhimu. Ripoti ya 2011 ilionyesha karibu vifo 10,000 vya watu kwa risasi kati ya vifo 14,000 huko Amerika mwaka huo.

Ripoti hii imetayarishwa na Ted Barrett, Todd Sperry, Joe Johns, Ashley Killough, na Paul Steinhauser.

article_content: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba has reiterated Ukraine’s determination to resist Russia’s invasion, declaring the country will not back down. Addressing NATO foreign ministers in Brussels, Kuleba called for sustained Western support and highlighted that the war’s outcomes affect all of Euro-Atlantic security. This appeal comes as concerns rise over Western fatigue from the drawn-out war, with global focus shifting toward the crisis in Gaza. With more than $40 billion in US aid already given since Russia’s 2022 invasion, a further $61 billion remains stuck in Congress. Similarly, a $50 billion package from the European Union faces pushback from Hungary, leaving Ukraine worried about dwindling resources ahead of winter. Western leaders continue to insist they’ll support Ukraine for as long as needed. US Secretary of State Antony Blinken said all NATO members at the summit vowed ongoing support, and that the US is working to get more aid approved in Congress soon. Yet, Ukraine is in urgent need of ammunition as promised deliveries stall. The United States is in talks with Greece to purchase $47 million in artillery shells, but European allies have only sent about 300,000 of the 1 million shells they pledged—an objective that may not be reached. Germany’s foreign minister has called for stepped-up military assistance, including the creation of a protective shield to help defend Ukraine from Russian attacks during winter. The NATO meeting comes as the conflict stagnates, with both Russian and Ukrainian forces locked in a deadlock after nearly two years. Ukrainian officials recently reported intercepting numerous Russian drones and missiles, while Russia claims to have shot down a drone near Moscow. The ongoing war has so far led to approximately 500,000 casualties among both Russian and Ukrainian forces.

Wito huu umetolewa wakati kuna wasiwasi juu ya uchovu miongoni mwa washirika wa Magharibi kutokana na vita virefu, huku dunia ikielekeza macho yake kwenye mgogoro wa Gaza. Marekani tayari imetoa msaada wa zaidi ya dola bilioni 40 tangu Urusi ivamie mwaka 2022, lakini dola bilioni 61 zingine zimekwama kwenye Bunge la Marekani. Vilevile, kifurushi cha msaada cha dola bilioni 50 kutoka Umoja wa Ulaya kimekwama kutokana na upinzani wa Hungary, na hii imeifanya Ukraine kuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu kupungua kwa rasilimali wakati wa msimu wa baridi. Viongozi wa Magharibi wanaendelea kusisitiza kuwa wataiunga mkono Ukraine kadri itakavyohitajika. Hata hivyo, Ukraine inahitaji kwa haraka risasi na silaha huku usafirishaji wa silaha zilizokuwa zimeahidiwa ukisuasua. Marekani iko kwenye mazungumzo na Ugiriki kununua risasi za makombora zenye thamani ya dola milioni 47, lakini washirika wa Ulaya wametuma kadri ya risasi 300,000 kati ya milioni 1 walizoahidi—lengo ambalo huenda halitafikiwa. Vita vinavyoendelea vimesababisha makadirio ya vifo na majeruhi kufikia 500,000 kwa pande zote mbili.

Former supermodel Paula Hamilton has been charged with assaulting a police officer, following an alleged incident at her home in Buckinghamshire. Hamilton is already facing drink-driving charges after a car accident near her residence three weeks earlier, where her car crashed into a neighbour’s conservatory. She later claimed she was bitten by a police dog during the search for her.

The most recent charge relates to an alleged assault on Police Constable Dominic Matheson, who was responding to a domestic disturbance at Hamilton’s home on September 29. Hamilton, reportedly holding a sunflower, is accused of punching PC Matheson in the chest. The officer did not sustain serious injuries. Following the incident, Hamilton was arrested, interviewed, and charged.

Hamilton, known for starring in a 1980s Volkswagen advertising campaign, has denied the assault charge at High Wycombe Magistrates’ Court and is scheduled to stand trial at Aylesbury Magistrates’ Court in February.

Thames Valley Police, after consulting the Crown Prosecution Service, confirmed Hamilton was formally charged and released on bail. She is also awaiting court proceedings on the alleged drink-driving offence.

A group of Lithuanian nationals based in Lincoln, England, received prison sentences totaling more than 20 years after carrying out a spree of lead thefts from churches across the East Midlands. Between January and September 2011, the gang targeted 20 churches in Lincolnshire, Leicestershire, and Nottinghamshire, stealing lead roofing for resale to scrap dealers. Their actions caused over £1 million in damage, though they made nearly £70,000 from the stolen metal.

Police captured the group after stopping a vehicle carrying stolen lead on the A46. Authorities were able to connect them to several thefts through DNA traces on items left at the scene, 'smart water' forensic marking technology, and evidence from automatic number plate recognition systems.

The six men convicted were: Andrius Cereska, Audrius Kvedaras, and Tadas Andruska, each jailed for four years after pleading guilty; Vidas Andruska, sentenced to seven years following a trial; Vitalijus Vilkys, given a suspended six-month sentence and required to complete community service for handling stolen goods; and Nerijus Razma, who received a 22-month sentence for theft.

Many of the churches were isolated, making them particularly vulnerable. Beyond the value of the stolen lead, the thefts caused significant structural and water damage, resulting in repair costs far exceeding the material's price. Insurance providers like the Ecclesiastical Insurance Group subsequently limited payouts per church in response to the wave of thefts.

Following the convictions, incidents of church lead theft in the area plummeted by 90%. Police and community leaders hailed the case as a considerable success in defending local heritage sites and emphasized the positive impact on affected congregations.

Kuanzia Januari hadi Septemba 2011, kundi hili lililenga makanisa 20 katika Lincolnshire, Leicestershire na Nottinghamshire, na kuiba bati za paa kwa nia ya kuuza kwenye yadi za chuma chakavu. article_content: The Philippine government's steadfast backing of Israel, especially regarding the current conflict in Gaza, brings up significant ethical and strategic questions. On October 27, the United Nations General Assembly passed a nonbinding resolution, with strong global support, calling for an immediate humanitarian truce between Israel and Hamas, and urging access for aid to Gaza. Though 120 countries supported this move, the Philippines abstained. Instead, Manila affirmed Israel’s right to self-defense but did not address the reported suffering of Palestinians. This stance is not new. The Philippines has supported Israel for decades, including by voting for the 1947 UN plan creating separate Jewish and Arab states. Diplomatic relations were solidified in the 1950s, and since then, the Philippines has rarely criticized Israeli policies and often shielded it from international censure. During a 2017 UN vote criticizing US recognition of Jerusalem as Israel’s capital, the Philippines again abstained, marking a shift from earlier positions. Under President Rodrigo Duterte, who pledged an independent foreign policy, support for Israel continued, highlighted by Duterte’s historic 2018 visit. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. now maintains strong diplomatic alignment with the US and continued support for Israel. After the October 7 Hamas attacks, which resulted in about 1,200 Israeli fatalities and over 200 people being taken hostage, the Philippines publicly supported Israel and condemned violence against Israeli civilians. However, consistent with its previous stance, Manila has avoided criticizing Israel’s counterstrikes in Gaza, which have led to more than 11,000 deaths, including many children. Some observers argue that the Philippines’ unwavering support for Israel weakens its own moral authority and its calls for adherence to international law—especially as it seeks global support in territorial disputes with China. Backing states accused of violating international norms may undermine Manila’s credibility in demanding respect for its own territorial integrity. For both ethical and pragmatic reasons, there are calls for the Philippine government to reconsider its position and adopt a foreign policy grounded in human rights and accountability for all. The country is urged to condemn harm to civilians, whether Israeli or Palestinian. Editor’s note: The opinions presented reflect the author’s views and not those of Al Jazeera.

article_content: The Police Service Commission (PSC) has rejected 84,606 applications during the ongoing recruitment for Constable Cadre positions in the Nigeria Police Force. PSC Spokesman Ikechukwu Ani stated on Sunday that 547,774 applications have been received so far through the recruitment portal, which will close on Sunday, November 26, 2023, after opening on October 15. Kaduna State leads with 40,272 applicants, while Anambra has the fewest at 1,664. Of the total applicants, 358,900 were successful and will proceed to the next stage, which includes physical assessments, credential verification, medical examinations, and background checks. Most rejected applicants were over the eligible age range of 18 to 25 years. Adamawa State ranked second in applications with 36,398, followed by Borno (32,048), Benue (31,122), Katsina (30,202), Bauchi (30,604), and Kano (30,004). Ebonyi, Lagos, Bayelsa, and Abia were among the states with the fewest applications after Anambra. PSC Chairman Dr. Solomon Arase expressed satisfaction with the number of applicants. He praised the strong interest among Nigerian youths in police careers and encouraged more participation from young people in the South-East, stating that turning to criminal groups is not a solution. Dr. Arase emphasized that development relies on safety and peace, and reaffirmed the PSC’s commitment to a fair recruitment process based on merit and justice.

Jimbo la Kaduna linaongoza kwa idadi kubwa ya waombaji (40,272), huku Anambra ikiwa na idadi ndogo zaidi ya waombaji (1,664). Kati ya waombaji wote, 358,900 wamefaulu na wataendelea kwa hatua inayofuata ambayo inajumuisha ukaguzi wa mwili, kuthibitishwa kwa vyeti, vipimo vya afya, na uchunguzi wa historia. Waombaji wengi waliokataliwa walizidi umri unaokubalika, ambao ni miaka 18 hadi 25. Jimbo la Adamawa ni la pili kwa idadi ya maombi (36,398), likifuatiwa na Borno (32,048), Benue (31,122), Katsina (30,202), Bauchi (30,604), na Kano (30,004). Ebonyi, Lagos, Bayelsa, na Abia ni miongoni mwa majimbo yenye waombaji wachache zaidi baada ya Anambra. Mwenyekiti wa PSC, Dkt. Solomon Arase, alionyesha kuridhishwa na idadi ya waombaji. Alisifu shauku ya vijana wa Nigeria katika kuchagua kazi ya polisi na kuhamasisha ushiriki zaidi kutoka kwa vijana wa Kusini-Mashariki, akisema kuwa kujiunga na magenge ya uhalifu sio suluhisho. Dkt. Arase alisisitiza maendeleo yanategemea amani na usalama, na akathibitisha tena kuwa PSC itahakikisha mchakato wa uajiri wenye haki na uadilifu.

The Indian government is considering relaxing lending norms for new coal-fired power plants, as it seeks to boost the country’s electricity capacity to meet sharply rising demand. This comes amid reports that France and the United States are preparing to propose a ban on private financing for coal projects at the upcoming COP-28 climate summit.

Sources in the power ministry indicate that the current requirement for power purchase agreements (PPAs) with distribution companies—necessary for securing funding for new coal plants—may be eased, potentially allowing funds to flow more easily to such projects.

This move follows Power Minister R K Singh’s call for India to begin work on adding 30,000 megawatts (MW) of new coal-based capacity, in addition to the 50,000 MW already under development. According to a ministry report in May, the average cost of building coal-fired power is estimated at Rs 8.3 crore per MW. Setting up the additional 30,000 MW would thus require investments of nearly Rs 2.5 lakh crore. Given a typical 70:30 debt-equity ratio for such projects, lenders could face over Rs 1.7 lakh crore in debt exposure. These numbers increase further when including the 50,000 MW already being built, though many of those projects would have been planned at lower costs and have already secured funding.

The push for expanding coal power comes as India saw a 20% year-on-year increase in power demand in August, September, and October. This year, peak power demand reached 2.4 lakh MW, up from 1.9 lakh MW in 2017-18. Power Minister Singh highlighted that if peak demand rises further, supply may not keep pace.

Currently, coal power plants are operating at a load factor of about 65%, reflecting increased reliance due to higher demand, even as renewable energy production remains strong. This suggests India will need more coal-based power to maintain grid stability, given the intermittency of renewable energy sources.
translated_content:
Serikali ya India inazingatia kulegeza masharti ya mikopo kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa vituo vipya vya umeme vinavyotumia makaa ya mawe, ili kuongeza uwezo wa umeme nchini na kukidhi ongezeko kubwa la mahitaji. Hii inatokea wakati ambapo Ufaransa na Marekani zinatarajiwa kupendekeza marufuku ya ufadhili wa binafsi kwa miradi ya makaa ya mawe kwenye mkutano wa COP-28 ujao.

Vyanzo vya wizara ya nishati vinaonyesha kuwa hitaji la mkataba wa ununuzi wa umeme (PPA) na kampuni za usambazaji — ambalo ni sharti ili kupata ufadhili wa miradi mipya ya makaa ya mawe — huenda likapunguzwa, na hivyo kurahisisha upatikanaji wa fedha kwa miradi hiyo.

Hatua hii inatokana na wito wa Waziri wa Nishati, R K Singh, kwa India kuanza kujenga megawati 30,000 za umeme mpya wa makaa ya mawe, mbali na megawati 50,000 ambazo tayari zinajengwa. Kulingana na ripoti ya wizara ya Mei, gharama ya wastani ya ujenzi wa umeme wa makaa ya mawe ni takriban rupia milioni 83 kwa MW. Kuongeza MW 30,000 zaidi kunahitaji uwekezaji wa karibu rupia trilioni 2.5. Kwa uwiano wa deni na mtaji wa 70:30, wakopeshaji watahitajika kutoa zaidi ya rupia trilioni 1.7 kama deni. Idadi hizi zinaongezeka ukiwemo MW 50,000 zinazojengwa, japokuwa baadhi ya miradi hii ilipangwa kwa gharama ndogo na tayari imepata ufadhili.

Kasi ya kuongeza umeme wa makaa ya mawe imechochewa na India kushuhudia ongezeko la asilimia 20 ya mahitaji ya umeme kwa mwaka katika miezi ya Agosti, Septemba na Oktoba. Mwaka huu, mahitaji ya juu sana ya umeme yalifikia MW 240,000, kutoka MW 190,000 mwaka 2017-18. Waziri Singh alionya kuwa ikiwa mahitaji yataongezeka zaidi, huenda usambazaji wa umeme haukutoshelezi.

Sasa, mitambo ya makaa ya mawe inafanya kazi kwa wastani wa asilimia 65, ikionyesha utegemezi zaidi kutokana na kuongezeka kwa mahitaji, japokuwa uzalishaji wa nishati mbadala upo juu. Hii inaonesha kwamba India itahitaji zaidi umeme wa makaa ya mawe ili kuhakikisha gridi inabaki imara, kutokana na kubadilika-badilika kwa nishati mbadala.

article_content: New York Fashion Week begins Thursday, ushering in previews of the Spring 2014 women's collections. Fashion expert Sheila Aimette from WGSN anticipates a burst of soft, sweet pastel hues, boosted by vibrant shades of blue—from cool aqua to classic navy—that will energize the softer palette. Anne Slowey, Elle Magazine's fashion news director, expects designers to build on resort-style looks: expect big florals, artful prints, unexpected pastel combos, and clean, architectural silhouettes with a sporty feel. Both Slowey and Aimette foresee bold experiments with prints and patterns, especially on matching tops and bottoms. 'Garments will stand out for their patterns because the shapes will be crisp and minimal,' says Aimette. Denim stays essential; watch for classic indigo jeans in skinny fits, teamed with boyfriend-style chambray shirts. Colored denim is declining, while timeless blue makes a comeback. Skirts go to extremes—either pleated mini kilts (a nod to the Met’s 'PUNK: Chaos to Couture' exhibition) or elegant mid-calf skirts inspired by the upcoming 'Grace of Monaco' film starring Nicole Kidman. Meanwhile, asymmetric hems and studded accessories are on the way out. For shoes, expect graphic flats, black-and-white loafers, and striking Lucite wedges. Emerging brands like Dion Lee, Rosie Assoulin, Tome, and accessory label NewbarK (by sisters Maryam and Marjan Malakpour) are earning attention for their clean lines and subtle sophistication. Slowey points to the rise of 'anonymous luxury'—beautiful, quality clothing that’s unbranded yet unmistakably refined. Stay updated by following Sarah LeTrent and CNN Living during New York Fashion Week.

article_content: Ethnic Greek Albanians allege that Prime Minister Edi Rama is attempting to conceal suspicious land transactions. Greece has warned it may delay Albania's European Union accession, as the EU seeks to revitalize the accession process for Western Balkan countries. The dispute centers on the May 11 imprisonment of Fredi Beleri, an ethnic Greek mayoral candidate in Himare, a small coastal town with a significant Greek community. The Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, 'This decision will impact the EU’s relationship with Albania, which depends on European values and the rule of law.' Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis recently stated that Beleri's case 'overshadows' Greek-Albanian relations and undermines recent progress. Both leaders have visited each other's countries in recent weeks. Beleri won the mayoral election while in pretrial detention but has not been sworn in after Albanian courts rejected multiple applications for his release or for permission to be sworn in. He is accused of vote buying and alleged witness tampering, according to his lawyer, but has pleaded innocent. His son, Petros Beleri, claims the arrest served political purposes, stating that it intimidated voters, particularly in ethnic Albanian villages, leading to lost votes. Opposition leaders, including former Justice Minister Ili Maniani and former Prime Minister Sali Berisha, describe the arrest as interference in free elections and label Beleri a political prisoner. The Council of Europe has also raised concerns, citing the presumption of innocence. Rama campaigned for the socialist incumbent, Jorgo Goro, and criticized Beleri leading up to the election. According to Vangelis Doules, leader of the Omonoia party, control over land in Himare is at stake, as the region holds valuable coastal property. Doules claims that many applications from Greeks for land registration remain unresolved, while Rama's supporters have acquired key estates. Land disputes in Albania stem partly from property redistribution during and after communist rule. The Albanian Ombudsman reports that pre-communist landowners are still owed significant compensation for expropriated land. Many land title claims remain unsettled due to lost documents, corruption, and complex legal history. Law 20, passed in 2020, was intended to clarify property rights, but progress has been slow. The European Commission's 2022 report notes widespread inaccuracies in Albania’s land registry. Land use and development remain contentious, especially as tourism is a government priority and much of the sought-after coastline is owned by ethnic Greeks. Doules alleges an anti-Greek agenda, citing obstacles for ethnic Greeks in property ownership and local representation. Beleri has challenged government decisions favoring strategic investors connected to government officials. Rama denies any political interference, asserting the independence of Albania's judiciary. He further claims he was informed of Beleri’s arrest after the operation had begun. Longstanding land ownership issues complicate development in Albania and contribute to ongoing diplomatic tensions between Greece and Albania.

Viongozi hao wawili wametembeleana hivi karibuni. Beleri alishinda uchaguzi wa umeya akiwa bado rumande lakini hajathibitishwa rasmi baada ya mahakama za Albania kukataa maombi kadhaa ya kuachiliwa au kuruhusiwa kuapishwa akiwa gerezani. Anashutumiwa kununua kura na kuingilia mashahidi, kwa mujibu wa wakili wake, lakini amekanusha mashtaka hayo. Mwanawe, Petros Beleri, anadai kukamatwa kwake kulitumiwa kisiasa, akisema watu walitishwa, hasa katika vijiji vya Waalbani, na hivyo kupoteza kura nyingi. Viongozi wa upinzani kama Waziri wa zamani wa Sheria Ili Maniani na Waziri Mkuu wa zamani Sali Berisha, wanalalamika kuwa tukio hilo ni kuingilia uchaguzi huru na kumwona Beleri kama mfungwa wa kisiasa. Baraza la Ulaya pia limeonyesha wasiwasi wake, likisema haki ya kutoonewa hatia imekiukwa. Rama alifanya kampeni kwa niaba ya mtetezi wa chama cha siasa, Jorgo Goro, na kumkosoa Beleri kabla ya uchaguzi. Kulingana na kiongozi wa chama cha Omonoia, Vangelis Doules, udhibiti wa ardhi Himare ndio wenye mgogoro mkubwa kwani eneo hilo lina ardhi yenye thamani kubwa kando ya pwani. Doules anasema maombi mengi ya Wagiriki kuandikishwa kwa ardhi bado hayajashughulikiwa, huku wafuasi wa Rama wakipata maeneo muhimu. Migogoro ya ardhi nchini Albania inatokana pia na ugawaji wa ardhi wakati na baada ya utawala wa kikomunisti. Mdhibiti wa serikali wa Albania anasema wamiliki ardhi kabla ya ukomunisti bado wanadai fidia kubwa kwa ardhi iliyonyang'anywa. Madai mengi ya umiliki ardhi hayajatatuliwa kutokana na hati kupotea, rushwa, na historia ya kisheria yenye utata. Sheria ya 20 iliyopitishwa mwaka 2020 ililengwa kuweka wazi haki za umiliki, lakini maendeleo ni kidogo. Ripoti ya Tume ya Ulaya ya 2022 inaeleza dosari nyingi kwenye daftari la umiliki wa ardhi Albania. Matumizi na maendeleo ya ardhi ni suala lenye utata, hasa utalii ukipewa kipaumbele na serikali na sehemu kubwa ya pwani inamilikiwa na Wagiriki wa Albania. Doules anadai kuna ajenda dhidi ya Wagiriki, akitaja vikwazo kwa Wagiriki wa Albania kupata ardhi na uwakilishi wa eneo lao. Beleri amepinga maamuzi ya serikali yanayopendelea wawekezaji wakubwa walio na uhusiano na viongozi wa serikali. Rama anakataa madai ya kuingilia mchakato wa kisheria, akisema mahakama ni huru. Pia anasema alijulishwa kuhusu kukamatwa kwa Beleri baada ya operesheni kuanza. Matatizo ya muda mrefu kuhusu umiliki ardhi yanakwamisha maendeleo Albania na kuchochea mvutano wa kidiplomasia kati ya Albania na Ugiriki.

article_content: Education ministers from across the Global South have reaffirmed their commitment to closing the digital divide for students. During a virtual meeting at India's second Voice of Global South Summit, they stressed the need to overcome digital barriers and create affordable tech solutions and educational resources, especially in local languages. Ministers and dignitaries from 14 nations—including Botswana, Brunei, Georgia, among others—participated in the session. Together, they emphasized the vital role teachers play worldwide and the importance of supporting their growth through capacity-building and exchange programs. The participants agreed to promote innovation, share best practices, and collaborate across borders to improve teaching, skill-building, and opportunities for academic partnerships through exchange programs for students and faculty. India's Education Minister, Dharmendra Pradhan, highlighted the New Education Policy as a possible model for developing countries to adopt agile and comprehensive educational strategies. Other education leaders shared their experiences and praised India’s dedication to encouraging cooperation among Global South countries. This summit follows the first Voice of Global South Summit and aims to keep up the momentum by strengthening digital skills, promoting inclusive education, and preparing shared input for international discussions. Deliberations from this event will help shape conversations at the upcoming G20 Virtual Summit hosted by India on November 22. The focus remains on making education accessible, equitable, and sustainable, all under the summit’s theme: 'Together, for Everyone’s Growth, with Everyone’s Trust.'

article_content: Recent research shows that women with breast cancer benefit just as much from a three-week course of radiotherapy as from the conventional five-week treatment. Receiving fewer sessions leads to less patient fatigue and reduces harm to healthy tissue. Many UK hospitals have adopted this approach since 2008, resulting in cost savings for the NHS and greater convenience for patients. Long-term studies involving 4,500 British women treated for early-stage breast cancer demonstrate that cancer recurrence rates with the shorter, 15-session program match those of the longer plan, while side effects are significantly reduced. John Yarnold of The Institute of Cancer Research and The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust says these findings confirm a safe, effective, and reassuring treatment. Researchers are now exploring if an even shorter, one-week course of radiotherapy can be as effective. The Fast-Forward trial is investigating whether five daily treatments in one week can offer comparable results to the established three-week, 15-session schedule. Kate Law of Cancer Research UK highlights the physical and emotional benefits for patients who need fewer hospital visits. Cancer prevention research has also advanced. Harvard School of Public Health found that colonoscopy screenings every ten years could prevent up to 40% of colorectal cancers in older adults. Analysis of over 1,800 colorectal cancer cases showed that colonoscopy, and the similar sigmoidoscopy, both lower the risk of developing and dying from the disease, though only colonoscopy provides protection against cancers in the upper colon. In the UK, around 41,000 people are diagnosed with bowel cancer each year and 16,000 die from it. The findings, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, confirm the value of colonoscopy for early detection and prevention. Sally Greenbrook of Breakthrough Breast Cancer praises the NHS for offering the highest quality care by using shorter radiotherapy regimens. Most women who have breast-conserving surgery also receive radiotherapy to eliminate any remaining cancer cells—about 30,000 women in the UK each year. As more patients survive cancer, reducing long-term side effects of treatment is increasingly important.

Kadri idadi ya wagonjwa waliopona inavyoongezeka, kupunguza madhara ya muda mrefu kunazidi kuwa muhimu.

article_content: House Republicans are struggling to unite, remaining paralyzed without consensus on a new Speaker. At the center of the turmoil is a broader question about the party’s identity, as highlighted by Representative Kat Cammack (R-Fla.): "Are we the party of Reagan?" Ten months after that question was raised, the answer appears to be no. The party’s far-right faction recently ousted House Speaker Kevin McCarthy, then mounted an unsuccessful campaign to elect Ohio Representative Jim Jordan—a figure former Speaker John Boehner once famously called a “legislative terrorist.” This unrest reflects the GOP's transformation over the past decade from Reagan-era ideology to a worldview influenced by the John Birch Society (JBS), a far-right group from the 1950s and 1960s that was known for conspiratorial thinking and anti-communism. Where conservative leaders once tried to marginalize the Birchers, their ideas now have a strong presence within the party. These include widespread conspiracy theories, isolationist foreign policy, and skepticism of federal law enforcement—echoed recently by Rep. Matt Gaetz (R-Fla.), who led efforts to remove McCarthy. Even the tactics of the Birchers—pressure campaigns and threats—have reappeared in recent leadership contests. What it means to be a Republican or a conservative has changed. Themes originating with the JBS now dominate Republican politics, a trend that accelerated with Donald Trump’s rise. The article reviews the JBS’s origins—founded in 1958 by businessman Robert Welch, named for an army officer killed by Chinese communists—and its dedication to rooting out communism, which led to extreme conspiracy theories. The JBS accused leaders like President Dwight Eisenhower of being communist agents and criticized measures like water fluoridation. While mainstream Americans rejected these views and the group shrank in the 1970s, the JBS’s fringe ideas endured, influencing activists such as Phyllis Schlafly and Pat Robertson, and eventually informing parts of Republican cultural policy. Through the 1980s and 1990s, the party sometimes aligned with fringe ideas but kept them at the margins; under George W. Bush, for example, the administration favored international alliances and inclusive policies, despite campaign stops at conservative institutions. By the end of Bush’s presidency, however, the party’s right flank rejected bipartisan initiatives like immigration reform and economic rescue measures. The election of Barack Obama revived conservative fringe conspiracies, with figures like Sarah Palin promoting baseless claims about Obama’s citizenship. The Tea Party further challenged GOP leadership from the right, setting the stage for Donald Trump’s rise. Several factors explain the ascent of the far right: learning from past failures, Republican leaders courting the fringe for electoral gain, and changing media and economic landscapes fueling alienation among many white voters. The isolationist and anti-elite sentiment grew, especially after the Cold War and during the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. The rise of social media and partisan media made fringe voices more influential and harder for party leaders to control. Despite the current strength of the far right (“MAGA” and Trump-aligned factions), continued electoral losses could eventually reduce their influence, as occurred with previous far-right movements. Matthew Dallek, professor at George Washington University’s Graduate School of Political Management and author of 'Birchers: How the John Birch Society Radicalized the American Right,' provides these insights. The article is part of TIME’s 'Made by History' series, which offers context from academic historians.

Katika kiini cha mzozo huu kuna swali kubwa kuhusu utambulisho wa chama, kama alivyouliza Mwakilishi Kat Cammack (R-Fla.): "Je, sisi ni chama cha Reagan?" Miezi kumi baadaye, jibu linaonekana kuwa hapana. Kikundi cha mrengo mkali wa kulia ndani ya chama kilimuondoa Spika Kevin McCarthy, kisha kikajaribu bila mafanikio kumchagua Mwakilishi wa Ohio, Jim Jordan—mtu ambaye aliyekuwa Spika John Boehner alimwita “gaidi wa sheria.” Ghasia hizi zinaashiria mabadiliko ndani ya GOP katika muongo uliopita kutoka kwa itikadi ya Reagan kwenda katika mwelekeo wenye athari za John Birch Society (JBS), kikundi cha mrengo mkali wa kulia kutoka miaka ya 1950 na 1960 kilichojulikana kwa fikra za njama na upinzani mkali dhidi ya ukomunisti. Wakati viongozi wa kihafidhina zamani walijaribu kuwaweka pembeni Birchers, sasa mawazo yao yamepata nguvu ndani ya chama. Haya ni pamoja na nadharia mbalimbali za njama, sera za kujitenga kimataifa, na wasiwasi na vyombo vya sheria vya serikali kuu—kama ilivyoonyeshwa na Mwakilishi Matt Gaetz (R-Fla.), aliyekuwa mstari wa mbele katika kumng'oa McCarthy. Hata mbinu za Birchers—kampeni za shinikizo na vitisho—zimeonekana tena kwenye kinyang'anyiro cha uongozi wa sasa. Maana ya kuwa Republican au mhafidhina imebadilika. Mawazo yaliyotokana na JBS sasa yametawala siasa za Republican, jambo lililokuwa la haraka zaidi kuanzia wakati wa Donald Trump. Makala hii inachunguza chimbuko la JBS—lilianzishwa mwaka 1958 na mfanyabiashara Robert Welch na kupewa jina la afisa wa jeshi aliyeuawa na Wakomunisti wa China—na harakati zake za kupambana na ukomunisti zilizochangia nadharia kali za njama. JBS iliwatuhumu viongozi kama Rais Dwight Eisenhower kuwa mawakala wa wakomunisti na kupinga mikakati kama kuweka floridi kwenye maji ya kunywa. Ingawa Wamarekani wengi walikataa maoni haya na kikundi kikadidimia miaka ya 1970, mawazo ya JBS yaliendelea na kuwaathiri wanaharakati kama Phyllis Schlafly na Pat Robertson na baadaye kuathiri baadhi ya sera za kitamaduni za Republican. Miaka ya 1980 na 1990, chama kiliwahi kushirikiana kwa kiasi na mawazo ya pembeni ila kiliendelea kuuepuka; chini ya George W. Bush, kwa mfano, serikali ilisisitiza ushirikiano wa kimataifa na sera jumuishi, ingawa kulikuwa na ziara kwenye taasisi za kihafidhina. Mwisho wa utawala wa Bush, hata hivyo, asasi za mrengo wa kulia zilikataa juhudi za ushirikiano kama mageuzi ya uhamiaji na mipango ya kufufua uchumi. Uchaguzi wa Barack Obama uliamsha tena nadharia za njama na upinzani kutoka kwa baadhi ya viongozi wa Republican kama Sarah Palin aliyeeneza uvumi usio na msingi kuhusu uraia wa Obama. Tea Party ilichochea upinzani zaidi dhidi ya uongozi wa GOP kutoka upande wa kulia, ikiandaa mazingira ya Trump. Sababu kadhaa zimechangia kukua kwa mrengo mkali wa kulia: kujifunza kutokana na makosa ya zamani, viongozi wa Republican kuwavuta pembezoni ili wapate kura, na mabadiliko ya vyombo vya habari na uchumi yaliyoongeza kutengwa kwa Wamarekani weupe wengi. Hisia za kujitenga na kuupinga mfumo ziliongezeka, hasa baada ya Vita Baridi na wakati wa vita vya Afghanistan na Iraq. Kuongezeka kwa mitandao ya kijamii na vyombo vya habari vyenye ushabiki kumeongeza usemi wa pembezoni na kufanya iwe vigumu kwa viongozi wa chama kuvidhibiti. Licha ya nguvu za sasa za mrengo mkali wa kulia (“MAGA” na wanamgambo wa Trump), kupoteza uchaguzi mara kwa mara kunaweza kupunguza ushawishi wao, kama ilivyojitokeza kwenye harakati za zamani za mrengo mkali wa kulia. Matthew Dallek, profesa katika Chuo Kikuu cha George Washington na mwandishi wa 'Birchers: How the John Birch Society Radicalized the American Right,' anatoa mawazo haya. Makala hii ni sehemu ya mfululizo wa 'Made by History' wa TIME, unaotoa muktadha kutoka kwa wanahistoria wa kitaaluma.

article_content: In a historic shift for Argentina, right-wing populist Javier Milei won the presidency in a resounding victory over Economy Minister Sergio Massa, capturing 55.7% of the vote to Massa's 44.3%. Milei, a libertarian economist and first-time lawmaker, secured all but three of the nation’s 24 provinces. His win marks a departure from decades of Peronist dominance in Argentine politics. Known for his combative style and fervent criticism of the political establishment, Milei campaigned on sweeping government reforms. He has vowed to privatize various state-run entities, including media outlets and energy firm YPF—though he stressed that YPF must first be strengthened to ensure beneficial privatization. Milei’s economic agenda includes dollarizing the economy, sharply reducing state spending, and eliminating the Central Bank, along with key ministries such as health and education. Milei’s rhetoric, symbolism—famously wielding a chainsaw at rallies—and alignment with global right-wing figures such as former U.S. President Donald Trump and Brazil’s ex-president Jair Bolsonaro resonated with voters frustrated by an annual inflation rate exceeding 140% and a poverty rate of 40%. After his victory, Milei told Radio Mitre he intends to travel to the United States and Israel before taking office on December 10, with the U.S. visit having a 'spiritual connotation' that includes meetings with rabbis in Miami and New York. A vocal supporter of Israel, Milei has indicated his wish to move Argentina’s embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. Celebrations broke out outside Milei’s campaign headquarters, with supporters waving Argentine and Gadsden flags— the latter bearing the movement’s 'Don’t Tread On Me' slogan. Some supporters voiced strong hope in Milei’s promised reforms, while experts like Benjamin Gedan and Andrei Roman pointed to potential volatility ahead due to Milei’s inexperience and unconventional proposals. Milei's campaign focused heavily on the economy, blaming past administrations for unchecked state spending and monetary expansion. His opponent Massa cautioned that Milei’s proposed elimination of key ministries and cuts to public services could endanger programs many Argentines rely on, a position Milei sought to counter by promising not to privatize education, healthcare, or soccer clubs. Milei holds conservative views on social issues, opposing sex education, feminist policies, and abortion, and questioning climate change’s anthropogenic causes. His campaign has drawn global attention amid a polarized political climate. Ultimately, Milei’s triumphant rise—from television commentator to Congress member to president—highlights widespread public discontent and a demand for dramatic change.

Milei, mchumi wa kiliberali na mbunge wa mara ya kwanza, alipata ushindi katika majimbo yote isipokuwa matatu kati ya 24. Ushindi huu ni mwamko mpya baada ya miongo kadhaa ya utawala wa Peronist nchini Argentina. Akitambulika kwa mtindo wake wa kukabiliana vikali na ukosoaji wa tabaka la wanasiasa, Milei aliendesha kampeni ya mageuzi makubwa ya serikali. Ameahidi kubinafsisha mashirika mbalimbali ya umma ikiwemo vyombo vya habari na kampuni ya nishati ya YPF—ingawa alisisitiza kuwa YPF inahitaji kuboreshwa kwanza ili kuuza kwa manufaa ya Wargentinia. Ujumbe na alama za Milei—ikiwa ni pamoja na kubeba chainsaw kwenye mikutano yake—na ushirikiano na viongozi wa kimataifa wa mrengo wa kulia kama aliyekuwa rais wa Marekani Donald Trump na rais wa zamani wa Brazil Jair Bolsonaro, vilikuwa na mvuto kwa wananchi waliochoshwa na mfumuko wa bei wa kila mwaka unaozidi asilimia 140 na viwango vya umaskini vya asilimia 40. Baada ya ushindi, Milei aliambia Radio Mitre kwamba ana mpango wa kusafiri Marekani na Israel kabla ya kuapishwa Desemba 10, ambapo ziara ya Marekani ina lengo la kiroho na inajumuisha kukutana na marabi huko Miami na New York. Baadhi ya wafuasi waliashiria matumaini makubwa kwa mageuzi aliyoyaahidi, huku wataalamu kama Benjamin Gedan na Andrei Roman wakionya juu ya hatari zinazoweza kutokana na ukosefu wa uzoefu na mapendekezo yasiyo ya kawaida ya Milei. Kampeni ya Milei ililenga zaidi masuala ya uchumi, akilaumu tawala zilizopita kwa matumizi makubwa ya serikali na uchapishaji wa fedha kupita kiasi. Mpinzani wake Massa aliwaonya Wargentinia kwamba mipango ya Milei ya kufuta wizara muhimu na kupunguza huduma za umma inaweza kuhatarisha mipango muhimu ya jamii, mtazamo ambao Milei alijaribu kuukataa kwa kuahidi kutobinafsisha elimu, afya, wala vilabu vya soka. Milei ana msimamo wa kihafidhina kuhusu masuala ya kijamii, akipinga elimu ya ngono, sera za kifeministi, na utoaji mimba, na anahoji mchango wa binadamu kwenye mabadiliko ya tabianchi. Kampeni yake imesababisha vichwa vya habari kimataifa kwenye mazingira yenye mgawanyiko wa kisiasa. Hatimaye, kupanda kwa Milei kutoka mchangiaji wa televisheni hadi mbunge na sasa rais kunaonesha uwazi wa hali ya kutoridhika kwa umma na hitaji la mabadiliko makubwa.

article_content: Quantum technology promises faster computing and heightened security for communications. Behind these developments are quantum networks, which use optical fiber nodes equipped with qubits and single-photon sources. Rare-earth (RE) atoms and ions, especially embedded in solid materials, act as efficient single-photon generators. Since these RE-doped materials are compatible with fiber systems and emit photons across a wide spectral range, they can be applied in telecommunications, quantum random number generation, and sophisticated imaging. In the past, most RE-based single-photon sources operated only under cryogenic, ultra-cold conditions, making them costly and difficult to implement widely. But in a recent study published in Physical Review Applied (October 16, 2023), researchers from Tokyo University of Science—led by Associate Professor Kaoru Sanaka—achieved a significant milestone: a single-photon source made with ytterbium ions (Yb3+) within amorphous silica optical fiber that works at room temperature. This means expensive cooling systems are no longer required, which could make quantum networks far more affordable and accessible. Dr. Sanaka explains that their optical fiber, doped with active RE elements, can directly generate single-photon emissions under normal conditions. These sources carefully control the statistical characteristics of individual photons, which are light's basic energy units. Experimental measurements confirmed genuine single-photon emission: when excitation and detection aligned with no delay, they observed a value below 0.5, showing true single-photon behavior. Ytterbium is well-suited to this application, having a straightforward energy-level structure and a long fluorescence lifetime (around one millisecond). The team used a heat-and-pull method to taper commercially produced ytterbium-doped fiber, reducing its diameter and tuning its optical features. In these tapered fibers, individual RE atoms give off photons when excited by laser light. The spacing between them affects whether the emissions appear as clusters or as discrete points. To validate these results, the team applied autocorrelation analysis—a way to examine similarities between a signal and its delayed version—to investigate the photon emission pattern. Their data revealed both non-resonant and single-ion emission events within the doped fiber. While further optimization could improve photon quality and quantity, this new ytterbium-doped fiber can be produced and used without the need for cooling. This overcomes a significant challenge and opens opportunities in quantum communication, truly random number generators, innovative logic operations, and breakthroughs in imaging that exceed traditional limits. Dr. Sanaka concludes that this affordable, room-temperature single-photon source will drive the growth of next-generation quantum technologies.
translated_content: Teknolojia ya kwanta inatoa matumaini ya kuharakisha mahesabu na kuongeza usalama kwenye mawasiliano. Katika maendeleo haya, mitandao ya kwanta hutumia nyuzi za macho zilizounganishwa na qubits na vyanzo vya fotoni moja. Atomi na ayoni za nadra (RE), hasa zilizowekwa kwenye vifaa imara, ni vyanzo bora vya fotoni moja. Vifaa hivi vilivyo na RE vinapatana na mifumo ya nyuzi na hutuma fotoni katika wigo mpana, hivyo vina matumizi kama vile mawasiliano ya nyuzi, uzalishaji wa nambari nasibu za kwanta na uchanganuzi wa picha za hali ya juu. Awali, vyanzo vingi vya fotoni moja vya RE vilihitaji halijoto ya chini sana (baridi sana), na hivyo kufanya gharama na matumizi yake kuwa magumu. Lakini kwenye utafiti uliochapishwa katika Physical Review Applied (16 Oktoba 2023), watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Sayansi cha Tokyo wakiongozwa na Profesa Mshiriki Kaoru Sanaka walifanikiwa kutengeneza chanzo cha fotoni moja kwa kutumia ayoni za ytterbium (Yb3+) kwenye nyuzi za silika zisizo na mpangilio ambacho hufanya kazi katika halijoto ya kawaida. Hii inaondoa hitaji la mifumo ya baridi ghali na kufanya mitandao ya kwanta ipatikane kwa urahisi na kwa gharama nafuu. Dkt. Sanaka anaeleza kuwa nyuzi zao za macho zenye vipengele hai vya RE zinaweza kutoa fotoni moja moja moja kwa moja kwenye hali ya kawaida. Vyanzo hivi hudhibiti sifa maalum za fotoni moja, ambazo ndizo sehemu ndogo kabisa za nishati ya mwanga. Vipimo vilionyesha utoaji wa fotoni moja: wakati kuchochewa na kugundua hakukuwa na ucheleweshaji, ilipimwa thamani chini ya 0.5, ikiashiria utoaji halisi wa fotoni moja. Ytterbium inafaa sana kwa matumizi haya ikiwa na muundo rahisi wa nishati na muda mrefu wa mwako wa takribani milisekunde moja. Timu ilitumia mbinu ya kupasha moto na kuvuta kutanua nyuzi za ytterbium zilizotengenezwa kibiashara, wakapunguza kipenyo na kurekebisha sifa zake za macho. Ndani ya nyuzi hizi zilizotengenezwa, atomi za RE hutoa fotoni zinapochochewa na mwanga wa leza. Umbali kati ya atomi huathiri kama mwanga wao utaonekana kama kikundi au kama chembe tofauti. Ili kuthibitisha matokeo, timu ilitumia uchambuzi wa ulinganifu wa kiotomatiki—njia inayolinganishwa ishara na matoleo yake yaliyocheleweshwa—kutathmini muundo wa utoaji wa fotoni. Matokeo yao yalionyesha utoaji usio wa resonansi pamoja na utoaji wa fotoni kutoka kwa ion moja moja ndani ya nyuzi zilizo na ytterbium. Ingawa bado kuna nafasi ya kuboresha wingi na ubora wa fotoni, nyuzi hizi mpya zenye ytterbium zinaweza kutengenezwa na kutumika bila baridi. Hili linaondoa kizingiti kikubwa, na linafungua fursa katika mawasiliano ya kwanta, utengenezaji wa nambari za nasibu za kweli, uendeshaji wa mantiki wa kisasa, na mafanikio kwenye uchanganuzi wa picha unaozidi mipaka ya kawaida. Dkt. Sanaka anahitimisha kuwa chanzo hiki cha bei nafuu cha fotoni moja kinachofanya kazi kwenye halijoto ya kawaida kitawezesha maendeleo ya teknolojia za kwanta za kisasa.

article_content: Virender Sehwag delivered a career-best one-day innings of 175 runs as India opened their 2011 Cricket World Cup campaign with a convincing 87-run win over co-hosts Bangladesh in Dhaka on Saturday. Opening batsman Sehwag partnered with Virat Kohli for a remarkable 203-run stand for the third wicket. Kohli remained unbeaten on 100, helping India reach a total of 370 for 4 wickets in 50 overs—one of the highest scores in tournament history. In response, Bangladesh put up a determined effort but finished on 283 for 9 wickets, losing five wickets for just 47 runs in the last 10 overs. Sehwag's powerful 140-ball knock included 14 fours and five sixes, matching Kapil Dev's famous 175 not out in 1983—the fourth-highest individual score in World Cup matches. Sehwag told reporters, “It was a good start for the team. I called this a revenge game and we have won. Bangladesh can compete in one-day matches though not as much in Tests, but today they could not. Special thanks to my physio for getting me ready while carrying some injuries.” Bangladesh elected to field after winning the toss. Sehwag opened with Sachin Tendulkar—the leading run-scorer in ODIs and Tests—who managed 28 runs from 29 balls before being run out. Gautam Gambhir, who usually opens in Test matches, scored 39 runs at a run-a-ball before being dismissed at 152 for 2 in the 24th over, bringing Kohli to the crease. Kohli reached his fourth ODI century from just 83 balls, hitting eight boundaries and two sixes. Bangladesh seemed in a good position at 188 for 2, but opener Tamim Iqbal, who top-scored with 70, was dismissed as the second wicket for Munaf Patel. Captain Shakib Al Hasan was caught by Harbhajan Singh for 55, which signaled the end of Bangladesh's hopes. Spinner Harbhajan Singh claimed a wicket and a runout, while Munaf Patel was India's top bowler with figures of 4 for 48 from 10 overs as India started their Group B campaign on a high note. Group B also features South Africa, England, and the West Indies. Group A will begin on Sunday, with New Zealand facing Kenya in Chennai, India, and hosts Sri Lanka playing Canada. Other Group A teams include Australia (the defending champions), Pakistan, and Zimbabwe.

Sehwag, pamoja na Virat Kohli, waliunda ushirikiano mkubwa wa mbio 203 kwa goli la tatu. Kohli alibaki uwanjani na kufikisha 100, akisaidia India kupata jumla ya mabao 370 kwa waliopoteza wiketi 4 katika overs 50—moja ya skor kubwa zaidi katika historia ya mashindano. Spinner Harbhajan Singh alipata wiketi na runout, huku Munaf Patel akiwa mchezaji bora wa bowling kwa India na hesabu ya 4 kwa 48 katika overs 10, India wakianza kampeni yao ya Kundi B vyema. Kundi B pia lina Afrika Kusini, England na West Indies. Kundi A litaanza Jumapili, New Zealand watacheza na Kenya huko Chennai, India, na wenyeji Sri Lanka kucheza na Canada. article_content: Patients who experience poor hospital care within the NHS are often failed because their complaints go unheard and valuable lessons are not learned, warns NHS Ombudsman Dame Julie Mellor. She highlighted that many patients feel too frightened to voice concerns about their treatment, fearing that it may affect the care they receive. Mellor described a negative environment in which patients are met with defensiveness, inadequate explanations, and missed opportunities for meaningful improvement. A new NHS Ombudsman report recommends significant reforms so that complaints are addressed more quickly, and action is taken before the quality of care is compromised. Suggested changes include establishing a 24-hour free advice service for patients, assigning each patient a named senior contact for concerns, and regularly collecting feedback. Labour MP Ann Clwyd, whose husband suffered serious failings in care, has submitted these recommendations to an independent review expected to release findings next month. Dame Julie told the Daily Telegraph that hospitals frequently fail to learn from serious incidents, increasing the risk that such errors will recur. Research indicates that more than half of NHS patients who consider making a complaint ultimately do not proceed—often due to concerns about bureaucracy or skepticism that it will make a difference. According to Dame Julie, patients and carers often contact the NHS Ombudsman out of desperation and frustration, as hospital complaints departments have frequently failed to provide even basic explanations or apologies. The Ombudsman's report identifies three primary motivations for complaints: seeking a clear explanation, acknowledgment and proper apology for mistakes, and a desire to prevent similar incidents from happening to others. The report also found that NHS staff are sometimes unwilling to investigate complaints properly because they fear repercussions for themselves or worry about challenging the organizational hierarchy. Overcoming this defensiveness requires fundamental cultural change within the NHS, says Mellor. Last month, Dame Julie pledged to increase the number of cases the Ombudsman examines tenfold. Meanwhile, a major review has also called for criminal penalties for NHS staff who intentionally or recklessly harm patients, and legal consequences for leaders who demonstrate negligence.
translated_content: Wagonjwa wanaopata huduma duni hospitalini ndani ya NHS mara nyingi wanashindwa kwa sababu malalamiko yao hayasikilizwi na masomo muhimu hayajifunzi, anaonya Ombudsman wa NHS Dame Julie Mellor. Amebainisha kuwa wagonjwa wengi wanaogopa kutoa malalamiko kuhusu matibabu wanayopata wakihofia huenda ikaathiri huduma zao. Mellor alielezea hali hasi ambako wagonjwa hukutana na utetezi, maelezo yasiyotosha, na fursa zilizopotezwa za kuboresha huduma. Ripoti mpya ya Ombudsman wa NHS inapendekeza mageuzi makubwa ili malalamiko yashughulikiwe kwa haraka zaidi na hatua zichukuliwe kabla ubora wa huduma haujaathirika. Mabadiliko yanayopendekezwa ni pamoja na kuanzisha huduma ya ushauri bure ya masaa 24 kwa wagonjwa, kumpa kila mgonjwa jina la mtu mkuu wa mawasiliano wa kushughulikia malalamiko, na kukusanya maoni mara kwa mara. Mbunge wa Labour Ann Clwyd, ambaye mume wake alipata matatizo makubwa ya huduma, amepeleka mapendekezo haya kwenye mapitio huru yanayotarajiwa kutoa ripoti mwezi ujao. Dame Julie aliambia Daily Telegraph kwamba hospitali mara nyingi hushindwa kujifunza kutokana na matukio makubwa, na hivyo kuongeza uwezekano wa makosa hayo kurudiwa. Utafiti umeonyesha kuwa zaidi ya nusu ya wagonjwa wa NHS wanaofikiria kulalamika mwishowe hawafanyi hivyo—mara nyingi kwa sababu ya kuhofia urasimu au kutokuamini kuwa hatua yoyote itachukuliwa. Kulingana na Dame Julie, wagonjwa na walezi mara nyingi huwasiliana na Ombudsman wa NHS wakiwa wamekata tamaa na kufadhaika, kwani idara za malalamiko hospitalini mara kadhaa zimeshindwa kutoa hata maelezo ya msingi au pole. Ripoti ya Ombudsman inatambua sababu tatu kuu za malalamiko: kutafuta maelezo wazi, kutambua makosa na kuomba msamaha unaostahili, na nia ya kuzuia tukio kama hilo kutokea kwa wengine. Ripoti hiyo pia imegundua kuwa wafanyakazi wa NHS wakati mwingine hukwepa kuchunguza malalamiko ipasavyo kwa sababu wanaogopa athari kwao wenyewe au kuhofia kupinga uongozi. Kushinda utetezi huu kunahitaji mabadiliko ya kimsingi ya utamaduni ndani ya NHS, anasema Mellor. article_content: Kenneth Edelin, a prominent Boston physician central to a landmark abortion case in the 1970s, died Monday morning in Sarasota, Florida, at age 74 after a battle with cancer, his wife Barbara confirmed. Barbara Edelin described her husband as an influential teacher and mentor who guided many young doctors throughout his career. She highlighted his commitment to advocating for women’s reproductive rights, especially for women of color and minority groups. Edelin was motivated to become a doctor after his mother died of breast cancer during his childhood, Barbara noted. In 1975, Edelin made national headlines when he was convicted of manslaughter for performing an abortion. This occurred two years after the U.S. Supreme Court’s Roe v. Wade decision legalized abortion. The Massachusetts Supreme Court later overturned Edelin’s conviction, a decision that contributed significantly to establishing legal standards for abortion and defining when human life begins. Following the case, Edelin became a vocal activist for reproductive rights, serving as chairman of the board of Planned Parenthood and joining the NAACP Legal Defense Fund’s senior board in 1986. LDF’s Director-Counsel, Sherrilyn Ifill, described Edelin as a fearless advocate for civil rights. Edelin was the first Black chief resident in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at Boston City Hospital. In his memoir, 'Broken Justice: A True Story of Race, Sex and Revenge in a Boston Courtroom,' Edelin recounted his experiences and emphasized the connections between reproductive rights and civil rights, asserting that the denial of both is an attempt to control other people's bodies.
translated_content: Kenneth Edelin, daktari maarufu wa Boston aliyekuwa katikati ya kesi ya kihistoria kuhusu utoaji mimba katika miaka ya 1970, alifariki Jumatatu asubuhi huko Sarasota, Florida, akiwa na umri wa miaka 74 baada ya kuugua saratani, mkewe Barbara amethibitisha. Barbara Edelin alielezea mumewe kama mwalimu mwenye ushawishi na mshauri ambaye aliwasaidia madaktari wengi wachanga wakati wa kazi yake. Pia alisisitiza kujitolea kwake kutetea haki za uzazi za wanawake, hasa wanawake wa rangi na makundi ya walio wachache. Barbara alisema kuwa Edelin alihamasika kuwa daktari baada ya mama yake kufariki kutokana na saratani ya matiti alipokuwa mtoto. Mwaka 1975, Edelin alipata umaarufu wa kitaifa baada ya kuhukumiwa kwa kosa la mauaji bila kukusudia kwa kufanya utoaji mimba. Hii ilitokea miaka miwili baada ya uamuzi wa Mahakama Kuu ya Marekani wa Roe v. Wade ulioruhusu utoaji mimba. Mahakama Kuu ya Massachusetts baadaye ilibatilisha hukumu ya Edelin, uamuzi uliochangia sana kuweka viwango vya kisheria kuhusu utoaji mimba na kufafanua lini maisha ya binadamu huanza. Baada ya kesi hiyo, Edelin alikua mtetezi maarufu wa haki za uzazi, akihudumu kama mwenyekiti wa bodi ya Planned Parenthood na kujiunga na bodi ya juu ya NAACP Legal Defense Fund mwaka 1986. Sherrilyn Ifill, Mkurugenzi-Mshauri wa LDF, alimtaja Edelin kama mtetezi jasiri wa haki za kiraia. Edelin alikuwa mtu wa kwanza mweusi kuwa mkuu mkazi wa Idara ya Uzazi na Magonjwa ya Wanawake katika Hospitali ya Boston City. Katika wasifu wake, 'Broken Justice: A True Story of Race, Sex and Revenge in a Boston Courtroom,' Edelin alielezea uzoefu wake na kusisitiza uhusiano kati ya haki za uzazi na haki za kiraia, akieleza kuwa kunyimwa yote mawili ni jaribio la kudhibiti miili ya watu wengine.

article_content: The Delhi Directorate of Education’s Nursery Primary Branch will organize a State-level Art Exhibition cum Competition for students for the 2023-24 session, tentatively in the first week of November. A circular from the DoE on Wednesday stated that students perform better when their creativity is recognized, with appreciation acting as a strong motivator. The circular highlighted that displaying students’ artwork can boost confidence, encourage self-expression, provide a sense of accomplishment, and improve verbal communication skills. Art is also seen as a way to appreciate different cultures and promote understanding. As per the DoE’s guidelines, schools are to provide full guidance and ample practice opportunities to all primary students to ensure better participation in the school-level painting/drawing competition. Students are also encouraged to practice at home over the autumn break. All schools are instructed to organize a school-level painting/drawing competition by October 30 and select the two best entries. These entries are to be submitted to the Nursery Primary Branch with a covering letter and certificate by October 31. The primary in-charge must certify the competition’s completion and selection process on official school letterhead, and this should be forwarded by the Head of School to the Nursery Primary Branch as per the DoE’s guidelines.

article_content: Johnny Depp and Amber Heard married in an intimate ceremony at their Los Angeles home on Tuesday, February 3, 2015. The celebrations are set to continue this weekend, as the newlyweds plan to host about 50 guests for a second ceremony at Depp's private island in the Bahamas. Amber Heard, known for her role in Magic Mike XXL, is reportedly telling friends she will wear a custom wedding gown by designer Stella McCartney, according to sources including Us Weekly, though this has not been officially confirmed. The couple first met while working together on the 2011 film The Rum Diary. Their upcoming island ceremony will be a small affair on 'Amber Beach,' a part of Little Hall's Pond Cay named after Heard. Guests will include Depp's children, Lily-Rose (15) and Jack (12), as well as Mortdecai co-star Paul Bettany. The couple chose this time for their wedding to fit their busy filming schedules—Heard is currently working in London, while Depp is set to begin shooting the next Pirates of the Caribbean in Australia. This is Amber Heard's first marriage. Depp was previously married to Lori Anne Allison (1983-1985) and was in a long-term relationship with Vanessa Paradis, the mother of his two children. Although there were rumors of strains in their relationship last year, friends say Depp and Heard are now in a good place and excited to celebrate with close family and friends.

article_content: Kathy Craven, a 43-year-old mother of three from near Wimborne, Dorset, is battling advanced breast cancer but has been denied access to a promising new treatment due to recent NHS funding changes. After visiting her GP 15 times with symptoms that her cancer had spread to her liver, Kathy only received a diagnosis after a private CT scan. Kathy hoped to receive Selective Internal Radiation Therapy (SIRT), a treatment involving radioactive beads that target cancer cells and could reduce her liver tumours by up to 50 percent. However, SIRT was removed from the Cancer Drugs Fund in April during a funding review. The therapy could actually save the NHS money compared to her ongoing chemotherapy, which has not been effective. Despite two exceptional funding requests, NHS England denied Kathy access to SIRT. Now, she and her partner Brian Russell, along with sons Alfie (13), Finn (8), and Casey (7), are working to raise £45,000 for private treatment—a significant increase over the NHS price of about £14,000. Kathy voiced her anguish at being denied more time with her family, calling the decision deeply unfair. Another patient, Dr. Becky Smith, also fought for access to SIRT but ultimately died despite eventually receiving the treatment. The removal of SIRT may affect up to 500 patients in England this year.

Baada ya kumtembelea daktari wake mara 15 akiwa na dalili kwamba saratani imeenea kwenye ini, Kathy alipatikana na tatizo hilo kupitia uchunguzi wa CT alioufanya hospitalini binafsi. Kathy alitarajia kupata tiba inayoitwa Selective Internal Radiation Therapy (SIRT), ambayo hutumia chembe chembe za mionzi kutibu seli za saratani na inaweza kupunguza uvimbe wa ini hadi asilimia 50. Hata hivyo, SIRT iliondolewa kwenye Mfuko wa Dawa za Saratani mwezi Aprili wakati wa upitiaji wa ufadhili. Tiba hiyo ingeweza kuiokoa NHS pesa ukilinganisha na kemotherapia anayoendelea nayo ambayo haifanyi kazi. Licha ya maombi mawili maalum ya ufadhili, NHS England ilimkataa Kathy kupata SIRT. Sasa, yeye na mwenzi wake Brian Russell na watoto wao Alfie (13), Finn (8), na Casey (7), wanajitahidi kuchangisha pauni 45,000 kwa ajili ya matibabu binafsi—gharama kubwa zaidi kuliko ile ya NHS ya takriban pauni 14,000. Kathy ameonesha uchungu wake kwa kunyimwa muda zaidi na familia yake, akisema uamuzi huo si wa haki hata kidogo. Mgonjwa mwingine, Dkt. Becky Smith, pia alipigania SIRT lakini hatimaye alifariki dunia licha ya kupata tiba hiyo hatimaye. Kuondolewa kwa SIRT kunaweza waathiri hadi wagonjwa 500 nchini Uingereza mwaka huu.

article_content: Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain’s participation in the World Cup is in doubt after he injured his right knee during England’s intense 2-2 friendly with Ecuador. The Arsenal midfielder left the match in the 63rd minute after a challenge with Carlos Gruezo and departed the stadium looking upset. He will have a scan to determine the severity of the injury. Previously sidelined for a groin issue, Oxlade-Chamberlain had only just returned to match fitness. Roy Hodgson, England’s manager, stated it is too early to know whether Oxlade-Chamberlain can stay with the squad, but if not, Michael Carrick or Tom Cleverley may be called in as replacements. Hodgson praised Oxlade-Chamberlain’s strong performance and expressed hope for a quick recovery, calling it 'a huge setback' if he's unable to play. During the same game, Raheem Sterling was sent off for a challenge on Antonio Valencia, who retaliated and was also red-carded. Sterling will now miss England’s upcoming game against Honduras. Jack Wilshere and Luke Shaw were taken off due to cramp but should be ready for the next match. Wayne Rooney and Rickie Lambert were England’s goal scorers. The match was also marred by a data security mistake, as sponsor Vauxhall unintentionally posted a team sheet displaying players’ passport numbers online. The tweet was swiftly removed, but the information had already circulated. Vauxhall apologized to the Football Association for the error.

Kiungo wa Arsenal alilazimika kutoka dakika ya 63 baada ya kugongana na Carlos Gruezo na alionekana akiwa na huzuni. Atapimwa ili kujua jinsi gani jeraha lake ni kubwa. Awali, Oxlade-Chamberlain alipata jeraha la groin na alikuwa amerudi kucheza hivi karibuni. Kocha wa England Roy Hodgson alisema bado ni mapema kusema kama Oxlade-Chamberlain ataendelea na kikosi, lakini akishindwa anaweza kubadilishwa na Michael Carrick au Tom Cleverley. Hodgson alimpongeza Oxlade-Chamberlain kwa mchezo mzuri na kutamani apone haraka, akisema itakuwa 'pigo kubwa' kama hatashiriki. Katika mechi hiyo hiyo, Raheem Sterling alionyeshwa kadi nyekundu kwa kumchezea vibaya Antonio Valencia, ambaye naye alijibu na akatolewa nje pia. Sasa Sterling atakosa mechi ijayo dhidi ya Honduras. Jack Wilshere na Luke Shaw walibadilishwa kutokana na kupata na maumivu ya misuli, lakini wanategemewa kuwa tayari kwa mchezo unaofuata. Wayne Rooney na Rickie Lambert waliifungia England mabao hayo mawili. Mechi hii pia ilikumbwa na tukio la usalama wa taarifa, baada ya mdhamini Vauxhall kuchapisha kwa bahati mbaya kikosi cha England mtandaoni kikiwa na nambari za pasi za wachezaji. Chapisho hilo lilifutwa haraka lakini tayari lilikuwa limesambazwa. Vauxhall waliomba radhi kwa FA kwa kosa hilo.
